tei:div.tei:p: sa pa lhan thabs khog la mkho ba'i thabs kha cig dpa' bo'i bskrol 'dod pa' dras lan ḍakki'i brda las rdol dang po rdor dril dpa' bskyed ni hū: g.yas pa thabs mchog rdo rje yis: 'khor ba'i 'khrul 'khor rgyun bcad nas: bde gshegs thugs kyi rdo rjer bsgral g.yon pa shes rab dril bu yis: ma rig bsal dub 'gro ba rnams dkrog te chos dbyings yum gyi klong: gnyis med thabs shes zung 'jug shog: yo a badzra dharma dhartu a: gnyis pa bsangs chu'i bskyed bzlas la hū bisne ta krita phaṭa: bsang chu mi dmigs chos dbyings rol pa las rdo rje bgegs mthar shes rab rlung 'byin yum: gnyis med bde sbyor rol pa'i brdas bskul nas: khrag 'thung yongs bskul dpa' bo'i stobs su bzhengs: bdud rtsi phra rab rdo rje'i rdul du gyur: bgegs tshogs zil gyis gnon pa'i mthu ldan gyur: hūṃ beesnon ta krita tshinta tshisto phaṭa: nyer spyog brjod la byin gyis brlabs gsum pa mchod rdzas byan mas ni las sngags kyis bsangs su bha wasasbyangs rnam par bkod pa'i phyi nang gsang mchod sprin: dngos zhen dri ma 'bag phyog kun bcom nas rgya che grangs mang ting nge 'dzin gyis 'phrul:

kun bzang nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyams par spel a ma hā pañtsa pātstsha badzra spa ra ṇa sa: de nasasbosabyung ni ba bzang shesnga srizhes spos mchog kun gtib cing ma dag nyesaskyon 'bag rtsog sbyangs byed pa'i rnams dag tshul khrims bzang po'i ngad pa yis thams cad dag sangs shel gyi rang bzhin gyur yin badzra du bo pra ti tsa sa ma ya hūṃ sang sa le sang nge ye swā hā:
'cha zab gsang rdo rjesnyingapolas thugs rje chen po dri med padma dkar po'i kha bskang las kyi rim pa bco lnga pa byin rlabs 'byung gnas zhes bya ba bzhugs so:

sa rngo: namogu ru padma ka ra ye: sheza ba ma1801 mgatu mi ra bde pho ye shes sku byamasadang snying rje'i zer dngar rab rgyas pa'i dri med padma dkar po'i dkyil 'bor la bdag sems rnam par dag pas phyag 'tshal lo chog smon las 'go 'dzoms pa'i skyes bu yas 'phags mchog thugs rje'i dkyil 'khor zhal phyes nas bsnyen sgrub lhur len mdzad pa skyongs pa la cho ga'i kha bskang las rim bco lnga bstan sa ma mā dopang dman gnasarig 'dzin zhabs bcag sar gu ru padma'i byin gyis brlabs pa'i gnas mi yi rgyu 'grul dben pa'i sar phyin te sa blang sa 'dul las kyi rim pa lnga gtong zhing maṇḍal gru bzhi mda' gang ba dri bzang ba byung lnga yis chags chags gdab gru do yar dpag rdul chen rasabris tshom gang 'dzoms byas te sgrub gtor bum pa dang zod chang shel rdo dngos grub rdzas rnams bsags bla rdo srog 'khor mthun pa'i yo byad sgrubs rnam lnga nyer spyod phyi nang mchod pa bkrams rgyal chen bzhemachod phyi ya dam rgya bsdams sgo byang khro bo mchod la nang dam rgya sgo gsum rnal phab nyon mongs gsang mtshams bcad bde pa'i stan gnas blo sems bag phab ste khrusadang gtsang sbra sngon du 'gro ba yis las kyi rim par 'dug pa gnad du brten sa ma shā dang po skyabs yul bskyed pa'i rim pa ni sarang mdun nam mkhar ma chags pad zla'i steng:rgyal kun phrin las

sa ma spyi gzugs ye shes sku 'jig rten dbang phyugs thugs rje chen po dkar: zhal gcig phyag bzhi bzhengs pa'i stabs su bzhugs: dang po gnyis kyi lcags kyu nor bu 'dzin: de 'og chags bral padma bsgrengs phreng 'dren: zhal 'dzum spyan dngas brtse ba'i rnams gyur can: dar dang ratna longs sku'i rgyan chas rdzogs: 'ja' 'od klong du dwangs gsal phur por bskyed: rgyud dang sgrub sde dkyil 'khor spro bsdu 'gyed: dkon mchog rtsa gsum 'dus pa'i gter du mos: mkhyen brtse nus pas bdag la dgongs par dmigs: skyabs 'gro dang no sems bskyed gzhung ltar bya las rim dang po snyi rgya rgya rgya gnyis pa yan lag bcu pa 'di ltar ro skyid yi hūṃ dus gsum btagags bzhugs rgyal ba sras bcas kyis:ye shes gcig bsdus 'gro ba'i mgon po ni: mtshungs bral thugs rje chen po'i lha tsho rnams: thugs rje brtse ba'i gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs gla badzra sa ma ya dza: spyan drangs ba'i yan lag go yo bahā 'pho 'byur med pa bde chen rdo rje'i khri g.yo 'gul bral ba byang chub sems kyi gzhir: mtshung bral thugs rje chen po'i lha tshogs rnams du ma

ro gcig brtan par bzhugs su gsol ma badzra sa ma ya dza: spyan drangs ba' yan lag go snye sa/: padmo kha 'busalta bu'i thal mo nyid gnas gsum la gtug ma lnga sa la phab:lus dpag med par sprul nas gus phyag 'tshal: rab 'byams rgyal ba'i thugs rjes bzung du gsol: tshe na mo na ma ho: phyag 'tshal ba'i yan lag go snyed ā&: 'jin med rnam dag ting nge 'dzin las sprul: phyi nang gsang gsum mchod sprin mtha' yas pa: kun tu bzang po'i rol pa la dmigs te: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams la gus pas 'bul o ratna maṇḍal byu dza ho: mchod pa 'bul ba' yan lag go oṃ āXnyu rin chen maṇḍal gser g.yu'i tshom bus mdzes: rang lus maṇḍal dbang po'i rgyan gyis spras sems nyid maṇḍal rig pa'i sgron mes gtams: 'phags mchog thug rje'i dkyil 'khor dgyes phyir 'bul: cha ratna maṇḍal pū dza ho: mapha 'bul ba'i yan lag go o sa/: sgog gcod ma byen bangs dang mi tshang sgod rdzan tshig phra ma ngag 'a la smas pa dang: batshob sems gnod sems log par lnga ba sogs: mi dge snyig las gang bgyes mthol lo bshags sam

ra pa ya snyi shudhe ā sdeg pa bshags pa'i yan lag go ma ātu: ngo skyes nyan rang byang chub sems dpa' yis: zag dang zag med dge ba rab sgrub nas: bdag dang gzhan gyi phan bde spel ba la snying nas dga' ba chen po'i yi rang ngo: bho dhi citta swā ra ṇa phaṭa: rjes su yi rang bya ba' yan lag go 37 ā( kun 'byung dka' thub dbang bsgyur theg pa ni: bsam mi khyab pa'i gdul bya dang mthun par: gang la gang 'dul chos kyi 'khor lo'i sgra mi nub phyogs bcur kun tu dar bar mdzod:yi/ dharma tsakra e haṃ na ma: sa ma ti sa: chos 'khor bskor ba' yan lag go 37 ba/ zhing khams 'di 'am gzhan na bzhugs pa yi: sangs rgyas byang sems rig pa 'dzin pa'i tshogs: mya ngan 'da' bar bzhed pa de dag kun: mi 'da' rdo rje'i khri la bzhugs gsol 'debs:yin badzra gu ru brnya dharma saṃ bho nir ma kwa ya sa ma ya tiṣṭha lhan: mya ngan ma 'da' bar bzhugs su gsol ba'i yan lag go yin sa/:'das dang ma 'ongs da lta dus gsum du: bsags dang bsags gyur bsags pa'i dge ba rnams: gcig tu bsdus te ma gyur 'gro la bsngo: phyam gcig kun bzang bla ma'i sa

thob shog: dge rtsa bsngo ba'i yan lag go trī: dad mos lcagasakyusabaskul te lha tshogs rnams: byams pa'i zhag pas bdag dang ro gcig 'dres: dga' ba'i sgrogs gis gnyis su med par bstim btang snyom dril bu'i byang chub sems rdzogs gyur: zhes skyabasayul bdag dang dbyer med bsre byin rlabs dngos grub mdzod chen thob par dmigs las rim gnyas pa rmi rgya rgya rgya de nasathugasarjechen po'i nga rgyal gyis dkar gtor bsangs sbyangs byin gyis brlabs pa ni mi( swā bha wa sogs sgroḥlasarin chen yangs pa'i sgod nang du: gtor ma zag med ye shes bdud rtsir gyur snyen yis/: lan gsum a ka ro yisabyin gyi brlabs dza shā:zhesabarjod dmigs bya lcags kyus bkug hūṃ ༷ stongan tsho tsang rgyan padma 'byung gnas kyi spyan sngar khas blang dam bcas mna' bor bas: mnga' ri skor gsum srung ba'i dkar phyogs skyong: dbu gtsang ri bzhir gnas pa'i dam tshig can: mdo khams sgang drug srung ba'i dregs pa can: dkar phyogs skyong ba'i tshogs tshoms thams cad kyis gtsang smar bdud rtsi gser stems 'di bzhes la: tshol 'byer sgab pa'i 'bras bu mchis par mdzod: sayilhamo bachun ma chen mo dang:

ra pa sa bdag lto 'bye sa 'dzin legs pa skyong: sa bdag klu gnyan gtod kyi rigs rnams kun: gtsang sbyar gtor ma gser skyems 'di bzhes la rnal 'byor sgrub pa'i phyi nang nyer 'tshe bzlog gzhan yang stong gsum stong gi 'jig rten la dbang bsgyur dregs pa dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs: gtsang sbyar gtor ma gser skyems 'di bzhes la: rin chen sa 'di bdag la rtsol ba dang gang bcol phrin las ma g.yel myur 'grub mdzod: ces brjod gtor skyems gtsang sar gshegs byas te phrin las gang bcol gegs med 'grub par 'byur sa ma yu las rim gsum pa snyi rgya rgya rgya sde brgyad tshogs la dmar gtor 'bul ba na rang nyid padma 'byung gnas nga rgyal gyis gtor ma bsang sbyangs byin rlabs bya ba ni ces swā bha wa sogs hūṃ las rin chenasnod du gtor ma ni: sha khrag 'dod yon lnga ldan phung por gyur o.ā hūṃ: lan gsum nam mkha' mdzod kyas spel bsgyur byin gyis brlabs dza hū: zhes brjod lcags kyu'i phyag rgya yas dregs pa sde brgyad tshogs rnams bkug byas te hā tri: o rgyan chen po padma 'byung gnas dang: rig 'dzin sngags 'chang dam ldan pho mo yis: bka' dang dam tshig gzhan la bzhag pa

bzhin: dkar po lha dang rngams pa bdud kyi sde: 'chi bdag gshin rje myur mgyogs ma mo'i rigs: srog bdag rgyal lo las mdzad btsan gyi rigs nad gtong klu dang nyes 'gyod gnod sbyin dang drang srong gza' dang 'gong po the'u rang sogs: bka' yi lha srin sde brgyad 'khor bcas kyis: mchod sbyin dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: gnod cing gdugs pa'i bsam pa rab zhi nas rtag tu dge ba'i sdong grogs rgya cher mdzod: yul ri'i rgyal khams sa phyogs 'di dag tu: bdag gis bla med byang chub mchog sgrub cing: sems can rnams kyi don rab brtson pa la: khyed rnams ru nga phrag dog ma mdzad par: zhi zhing byams pa'i gnas mgron dam tshig srungs: dam chos spel ba'i sdong grogs mdzad du gatheg05: bka' dang dam 05 ma 'da' sa ma yā: ces gtor skyems gtsang sar gshegs pa yis phrin las gang bcol gegs med yid bzhin 'grub sa ma mā las rim bzhi pa3/ rgya rgya rgya de nas bgegs la 'bras chan glud bsngo ni rang nyid rtamachog rol pa'i rgyal gyis gtor ma bsang sa sbya sa byin gyi brlabs pa na glus swā bha wa sogs tstshaḥlas ren chen snod du gtor ma ni: 'dod pa'i

sa pasnye yon tan lnga dang ldan par gyur: ma a hūṃ: saṃ bha ralisngags dang a ka ro sbyangs spel bsgyur la byin gyis brlabs par bya bden pa chen po'i bgegs tshogs 'gugs pa ni na 31mchog gsum sku gsum rtsa gsum bden pa dang: bden gnyis bslu ba med pa'i nus stobs kyis: bar chad gdon bgegs log par 'dren pa'i tshogs glud gyi gtor ma len phyir 'dir khug cig: bla sarba bisnan a raX ya dzaḥ dzaX hūṃ baṃ ho: bgegs bskrad gzhung bzhan byas la thun gyis brab hū bzhi brjod cing drag sngags gzir ba bya sa ma yu las rim lnga pathi rgya rgya rgya lha tshogs snyan gsan dbab ste byin 'bebs ni spos bsregs thal sbyar dad mos tshad med pas: rang gi snying ga nas 'od dang 'od zer mu med par 'phros te: lho nus rnga yab kyi gling dbus: zangs mdog dpal gyi ri bo padma 'od kyi pho brang nas: o rgyan gyi slob dpon padma 'byung gnas dang: lha lcam manta ra ba dang: ye shes mtsho rgyal la sogs pa'i thugs byon gyi jo mo rnams dang rgya gar gyi rig 'dzin chen po brgyad dang: grub chen brgyad cu: bod kyi rje 'bangs nyer lnga: sprul pa'i gu ru mtshan brgyad: yang sprul 'gro 'dul gyi gu ༄ drug: smon

lam las 'phro sad pa'i gter chen brgyad dang: gter phran stong rtsa gnyis: gzhan yang bka' gter gyi bla ma rig 'dzin brgyud pa dang bcas pa rnams dang khyad par du rgyud sde bzhi drug gi yi dam rgyal ba rgya mtsho rnams dang ma gnas gsum kyi dpa' bo mkha' 'gro dam can rgya mtsho rnams kyi thugs dam gyi rgyud bskul te: sku phyag rgya sna tshogs gsung yig 'bru phra mo: thugs phyag mtshan bsam yas: yon tan dang phrin las thams cad 'ja' dang 'od phung gi rnams par gnas dang sgrub rdzas dang sgrub pa po rnams la mtsho la kha char bab pa ltar thim nas: gnas dag pa rab 'byams kyi zhing khams: sgrub khang lhun grub rang byung gi gzhal med khang: dam rdzas rnams myong grol ye shes kyi bdud rtsi sgrub pa po rnams dag pa gshis sad kyi dpa' bo dang mkha' 'gro'i rol ba dpa' bo dang mkha' 'gro'i rol pa chen por dag smin rdzogs par bsam mo rol mos dang snyan pa'i dbyangs bcas nas rgyal kun byin rlabs yang yang dbab par bya sa ma mā las rim drug pasnyi rgya rgya rgya de nas dbang bskur rgyas gdab bya ba ni rang dzagasnyeng ga'i 'od zer gyis phyogs bcu'i

ra pa rgyal ba sras bcas rnams: mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs te: kun kyang dgyes pa chen po yis: phyag na bum pa ye shes kyi: bdud rtsis bkang ba'i snod btegs nas: dbang bskur sku gang dri ma dag: chu yi lhag ma yar lud pas: rgyal ba rig lnga'i dbu rgyan gyur: ma ma hā shu bye ta dzñā na badzra swā bha wa atpa ko3nya: ma ma hā a darsha dzñā na badzra swā bha wa atma ko3nya: 67 ma hā sa ma ta dzñā na badzra sā bha wa atpa ko3nya: bla ma hā pra te be kta ṇa dzñā na badzra swa bha wa atma ko3rta: o ma hā kri hye nus ṭa na dzñā na badzra su bha wa atma ko3nya: gnas gsum rdo rje'i 'bru gsum las: sku gsum rgyal ba rgya mtsho bstims: yongs gyur spyi bor zla ba la: rnam snang dkar po 'khor lo 'dzin mgrin par padma la brten pa'i: snang mtha' dmar po padma bsnams: snying gar nyi ma la gnas pa'i mi bskyod sngon po rdo rje 'dzin: kun kyang brtse ba chen po yis 'gyur ba med pa'i rgyas gdab po oṃ dzi na dzig sa ma ya dza dza tiṣṭha badzra oṃ a ro lug sa ma yā dza dza: tiṣṭha badzra: cha badzra swā twa sa ma ya dza: tiṣṭha badzra: slar yang rdo rje gsum gyis sa bon las 'od

'phros pas rab 'byams rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa thams cad spyan drangs gnyis su med par bstim mo: gnad des dbang thob srung ba'i gur du spyod byin rlabs mchog gi pha phog thob pa ra 'gyur sa ma yu las rim bdun pa lha rgya rgya rgya des nas dam jos byin gyis brnyabs pa ni oṃ ma hā shu hye ta sogs dam rdzas sgod dang bcas pa mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid du gyur: stong pa'i ngang las lhun grub rang byung gi gzhal med khang rgya che la khyon yangs pa: gru bzhi sgo bzhi rgyan rta bab bang rim khyud mo dang bcas pa yongs su rdzogs pa'i dbus su trītshigs byung ba'i ril bu 'am dam rdzas rnams 'phags pa 'jig rten dbang phyug sku mdog dkar gsal zhal gcig phyag bzhi zhal 'dzum chags pa'i rnam gyur du ma dang ldan pa dang po gnyis kyi lcags kyu dang nor bu 'dzin zhing: de 'og gnyis kyi padma dang bsgrengs phreng bsnams pa: dar dang ratna longs sku'i rgyan chas bcu gsum gyi mdzes par spras pa: zhabs gnyis bzhengs pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs shing lha tshogs rnams kyi spro bsdu 'khrigs pa: gzhan yang 'phags pa'i sku las sku grangs med pa spros te til gyi go bu phyur ba bzhin du

ra pa bzhugs par bsam: de dag rnam kyi spyi bor sku mi 'gyur ba'i ngo botsan gyi mtshan pa: mgrin par gsung mi 'gags pa'i ngo bowayi mtshan pa: snying gar thugs mi 'gyur ba'i ngo bo/ gi mtshan pa rnams su gsal gdab po dedag las 'od 'phros pas lho phyogs ri bo gru 'dzin gyi zhing khams nas 'phags pa thugs rje chen po 'khor byang chub sems dpe'i tshogs dang bcas pa thams cad kha ba bu yug 'tshubs pa bzhin spyan drangs te sgrub pa'i rdzas dang bskyed pa'i lha la sib sib bstim mo: yin arya ma ki shā ra sarba sa pa ri wā ra badzra sa ma ya dza dza: e a ra li trī trī po phe : a we sha ya a āḥ lan gsum brjod la byin rlabs dbab bsnyim bya dam rdzas chud mi za bar byin rlabs 'phel sa ma mā las rim brgyad pa dzi rgya rgya rgya de nas bsgrengs phreng byin rlabs bya ba ni snyed ma hā shu hye ta sogs che ra re g.yasagayod rigs lnga yab yum dal: rnal 'byer sbyor bas byang chub sems kyi rgyun: sras kyi rnam par 'phos rte bsgengs phreng rnams: dam pa rig brgya'i dkyil 'khor chen por gsal mdo 'dzin kun bzang yab yum rol par mos: de dag rnams las 'od zer

dpag med 'phros rgyal ba sras bcas thugs dam rgyud bskul nas: mkhyen brtse nus gsum dbang byin dngos grub kun: thib kyis byung nas sgrub rdzas phreng ba nyid: ye shes lha skur gsal la sib sib bstim: 31 sarba brnya bho dhi sa twa pradzña gu garma sa ma ya dza dza a bhi ྅sdom stu tiṣṭha badzra: lan gsum dbyangs gsal rten 'brel snying po bsgrangs byas te bdun nam nyer gcig brjod la byin rgyas brlabs khyad par bzlas sngag gong 'phel bsgyur byed na skyid ru tsa ra ma ṇa pra warnya na ye swā hā: brgya rtsa brgyad brjod me tog 'thor te brlabs gsang sngags bzlas pa chud mi za bar 'gyur sa ma yā las ram dgu palha rgya rgya rgya de nas 'dzab kyi ril dmags bya ba ni bum pa gzhal yabasakhang gi nang du bzhugs pa'i ril bu 'am dam rdzas rnams 'phags pa'i lha ru gsal ba rnams las 'od zer 'phros te rgyal ba sras dang bcas pas thugs rgyud bskul te byin rlabs dbang dang dngos grub thams cad bsdus te sib sib thim par bsam: bzlas pa bya de nas nye bsnyen la brten ril dmigs ni 37 ye shes lnga las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang yangs shing rgya che ba'i dbus su dam rdzas rnams 'jig rten dbang phyug gi sku til gyi gong bu phyur ba ltar

sa / gsal ba'i gnas gsum las 'od zer skar ma'i phreng ba ltar 'phros te rab 'byams rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa'i gzi byin dngos grub thams cad bsdus te rgyun mi chad par thim par bsam: bzlas pa bya de nas sgrub pa'i ril dmigs bya ba ni yin snang srid thams cad gzhal yas khang du gsal ba'i dbus su: sgrub rdzas rnams 'phags pa'i sku ru gsal ba rnams las 'od zer 'phros: rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa'i dbang byin dngos grub thams cad ma lus shing lus pa med par rgya mtsho chen po la kha char bab pa ltar bskyed pa'i lha dang sgrub pa'i rdzas la sib sib thim par bsam: dam rdzas 'phags pa'i lha tshogs rnams kyi sku re re las kyang brgya stong khri 'bum dung phyur grangs med par 'phros te kun gyis 'dzab dbyings di ri ri sgrogs par bsam la: sgrub sngags dang oṃ a ra pa tsa mi ta hrī da ye swā hā: btags la 'dzab dbyangs ci 'grub bya ba'o de nas sgrub pa pho po'i bzlas dmigs ni bdag mdun lhar gsal ba rnams kyi sku grangs med pa 'phros te 'dzab dbyangs ti ri ri sgrogs pa dang: bum pa gzhal yas khang gi lha tshogs rnams kyi sku las sku

brgya stong khri 'bum bye ba sa ya dung phyur grangs med pa 'phros te: kun gyi 'dzab dbyangs di ri ri sgrogs pas stong gsum thams cad g.yo zhing bar bsam: sgrub sngags dang o a ra li sa ma ya po : ya ra le sa ma ya phe : ra sa ya na tsatta trī hrī phe phe : ci 'grub brjod la ral bu spel zhing spros de nas las sbyor ral dmigs bya ba ni hūṃ nyu: ril bu thagashes lha yi sku las 'od dang me dpung 'phros pas gzung 'dzin gnyis kyi bsdus pa'i las nyon bag chags thams cad thul gyis bsregs pa dang: phrin las rnams bzhi gegs med yid bzhin du 'grub par bsam la las sngags dang: glus sarba panyu shirnyi ku ru shā: ratna pañtsa puṣṭi ku na sa: padma pañtsa wa shaṃ ku ru sa: karma pañtsa gnod byed mā ra ya phaṭa: ci 'grub gdags shing bzlas pa nan du bya gnad de'i dam dzos gong nas gong 'phel 'gyur sa ma yu las rim bcu pasnyi rgya rgya rgya de nas las bzhi'i sham dang 'dod gsol ni rtsa sngags mthar nad gdon 'jigs brgyad sgrib gnyis bag chags thams cad shirnu ku ru ye su ha: zhi ba'i phrin las rab 'byams thams cad thogs pa med pa tshan gyis grab par gyar cig: tsho bsod dpal 'byor ye shes yon tan

ra pa: thams cad puṣṭi ku ru ye swā hā rgyas pa'i phrin las rab 'byams thams cad thog pa med pa lhun gyis grub par gyur cig: khams gsum srid gsum 'dod dgu'i dpal yon thams cad wa shaṃ ku ru ye swā hā: dbang gi phrin las rab 'byams thams cad thogs pa med pa lhun gyis grub par gyur cig: gnod byed dug lnga dug gsum las byung ba'i log par lta ba thams cad ma ra ya pāṭa swā hā: drag po'i grin las rab 'byams thams cad thogs pa med pa lhun gyi grub par gyur cig: yang na grin las rab 'byams thams cad thogs pa med pa lhun gyis grub par gyur cig: dbyangasagasal yig brgya rten snying gsum gsum gi lhag chad kha bska 'dod gsol gdab pa ni he 'phags mchog thugs rje chen po padma dkar po'i lha tshogs thugs brtse ba chen pos dgongs su gsol bdag gis dka' ba dang du blangs nas yi dam gyi lha mchog bsnyen cing bsgrubs: ngal ba khyad du bsad nas 'gro don 'ba' zhig la brtson: lus sgog 'ben du btsug nas stong nyid snying rje byang chub kyi sems rin po che bsgoms par byas pas: lhag pa'i lha mchog khyed la

thugs mkhyen pa'i ye shes brtse ba'i thugs rje: mdzad pa'i phrin las: skyobs pa'i nus mthu: sgrol ba'i dpa' shugs 'dren pa'i dam bca' zab mo mnga' ba lags pas:bdag cag sgrub pa po'i 'gal rkyen nad gdon sdig sgrib nyes lhung dri ma'i tshogs thams cad zhi ba dang: tshe dang bsod nams dpal dang 'byor ba nyams dang rtogs pa'i yon tan thams cad zla ba yar gyi ngos bzhin gong nas gong du 'phel zhing rgyas te mchog thun mongs gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsol ba dang: khyad par du 'brel thog sems can pho mo 'khor ba dang ngan song gi 'jigs chen po las skyab nas: myur du bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par mdzad du gsol mchod cing bstod pa gsol gdab la sogs bskyal gnad des don gnyis gegs med yid bzhin 'grub sa ma shā las rim bcu gcig pasnyi rgya rgya rgya de nas chos skyong gtor ma byin rlabs ni re yag : /(ngapa'i ngang las rlungame thod pa'i sgyed pu gsum gyi khar ulas ka pa la stong gsum dang mnyam pa'i nang du sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga gtso bor gyur ba'i bza' bca' gta ba ba ldag gzhib 'dod rgu'i dpal

ra re yon phun sum tshogs pa nam mkha' mdzod du gyur: 31 āḥhūḥsarba pañtsa a dṛ ta hūṃ trī 'i: lan gsum 31 ma hā bā ling ta hūṃ hrī 'i: lan gsum 61 ma hā rakta maṇḍal hūṃ hrī 'i lan gsum gtor ma dgra bgegs kyi sha khrag gi rang bzhin la ngo bo zag med ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur: oṃ āhūṃ ha ho hrī: lan gsum rang nyid dpal chen por gsal ba'i thugs ga'i hū las 'od zer 'phros pas: rdo rje chos skyong ba'i srung ma bka' sdod pho nya'i tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la phog: sngon gyi bka' tha tshig dran nas chos kyi sku las gzugs kyi skur bzhengs te kha ba dang bu yug 'tshubs pa bzhin du byon nas mdun du 'khod par gyur: de nas las kya rdo rje'i tshogs zhus ni phod spyo phu thung bsnol la phyag gsum bcas ho: dgongs su gsol lo: spros pa med pa'i dbyings: rang bzhin rnam par dag pa'i klong du bzhugs pa'i thugs rje chen po dri med padma dkar po dang:byang chub sems dpa' nor 'dzin dang: sems ma gsang sngags 'dzin: rang grol 'khor gyi tshul du bzhugs pa'i sems dpa' brgyad: sems ma bzhi sgo smong rta mgrin

rigs bzhi'i tshogs dang bcas pa thams cad dgongs su gsol deng 'dir bla na med pa'i dkyil 'khor chen po 'dir rmad byung ga ṇa tsakra'i 'khor lo rgya chen po bskor lags na: thugs rje chen po'i lha tshogs rnams kyis bzhes pa ci gnang: de nas rdo rje rgyal po' 'di skad do chagam ho gsang chen bla na med pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi sgo 'dir zhugs pa'i rdo rje rgyal theb: karma gdangs chen las kyi rdo rje: rdo rje spyan po: las mdzad king ka ra: dgyes bskyed gzungs ma sogs mched lcam 'dus pa rgya mtsho'i tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad dgongs su gsol deng gi dkyil 'khor gnyan po 'dir zhugs nas phun sum tshogs pa lnga ldan gyi gzhi bzung: bsnyen sgrub yan lag bzhi'i gzhung bsrangs: mi 'gyur ba'i ting 'dzin dang g.yo 'gul bral ba'i lta sgom gyi sgog byas te: zhor la tshogs gnyis yongs su rdzogs pa'i phyir rmad byung ga ṇa tsakra'i 'khor lo bskor na: gtsang sme gnyis 'dzin gyi rtog pa dag pas mnyam nyid ye shes rol pa'i dga' ston gzhung bzhin du drongs dang bzhes par gnang ngo: kun gyis ske maho a la la ho: zhes

ra ma pas mdun bsus gzhung bzhin legs par gto de nas tshogs bsgral bya ba ni tshogs snye da ye las bhanta gru gsum nang tshogs rdzas gnod byed dgra bgegs dngos su gsal: na mo: rtsa rgyud bla ma rgyal ba zhi khro rab 'byams dang: ma gnas gsum gyi dpa' bo mkha' 'gro bka' bsrung dam can rgya mtsho'i bden stobs kyis gzugs can gzugs med dgra bgegs rgyal bsen dam sri 'gab 'dre dus mtha'i 'gong nag thams cad mtshan ma rdzas kyi rten 'di la myur du khug cig: dzaḥ/ baṃ ho: lan gsum de nas lhag gtor byan rlabs ni oṃ a dṛ tas bsangs oṃ swā bha was sbya sa/ a las bhasnyo lcang lo can yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du dam rdzas lhag gtor 'dod rgu'i dpal yon phun sum tshogs pa nam mkha'i mdzod du gyur 31 āḥhūṃ ha ho trī: lan gsum rjes su gzhung bzhan lhag ma gto de nas bskul pa'i bden brjod 'gugs bstams ni yeḥyig nag pe yongs su gyur pa las las kyi gshin rje'i btson khang nag po rgya che la gting zab pa'i nang du: gtor ma dṛ dang tri ༷las byung ba'i dgra bgegs nyam thag pa'i las can du gyur na mo byin rlabs kyi rtsa ba

bka' brgyud bla ma rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang:dngos grub kyi rtsa ba yi dam lha tshogs rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang rten 'brel gyi rtsa ba dpa' bo mkha' 'gro rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang:phrin las kyi rtsa ba chos skyong srung ma rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang:don dam chos nyid ngo bo gdod nas rnam par dag cing kun rdzob rgyu 'bras basmu ba med pa rten 'brel zab mo'i bden pa'i mthus:sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la 'tshe zhing sems can gyi bde skyid bcom par byed pa'i 'byung po gzugs can gyi dgra:gzugs med kyi bgegs tshe len gyi bdud:bar chad kyi rkyen:byad ma rbod gtong lha srung dang bcas pa thams cad mtshan ma rdzas kyi rten 'di la myur du khug cig:dza dza:dzaḥhūṃ baṃ ho:lan gsum bdun dang dgu sogs gang 'os bskyal slar yang bdag mdun rnams kyi sku las thun mtshon sna tshogs kyi char bab pa'i dgra bgegs kyi gzugs phung dum bur gakhung rnam shes tsodakar po dri ma med pa'i rnam par mdun bsted lha yi thugs gar thim pas na la mi shes pa'i dbyings su sangs rgyas:tshe bsod rnams dmo yig ljang gu'i rnam par rang la

ra pasnye bstims te bsod nams dang nus mthu phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan: gzugs phung sha yi ri bo khrag gi rgya mtsho rus pa'i gram khrod bde stong ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen po gcig tu gyur: tshe ya /: lan gsum lha tshogs bskul zhing chad mdo gzhu bzhin gto de nas brtan gtor byin rlabs bya ba ni ren po che'i snye da yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du bshal chu'i gtor ma zag pa med pa myong grol ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen po gcig tu gyur: tshe43hūṃ ha ho hrī: lan gsum rjes su brtan ma gzhung ltar gtong de dag mchod gsol tshogs kyi rim pa'o sa ma yā:las rim bcu gnyis pa lha rgya rgya rgya de nas rjes chog pro mnan bya ba ni gtor gzheX kha sbubs pa dang mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad nub par gyur:na re mdza ga gsum sku gsum rtsa gsum bden gnyis bslu ba med pa'i nus stobs kyis: gnod byed dam sri 'byung po thams cad gzugs kyi rten la khug cig: dza dza: dzaX: baṃ ho lan gsum gnod byed dam sri 'byung po thams cad sa rim pa dgu'i mar zhabs las kyi gshin rje nag po'i lto ba: gza' bdud ra hu la yi gdong zur ri rab chen po bsnol ba'i mar

'og: rgya mtsho chen po 'khyil ba'i gting rum: gru gsum las kyi gshin rje'i btson khang nag po'i nang du tshud de: pho thams cad kha sbubs mo rnams gan rkyal gyi tshul du gnas te 'phar ldang g.yo 'gul med par bsam: gzhung bzhin pro nan rim pa rgyas par bya slar yang gtor gzhong btegs la 'di skad do gtor gzhes bsad nam kyi sgod yar btegs pa'i dbus su phan bde'i longs spyod 'dod yon sna tshogs kyi char chen pos gang bar bsam sarba puṣṭa mkhye sidhi pha la hūṃ: sgrub pa'i rkyen bzlog bde legs gso ba'i thabs dam ldan rnams kyis spyod yul dam pa'o sa ma yu las ram bcu gsum pa lha rgya rgya rgya de nas dngos grub bskul pa'i rim pa ni hūṃ (:bzhengasasdogan bzhedas ༷sten stobs bcu mnga' ba'i lha: 'gro ba yongs kyi skyabs gcig thugs rje'i gter: dri med padma dkar po'i lha tshogs rnams: mkhyen brtse nus pa'i bdag la dgongs su gsol: rtse gcig sgom sgrub lhur len byed pa yi: rnal 'byor dad ldan bdag gi mos ngo ca ye shes gsang ba'i klong las skar bzhengs la: mkhyen brtse nus pa'i dbang dang dngos grab stsol: deng sang jo rje srin po' nam lang nye: dbang byin

ras/: dngos grub rtsol len dus la bab: byin rlabs 'od brgya'i nyi ma rab sbar nas: gdul bya'i blo yi padmo zum phyes la: rtogs grol dus mnyam 'grub pa'i dngos grub stsol rtsa sngags mthar kā ya mirnyi tshe: wākka sirnyi āX tsitta sirnyi (: sarba sirnyi hrī: brgya rtsa brjod la mchod ci bstod pa'i rjes gcar phag thob pa'i dngos grub blangs bar bya sa ma yu las dzam bcu bzhi pasnyi rgya rgya rgya de nas mchod par bya ba'i rim pa ni bdag mdun dang mched pa'i rdzas rnams la dpa' bo dang dpa' mo mdzes sdug lang tshos spras pa grangs med pa'i sku'i mdzes pa'i gar byed cing: phyag g.yas na mchod pa'i sprin dpung bsam gyis mi khyab pa thogs te lha tshogs rnams la phul te dgyes pa bskang bar bsam la: gzhung bzhin mchod pa rgyas pa bya gzhan yang mchod pa'i lha mo rnams kyis sku mdzes pa'i gar byed khrigs khrig: gsung snyan pa'i bstod glu dir dir: thugs lha tshogs kyi yon tan dran pa'i ting 'dzin: dag mnyam rol pa chen pos bstod pa phul bar bsam gzhu dang mthun par bstod pa rgyas par bya slar bdag mdun gyi gnas so sor thim pas mthu stobs nus byin dbang dang dngos

grub 'phel zhing rgyas te yongs su rdzogs pa thob par bsam: bshagabapa bsngo smon bsdu ldang gzhung ltar bya de nas shis bo da snyan gsan dbab pa ni rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros te phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa'i thugs rgyud bskul dbyings las gzugs kyi phyag rgyar bzhengs nas mdun gyi lha lam yongs su gang bar byon te: zhal nas bkra shis pa'i bden tshig gi glu dbyangs di ri ri brjod cing: phyag nas me tog manta ra ba'i char chen po brnyil bar bsam bkra shas rgya pho brjod la me tog 'thor de nas smon lam gdab pa'i rim pa ni na mo: phyogs bcu dus bzhi'i rgyal ba sras dang bcas: ye shes gcig bsdus dri med thugs rje'i gter: bden gnyis bsgru ba med pa'i nus mthu yis: smon lam gang btab 'grub pa'i dbang po mdzod: rgyal bstan nub med dar zhing rab rgyas nas: dam chos snang ba'i lang tsho'i dga' ston la: skye rgu kun kyang legs par spyod pa'i mthus phan bde nyi ma gsar du 'khrung bar shog: dmag 'khrug nad mug mtshon cha'i rgud pa kun ming tsam med par zhi zhing stong gyur te: rdzogs ldan gsar ba'i dge mtshan nyin snang

ra pa la: ma gyur 'gro ba bsam yas spyod par shog chos sgor zhugs pa'i skal ldan pho mo rnams thugs mthun khrims gtsang dam tshig rnam par dag bskyed rdzogs lhur len lta sgom spyod mthar phyin: sku dang ye shes btsan sa zin par shog: gdangs kyi 'gro khams dong nas sprugs pa'i phyir dbyings las ma g.yos ye shes gzugs kyi skus: gang la gang 'dul mdzad pa mthar phyin nas: kun tu bzang po'i rgyal sa zin par regag: de ltar smon pas re 'bras gegs med 'grub nyams dang rtogs pa'i yon tan gong 'phel rgyas phyi nang bar chad bdud kyi phrang las grol zung 'jug po ṭa la ru mngon sangs rgyas the tshom med do rdo rje rgyal po'i bka' bden rdzun lag tu lo dang nges shes gsal sam wā las rim bco lnga palha rgya rgya rgya ye ma rgyal ba'i dbang thopadma saṃ bha was ma 'ongs 'gro la brtse ba chen po yis snyang dang 'dra ba'i yang zab med byung ba grub pa' dbang phyugasabye'u chung khyod la gtad da dung spel ba' dus la ma bab pa'i rin chen brda la thob cig sa ra dzu mdo khams rdo rje' rdzong du dgong pra bsdams ma 'ongs snyigs ma gsum cu kha ral dus nga sprul khye'u chung nus ldan 'dus rtsaladang 'phrad nas bstan pa ran chen 'dzan skyong spel gdul bya 'bum phrag 'og man zhing la

'god 'gro don bsam mi khyab pa'i rten 'brel yod zab gsang thub par srungs shig lha yi bu skal med lag tu mashor a tham rgya las can snying gi bu dang 'phrad par shog sam mā rgya rgya rgya kha bskang la rim bco lnga pa rdzogs so gter rgya gtad rgya sbas rgya zab rgya gsang rgya gu rgya o rgyan gyi slob dpon padma rte wa'i bka' bdag 'dra mkhar chen bza'i bkod pa'o brda zim snyi chos kyi bdag po 'gyur med gyomatshodang chosal mosagus mthu thob sgron ma skyabs chos sgor zhugs pa'i ki rang grolazung chos kyi grogs mo ratna sarasogs chos bdag rnams kyi yang yang bskur ba'i ngor chos gter mdzod 'dzin nusaldan rdo dzeyis/ chosagan gtsang ma padma bad brtseg nas/chos kyi gzugs su bkod nas yi ge pa/ chos brgyad blos btang smon sem zhesabya'ibris/ chos med 'gro khams dong sprugs nusapar shog sarba maṅga lam/

rasto: zab gsang rdo rje'i snying po las: thugs chen padma dri med dkar po'i brgyud 'debs rin po che'i phreng ba bzhugs so:ra pa na 31 ārya 81 ki shwa ra ye:mi1gegorgaste/11khri1tshusgo dus gsum rgyal ba yongs kya spyi gzugs mchog snyigs dus blo gsal bung ba dga' bskyed pa'i rgyal kun spya gzugs padma kā ra la mthon mthing ral ba'i gtsug gi rgyan du mchod ma 'ongasal ldan skal bzang don ched du 'gro ba 'dren mdzad phyag na padma yis gsol 'debs byan rlabs dngos grub 'byung gnas bstan dad mo' gdung ba drag po' nyams su longs e ma ho rgyal ba kun gyi phrin las med byung ba: 'khor ba dong nas sprugs pa'i mthu thob cing: ye shes gcig gyur 'gro ba'i mgon po la: gsol ba 'debs so las ngan duḥkha sol: nyon mongs sdig sgrib zhi bar byin gyis rlobs bag chags dre bral shel ltar gsal ba'i sku ma rig mun sel spyan stong 'gro la gzigs: thugs rje chags pa'i btang snyoms gru char 'bebs gsol ba 'debs so las ngan du kha sol: nyon mongs sdig sgrib zhi bar byin gyis rlobs: 'khrul ba ye bral gangs kyi ri bzhin brjid:

phyag rgya gar gyis 'gro ba 'dams las skyobs bzhengs pa'i stabs kyis 'khor ba'i sgo 'phar gnon:gsol ba 'debs so las ngan duḥkha sol:nyon mongs sdig sgrib zhi bar byin gyis rlobs:shes rab zer brgyas rmongs pa'i blo sgo 'byed ye shes lcags kyus 'gro khams kha lo bsgyur:bde stong char gyis ltog skoms gdungs ba sel gsol ba 'debs so las ngan duḥkha sol:nyon mongs sdig sgrib zhi bar byin gyis rlobs:sprul ba bsam yas dad ldan pho mor 'gyed:thugs rje bsam yas bod la nyi ma brdal:'dren stobs bsam yas 'khor ba kha lo bsgyur:gsol ba 'debs so las ngan duX kha sol:nyon mongs sdig sgrib zhi bar byin gyis rlobs:diltar gas la ba btab pa'i gzi byin gyis:dmus long 'gro ba bdag gzhan thugs rjes gzigs:nyon mongs las 'thas mdud pa rang sar grol:gzung 'dzin kun rtog 'khrul ba rmings nas brgyel 'dod yon sgyu mar zhen 'dzin rang grol te tshe gcig srid pa'i pha mthar rab brgal nas:ri bo po ṭa la ru skye ba dang:phyir mi sdog par 'phags pa'i zhal mthong nas:'gro

ra pa khams dong sprugs nus pa'i dpal thob 31ga:de ltar yid la byas te gsol btab na phyi nang gsang ba'i bar chad galul lasargyal bsam pa'i don 'grub 'phags pa'i lha zhal mthong the tshom med do gu ru padma'i bka' gsang ba'i bde drod zungs shig lha phyag rje skal med lag tu ma btang a tham rgya sa ma yu rgya rgya rgya gu rgya dzi ces pa 'di 'ang chos kyi bdag po padmachos 'phel rgya mtshos thugasabazhed 'grub pa'i phyir dang /chosabadag ra med rgya mchos ran po che'i snod dang bcas te bskul ba dang sbyin bdag padma rnam rgyal gyis dar dang rin chen rdzasa'aga' re dang bcas te yang ya bskul ba dang /grogs mo ratna sar tshig gis bskul ngor bdag 'dra nusaldan rdo rjes mkha' 'gro'i brda ras las zhal bshus te dag par phab pa dge legs 'phel/sarba masgo lam/

sasto: zab gsang rdo rje snying po las thugs rje chen po dri med padma dkar po'i dgos chos: gsol 'debs mthong ba don ldan bzhugs so:na 31 gu na padma kā ra ye:snya24sna 31)/ dad dang mosagus gdung shugs drag po yis mdun mkhar 'phags pa'i lha tshogs gsal gdab ste gsol ba 'debs par bya ba'i rim pa ni thal sbyar snyan pa' dbyangs 4sa'adi skad do na mo ārya lo ki shwa ri ye: grangs med gong nas thugs bskyed rnam dag pa'i: mdzad pa rmad byung gang 'dul 'gro don sgrub: ngan song dong sprugs 'phags mchog thugs rje'i lhar: gsol ba 'debs so thugs rjes lcags kyus zungs: ngan song sgo gcod thar ba'i lam sna drongs: rme ma ṇi padme hūṃ hrī:ma chags dro bral shel ltar 'tsher ba'i sku thugs rjes brtse ba'i 'dzum mdzes lang tsho sgeg: bzhengs pa'i stabs kyis 'khor ba'i sgo 'phar gnon gsol ba 'debs so thugs rjes lcags kyus zungs ngan song sgo gcod thar ba'i lam la drongs: rma ma ṇi padme hūṃ trī: chags bral ku mud shel dkar phreng ba 'dren: 'gro 'dren lcags kyu 'dod 'byung nor bu bsnams: dar dang ratna

bcu gsum rgyan rdzogs la gsol ba 'debs so thugs rje lcags kyus zungs ngan song sgo gcod thar ba'i lam la drongs: sa ma ḍopadme hūṃ hrī gang sku mthong ba'i mod la mun tshogs bcom: grags stong gsung gis 'gro kun smin grol byed gang thugs mkhyen brtse'i 'od zer stong 'bar la gsol ba 'debs so thugs rje lcags kyu'i zungs ngan song sgo gcod thar ba'i lam la drongs: mo ma khopadme hūṃ hrī: bcu phrag bcu dang bcu gnyis lang tsho sgeg: 'gro kun blo yi ma rig mun pa sel: ye shes thugs rje'i dbang phyug mchog de la gsol ba 'debs so thugs rjes lcags kyus zungs ngan song sgo gcod thar ba'i lam la drongs sgo ma khopadme hūṃ trī: yeshes 'od lnga'i gur khang phyogs bcur 'khrigs: mkhyen brtse nus pa'i gzi mdangs yongs la brdal: gangs can bod kyi skyabs gcig thugs rje'i gter: gsol ba 'debs so thugs rjes lcags kyus zungs ngan song sgo gcod thar ba'i lam la drongs: 3 ma khopasgrohūṃ hrī:rnam 'phrul bsam mi khyab pa'i ye shes gar 'dul mdzad phyag las 'khor los bsgyur rgyal stong

sa pa 'dren pa bla med spyan las sangs rgyas stong:gsol ba 'debs so thugs rjes lcags kyus zungs ngan song sgo gcod thar ba'i lam la drongs o ma ṇi padme hūṃ hrī:'gro ba'i dgos 'dodadapal spel nor bu 'dzin:gsang sngags rgyud sde bcud 'dzin bde spel ma:'gro drug dbyings grol sdug bsngal rang grol la:gsol ba 'debs so thugs rjes lcags kyus zungs ngan song sgo gcod thar ba'i lam la drongs: ma ma ṇi padme hūṃ hrī thabs mkhas mdzad pa rmad byung chags thogs bral:gzung 'dzin ma rig dbyings grol dri ma bral:rmad byung thabs mkhas rdo rje snying po dang:'gro ba rnam 'dren don yod zhags pa la:gsol ba 'debs so thugs rjes lcags kyus zungs ngan song sgo gcod thar ba'i lam la drongs yo ma ṇi padme hūṃ hrī: thugs rjes 'gro ba 'dren la dpa' mi zhum:gang 'dul mdzad pa'i mthu thob spob pa mtho gzung 'dzin dbyings su grol ba'i brtul zhugs thob:gsol ba 'debs so thugs rjes lcags kyus zungs:ngan song sgo gcod thar ba'i lam la drongs:ma ma ḍi padme hūṃ hrī:ma gyur 'gro brnam 'dren

thugs rje'i gter thams cad kun mkhyen byang sems mched brgyad dang: ye shes rig sku thugs rjes mtha' yas la: gsol ba 'debs so thugs rje lcags kyus zungs: ngan song sgo gcod thar ba'i lam la drongs: slo ma ṇi padme hūṃ ༷: rgyal kun dgyes bskyed rdo rje sgeg mo dang sna tshogs bde spel ku mud phreng ba 'dzin: dgyes bskyed glu dang rdo rje gar ma la: gsol ba 'debs so thugs rje lcags kyus zungs: ngan song sgo gcod thar ba'i lam la drongs: o ma ṇi padme hūṃ hrī: rtag chad mu bzhi gnas dag ye shes sku:lcags kyu zhags pa lcags sgrogs dril bu 'khrol las mdzad hya skṛ wa rigs bzhi la: gsol ba 'debs so thugs rjes lcags kyus zungs ngan song sgo gcod thar ba'i lam la drongs: o ma ṇi padme hūṃ hrī ngo mtshar mdzad pa rmad byung bsam yas pa'i: khams gsum rigs drug 'khor ba dbyings su 'dren: gang 'dul thabs skyong byang chub sems dpa'i sku: gsol ba 'debs so thugs rjes lcags kyus zungs na song sgo gcod thar ba'i lam la drongs: yo ma ṇi padme hūṃ hrī: de ltar gsol ba btab pa'i byin rlabs

ra pa kyis: bdag dang bdag la 'brel ba'i skye bo kun: rgyu 'bras ngan pa'i dbang du mi gtong bar: 'phags mchog thugs rje'i spyan sngar skye bar shog:gzugs snang dag pa 'phags mchog thugs rje'i sku: grags pa sngags kyi rang bzhin yi ge drug 'gyu 'phro stong nyid snying rje'i rol par blta: thams cad dag mnyam dgongs pa'i gzer gyis bcing: ma ma khaṃ padro hūṃ hrī: 'der 'tshogs skal ldan rnal 'byor pho mo rnams: yang gsang thugs rje'i lam la rab brten te: tshe 'dir po ṭa la ru dbugs dbyung phyir: gsung mchog yig drug brgya rtsa bsgrangs bar zhu:yin ma khaṃ paskye: hrī: rnam rtog gzhan kyi bar ma chod pa ru gdan zog gcig tu brgyad rtsa brjod gyur na 'phags pa'i thug rje'i zin de nyes skyon dag 'brel ba thob tshad don dang ldan par 'gyur sa ma yu me ma rgyal ba/ dbang po padma se bha was ma 'ongs 'gro la brtse ba chen po yis snying dang 'dra ba'i yang zab rmad byung ba grub payidabang phyug khye'u chung khyod la gtad da dung spel ba'i dus la ma bab pas rin chen brda la thob cigasar bye mdo khams rdo rje' rdzong la dgongs pra thob ma 'ongs snyigs ma sum cu kha ral dus nga sprul las canasasaldan rdo rje rnyed bstan dang 'gro la phan bde'i nyi ma

spel 'gro don bsam mi khyab pa'i rten 'brel yod gdul bya 'bum phrag 'og min zhing la bgod de lta bu yi yang zab med byung ba thub par srungs ga bstan srung lha bu yi skal med lag tu ma shor a tham rgya las can snying gi bu dang 'phrad par shog sam shā rgya rgya rgya gsol 'debasamathong ba don ldan rdzogs so gter rgya gtad rgya sbas rgya zab rgya gsang rgya gu rgya yo rgyan gyi slob dpon padma saṃ bha wa'i bka' bdag 'dra mkhar chen bzasabakod pa'o brda thim lha snying zig gtsug tu brten pa'i 'gyur rgyam dang: snying nasadad 'dun che bsgon ma skyabs/ snying po chosagater bdag po pad chosadang / snying gi grog moratna ra sogs/ snying slob du ma'i pang yang bskul ba'i ngor snying gter zab pa skor bdun bcud rigs 'di/ snying nas padma'i bka' bsgrubacusaldan pas/ snying gtams mkha' 'gro'i gsang mdzod legasapar smras/ snying slob dam pa11 sem zhesabya'i bris snying la gdon zhugasa'agro khamasadong sprug shog sarba masgo lam/

ra pa mchod jos byin rlabasani yo badzra a bṛ tagabasangs oṃ swā bha wasasbyangs/ dmigs bsam brjod bral chos sku'i rol pa las: sna tshogs mchod sprin kun tu bzang po'i sprin: dpag yas nam mkha'i khyon dang mnyam pa yis: rab 'byams rgyal ba'i zhing rnams yongs khyab gyur: ma badzra spra ra ṇa sa: gzhan yang mchod sngags spel sngags gang mos brjod nyer mkho'i phyir du nus ldan rdo rje bris/ sarba maṅga lam sa skad cig dran rdzogs gsal 'debs ni a: ka dag gzhi dbyings chos sku'i mkhar: lhun 'grub rig pa'i ye shes gar: ma skyes mi 'gags spyan ras gzigs:bskyed du med de ye yin ngang: bzlas pa bya'o nyer mkho' phyir du nus ldan pas so sarba ma lam/
gas zab gsang rdo rje snying po las thugs rje chen podre med padma dkar po'i byin 'bebs thugs dam gnad nas bskul ba'i lcags kyu zhes bya ba bzhugs so:

sa re na mo gu ru padma ka ra ye: chen rjes lhardzu khrikhubyamasadang ṣi (bee 'od zer gyis 'gro ba'i mi shes mun pa sel 'phags mchog dri med pad dkar la spyi bo'i gas de gus pas 'dud bdag 'dra padma se bha was ma 'ongs las ldan don phyir du sgrub pa'i cha lag dam pa ni byin 'beb thugs dam gnad bskul bstan:sa ma mā rnal 'byor dpon slobs 'khor bcas rnams dung gling rol mo' sgra bcas te da la bskor zhing spos dud spros snyan pa'i dbyang bcasa'adi skad do hūṃ hūṃ /lto phyogs rim gru 'dzin nas:dri med padma dkar po ni:thugs dam gsang ba'i gnas 'dir gshegs:byin rlabs dngos grub char ltar phob:bdechen padma brtsegs pa nas longs sku gsang ba 'dus pa yang:thugs dam gsang ba'i gnas 'dir gshegs:dbang dang dngos grub char ltar phob:yeshes gsang ba'i thugs klong nas:'chi med snang ba mtha' yas yang:thugs dam gsang ba'i gnas 'dir gshegs 'chi med tshe yi byin chen phob:dbang drag rol pa'i dur khrod nas:padma dbang chen rta mchog rgyal:thugs dam gsang ba'i gnas 'dir gshegs gdug pa 'dul ba'i byin chen phob:byams dang snying (bee

ra / pho brang nas 'phags mchog sdug bsngal rang grol yang: thugs dam gsang ba'i gnas 'dir gshegs: 'khor ba dong sprugs byin phob cig bde stong dga' bzhi dag pa'i sang: dbang bsgyur yang gsang bla na med: thugs dam gsang ba'i gnas 'dir gshegs: sgrub la bde stong dga' bzhi stsol: dri med dag pa'i klong yangs nas 'gro 'dul phyag na padma yang: thugs dam gsang ba'i gnas 'dir gshegs: rtags mtshan rmad byung phyin phob cig: 'od gsal dag pa'i pho brang nas: pad phreng rgyal ba rgya mtsho yang thugs dam gsang ba'i gnas 'dir gshegs: byin rlabs rmad byung char ltar phob: klong grol bde stong pho brang nas ngan song dong sprugs gtso 'khor bcas thugs dam gsang ba'i gnas 'dir gshegs nyams rtogs 'bar ba'i byin phob cig dag mnyam chos sku'i gzhal yas nas: gtso 'khor sprul pa bsam mi khyab thugs dam gsang ba'i gnas 'dir gshegs: phan dang bde ba'i byin phob cig: dbyings rig zung 'jug dag pa nas: dpa' bo mkha' 'gro bsam mi khyab thugs dam

gsang ba'i gnas 'dir gshegs: bde stong 'bar ba'i byin phob cig phrin las lhun grub dkyil 'khor nas: drags pa dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs thugs dam gsang ba'i gnas 'dir gshegs bar chad bsal ba'i byin phob cig lha tshogs sprin ltar thibs se thib: byin rlabs na kun thu lu lu dngos grub sbrang char nyi li li gnas 'dir spyan 'dren byin phob cig: sgrub pa po la dbang bzhi bskur: bgegs dang log 'dren bar chad sol mchog dang thun mongs dngos grub stsol oṃ arya lo ki shwa ri sarba sa pa ri wā ra e a ra li trī hrī pho pho a we sha ya a ba ye shesapa'i lha tshogs thams cad kha ba dang bu yug 'tshubs pa bzhin du byon nas bdag gnas sgrub pa'i rdzas yo byad rnams la thim pas dag smin rdzogs par bsam: de ltar dbab pa'i byin rlabasa'abyung nyams dang rtogasapa'i yon tan rgyas don gnyisalhun gyi 'grub par 'gyur ze tshom med do ma mā ye ma rgyasaba'i dbang po padma bha wa'i ma 'ong 'gro la brtse ba chen po yis snying dang 'dra ba'i yang ba med byung ba grub chen khye'u chung lo tsā khyod la gtad da dung ma spel rin chen brda la thob mdo khams rdo rje'i rdzong du dgong pra sdoms ma 'ong

ra pa snyigs ma sum cu kha ral dus nga sprul dpa' bonu ldan rdo rje dang 'phrad nasabastan pa rin chen 'dzin skyong spel lasacan chosabadag rig pa 'dzin par 'doms gdul bya 'bum phrag 'og min zhing la 'god 'gro don bsam mi khyab pa'i rten 'brel yod bka' log lag tu ma shor spu gri gsum gdamasabacud thub par srungasashig lha bu sring skal med lag tu ma shor a tham rgya las can snying gi bu dang 'phrad par shog sa ma shā rgya rgya rgya byin 'a ba thugasadam gnad bskul rdzogs so gter rgya gtad rgya sbasargya zab rgya gsang rgya gu rgya o rgyan gyi slob dpon padma saṃ bha wa'i bka' bdag 'dra mkhar chen gzas bkod pa'o brda thim snyi dbang chen gsang mdzod 'dzin pasgom dang / dbang skal chos bdag mtshan gsol 'gyur med rgyam/ dbang gi smin gyurashirte rang grol zungs/ dbang chen dpa' bo dgye bskyedaratna sags/ dbang bsdu slobasam du mas bskul ba'i ngor dbang skal gter spyodanus ldan rdo rje spel dbang gi yi ge'i ri byedasnyen sems so/ dbang med dmus long 'gro kham dongs sprug shog sarba ma lam/
54 zab gsang rdo rje snying po las: thugs rje chen po dri med padma dkar po'i rig 'dzin brgyud pa'i byin 'bebs rin po che'i tog zhes bya ba bzhugs so:

ra pa na mo gu ru padma ka ra ye: ja11 17sha nas byamasadang snying rje'i dbang phyug mchog gangasacan bod kyi skyabs gcig pu dri med padma dkar po la gus pasags de snying nas 'dud rgyal dbang padma saṃ bha was ma 'ongs 'gro la snying brtse'i phyir sgrub pa'i cha lag zab mo ni rig 'dzin brgyud pa'i byin 'bebasabastan sa ma yu rnal 'byor sgrub pa'i gzhung bsrang tshe byin rlabs gnad 'beb byed dgos na dri bzang sbos dud rgya chen spros snang gsal 'od ldan brgya rtsa sbar rol mo sna tshogasasgra snyir zhing glu dbyangs snyan pa'i tshag dang bcas lu gu rgyud sbrel 'di skad do sa: dpal ldan nub phyogs byarngo rgyan yul: dha na ko sha'i mtsho gling du: ya mtshan mchog gi dngos grub brnyes padma 'byung gnas byin phob cig yo ṭa ya na'i rgyal srid bzung: thams cad chos kyi smin par mdzad: sbyor sgrol thabs mkhas spyod pa bskyongs: padma rgyal po'i byin phob cig dur khrod bsil ba'i tshal dbus su dpa' bo mkha' 'gror chos 'khor bskor: bdud rtsi bam ro'i dngos grub brnyes:nyi ma 'od zer byin phob cig phra men mu stegs rgol sbyor tshe bde chen rol ba'i dur khrod nas zab mo gter gyi dngos grub brnyes seng ge sgra grogs byin phob cig yul

gasto ni za tor chen po ru gson bsregs 'byung khams chu ru bsgyur bka' 'dus chos kyis smin grol mdzad: padma saṃ bha'i byin phob cig brag dmar bya skyib tshal ljongs su pra bha haste la sogs bsten thams cad mkhyen pa'i dngos grub brnyes blo ldan mchog sred byin phob cig a su ra yi brag phug tu shāka thub nye gnas kun dga' bo rab brten sangs rgyas gnyis par grags: shākya seng ge'i byin phob cig: stag tshang bsam 'grub ke'u tshang nas: dregs pa tshar gcod zab gter sbas: bdud 'dul sngags kyi dngos grub brnyes rdo rje gro lod byin phob cig: byin chen ngo mtshar mchog gi gnas yongs rdzogs shel gyi brag phug nas yang dag thugs kyi dngos grub brnyes nam mkha'i snying po'i byin phob cig byin chen ngo mtshar mchog gi gnas bsam yas dbu rtse ru gsum tu che mchog yon tan dngos grub brnyes khri srong lde'u btsan byin phob cig: byin chen ngo mtshar mchog gi gnas seng chen ne'u tshangs phug mo phu 'jam dpal gshin rje'i dngos grub brnyes: dzā na ku ma'i byin phob cig byin chen ngo

mtsharamachog gi gnas: dbang chen gsung gi dkyil 'khor du rta mchog rol pa'i dngos grub brnyes: rgyal ba mchog dbyings byin phob cig: byenachen ngo mtshar mchog gi gnas: grags pa'i mtsho chen da la dra phrin las phur pa'i dngos grub brnyes bdud 'dul chen mo'i byin phob cig: byenachenayang mtshar mchog gi gnas mkhar chu dpal gyi yang dben du rbod gtong ma mo'i dngos grub brnyes: dpal gyi ye shes byin phob cig: byinatshan ngo mtshar mchog gi gnas yer ba bkra shis zla phug nas: bde gshegs 'dus pa'i dngos grub brnyes: khye'u chung lo tsā'i byin phob cig byinachen ngo mtshar mchog gi gnas: lho brag gnam lcags 'bar ba nas: 'jig rten mchod bstod dngos grub brnyes: dpal gyi seng ge'i byin phob cig byinachen ngo mtshar mchog gi gnas: rong gsum sngags kyi sgrub gnas su drag sngags mthu yi dngos grub brtes: bee ro tsa na'i byin phob cig: byin chen ngo mtshar mchog gi gnas: gsang phug tsitā 'bar ba rtsa dpal chen rol pa'i dngos grub brnyes: bdud 'dul rdo rje'i byin phob cig: byen

ra /: chen ngo mtsharamachog gi gnas:yang dben bkra shis dpal brtsegs su brtul zhugs rol pa'i dngos grub brnyes bdud 'dul bshad ba'i byin phob cig byin chen ngo mtsharamachog gi gnas:gar bzhugs dag pa'i gnas mchog zhudagongs pa 1nga rdol dngos grub brtes:bdud 'joms gling pa'i byin phob cig:byin chen ngo mtsharamachog gi gnas:rang snang dag pa'i pho brang nas:'gro ba 'dul ba'i dngos grub brnyes:rtsa ba'i bla ma'i byin phob cig:byin chen ngo mtshar mchog gi gnas:'og min gsang ba'i gnas mchog tu bdud 'joms 'gro 'dul dngos grub brtes:yi dam lha tshogs byin phob cig:byin chen ngo mtshar mchog gi gnas:dbyings gsum dag pa'i pho brang du:bde stong dga' bzhi'i dngos grub brtes:ma mo mkha' 'gro'i byin phob cig:byin chen ngo mtshar mchog gi gnas:dam tshig gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor du bka' gsang gnyan gyi dngos grub brnyes chos skyong srung ma'i byin phob cig:byin chen rnams kyi byin phob cig:dbang chen rnams kyi dbang bskur cig:rtags dang mtshan ma bstan

pa dang sku gsung thugs dang gnyis med mdzod: chag badzra ma hā gu ru sabo sa pa ri wā ra sa ma ya hrī trī phe po : a be sha ya a yis dzosadang yo byad byin gyisabarlabasapar 'gyur rnal 'byor nyams dga' shisapa dang gsal bar dri bzang ngad pa 'thib na pheb rtags so gnad 'di sgrub pa po yi sgog ltar zungs sa ma mā sa ma rgyal ba'i dbang po padma saṃ snya wa'i ma 'ongs 'gro la thugs rje brtse ba yis snying dang 'dra ba'i yang zab med byung ba grub pa'i dbang phyug khye'u chung khyod la gtad da dung spel ba'i dus la ma bab pa'i rdo rje brda la thob cig ra dzu mdo khamasartse shod gsham du dgongs rgya thob ma 'ong snyigs ma sum cu kha ral dus nga sprul dpa' bo nu na rdo rje dang 'phrad nasabastan pa 'dzin skyong spel ba dang las can skal bzang chos bdag rnams la 'doms gdul bya 'bum phrag 'og min zhing la 'god 'gro don bsam mi khyab pa'i rten 'brel yod bka' 'di thub par srung shig lha bu mched bka' log lag tu ma shor spu gri gsum dam ldan thugasakyi srasa'aphrad par shog sa ma shā rgya rgya rgya rig 'dzon byen 'azabasarin po che'i tog zhes bya ba rdzogasaso gter rgya gtad rgya sbasargya zab rgya gsang rgya gu rgya o rgyan gyi slob dpon padma saṃ bha wa'i bka' bdag 'dra mkhar chen gzas bkod pa'o brda thim snyi rnal 'byorapadma chosa'aphel rgya mtsho dang rnal ma'i nyamasalen gnad bsnun 'byur

ra pa rgyam dpal/rnal dbab blo semasalas rlungakairnyisogs/rnal 'byor gsang grogasarasgo bskul ngo du/rnalama'i zab gter nusaldan rdo risasmras/rnal dbab yi ge'i ri byedachen shemasatho/rnaladum dbab 'gro khams dong sprug shog sarba maṅga lam/

gas zab gsang rdo rje snying po las: sgrub pa chen po'i dus su nye bar mkho ba'i byin 'bebs 'od kyi drwa ba bzhugs so:sa na mo gu ru dhe wa ḍakki ye: da bla tsho dam tshig dang ldan pa'i rnal 'byor pa rnams kyis sgrub pa chen po'i gzhugs bsring tshe byin rlabs kyi gnad bskul 'ad gnad shin tu che bas dus drug tu sbyor ro de yang sha chen dang tshil dud spro sbyar spos sogs dri yid du 'ongs ba rnams kyang bdug mos gus gdung ba drag po'i shugs bskyed rdo rje g.yab dar dang mda' dar la sogs thogs nas bro gar bya rol mo sna tshogs kyi sgra dang bcas te dang po bzhengs bar bskul ba ni rtsa ba gsum dang phyog bcu dus bzhi'i rgyal ba sras bcas dpa' bo mkha' 'gro nor lha dam can thams cad thugs ye shes chos sku'i ngang las gzugs kyi phyag rgyar bzhengs nas nam mkha' bar snang thams cad gang bar bsam la: gnyis pa mthu rtsal gnad 'bebs ni hū hū dza: skyes 'gags 'gyur med spros mtha' bral ba nas dgongs rgyad bla ma rnams kyi byin phob cig rang bzhin 'od gsal lhun grub bde chen nas brda rgyad bla ma rnams kyi byin phob cig: rtsol bral bde

ba chen po'i pho brang nas snyan rgyud bla ma rnams kyi byin phob cig gsang chen padma 'od kyi pho brang nas mtshungs bral padma rgyal po'i byin phob cig: thabs mchog bde chen gar gyi rdo rje che yi dam rgyud sde rgya mtsho'i byin phob cig rnam kun mchog ldan btsun mo'i mkha' dbyings nas: 'bum phrag yangs pa'i ḍakki'i byin phob cig: gsang ba snying po dam tshig bcud skyong ba pho nya dam can rgya mtsho'i byin phob cig dgos 'dod longs spyod char chen 'bebs mdzad pa'i: nor lha gter bdag rnams kyi byin phob cig rdo rje'i bro gar glu bro bde legs bskyed king dang dpa' bo dpa' mo'i byin phob cig rlung sems ting nge 'dzin gyi drod tshad nyul ko seng dbang phyug sgo ma'i byin phob cig byen chen rnamabakakyi byin phob nus mthu bskyed: dbang chen rnamabasakyibasadabang bskur nus mthu bskyed sgrub pa'i gnas yul skal ldan sgrub rdzas la zhing dang gzhal yas lha sngags myong grol gyi rol pa chen por dag smin rdzogs byin phob rdo rje'i dam dgongs rtag mtshan ma g.yel zhig: mchog thun dngos grub sbrang char rdol bzhan stsol: rtsa sngagasamathar

sa 2: badzra sa ma ya dza dza rol mo'i la sa rngamasadang 4sa te byin dbab par bya'o gsum pa gnad nasabaskul pa rnams bdag gnas yo byad la bstim bzhugasani hū hū hū:nam mkha' gang bami rgyal sras dang bcas pa thams cad bdag gnas sgrub pa'i rdzas yo byad rnams la thim pas lhag pa'i lha yi sku gsung thugs kyi rol ba chen por dag smin rdzogs par bsam la dza dza sto:cesapa'i byad kyis no la ngar btags pa ltar du byin rlabasanusastobs myur mun khang du mar me btagasapa bzhin nyamasartog yon tan gsar du 'khrung 'byang ba la bang rtsal bsnan pa ltar bzhin du lam rtag thod brgal du ོgas par ra ro gnad 'di sgrub pa po rnamasashin tu gcesapar zungasashig mtsho rgyal ma zhes mon kha nee ring chen po nagaci ru chen po che'i mtsho rgyal dang khye'u chung lo tsā gnyis la rdor snying dbang lung gnang ba'o sam mā rgya rgya rgya zhing padma 'od du a tham rgya drug cu dpyad zig le gcig tu zum ze'u 'byu'i dang ma surya'i ga'ur pheb bum pa kha ti 'brasal mi re yang blo gsal rkang drug tshal du thig tsam 'dzag zhesaḍagi yi ge rgyan phreng can gyisabasgragasaso chos bdag rnamasaganyisadagyesapa'i phyir nusaldan rgad po kha su le'i 'tshol gtam dad ldan smon lo bris/lom na sgrub pa'i gso gyur cig sarba maṅga lam/
54 zab gsang rdo rje snying po lasaḥ thugs rje chen po dri med padma dkar po'i zab sgrub bdud rtsi'i bum bcud bzhugs so:

ra /snye na mo ārya lo ki shā ra ya sgo44)bgasgo gzodan sprosabraladri med ye shesasku rnam kun mam ldan longs spyod gsamadzad dbyings 'gro khrul padma dkar po zugasarje'i gter mi 'bral bde chen 'khor lo'i rgyan du mched ma'ong snyeg ma'i 'gro ba dmu rgod rnams gson rnamasasrin po shi tshad 'dre ru gol nang mkhon 'khrug rtsod ngang la tshe dus 'da' de dusalha gzhan kun gyisami 'dul bas dam bca' mthu btsan lha lnga skyob par 'gyur de phyir chags bral padma dkar po yi zab sgrub bdud rtsi'i bum bcud bstan par bya las dang skal ba can rgyas nyamasasu long sam shā dbangag pa'i dam sa srog 'khor dang sgrub pa'i gtor ma rin chen pad spungs can myong grol sgrub saskye bdun gtso bo la blon bcu 'bangs sde nyi shu rtsa lnga bcas mngar gsum dag gi ril bu sran ma tsam kha tog dkar po gang kyi mdog can bya shel bum lagazhug da la'i dbusasu bkod rnam lnga nyer spyod phyi nang mched pa bkram dben pa'i sa bzung sde brgyad grogasasu bkol bar chad bgegs tshogasabarngan la dbyingasasu bsgrad khrus dang gtsang sbra phyi nang dam rgya sdom bde ba' stan la bag phab gnasapar bya blo semasadangs shing mthun rkyen tshang bar bsags sngon 'gro'i chos kyis rgyud sbyang dad spro bskyed dkon mchog gsum gsal spyan sngar mchod sprin stobs rlung dang ting 'dzin spro bsdu gnad du shes de

ra pasnye nas yang gsang lam la zhugs par mdzod sa ma mā de yang sngon 'gro las rim bcu yis bstan dang po skyabs su 'gro ba'i rim pa ni na mo bde gshegs snyeng po sku gsum ye shes dbyings ma rtog dmus long 'khor bar 'khyams pa rnams rang grol mnyam rdzogs dbyings la bgrod bya'i phyir pad dkar thugs rje'i gter la skyabs su mchi lan gsum gnyis pa byang sa mtshog tu sems bskyed ni he 'gro drug pha ma snying rje'i yul gyur rnams: rang ngo ma mthong 'khrul snang las rjes 'brang bzod med duḥkhas mnar ba'i 'gro ba rnams:rang grol byang chub thob phyir sems bskyed do lan gsum gsum pa tshogs bsags yan lag bdun pa ni na mo ma chags dri bral thugs rje chen po'i lhar: bdag lus rdul snyed grangs sprul gus phyag 'tshal: snang srid 'dod yon kun bzang mchod pa 'bul gzung 'dzin las nyon dri ma mthol lo bshags rnam dkar dge ba'i las la rjes yi rang: gang 'dul theg pa'i sgo 'phar 'byed pa dang bstan 'dzin dam pa mya ngan mi 'da' bzhugs dge tshogs bsdus te ma gyur 'gro la bsngo: phyam gcig kun bzang bla ma'i sa thob

31ga: lan gsum bzhi pa bsags sbyang maṇḍal 'bul ba ni tt+waṃ rin chen maṇḍal 'bru sna'i tshom bu bkod: rang lus rnam dag phung khams rgyan gyis mdzes: sems nyid rang grol rig pa'i bkod pa rnams: yongs rdzogs gsal ba blo yis blang byas te: thugs rje chen po'i dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul: bdag sogs 'gro ba'i tshogs gnyis rdzogs gyur cig:sgoratna maṇḍal badzra pu dza te a hūṃ: lnga pa bgegs tshogs bskrad par bya ba ni hūṃ trīḥ nyon cig bgegs dang log 'dren 'byung po'i tshogs: byang chub sgrub la bar chad byed pa'i bgegs 'dod yon lnga ldan glud gtor 'di khyer la rang rang so so'i gnas su bde bar dengs gal te mi 'gro gnod cing 'tshe ba'i rigs: bdag nyid dbang chen khros pa'i nga rgyal gyis: thal ba rdul brlag lus sems phral bar byed rdo rje'i mtshon gyi 'du 'phro skar ltar 'khrug: khro chung sprul pa'i pho nya char ltar 'bebs: de bas da lta nyid du phyir dengs shig: hūṃ hūṃ u tsa ta ya phaṭa: / bzhi brjod cing thun brab gu gul bdug drug pa bsrung ba'i 'khor lo bsgom pa ni hūṃ trīḥ snang srid sna da bcud dag mnyam rgyal ba'i zhing: ma dag 31ga 'dren

sa bgegs kyi ming yang med: 'on kyang slo bur gdon bgegs mtshams bcad do: gzhom med rdo rje 'bar ba'i bsrung 'dor sgom: yo badzra dzñā na sa ma ya rakta rakta st+waṃ bdun pa brda' sgo dbye phyag dam bca' ni hrī: bde gshegs kun 'dus rang rig byang chub sems ma rtog rang gsal 'char sgo da dbye 'o: sku gsum klong yangs chen por phyag 'tshal lo: lha gcig sgog gi phyir yang mi gtong sgrub: hūṃḥmaṇḍal pra we sha ya phaṭa: na mo na ma ho: badzra tsitta shā: brgyad pa phyon 'bebasasbos bsregs rol mo bcas hū hrīḥ rang snang mi shig bde chen dag pa'i zhing: lho phyogs dri bral dri bo gru 'dzin nas: 'phags mchog thugs rje chen po'i lha tshogs rnams: gnas 'dir byon la byin chen dbab tu gsol:skal ldan bu la dbang bzhi'i ye shes bskur: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub char ltar phob: ma ārya lo ki shā ri sarba sa ma ya dza dza a we sha ya pho pho : dgu pa mchod rdzas byin rlabs bya ba ni tī hrīḥ ma chags dri bral thugs rje'i dkyil 'khor du: phyi nang gsang ba bla med mchod pa'i sprin: dpag yas nam mkha'i khyon rnams yongs bkang ste: gus pa'i

'bul lo dgyes pa chen por bzhes: slo ma hā pañtsa pu tsa ho badzra spa ra ṇa khaṃ rsā pa ༅gsasbyang bya ba'i rim pa ni ho dpang gyur skyabs mchog bla ma dgongs su gsol: bdag ni ma rig 'khrul ba'i dbang gyur te bsnyen sgrub ting 'dzin g.yel zhing dam tshig nyams 'gal 'khrul nongs pa gang mchis bzod par gsol badzra sa ma ya bhi shukhye u yi ge brgya pa bzla pa'i nyamasachagasabyang sbyor ba sngon 'gro'i rim pasnyirgya sa ma mā gu rgya snyi dngosagazhi las rim rnam pa bco lnga bstan dang po ting 'dzin gsum gyi khog phub ni ma tsha rnams tshanadamigasarang byung rdzogs pa che ma skyesaye shes snying po byang chub sems: thabs shes zung 'jug ngo bohrī yig dkar ma 'gags bde chen bskyed pa'i rgyu ru shar: o sa/ dzñā na sa ma ti hūṃ gnyis pa gzhal yas khang bskyed rim pa ni trī chosadabyingasami'agyur nam mkha' mtha' dbus bral bskyod byed rlung nag ba dan g.yo ba'i mtshan sra brtan dbang chen gser gyi sa gzhi yangs ma chags dwangs gsal chu yi dkyil 'khor 'khyil tsha bsregs 'bar ba me yi yongs su brdal rin chen mdzes pa'i ri rab mtshan nyid rdzogs: de dbus

sastocho bhe las rang byung gzhal med khang gru bzhi sgo khyud rta bab bang rim rdzogs 'dod snam pha khu drwa ba drwa phyed 'phyang shar bu mda' yab ri dwags chos 'khor gdugs tshad dang mtshan nyid bkod pa phun sum tshogs phyi rim bsrung ba'i 'khor lo rim lnga'i klong:dri bral yan lag brgyad ldan rdzing bu la gser gyi phye ma g.yu yi ne sang tshal sman gyi spang ri dri bzang ngad pa g.yo: byang chub shing las dril g.yer chos sgra 'ur lha bya 'phur lding ri dwags rtse 'jo sgeg: ma rmos lo thog 'bras bu mang po'i kheb mchod pa'i lha mo du mas gar bsgyur spro 'ja' zer sna tshogs 'phan gdugs rgyal mtshan mdzes ngo mtshar yid 'ong bkod pa lhun gyis grub dzhaḥbadzra dzña na sa ma ya hūṃ gsum pa lha sku bskyed pa'i ram pa ni hrī: lhun grub pho brang mdzes ldan yid 'og dbus ma chags padma dkar po 'dab stong khar: bsil zer ri bong 'dzin pa nya gang ba'i: gdan steng trī yig dkar pos 'phro 'du las bdag snang mi 'gyur 'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs dri med padma dkar po gangs ri'i mdangs: zhal gcig phyag bzhi mdzes 'dzum

yid 'ong sku:thugs rje chags pa'i 'gro la thabs kyis gzigs:phyag g.yas dang pos lcags kyus 'gro ba 'dren:'og ma skyabs sbyin nor bus dgos 'dod stsol g.yon steng padma dkar po chags pa bral 'og ma shel dkar phreng bas 'gro blo bsgyur:sngags kyi tshul 'dzin dbu sgra thor cog la:'gro ba'i re skong ratna'i rtse phran mdzes sgrub mchog rjes 'dzin zar bu g.yon du 'phyings longs sku rigs lnga'i dbu rgyan dar sna'i 'phan rin chen mu tig phra ldan snyan cha dang:mgul phreng do shal se mo do yis brgyan phyag shadas gdu bu ratna'i mig dang ldan dar dkar gser gyi tshom bu'i stod g.yogs la dmar ser 'char ga'i mdangs 'dzin smad shams spras:'ja' lnga'i chun 'phyang dar dpyang ljang sngon 'phur:sna tshogs zi ldir ri dwags bse ru'i lngags:longs sku'i brgyan chas bcu gsum mdzes par spras:bzhengs pa'i stabs kyis srid zhi'i sgo 'phar gnon:ye shes 'ja' 'od lnga ldan gur khang 'khrigs:rig bdag snang mtha' dmar gsal mnyam bzhag bzhugs:g.yas su padma dmar gsal puṣṭa'i khar sras mdza ga rna ra 'jin

sasko: dkar po bzhengs tshul can:dar dang ratna longs sku'i chas rnams rdzogs:phyag g.yas mchog sbyin padma'i yu ba 'dzin:g.yon pas re bskong yid bzhin nor bu bsnams zur zhal tshul gyis gtso la 'dud pa'i nyams:g.yon ngos ātpal mthing gsal bzhad pa'i steng:sras mo gsang sngags 'dzin mdzad sku mdog mthing zhal gcig phyag gnyis bcu gsum rgyan rdzogs shing:g.yas pas dam chos glegs bam gtsug tu bkur:g.yon pa'i skyabs sbyin phyag rgyas padma bsten mnyen lhug 'khril ldem gzhon tshul chags pa'i sku gsal 'tsher lhun sdug gzi brngid 'od zer 'bar:snang stong sgyu ma lta bu'i sku ru bskyed:phyi rim padma 'dab brgyad gyes pa'i khar:shar dusems dpa' chags thog bral ba dkar:lho ru dri ma med pa gser gyi mdog:nub tu rdo rje snying po ra ga'i mdangs byang du don yod zhags pa ljang gsal 'tsher:shar lto spob pa rab mtho beeḍūr mdog:lho nub dpa' mi zhum pa rgya skegs mdangs nub byang 'gro ba rnam 'dren shel ltar dkar byang shar brtul zhugs chen po dmar ser mdzes:kun

kyang bzhengs pa'i stabs kyis 'gro ba 'dul:longs sku'i rgyan rdzogs 'ja' sham dar dpyang 'phur:zhi ba'i tshul dgu'i lang tsho'i 'od zer 'bar:kun kyang g.yas pa skyabs sbyin phyag rgya yis:padma dkar po'i yu bar 'dzin cing bsten:g.yon pas yid bzhin nor bu dbang rgyal bsnams gzi brjed blta ba'i chog mi shes pa'i sku:ngan song sgo brgyad dbyings su 'dren par byed:snang stong 'od sku 'ja' yi rang bzhin gsal:phyi rim padma 'dab bzhi gyes pa'i khar:sgegs mo phreng ba rin chen glu gar ma:mthing ser dmar ljang lha mo'i cha byad can gar gyi bsgyur stabs bro gar lings se ling:rang rtag phyag rgya dkyil 'khor lha la stobs:rgyal ba ma lus dgyes bskyed pho nya mo bcu drug mdangs ldan yid 'ong lha mor bskyed:sgo bzhir dbang chen sde bzhi las mdog can:lcags zhags sgrog dril bhanta dku la brten:dur khrod chas rdzogs gyad kyi 'dor thabs bsgrad:ye shes me yis ma rig 'khrul 'khor bsreg che btsan 'gran bral don gyi sku ru bskyed gzhan yang bar mtshams sangs rgyas byang sems dang lo paṇa rig 'dzin

ra〉snye dpa' bo mkha' 'gro rnams: til gong phyur bzhin snang stong 'od skur bskyed gnas gsum rdo rje'i sa bon yig 'bru las: 'od 'phros rgyal ba sras bcas ma lus pa: phyag rgya yig 'bru phyag mtshan rnam pa dza thibs kyis byung ste bdag mdun sgrub rdzas la dbyer med gcig 'dres dbang byin rdzogs par bsam: bzhi pa spyan 'dren bya ba'i rim pa ni hū hrī rang snang mi shig bde chen dag pa'i zhing: lho phyogs po ṭa la yi gnas mchog nas: 'phags mchog dri bral pad dkar gtso 'khor bcas: thugs dam dbyings las spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: 31 ārya ma ki shwa ri sarba sa pā ri wā ra badzra sa ma ya dza dza: lnga pa bzhugs su gsol ba ni hrī gdan gsum tshang ba rdo rje phung po'i lhar: dbyings nas spyan drangs ye shes dkyil 'khor bsre: dam ye ro gcig bde ba chen po'i ngang: 'du 'bral med par rdo rje'i ngang du bzhugs:ma badzra sa ma ya tiṣṭha lhan: drug pa lha phyag 'tshal ba'i ram pa ni na mo ma chags dri bral ye sangs rgyas pa'i sku: thugs rje brtse ba'i sgub mchog rnams la dgongs: dad ldan gdul bya'i lo tog smin mdzad pa'i: thugs rje chen

po'i lha la phyag 'tshal lo: 3sna dzñā na shrī na mo na ma ho bdun pa phyi yi mchod pa 'bul ba ni hūṃ trīḥ thugs rdochen po ye shes gsang ba'i lhar: dgyes bskyed phyi yi mchod pa 'bul ba ni mdzes pa'i ku mud utpal dbu la 'bul dri zhim ngad ldan bdug pa shangs la stobs: gsal byed dbang gi sgon me spyan la bskangs bde chen dri mchog bsil ldan sku la 'bul ro ldan zhal zas sna tshogs ljags la bstabs: rol mo sgra dbyangs tshogs kyis snyan la bskangs: dgyes bzhes sgrub pa po la dngos grub stsol: tshogs rdzogs don gnyis lhun gyis grub gyur cig: sa badzra pu tsa sarba sa ma ya /: brgyad pa nang gi mchod pa 'bul ba ni trī yeshesathugasamachog dri med padma dkar: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs dgyes pa bskang ba'i rdzas gzugs snang dag pa'i ngo mtshar a dargo: sgra zhen rang grol grags stong haṃ bu ra: dri 'dzin dbyings rol tshor stong ngad ldan dri: ro zhen rtog grol myang stong nus pa lngan reg stog rngam dag bde mchog pa3 li: 'khyal bral ye shes rjo rje mkha' dbyings e: rgyal kun dgyes pa bsred phyir bdag 'bul na thugs rje brtse ba chen pos

sasko: rab bzhes la: dbang dang dngos grub mchog gi gru char stsol: mo dzñā na sarba panyu 8 tsa ho: dgu pa gsang ba'i mchod pa 'bul ba ni trī ma chags dri bral thugs rje chen po yi: sku gsung thugs yon dgyes pa bskang ba'i byir: rdo rje'i rigs ma bcu drug lang tsho sgeg: mdzes pa'i mchod sprin bsam yas stobs par byed: bde chen dga' bzhi rgyun gyis 'phrul rtsed bsgyur: gnyis med ye shes gsang ba'i mchod sprin rnams: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs dgyes pa bskyed phyir 'bul: thugs rje brtse ba'i rab dgongs mnyes par bzhes: sgrub mchog bdag la dbang dang dngos grub stsol: zlo dzñā na badzra pañtsa pu tsa khā hi: bcu pa sman mchod 'bul bar bya ba ni hū hrīḥ rtsa brgyad stong sbyar bdud rtsi a dṛ ta rigs lnga yab yum rdzas su byin rlabs pa'i: rmad byung ngo mtshar byang chub sems kyi sprin dkyil 'dza ra lha tshogs dgyes pa bskang phyir 'bul: thugs rje brtse ba'i rab bzhes mchog thun gyi: dngos grub ma lus sgrub mchog bdag la stsol: rmim hā pañtsa a pra ta la kha ram khā hi: rsā gcig rakta dmar gyi mchod pa ni hā rji rten 'grel bcu gnyis dbyingasasu

bsgral ba'i khrag gu hye mu la rakta ghirti'i bcud: nyon mongs chags pa dbyings su stongs byed pa'i: dam rdzas rmad byung rakta'i bcud chen po dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams la gus pa'i 'bul: khams gsum 'khor ba dbyings su stongs gyur cig: tsa(mahārakta la kha ram khā hi: babyu gnyisagator ma' mchod pa 'bul ba ni hūṃ trīḥ gtor gzheng ratna 'bar ba'i snod yangs par: dam rdzas brjed ldan ro brgya nus pa stong: yon tan phun tshogs dpal gyi mchod sdong ni: snod bcud 'dod yon rgyan gyis rab spras te: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams la gus pas 'bul bdag la tshe dbang mchog gi dngos grub stsol: ma mahā bā lirnya la kha ram khā hi bcu gsum sbyor dang sgrol ba' mchod pa ni hūṃ sdi thabs dang shes rabaganyis su med par sbyor: bde chen dga' bzhi'i rgyun bzang byang chub sems blo ngan 'khor ba'i zhe sdang rab bsgral nas: dug gsum mchod pa bla med rtsi sbyar ba'i sbyor smol mchog gi mchod pa chen po 'di: dkyil 'khor lnga tshogs rnams la gus pas 'bul: stan grun brtel zhugs sngags kyi dngos grab stsol: sa(mahwa sto dri tsitra sta na gru ṇa pu

ra pa: tsa khā hi rsā bzhi bstod pa glu gar bya ba ni hū hrīḥm chags dri bral longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku:ye shes thugs rje'i 'gro ba thabs kyis skyongs:res med dmus long yongs kyi skyabs gcig pu:thugs rje chen po'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod:'khor ba dbyings sgol brtse ba'i mthu mnga' zhing:rgyal kun thugs kyi sras mchog 'gro ba'i mgon:phan dang bde ba'i dpal ster bum pa bzang:dpal ldan nor bu 'dzin la phyag 'tshal bstod:gsang sngags 'bum phrag rgyud kyi gnyer 'dzin cing:rgyal ba kun yum bde chen dga' bzhi'i gzhi:skal ldan sgrub pa po yi skyabs gcig ma:gsang sngags 'dzin mdzad mchog la phyag 'tshal bstod:ma chags padma rā ga'i mdangs 'dzin cing sor rtog thabs kyis gang la gang 'dul gyi:rnam 'phrul bsam mi khyab pa'i gar bsgyur ba:rigs bdag snang mtha' yas la phyag 'tshal bstod 37gas brgyad rnam dag ye shes gsang ba'i sku:yul brgyad rang grol thugs rje chags pa bral:rmad byung thabs kyi 'gro khams kha lo bskyar:byang chub sems dpa' brgyad la phyag 'tshal bstod phyi nang bcu drug

gar gyi rnam rol las rgyal ba'i dgyes bskang sgrub la bde stong bskyed ye shes dbyings las ma g.yos gdul bya'i mgon: dga' bzhi'i 'byung gnas yum la phyag 'tshal ltod tshad med rnam bzhis gang 'dul 'gro don mdzad phrin las rnam bzhi gegs med yid bzhin sgrub: mu bzhi gnas dag thabs kyis sgo skyongs mdzad rta mgrin rigs bzhi'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod gzhan yang thugs las sprul pa'i sangs rgyas stong: bcu gcig zhal gyis 'khor ba'i gnas bcu stong: phyag spyan stong gis 'gro khams dong nas sprugs bka' drin mnyam med rje la phyag 'tshal bstod: gdul byalidapal du 'gro 'dul padma 'byung: 'jigs pa brgyad skyob rje btsun tā re ma gdug pa drung 'byin badzra ki la ya: rnam 'phrul bsam mi khyab la phyag 'tshal bstod: brtseb chen pos 'khor ba kha lo bsgyur: btang snyoms chen pos nye ring chags sdang bral: ye shes chen pos 'brel tshad thar lam 'god bka' drin chen po de la phyag 'tshal bstod: dus 'dinas bzung gdod ma chos sku'i bar: 'du 'bral med par bdag ni rjes bzung ste: nyams

sasko— rtogs yon tan tshe dpal lang tsho bskyed phyi nang bar chad bdud kyi 'phrang las sgrol zung 'jug po ṭa la ru phyin par shog: bco lnga ༅gsasbyang bya ba'i rim pa ni hoskyabs kun yongs 'dus 'gro mgon thugs rje'i gter: spyan ras gzigs dbang brtse ba chen po'i dgongs: bdag ni ma rig 'khrul ba'i dbang gyur te: gzhung bzhin ma ldan rtsa ba yan lag gi: dam tshig chags nyams 'gal 'khrul nongs pa kun mi 'chab mi zed gnong 'gyod drag pos bshags klong yangs chen po'i ngang du bzod par gsol: tshangs pa mchog gi dngos shā1ba sa pa du gsol: yi ge brgya pas bshagasasbyang bya ba'o dngos gzha lha bskyed rim pazhwa/rgya sam mā brda tham rjes byung las rim rnam pa lnga yi bstan dang po 'dzab bskul bya ba 'di ltar ro hū hrīḥ ye shes gsang ba thugs rje'i dkyil 'khor nas: rgyal kun dbang phyug dri med padma dkar: thugs dam gnad bskul gzugs kyi skur bzhengs la: sgrub pa'i bu la mkhyen brtse nus pa'i dgongs byin rlabs ya mtshan mchog gi dngos grub stsol: 'a ba pa'i rtags mtshan bzang po gzhung bzhin tu: ring por mi thog da lta nyid du

ston thugs mchog gsang ba'i nyi ma klong nas sbor thugs dam ma g.yel badzra sa ma yā: ces bskul rol mo'i sgra yis snyan gsan dbab gnyas pa 'dzab bzlas bya ba'i rim pa ni hūṃ trīḥ rang nyid thugs rje chen po'i thugs ka ru pad zla'i gdan la ye shes sems dpa' ni rta mgrin dmar gsal tshon gang gyad stabs bsgrad he ru ka pa'i thugs klong zla ba'i steng:gser gyi rdo rje nas 'byu tsam pa yi lte bar nyi zla kha sbyor ga'u ru trī yig dkar gsal spus bris tsam nyid la rtsa sngags 'bru drug pad 'dab gdan la 'khor bzlas pas 'od zer 'phro 'dus 'gro drug gi rgyud sbyangs las nyon dri ma dbyings su sangs: ye shes thugs rje'i sku mchog 'grub par bsam o ma khopadme hūṃ trī: rtsa sngags khru khrum dag par bsgrangs ba yis dbang dang byin rlabs dngosagrub char ltar 'bebs nyams rtogs yon tan sngar med hur bo 'khrungs rtagasamatshan dngos nyams smi lam kun tu 'byung bden rdzun lag tu longs dang nges shesagasal sa ma shā gsum pa sgrub pa'i 'dzab dmigs bya ba ni hūṃ trīḥ bdag mdun lha chogs thugs ga'i sngags phreng ni: lu gu rgyud 'brel bar ma chad par 'khor: 'phro 'dus zer gyis 'khor 'das

gasto: dwangs bcud bsdus srog gi 'khor lor bar ma chad par thim dbang byin dngos grub ma lus klong nas rdol nyams rtogs yon tan tshe dpal 'byor rgyas bsam snang grags rigs gsum lha sngags chos kyi sku dag pa rab 'byams dgongs pa'i gzer rgyas 'debs: yengs med 'od gsal 'gags med chen po'i ngang 37ma ṇi padme hūṃ hrī: 'bru 'bum bzlas pas nyams rtogs yon tan 'bar tshe dpal 'byor ba yar ngos zla ltar 'phel snang srid dag mnyam rgyal ba'i zhing du mthong 'grub rtags dngos nyams rmi lam kun tu 'byung the tshom med do padma rgyal po'i bka' sa ma pā bzhi pa las sbyor sngags kyi 'dzab dmigasani hū hrī rang nyid lha yi thugs ga'i sngags 'khor lo: drag tu bskor bas 'od zer dpag med 'phros: snang srid lha klu dregs can mi ma yin: rgyal bsen 'gong 'dre the'u rang ma lus par 'od phog rngams pa'i blo bral byang chub sems yang dag snying pos rgyud brlan dbang du bsdus: ci bcol bka' nyan bstan pa bsrung ba dang bar chad bdud 'dul sgrub pa'i grogs su bkol las bzhi lhun gyis grub pa'i dpal thob bsam: o ma je pabye hūṃhrī de ltar

bzla pa 'phro 'du'i ting 'dzin gyi gnad bcun 'byu 'bum bzlas pas bar chad bzlog stong nyid snying rje'i yon tan gsar du 'khrung 'brel tshad ri bo gru 'dzin zhing la 'god 'grub rtags dngos nyams rmi lam kun tu 'byung sa ma mā lnga pa bsnyen pa kha gso lhag chad bskangs mchod cing bstod la 'dod don gsol ba ni trī skunashos thugs rje phyogs ris mtshan ma bral: 'gro ba yongs kyi skyabs ga ga spyan ras gzigs mkhyen brtse nus pa'i sgrub mchog bdag la dgongs: dbang byin dngos grub thugs gyi klong nas rtsol: shes rab gsal ba'i sgron me rab sbar nas: chags thog rmongs pa'i blo tshogs drungs 'byin mdzod: ye shes gsang ba'i nyi ma rab 'bar bas: gzung 'dzin srid pa'i rtsa ba drungs 'byin mdzod: rlung sems ting nge 'dzin la dbang thob nas skye 'gro gang la gang 'dul dpal thob mdzod chags sdang nyon mongs g.yul ngo rab bsgral nas: dag mnyam kun bzang dgongs pa rtogs par mdzod: ye shes sgo brgya rig pa'i sgron mes 'byed: zab mo gter gyis 'gro khams dong sprugs mdzod: bder gshegs dgongs pa gcer byung mngon mthong ba'i: ka dag dang po'i gzhi thog grol bar shog: bzang

ra /snye ngan las kyis 'brel ba'i skye bo kun: ye shes lcags kyus rab zin grol bar shog: sdang zhen gnyis snang 'khor ba'i sems can rnams dbang med srid pa'i pha mthar bsgal bar mdzod: bdag ni mthong thos dran reg 'gro ba yi: rgyud la byams dang snying rje 'khrung bar mdzod: las nyon du khas mnar ba'i skye 'gro kun: phyam gcig bdag gi gdul byar 'gyur bar mdzod 'bum phrag yangs pa'i tshom bu dang bcas nas: ri bo po ṭa la ru grol bar 31ga: ces sogs bsngo ba smon lam mtha' rgyas bya rjes byung bzlos brjod rim pa3/rgya sa ma yu rgya rgya rgya ye ma rgyal ba'i dbang po padma saṃ bha was ma 'ongs 'gro la brtse ba chen po yas rgud pa bsal phyir rin chen zab gter sbas bstan pa 'dzin pa 'i skyes bu dang bcas pa dus dang dus su 'byung 'gyur lung bstan dang smon lam gtad rgya dang bcasayongs su bzhag khyad par zab gsang rdo rje snying po' sde bcu gsum chos skor rmad byung ngo mtshar gnas las lngan bu lnga khye'u chung khyod la gtad da lta ma spel rin chen bdo la thob mdo khams rtse shod gsham du dgongs rgya sdom ma 'ongs snyigasam sum bcu kha ral dus nga sprul dpa 'a bo nus ldan rdo rje 'byu skyes bu de dang gdams pa 'di 'phrad nas bstan dang 'gro la phan bde spel gyur cig cog

ro'i sku dang rtse mang gsung gi zer dharma sam gas thugasakyi 'khor lo gar skyes mtshogapadma chosa'aphel zhes bya ba chos kyi bdag por 'byung gnasabastan pa 'dzin 'brel tshad rgyud la stong nyid snying rje 'deb 'gro don myo dang byang nas kun sum tshogs chos bdag dra bral skyes bu nyer lnga 'byung bstan pa' zhabs tog sgrub la phan bde spel bslu ba med do rdo rje rgyal po' bka' bden rdzun lag tu longs dang nges shes gsal skal med lag tu ma shor bstan srung tshogs las can snying gi bu dang 'phrad par shog sa ma yā rgya rgya rgya zab sgrub bdud rtsi'i bum bcud rdzogs so gter rgya gtad rgya sbas rgya zab rgya gsang rgya o rgyan gyi slob dpon padma saṃ bha wa'i bka' bdag 'dra mkhar chen bzas bkod pa'o gu rgya bdo thim lha ces 'di 'ang chos kyi bdag popadma chosa'aphel rgya mtshos ya yang bskul ba dang chos bdaga'agyur med rgya mchosarin po che'i snod 'byu yasadagangs ba dang / slob bu dad ldan padma rnam rgyal gyisarin chen gnyis pa'i rdo rje rtse lnga ldem sgo'i mdzes pa bkra shis lha regs dkar po dbang lnga' mad sa 'dzin gyis cod paṇa bri gzhi shog dkar dang bcas te bskul ba dang / nye gnasayeshesadang grog mo ratna sar gnyis kyis yang yang bskul ba'i ngor bdag 'dra dpa' bo nus ldan rdo rje'am dri med klong yangs rdo rje zhes bya bas mkha' 'gro'i brda ras zab mo las zhal bshus te dag par phab pa dge legs 'phel/ sarba masgo lam/

ras/: lha mchag thugasarje'i mab don khā nyi 67 āhwa ches sku snang ba mtha' yas zhal du sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta la khā re khā hi: longs sku nam mkha' rgyal po'i zhal du sarba pañtsa a dṛ ta la khā ram̐ khā hi: sprul sku mtsho skyes rdo rje'i zhal du sarba pañtsa a bṛ ta la khā ram̐ khā hi las can rje 'bangs grogs lnga'i zhal du sarba pañtsa a dṛ ta la khā re khā hi:grub dbang khye'u chung lo tsā'i zhal du sarba pañtsa a bṛ ta la khā ram̐ khā hi: brgyud ldan bla ma rnam kyi zhal du sarba pañtsa a dṛ ta la khā ram̐ khā hi: drin chen rtsa ba'i bla ma'i zhal du sarba pañtsa a dṛ ta la khā ram̐ khā hi: yi dam thugs rje chen po'i zhal du sarba pañtsa a dṛ ta la khā ram̐ khā hi: dgyes bskyed gsang ba ye shes zhal du sarba pañtsa a dṛ ta la khā ram̐ khā hi: sras mchog nor bu 'dzin pa'i zhal du sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta la khā ram̐ khā hi: sras mo gsang sngags 'dzin ma'i zhal du sarba pañtsa a pra ta la khā ram̐ khā hi: byabhe chub sems dpa' brgyad kyi zhal du sarba pañtsa a dṛ ta la khā ram̐ khā hi: las mdzad sems ma bzhi yi zhal du sarba pañtsa a dṛ ta la /rwa ram̐ khā hi: sgo skyong rta mgrin rigs bzhi'i zhal du sarba pañtsa a bṛ ta la khā ram̐ khā hi: bstan

srung lha bu ming sring zhal du sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta la khā ram̐ khā hi gzhan yang bka' brgyud bla ma'i zhal du sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta la khā ram̐ khā hi: yi dam rgyud sde rgya mtsho'i zhal du sarba pañtsa a dṛ ta la khā ram̐ khā hi 'bum phrag yangs pa'i mkha' 'gro'i zhal du sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta la khā ram̐ khā hi: las mdzad dpa' bo dpa' mo'i zhal du sarba pañtsa a dṛ ta la khā ram̐ khā hi:bka' srung gter bdag rnams kyi zhal du sarba pañtsa a dṛ ta la khā ram̐ kha hi: bdag la mchog thun dngos grub ma lus pa stsol cig sarba sirnyi pha la oṃ ushā: lha tshogs dgyes bskyed mtshan don khya hi ni lha mchog bka' gsang zim yig med pa'i skor lha gcag sku skyes padma dgyes pa'i phyir lha sngags phyag rgya'i rnal 'byoranusaldan pas/ lha chos yi ge'i ras su bris pa'i dge'i/ lha mi la sogs 'gro khams dong sprug shog sarba masko lam/
ras zab gsang rdo rje snying po las: thugs rje chen po dri med padma dkar po'i bum pa rnam gnyis sgrub pa'i cho ga dngos grub bcud 'dus zab mo bzhugs so:

ra /spyo na mo ārya lo kai shwa ra ye 612 431 1 rgyal kun thugasardo'i 'od zer bye ba'i bcud skal bzang 'gro la phan bde'i dpal du shar snyigs ma'i rgud sel 'pha gas mchog spyan ras gzigs mthon mthing ral ba' rgyan du mchod par bgyi ma 'ongasol can skal bzang pho mo rnams smin byed dbang dang gshin po rjes 'dzin sogs gang la nyer mkho'i bum pa sgrub pa'i thabs zag med bdud rtsi'i dpal ster bstan par bgyi sa ma mā rin chen shel lam dngul gyi bum pa ni mtshan nyad bkod pa phun sum tshogs par bsgrub chag gas bug ral bral ba'i snod bzang nyad shar gya rgyun 'bab dri bzang chu yis dgangs shes rab ḍakki mda' ma phog pa'i btsal bzang drug snying po lnga yi bcud kyis gtams ku sha'i chen po brtsegs pa 'i khri ru 'khod byug bdug brab gsum mgul ching kha rgyan mdzes me tog drwa ba' gur khang nang du btsud rnam lnga nyer spyod phya nang mchod pas bskor sman gtor rakta nyer mkho'i yo byad bsags de nas bdag bskyed bzlas pa bzhung bsrangs rjes rnam rgyal bum pa sgom sgrub bya ba ni yin swā bha was stong par sbyang tshogadachags cheras dbyengathangastong pa'i rang bshin las lhun grub bkod pa phun sum tshogs pa yi gzhal med khang dbus padma zla ba'i steng:〉༄yig dkar pos 'phro 'dus yongs gyur pa'i:'gro 'dul 'phags

ra re mchog spyan ras gzigs dbang dkar: gangs la nyi shar ji bzhin gzi mdangs 'bar: zhal gcig phyag bzhi bzhengs pa'i thabs kyis bzhugs: phyag g.yas gnyis kyis lcags kyu nor bu bsnams: g.yon gnyis padma 'dab brgyad shel phreng 'dren longs sku'i rgyan cha bcu gsum mdzes par spras: 'dzum sgeg zhi tshul dgu yi lang tsho'i 'byud: 'ja' 'od lnga ldan phyogs bcur 'od zer spro: g.yas g.yon nor 'jen gsang 'dzin dkar sngo dmar: mtha' 'khor byang chub sems dpa' mched brgyad dang: sgo skyong rigs bzhi las mdzad pho nya 'khrigs: gnas gsum rdo rje'i sa bon yig 'bru las: 'od zer dkar dmar mthing gsum dpag med 'phros: rab 'byams rgyal ba sras bcas ma lus pa: thibs kyi byung nas mdun mkhar sa ma dza: de nas spyan 'dren bzhugs gsol phyag 'tshal ni hū hrīḥ rang snang rnam dag bde chen pho brang nas rgyal ba sras bcas ma lus spran 'dren gshegs: dam ye ro gcig brtan par bzhugs su gsol: sgo gsum mos gus dad brgyas phyag 'tshal lo: 31 ārya 'o ki shwa ri badzra sa ma yu dza dza:
