dzñā na tiṣṭha lhan: na mo shrī na ma ho: de nas mchod pa 'bul bar bya ba ni hūṃ hrīḥ yeshes ting nge 'dzin las bskyed pa yi: phyi nang gsang gsum rnam dag mchod pa'i sprin: mig 'phrul lta bu'i gter du rab dmigs nas thugs rje chen po'i dkyil 'khor dgyes phyir 'bul: blang ma hā pañtsa pu tsa ho: de nas bstod pa bya ba'i las ram ni hūṃ hrīX gribral padma rgyas pa'i rnam rol can: ye shes lcags kyus 'gro ba thabs kyis 'dul: btang snyoms gru la nye ring chags sdang bral thugs rje chen po'i sku gsung thugs la bstod: de na bzlas dmigasa'adzab kyi rim pa ni bdag gi thugs ka nas 'od zer kha tog lnga ldan mchod pa'i tshul du spros: mdun bskyed bum lha'i thugs gar phog: thugs dam gyi rgyud bskul: thugs rje'i byin rlabs dbang dang dngos grub thams cad 'od dang 'od zer gyi rnam par ba spu'i bu ga thams cad nas bab: bdud rtsi byang chub sems kyis bum pa'i nang thams cad gang bar bsam rtsa sngags stong dang khri sogs ci rigs bzla gshin po' ched du bzlasadamigs 'di ltar ro bdag chagathugs ka nas 'od zer mu med pa 'phros: bum lnga'i thugs dam gyi rgyad bskal: 'od

sa / zer phyogs bcur 'phros: dus gsum gyi bde bar gshegs pa sras dang bcas pa rnams la mnyes mchod 'bul: dbang byin dngos grub thams cad bsdus te bum lha'i thugs gar thim: yang 'od zer mar 'phros: gang la gang 'dul gyis rigs drug gi sdug bsngal dang sdig sgrib ma lus pa sbyang: thams cad kyang yi dam thugs rje chen po'i skur gyur nas gsung mchog yi ge drug ma'i 'dzab dbyangs ti ri ri sgrogs par sgom: khyad par du dmigs yul tshe las 'das pa'i gtsor byas pas bar do la gnas pa'i sems can thams cad kyi las ngan pa'i sgrib pa skad cig nyid la byang: snang ba rnam par dag pa ri bo po ṭa la'i zhing khams mched: 'phags mchog thugs rje chen po'i gdul byar gyur nas phyir mi ldog pa'i sa thob par dmigs: slar yang 'od zer rnams tshur 'dus bum lar thim: bum lha'i sku yi cha thams cad nas dag byed ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgyun bab nas bum pa gang bar dmigs: 61 yi hūṃ snyes ma ṇi padme hūm̐ trī: brgya sto khra 'bum la sogs ci 'grub bzla slar ya mchod ci bstod la bzhu btul na skyes yisahūṃḥ bum pa'i lha rnams

rten dang brten par bcas pa thams cad 'od du zhu nas bum chu bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por 'khyil bar dmigs: de nas shes lha la khrus gsol bya gnyis pa las kyi bum pa bskyed bzlas ni oṃ swā bha wa sogs shukhro nya: las kyi bum pa mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid du gyur: stong pa'i ngang las mtshan nyid phun sum tshogs pa'i gzhal med khang gi dbus su pad zla nyi ma'i steng du khro rgyal rta mgrin sku mdog dmar gsal khro gtum bzod par dka' ba: gar dgu'i nyams dang ldan zhing ye shes kyi me rab tu 'bar ba'i dbus su zhabs gnyis gyad gyi 'dod thabs su bsgrad pa: phyag g.yas dbyug do nam mkha' la phyar zhing: g.yon sdigs mdzub dkur brten pa: sgra gseb nas rta mgo ljang zhur hi hi sgrogs pa'i rnam 'gyur can mdzes pa: snang stong gnyis su med pa'i gnas gsum las 'od zer 'phros dbyings nas ye shes pa spyan drangs gnyis su med par bstim: ma badzra sa ma ya dza:dzaḥ/ baṃ ho: a patram̐ sogs shabha a ྅ bum lha'i sku yi cha thams cad nas dag byed ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgyun bas bum pa'i nang kheng bar dmigs la: tho badzra kro dha

sa pa: khya ṣṭṛ wa hu lu hu lu hūṃ phaṭa: brgya stong la sogs ci rigs bskyal bar bya slar yang sngags kyi mchod cing bstod pa ni hū hrīḥ spyan ras gzegs dbang rngams brjid rol pa'i sku: ma chags ra ga'i mdangs 'dzin log rtog sgrol: gar dgu'i nyams rdzogs khro rgyal 'dus pa'i lha: rta mgrin rta skad bzhad la phyag 'tshal bstod lha 'od du zhu nas bum pa'i chu la thim pa'i dag byed yan lag brgyad ldan du gyur: de nas bdag dbang len pa'i rim pa ni: hū hrīḥ ji ltar bltam pa tsam gyis ni: lha rnams kyis ni khrus gsol ltar: la yi chu ni dag pa yis: mi gtsang dag phyir khrus bgyi'o: snyed sarba pa paṃ bhi shukhye shwa dha na ye swā hā: de nas maṇḍal phul la snyan pa'i sgras hrī: ye shes rgyal po bde gshegs klong chen mdzod: 'dzad med sku gsung thugs yon phrin las gter rmad byung gsang gsum dngos grub bdag sgrub na: da lta nyid du dbang dang byin rlabs kun: 'od zer yi ge'i rnam par thibs kyi byung:gnas lnga'i 'khor lor sib kyis 'dres pa yis: dbang bzhi'i ye shes nyams su myong ba dang: rig pa rtsal gyi ye shes thob par dmigs: bla āḥhūṃ tri de nas skyes bu' ngan khrus bya ba

dang dad ldan slob ma'am ni gshin po sogs thugs rje brtse ba'i rjes su 'dzin pa 'i tshe za 'dod chosabargyad re ba'i ma gos par gzhan phan don gnyer stong nyid snying rje'i blos spyod na rang dang 'gro ba'i don rnams kun rtsol med pan bzhin 'grub po la ldan rnams ma 'ongs snying gi bu dang 'phrad par shog skal med lag tu ma shor dam can rnams sa ma yu rgya rgya rgya bum pa'i cho ga dngosagrub bcud 'dus rdzogs so gter rgya gtad rgya sbasargya zab rgya gsang rgya gu rgya o rgyan gyi slob dpon padma saṃ bha wa'i bka' bdag 'dra mkhar chen bzas bkod pa'o brda tham snyi ce pa 'di 'ang chos bdag padma chos 'phel rgya mtsho chos bdag 'gyur med rgya mtsho slob bu padma rnam rgyal sogs kyis yang yang bskul ngor bdag 'dra dpa' bo nus ldan rdo rjes mkha' 'gro gsang ba'i brda ris la dag par phab pa dge legs 'phel/ sabo maṅga lam/
ra〉 zab gsang rdo rje snying po las: thugs rje chen po dri med padma dkar po yi tshogs mchod bsod nams gter gyi bum bzang zhes bya ba bzhugs so:

ra pa: na mo ārya lo ki shwa ra ye dngha111spe yoshe sgon mi 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon dmus long 'gro ba'i skyabs gcig thugs rje'i gter rgyal kun phrin las 'gro 'dul spyan ra gzigs mi 'bral bde chen 'khor lo'i rgyan du mchod ma'ongasalas ldanaskal bzang skyes bu rnams rdo rje theg pa'i lam la zhugs pa'i tshe bskal tshogs skad cag 'du ba'i man ngag dang dam tshig nyams chags bshags sbyang byed pa'i thabs med byung ga ṇa tsakra'i las rim bstan sa ma pā domang mo sam dā na dang ni zla rgyasazla phrum dkar skyems sgron me dang bdug pa ngad ldan la sogs gang 'byor bsags dam ldan rnal 'byor rig 'dzin pho mo'i tshogs 'byor ldan phyi nang gas ba'i dga' ston tshogs mkhyen ldan rgyal ba sras bcas lha yi tshogs dgyes ldan ye shes chen po don gyi tshogs ngo mtshar bkod pa ma 'dres lhun grub tshogs dag mnyam rang grol chen por phul bar bya don gnyis lhun grub sku gnyis maro na du 'gyur sa ma phu dang po las kyi rdo rjes phyag gsum 'tshal phod kya phu dung bsnol la zhe sa bcas tshogs la spyod pa'i zhu ba lan gnang sprad chang chu nang gsum sngon du 'gro ba'i bran de nas byin rlabs bya ba'i rim pa ni hūṃ trīḥ rang nyid yi dam lha yi thugs ka nas tshogs 'khor sbang ba'i yi ge ram̐ yi khaṃ 'phros te ma dag dngos 'dzin dri ma kun: bsreg gtor ba sa

gas la gtsang ma'i rang bzhin gyur: ñtsa rdo rje'i snying po sa bon yi ge ni: o 'phros 'dod yon lnga ldan phung por gyur: uyis dri med ye shes bdud rtsir gyur: hū gis kun bzang mchod pa'i sprin du gyur: ha yis 'dod pa'i lha mos spro bsdu 'khrigs: ho las 'od zer sna tshogs phyogs bcur 'gyed: hrī yis mthong snang lha tshogs dgyes pa bskang re ye kho: sa bahū ha ho hrī: lan gsum de nas tshogs zhing spyan 'dren bya ba ni hūṃ hrīḥ bde chen rang byung lhun grub bkod pa'i zhing dag mnyam dga' bde phun sum tshogs pa'i gnas: lho phyogs ri bo gru 'dzin gzhal yas nas: 'gro 'dul spyan ras gzigs dbang gtso 'khor bcas: zhal zas tshogs kyi 'du bar gshegs su gsol: snang ba 'ja' dang 'od phung lams se lam rig 'dzin sku dang thig le shigs se shig: dril gser sgra snyan rol mo si li li: dar dang ba dan mda' dar lhabs se lhab: dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i brda' skad ti ri ri: king dang lang ga'i bro gar khrigs se khrig: rnal 'byer gdung ba'i sgra dbyangs 'u ru dza zhal zas tshogs kyi mchod pa dpungs se spung snang gsal

'od stong ldan pa ta la la: 'du ba tshogs kyi 'khor lor spyan 'dren gshegs sgrub mchog bu la dbang dang dngos grub stsol: sa ārya lo ki shā ra sarba sa ma ya dza dza: de nas rgas phud khrul ba'i rim pa ni hū hrīḥ bde gshegs kun 'dusathugs rje'i dkyil 'khor lha dri med padma dkar po dgyes pa'i phyir: zhal zas 'dod yon tshogs kyi mchod pa 'bul:dam bskang tshe dbang mchog thun dngos grub stsol: ma ma hā ga ṇa tsakra pu tsa la khā hi: de nas gags pa bya ba'i rim pa ni ho rtsa gsum 'dus zhal bla ma spyan ras gzigs: dri med padma dkar po'i lha tshogs dgongs: bdag ni ma rig 'khrul ba'i dbang gyur te: rtsa ba yan lag dam tshig nyams pa kun: rab gnong 'gyod pa'i sems kyis mthol lo bshags: zhal zas tshogs kyi bskang ngo dag tshangs stsole: 31 badzra sa ma ya sdokhre u de nas bsgral las 'gugasagazhug grub nas slar hū je ye shes zang thal dri bral thugs rje'i gter ma 'gags snying rje'i rang gzugs khros pa'i sku: rta mgrin dbang gi skur bzhengs rngams pa'i stobs: rab tu bskyed la gdug pa 'dul phyir bzhengs bstan pa'i dgra sde thal

ra pa: bar brlag pa dang: gnod byed ming tsam med pa'i phrin las mdzod: o badzra kro dha sarba sa ma ya j-iḥtri sha hūṃ mā ra ya rbad sod de nas bstabs par bya ba' rim pa ni hūṃ hrīḥ bdag 'dzin rū tra bsgral ba'i phung po khams dbang yul skye mched don snying nang rol bcas: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams kyi zhal du bstabs: 'khor ba dbyings su rol ba'i phrin las mdzod: slo badzra kro dha sarba rū tra e dam ma hā pu tsa khā hi: de nas lag ma gtong ba' rim pa ni pho pho : lhag la dbang ba'i bka' nyan pho nya ni: rdo rje'i las mdzad ma sring ging lang ga: dbang phyug nyer brgyad 'khor bcas 'dir gshegs shig pham phab bka' yi lhag gtor 'di bzhes la: rnal 'byer sgrub pa po yi brin las sgrub: bcol ba'i las rnams ma g.yel myur 'grub mdzod: zab gsang bstan pa phyogs bcur rgyas par mdzod: sa dzñā na dha ka dhakki ni u tsi ṭa bha lirte kha kha khā hi khā hi: de nas bskul ba'i las rim 'di ltar ro hūṃ hrī mi gnas dag pa chos sku'i mkha' klong las: lhun grub rang gsal 'phags mchog thugs rje'i lha yab yum 'khor bcas thugs dam gnad nas bskul:

gdug pa'i gzung 'dzin rmang nas brnyil ba dang rtsa rlung dbang thang tshe bsod rgud pa sol: rnal 'byor sgrub pa'i 'bras bu mchis par mdzod: bka' dang dam la 'da' sa ma yā: ces brjod skyems gtor gtsang sar gshegs par bya de nas chad mdo gtong ba'i rim pa ni hūṃ bye sngon tshe 'das dus bskal ba'i dang po la: srin po'i rgyal po ma ṭaṃ rū tra nyid: bsgral ba'i dpa' rtags 'chang ba'i he ru gas dregs pa dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs rnams kyis sgog snying phul la bka' bsgos dam bzhag tshe gsang sngags bstan pa bsrung bar ma chad dam: dam ldan phrin las skrub par ma chad dam: zab gsang bstan pa skyongs bar ma chad dam: dam rdzas mchod gtor len par ma chad dam: sbyin bdag bde legs 'byor bar ma chad dam: sngon tshe zhal bzhes dam las ma 'da' bar: 'dod yon brgyan pa'i gtor ma 'di bzhes la: rnal 'byor bcol ba'i brin las grub par mdzod: hūṃ bya de'og bskal ba rdzogs ldan chen po'i dus: mnyam med ston mchog thub pa'i dbang po yis: sde snod gsum gyi chos 'khor bskor ba'i tshe: byang chub sems dpa' dri med rgyal po

rasto: yis:lha klu'i gnas su gsang sngags bstan pa spel:stong nyid snying rje'i khams gsum yongs la brdal:dpa' bo mkha' 'gro dam can rgya mtsho yis:srog snying phul la bka' bsgos dam bzhag tshe gsang sngags bstan pa bsrung bar ma chad dam:dam ldan brin las sgrub par ma chad dam:zab gsang bstan pa skyongs bar ma chad dam:dam rdzas mchod gtor len par ma chad dam:sbyin bdag bde legs 'byor bar ma chad dam:sngon tshe zhal bzhes dam las ma 'da' bar:'dod yon brgyan pa'i gtor ma 'di bzhes la:rnal 'byor bcol ba'i phrin las grub par mdzod:hūṃ bye de 'og bod yul mun gling gdug pa'i tshogs:'dul mdzad chos rgyal khri srong lde'u btsan gyis:o rgyan slob po padma spyan drangs nas:bsam yas lhun grub chos kyi sgron me sbar bka' bab skyes chen chos bdag nyer lnga la:gsang sngags chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba' tshe:phyi nang gsang ba'i bka' srung dregs tshogs kyis:srog snying phul la bka' bsgos dam bzhag tshe:gsang sngags bstan pa bsrung bar ma chad dam:dam ldan brin

las sgrub par ma chad dam: zab gsang bstan pa skyongs bar ma chad dam: dam rdzas mchod gtor len par ma chad dam: sbyin bdag bde legs 'byor bar ma chad dam sngon tshe zhal bzhes dam las ma 'da' bar: 'dod yon brgyan pa'i gtor ma 'di bzhes la: rnal 'byor bcol ba'i phrin las grub par mdzod: nyu bhyo de'og lnga brgya'i snyigs mar bab pa'i tshe: rnga yab padma 'od kyi gzhal yas dbus: o rgyan chen po padma 'byung gnas kyis: grub pa'i dbang phyug nus ldan rdo rje la: 'od gsal snying po'i klong rgya bkrol ba'i tshe: dregs pa lnga bcu gter bdag sum cu yis: sgog snying phul la bka' bsgos dam bzhag tshe: gsang sngags bstan pa bsrung bar ma chad dam: dam ldan phrin las sgrub par ma chad dam: zab gsang bstan pa skyongs bar ma chad dam dam rdzas mchod gtor len par ma chad dam: sbyin bdag bde legs 'byer bar ma chad dam: sngon tshe zhal bzhes dam las ma 'da' bar: 'dod yon brgyan pa'i gtor ma 'di bzhes la: rnal 'byor bcol ba'i phrin las grub par mdzod: shā bye da dus rtsub 'gyur ru gzing 'khrug

sasko: pa'i skabs: sgrub pa'i rnal 'byor dam ldan rgya mtsho yis: gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor gnyan po'i zhal phyes nas bsnyen sgrub ting 'dzin zab mo'i las gzhung bsrang: skye 'gro yongs la phan bde spel 'dod pas: sngon tshe bka' dam la bzhag srung ma'i tshogs: chad don khas blang mna' bor gsang mtshams ni: gsang sngags bstan pa bsrung bar ma chad dam: dam ldan phrin las sgrub par ma chad dam: zab gsang bstan pa skyongs bar ma chad dam: dam rdzas mtshod gtor len par ma chad dam: sbyin bdag bde legs 'byor bar ma chad dam sngon tshe zhal bzhes dam las ma 'da' bar 'dod yon brgyan pa'i gtor ma 'di bzhes la: rnal 'byor bcol ba'i phrin las grub par mdzod: sbyin bdag bde legs 'byor bar ma chad dam: khas blang tha tshig gnyan po 'di min nam: g.yel na mthu ldan khyed rnams nyams par 'gyur: chad don dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: rnal 'byor bcol ba'i brin las grub par mdzod: bka' dang dam la ma 'da' sa ma yā: de nas brtan ma skyong ba'i rim pa ni hūṃ bhyo slob dpon chen po padma

saṃ bha wa'i: spyan sngar khas blang mna' bor dam bcas pa'i: rgya bal bod yul bstan pa bsrung mdzad pa'i: bdag nyid chen mo la sogs bdud mo bzhi: gangs dkar sha med la sogs gnod sbyin bzhi: gong btsun de mo la sogs sman mo bzhi: che zhe chen mo dpon g.yog 'khor dang bcas: lhab lhub mang po rgyan cha pu ru na dril g.yer sna tshogs sgra snyan si li li: sna tshogs gar gyi bro gar lings se ling: sgrub pa po la gdung sems nyi li li: ma thogs sgrub pa'i gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol: dam rdzas bshal chu'i mchod pa 'di bzhes la sgrub pa'i phyi nang gsang ba'i rkyen gegs bzlog: tshe bsod dpal 'byor nyams rtogs yon tan dang mthun rkyen legs tshogs gong nas gong 'phel mdzod: mtha' mi kla 1 mu stegs cho 'phrul gzhoms bod yul bkra mi shis pa'i nyer 'tshe bzlog: phrin las sgrubs shig ma mo brtan ma'i tshogs bka' dang dam la ma 'da' sa ma yā: ces brjod skyems gtor gtsang sar gshegs par bya de nas bro mnan bya ba'i rim pa ni hūṃ hrī: yang gsang thugs rje chen po'i dkyil 'khor du: bar chad byed pa'i bdud dang

sasko dam sri rnams 'dul mdzad khro bo'i rgyal po rta mchog dpal: gdug pa dam sri 'dul ba'i bro la bskul: dbang gi dpa' rtags rta skad tse re re khro rgyal rngams pa'i 'byug sgra 'u ru phu rol ba'i rta bro gar byed khrigs se khrig: bdud dang dam sri 'byung po rdul du rlogs: ya ma dam sri stam bha ya nan nan: mja ci bstod la dngos grub len pa ni hū hrī: mi gnas ye shes don dam chos sku'i 1nga: lhun grub ye rdzogs sku dang ye shes kyi: gter mdzod dam pa rgyal kun gsang gsum dbyings rnal 'byor bdag gi yang yang bsnyen sgrub na: dngos grub zab mo thugs kyi klong nas stsol: sku gsum ye shes mthong ba ngo mtshar che: dbang bzhi'i chu rgyun 'beb pa skal ba bzang lha dang rang sems dbyer med a la la rig 'dzin rnam bzhi 'grub pa e ma ho: rtsa sngags mthar kā ya wākka tsitta sarba sirnyi pha la hūṃ: de nas bzod gsol bshags pa bya ba ni ho dkyil 'dzadar lha tshogs mkhyen brtse'i dgongs su gsol: bsnyen sgrub gzhung bsrang dam rgya bsdams na yang: bdag ni ma rig rmongs pa'i las dbang gis: rtsa ba yan lag dam tshig nyams pa

kun gnong zhing 'gyod sems drag pos bshags bgyi'o: badzra sa ma ya bhi shuddhi āḥ de nas bsngo ba'i rim pa 'di ltar ro hrī 'das dang ma 'ong da lta dus gsum kun zag dang zag med dge rtsa ci bsags pa thams cad ma lus gcig tu bsdum byas te: ma gyur 'gro ba yongs la bsngo bar bgyi: lan gsum de nasasmon lam gdab par bya ba ni hrī: bdag ni mthong thos dran reg 'gro ba yi: rgyud la stong nyid snying rje'i rgyas theb nas: phyam gcig bde chen dag pa'i zhing dbus su: phyir mi ldog pa 'phags pa'i zhal mthong shog lan gsum de nas rtag pa'i mtha' bsal rim pa ni yi snang cha ma 'gags thabs kyi dkyil 'khor ni phyi snod gzhal yas de yang lha tshogs la lha rnams gtso bo de yang ye shes sems: / yig gyen rdzogs nā dwa chos sku'i ngang: smra bsam brjod bral de bzhin nyid du ā de nas chad mtha' bsal ba'i rim pa ni phaṭa slar yang mkha' las 'ja' tshon shar ba bzhin: bdag snang mi shig snang stong lha yi sku: dri med padma dkar po'i nga rgyal gyis sgyu ma lta bu'i spyod lam bsgom par bya'o: phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa: de nas bkra shis brjod pa'i rim pa ni hūṃ hrī byin rlabs

ra / 'byung gnasabargyud pa drurga rdzogs gar: dpal ldan bla ma dam pa'i bkra shis shog: dngos grub kun 'byung rgyud sde bzhi drug gi: yi dam lha tshogs rnams kyi bkra shis shog: dga' bzhi ye shes bskyed cing dbyings gsum skyongs: ma mo mkha' 'gro rnams kyi bkra shis shog: bar chad sel zhing phrin las kun bsgrub pa'i: bstan srung dam can rgya mtsho'i bkra shis shog: phan bde'i nyi ma phyogs bcur rgyas mdzad pa'i: zab gsang rdo rje snying po'i bkra shis shog: rdzogs ldan gsar ba'i lang tsho ltar 'phel nas: skye dgu chos la spyod pa'i bkra shis shog: dpe yi bkra shis g.ya' dag nam mkha' la: nyi zla gza' skar 'dzom pa'i mdzes gyur cig: don gyi bkra shis sems nyid stong pa'i gshis: gsal rig 'dzin pa bral ba'i mdzes gyur cig: rtags kyi bkra shis chos dbyings nam mkha' la: sku gsum lhun rdzogs 'bras bu'i mdzes gyur cig bdag gzhan rnal 'byor phyi nang bdud las rgyal: phan bde'i myu gu 'khrung ba'i bkra shis 31ga: ces sogs shis brjod bsngo smon rgya chen bya gnad des tshogs rdzogs sgrib dag dngos grub thob sa ma yu ye

ma rgyal ba'i dbang po padma se bha was ma 'ongs 'gro la brtse ba chen po yis thugasakyi yang bcud rdo rje snying po'i chos man ngag sgog gi ti ga zab pa'i sgo grub pa'i dbang phyug khye'u chung khyod la gtad da lta ma spel rin chen brda' la thob mdo khams rtse shod gsham du dgongs rgya mdzod ma 'ongs snyigs ma sum bcu kha ral dus ma phyugasand yam dusa'akhrug gzing pa lang de tshe khyod nyid nus na 'du pa rtsal sngags rigasagrub pa'i dpa' bo rnam par snang skyes bu de dang gdamasapa 'di 'phrad nas bstan dang 'gro la phan bde 'byung bar 'gyur bden rdzun lag tu longs dang nges shes gsal skal med lag tu ma shor bstan zung tshogs sa ma shā rgya rgya rgya tshogs mchod gter gyi bum bzang rdzog so gter rgya gtad rgya sbas rgya zab rgya gsang rgya gu rgya o rgyan gyi slod dpon padma saṃ bha wa' bka' bdag 'dra mkhar chen bzas bkod pa'o brda zim lha cesapa 'di 'ang chos kyi bdag po padma chosa'aphel rgya mtshos yang yang bskul ba dang / chos bdag 'gyur med rgya mchosayang yang bskul ba dang / sbyin bdag padma rnam rgyal gyis dar dang dngul gyi rdo rje rtse rgyal ldem sgro dang dbang lnga'i cod paṇa bcas nas yang yang bskul ba'i ngor bdag 'dra dpa' bo nus ldan 'dus pa rtsal gyis mkha' 'gro gsang ba'i brda' ris las zhal bsas te dag par phab pa dge legs 'phel sarba mtho lam/ bstan dang 'gro ba'i don gnyis 'byung 'byur cig //

gas:zab gsang rdo rje snying po las:thugs rje chen po dri med padma dkar po'i:bstan srung lha bu ming sring gi zab sgrub 'dod 'byung nor bu bzhugs so sa( na mo ārya ma ki shwa ra ye:tshanasgyuka 147 dus gsum rgyal ba'i gsang gsum mdzod 'cha ba sku dang ye shes 'byung gnas phan bde'i bdag dri bral padma ku ra thugs rje'i gter sku gsum klong yangs chen por phyag bgyi'o ma 'ongasal ldan skal bzang pho mo rnams zab lam rdo rje snying po'i sgor zhugs nas bsnyen sgrub bzlas dmigs tshul bzhin byed 'dod na bar chad 'joms byed srung ma'i mchod sgrub gal sa ma shā de yis lasal sbyor dngos rjes gsum las dang po bla rdo srog 'khor sa ldan sgrub da la yid 'ong mda' gang gru bzhi bca' sgrub pa'i gtor ma zhal shel ja bzhin bkod phyi nang mchod sprin mtha' yas rnam par brgyan dkar dmar skyems dang gtor ma bā ling ta bza' bca' btung ba dkar gsum mngar gsum sogs gang 'dod mchod pa'i yo byad phun tshogs bsags khrus dang gtsang sbra sngon du 'gro ba yis bdag bskyed 'phags pa'i gzhung bsrangs bsnyen sgrub gtong de dag sbyor ba sngon du 'gro ba'o gnyis pa srung ma'i las gzhung bsteng ba ni sgo ma hwa shu bye ta dzā na ko3rha:rang nyid yi dam lha ru gsal ba'i mdun:spral ba'i zhing

bkod phun sum tshogs pa'i dbus: rin chen lnga las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang: tshad dang mtshan nyid lhun gyis grub pa'i nang: dgos 'dod longs spyod char ba sprin ltar 'bebs: dung gi mdangs 'dzin sha dkar g.yu yi rwa: spu sdug mdzes pa'i lang tsho stong gis 'byud rin po che yi rgyan cha pu ru ru de yi steng du lha mchog 'dod pa spel dkar gsal shel gyi ri la nyi shar bzhin zhal gcig phyag gnyis 'dzum sgeg lang tsho 'bar: dar gyi la thod ratna'i sgog zhu mdzes: g.yu yi zur phud g.yas g.yon 'phyang pa 'phur lha gos dkar po g.yu yi tshom bu can sku smad sham thabs klub pa'i tshul du brgyan gser g.yu ratna mang pos 'phyang pa spras: dar sngon dpyangs pa g.yas g.yon kun la 'phur:spyi gtsug dam rtag rdo rje phyed pa las: mchog thun dngos grub 'dod dgu'i gru char 'bebs phyag g.yas lcag kyus 'gro blo dbang du sdud g.yon pas gter gyi bum pas dgos 'dod stsol zhabs gnyis gar gyis sha dkar khri la rol: 'ja' 'od zer gsum phyogs bcu kun tu 'phro: de yi g.yon phyogs yu mo g.yu mdog la: dar gyi stan la

rasto rin chen sga yis mdzes de steng dmar ser 'char ga'i mdangs 'dzin pa'i: lha yi sring mo dpal chen 'dod ster ma: mdzes 'dzums udmal yi dri bsung 'thul byams brtse'i lcags kyus 'gro ba ma lus 'dul: dag pa'i lam ston 'khor ba'i skyabs gcig ma: btsun ma'i tshul 'dzin sangs rgyas bstan pa srungs: dar dmar gser gyi me tog bkra ba yis: smad kyi sham thabs 'ja' yis rkang dor bkra: rin chen gdu bu g.yu byur phra yis mdzes: gsang gos sngon po sku yi stod du bkra: pad phreng ratna'i do shal sum rim 'phyangs: dbu skra thor cog spod shel gzi mchung dang: rgya g.yu mu tig dag gis thod rgyan mdzes: dung gi gtsug phud g.yas dang g.yon du 'khrungs:padma'i lcags kyu zhags pa phyag na bsnams: snang stong 'od sku 'ja' yi rang bzhin la: na bun g.yu sbrangs char ba sil ma 'bebs 'tha' 'khor lha dang lha mo bsam mi khyab:nyi rdul 'khrigs bzhin gtso la 'dud cing bskor: de dag gnas gsum rdo rje'i sa bon las: 'od zer dkar dmar mthing gsum dpag med 'phros dag pa'i zhing mchog po

ṭa la yi gnas: sgrub dang sbas yul gter gnas la sogs pa'i: rang bzhin gar bzhugs dag pa'i gnas mchog nas spyan drangs bskyed pa'i lha la sib sib bstims dam ye ro gcig brten pa'i rdzas la bzhugs: zab gsang bstan pa srung phyir gus phyag 'tshal dgyes pa'i dam rdzas phyi nang gsang gsum gter dkar mngar rtsi sman shing tog sbod kyi rigs: zla rgyas zla phrums 'o phud ba lirnyi: ja chang phud bzang rin chen ngar btab pa: ratna gzugs 'gros dkor nor bsam mi khyab: 'dod pa'i yon tan ma tshang med pa ni: mig 'phrul lta bu'i gter chen mtha' yas pa'i: sras mchog lha bu ming sring thugs dam bskangs: dgyes bzhes phrin las rnam bzhi 'grub pa dang: zab gsang bstan pa phyogs bcur 'phel rgyas mdzod: gdungs dbyangs rol mo'i sgra yis bstod par bgyi thugs gar sgog yig trīḥl sngags kyis bskor bzlas pas phrin las rab 'byams 'a ba pa dang 'dod pa'i yon tan gegs med stsol ba sogs: bcol ba'i phrin las ma g.yel dam tshig can: o ma hā de wa dzā na dhe wi sa ma yā hring trīng phe dza: 'bod

sa ma: pa chu bo'i gzhung bzhin bzlas pa yis phrin las rab 'byams gegs med yid bzhin 'grub sa ma yā skyid ma hā dhe wa dzñā na de wi sa ma ya hrīng trīng phe dza dgra la rbad: rbad pa chu yi rgyun bzhin bzlos pa yis bar chad bstan pa'i bdud dpung brlag par 'gyur sa ma yā skyid ma hā de wa dzñā na de wi dgra bgegs gnod byed sarba sha hūṃ mā ra ya gnod byed kyi tshe sgog la rbad sod: bsad pa'i bzlasapa chu bo'i rgyun bzhin bzla bar chad dgra dang bgegs tshogs rdul brlag 'byur sa ma wā gsum pa skabs su gsol mchod brgya stong sogs grangs bsogs mchod rdzasayo byad rgya chen sbungs de nas mchod cing bstod par bya ba ni oṃ ma hā de wa dzñā na de wi sarba sa pa ri wā ra ma hā aste pabye sogs shabha du pa sogs sparnye dharma ma hā sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta ma hā rakta ma hā bā lirnya la kha re khā hi:hū hrī: bde chen ye shes gar gyi dbang chen gyis 'gro blo theg chen chos la 'god par byed: gsang sngags bstan pa'i sgron me rgyal ba'i yum: lha bu ming sring bcas la phyag 'tshal bstod: 'di bzung ji srid gdod ma chos sku'i bar: bdag ni srung skyobs phyi nang bar chad sol: zas nor longs spyod 'dod dgu'i gru char stsol: ri bo po ta la ru lam

sna drongs: khams gsum 'khor ba yongs sgrol phrin las mdzod: bka' dang dam la ma 'da' sa ma yā ces brjod skyems gtor gtsang sar gshegs gnad de phrin las rab 'byams 'grub sam mā yim rgyal bamidabang po o rgyan padma ngas ma 'ongs 'gro la brtse ba chen po yis thugs kyi yang ge zab gsang rdor snying chos med byung thugs rje chen po'i sgrub skor ni ma 'ong skal ba bzang po' dpal du shog snyigs ma'i rgud gsonu ldan rdo rje yis rnyed nas bstan 'gro'i phan bde rab spel nas bde legs lang tsho'i snang ba rgyas gyur cig skal med lag tu ma shor spu gri gsum sam mā rgya rgya rgya bstan zung lha bu ming sring gi zab sgrub rdzog so gter rgya gtad rgya sbas rgya zab rgya gsang rgya gu bye snyi ces pa 'di yang chos kyi bdag popadma chosa'aphel rgya mtsho chos bdaga'agyur med rgyams slob bu padma rnam rgyalagyisathab shesakyi dzosa'aga' re dang bcas nas yang yang bskul ba'i phyir dang / grog mo ratna sa ra rnams kyis bskul ba'i ngor bdag 'dradapa' bo nus na rdo rjes dag par phab pa dge leg 'phel/ sarba ma lam/

gas zab gsang rdo rje snying po las: thugs rje chen po dri med padma dkar po'i: bstan srung lha bu ming sring gi gsol mchod bdud rtsi'i thig pa bzhugs so:sa na mo ārya lo ki shā ra ye: 11——rgyu1— ma 'ongasalasaskal ldan rnams kyis srung ma mchad gsol bya ba la phyi nang nyer spyod mchod pa bshams sngags dang phyag rgyas byan gyis rlabs rang nyid lha yi nga rgyal gyis spos dud tshil zhun dud pa spro rol mo snyan pa'i sgra bcas te hū hrī 'jig rten bde skyongs skye 'gro yongs kyi mgon: sangs rgyas bstan pa srung ba'i lha chen po: legs nyes ltang 'dzin dam tshig rjes gcod pa'i: ye shes dbyings las ma g.yos sprul pa'i sku: skyes mchog lha yi sras po ming sring ni: dpon g.yog 'khor dang bcas te gshegs su gsol dam tshig gsang ba'i rten la dgyes par bzhugs lha phyag 'tshal lo brtse ba'i rgyang ma ring dgyes pa'i mchod rdzas rnam lnga nyer spyod bdun sman gtor rakta sbyor sgol byang chub sems ja chang phud dang bdud rtsi stems mchod dkar zla rgyas zla phrum mo sa raku' mtsho ri dwags g.yung dwags chu gnas bya yi rigs ga ṇa tsakra snang gsal

bsangs dud spro: 'dod pa'i yon tan ma tshang med pa ni: mig 'phrul lta bu'i gter du rab spel nas: skyes chen lha yi rgyal po gsol zhing mchod lcam mo dge bsnyen chen mo gsol zhig mchod: las mdzad lha chen mched brgyad gsol zhing mchod: bka' nyan sems ma rnam brgyad gsol zhing mchod: lha mchod bsam mi khyab pa gsol zhing mchod:yang sprul bka' nyan pho nya gsol zhing mchod: g.yog dang yang 'khor bcas gsol zhing mchod: thugs dam bskang ngo nyam chags 'gal 'khrul bshags: gdung dbyangs rol mo'i sgra yis gus pa'i bstod: zab gsang bstan pa srung bar mnga' gsol lo rnal 'byor sgrub pa po la brtse ba'i skyongs sangs rgyas bstan skyong dkon mchog dbu 'phang bstod: dge 'dun sde spel rnal 'byor phrin 'a sa sgrub: zab gsang rdo rje snying po'i bstan pa ni: phyogs bcu kun tu dar zhing rgyas par mdzod: skye 'gro ma lus bde skyid dpal la spyod rdzogs ldan lang tsho gsar ba'i rab mdzes nas: khams gsum chos la spyod tsang yangs pa'i khams: gzhen nu bum skur grol ba'i phrin las mdzod: bka' dang dam

ra ma la ma 'da' sa ma yā: ces pa'i grangs bsogs 'dod don bcol bā ling skyems phud grangs ldan bsags gnad de phrin las rab 'byams 'grub phyi nang gsang ba'i gegs la grol bden rdzun lag tu long dang gsal the tshom med do sa ma yu skal med lag tu ma shor cig snying gi bu dang 'phrad par shog sa ma yu rgya rgya rgya gter rgya gtad rgya sbas rgya zab rgya gsang rgya gu bye snyi ces pa 'di 'ang chos kyi bdag po padma chosa'aphel rgya mtsho chos bdag 'gyur med rgya mtsho slob bu padma rnam rgyal sogs kyis bskul ngor bdag 'dra dpa' bo nus ldan rdo rjes dag par phab pa dge legs 'phel/ sarba maṅga lam/

sastocho zab gsang rdo rje snying po las:thugs chen dri med padma dkar po'i bstan srung lha bu ming sring gi bla rdo sgog 'khor zab mo bzhugs so:sa(snye na mo ārya lo zhi shā ra ye:/tho1111 dusagasum rgyal ba sras bcas kya ye shes rdo rje gsang gsum daphyid don gya klong pho spyan ras gzigs gang sku dra med dbyings la 'dud ma 'ongasalasaldan pho mo ya zab gsang lam du byed pa'i tshe srung ma snyen sgrubs gal che ba' mkho dzos snying dang srog lta bu'i bla rdo zab pa'i rno ba da bstan sa ma yu de yang dri bral shog dkar ngor li khri bzang drug bsres pa yis mu khyud rim pa bdun du bkod lte bar nar bu mig gsum bkod snying po yarjestsal badzra rakṣa sneḥzhesagadags mtshal lam mazing gis dbu can bri gnyis pa la ni 'di ba nga no oṃ badzra dhe wa padma de 'i trī sarba sa ma ya sirnyi pha la hūṃ kwa ya wākka citta badzra pho dza mu khyud gsum par 'di ltar bkod oṃ ma hā dhe wā padma dī zhi chang sarba sam ya po dza sdang ba'i dgra bo la shag rbad mu khyud bzhi par 'di ltar ro mi ma hā dhe wā padma dī wi trī sarba sam ya dgra bgegs rjiḥtri sha hūṃ mā ra ya rbad sod mu khyud lnga par 'di ltar bkod 'chang ba po'i bsrung ba' 'khor lo 'di las lha mchog mang sring 'khor dang bcas pas bla chags par gyur cag srog bstan par gyur cag sku gsung thugs

yong su gan par gyur cig badzra sam ma rakṣa rakṣa hūṃ mu khyud drug par dbyangasagasal dang rten snying su pra tini dang badzra zhesapa legasapar 'god mu khyud bdun par nor 'dzin bri dzos ni bzang drug chosasman byug snying po galu byang mgron bu dang byu ru mig gsum gzhug par bya lnga ching sgo rdzogasadar gyi dril dkyil 'khor dbusagazhug nyer spyod bkram tshul bzhin sgrub pa'i rtags mtshan 'byung lusal ba nga ba phrin lasa'agrub g.yel med rnal 'byor 'dod pa'i don gegasamed re 'brasathob par byed bden rdzun lag tu longasadang gsal the tshom med do sam mā skal med lag tu ma shor cig snying gi bu dang 'phrad par smon sa ma mā rgya rgya rgya gu rgya snyi cesa'adi 'ang slob bu padma rnam rgyal kyis bkra shis lha regasadabang lnga'i cod paṇa rin chen gnyis pa'i rdo rje rtse rgyal ldem sgro dang bca pas yang bskul ngor bdag 'dra mo rgyan nusaldan rdo rjes mkha' 'gro gsang ba'i brda risalas zhal bshu te dag par phab pa dge legs 'phel sarba mang ga lam//

sasko zab gsang rdo rje snying po las bstan bsrungs yongs jogs kyi gsol mchod nyung ngur bsdus pa phrin las lhun grub bzhugs so gas na re gu ru padma ka ra ye shā / rang nyid gas po'i nga rgyal gyis mdun du bka' zung dregs tshogs gsal mchod rdos bsangs sbyangs byin rlabs nas 'dod pa'i yid kyis brjod par bya tshog āḥ rang mdun phalas dum gcig bhanta ru 'dod yon bza' bca' btung ba sha khrag rigs siye 8las byung bas bsregs gtor bkrus: sha lnga bdud rtsi zag med ye shes rdzas rnams pa dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i phung khams kyis dbang drag shan dmar ma hā de wa'i sku: tshogs kyi bdag po legs ldan phyag bzhi pa bdud mgon seng gdong las byed bya rog gdong gur zhal phyag drug ma ning tsi ma ra dregs chen bco brgyad sde dpon sum cu dang: mi mgon dkar po ya ma ra tsa dang shan pa kus 'debs zangs ri dgra 'joms rtsal gza' mchog chen po dam can rdo rje legs lha srin sde brgyad pho rgyud dpa' bo sde gsol lo mchod do thugs dam gnyan po bskangs e ka tsa

ti yaka nag mo dang:dpal ldan lha mo sha za kha mo che:rdo rje g.yu sgron tshe ring mched lnga dang:phur srung bcu gnyis myur mgyogs ngas nus ma dmag zor rgyal mo dbang phyug nyi shu brgyad:bstan ma bcu gnyis lha mo mo rgyud rigs:gsol lo mchod do thugs dam gnyan po bskang:klu bdud btsan dang spu gri mched gsum sde drag mo mched gsum thang lha rma chen spom:dge bsnyen nyer gcig 'brong ri smug po dang:rdo rje legs pa rnga la stag rtse sogs:gter srung phyi nang gnyis skyong sde tshogs kyis:gser skyems phud bzang rin chen ngar btab pa sha khrag dam rdzas 'dod rgu'i longs spyod kyi gsol lo mchod do thugs dam gnyan po bskang:zhergyas dbang dang drag po'i las rnams sgrub:sangs rgyas bstan skyongs dkon mchog dbu 'phang bstod:dge 'dun sde spel slob dpon sku tshe bsrings:rnal 'byor don sgrub sbyin bdag bde rgyas mdzod khyad par ba gsang rdo rje snying po'i chos:phyogs bcu kun tu dar zhing rgyas pa dang:nad mug mtshon 'khrug ming gi lhag mar gyur legs tshogs bkra shis rdzogs ldan ltar smin nas:dus gsum kun

sa /: nas dge zhing bde legs 31ga: bka' dang dam la ma 'da' sa ma yu: ces brjod phrin las rab 'byams 'grub the tshom med do sa ma mā rgya rgya rgya gu rgya zhes pa 'di yang chos kyi bdag po rdar ma'i mtshan can kyi bskur ngor bdag 'dra nus ldan rdo rjesabris pa dge'o dge'o/ dge'o/ legs so/ sarba masgo lam/
badzra zab gsang rdo rje snying po las thugs rje chen po dri med padma dkar po'i phyag 'tshal bya ba sdig sgrib rang grol zhes bya ba bzhugs so:

badzra na mo gu ru padma kā ra ye: rmāgaca/gru cas/ thugs thalago 4 bye ba'i rṣas phreng gis 'gro ba'i mi shes mun pa bsil mdzad pas thugs rje chen po dri med pad dkar la sgo gsum mos gus drag pos phyag 'tshal lo ma 'dzasal can skal bzang pho mo rnams gsang chen rdo rje'i lam la zhugs pa'i tshe lus ngag yid kyi sgrib tshogs dag pa dang don gnyis gegs med yid bzhin 'grub pa'i phyir phyag 'tshal bya ba'i gnad 'di brtson pas zungs sa ma yu tha tha rgya rgya man yami: rgyal ba sras bcas mdun gyi nam mkhar gsal thal mo sbyor la mos gus drag po yis na ma ma chags gribral padma rā ga'i mdangs bde chen 'dus ma byas pa'i ye shes sku: chags thogs bral ba'i mkhyen brtses 'gro khams 'dul bcom ldan snang mtha' yas la phyag 'tshal lo: dbyengs dang yeshar zung du 'jug pa'i gar: dad ldan bu la bde stong nyams rtogs stsol: bde mchog yab kyi dgyes pa bskang mdzad ma: yum chen gos dkar mo la phyag 'tshal lo: brgyad tshags sgrob bral dag pa'i ye shes dbyings: mi 'gyur mi shigs bde ba chen po'i sku: phung lnga dbyings sgrol dag pa chen po'i gshis: bcom ldan rdo rje sems la phyag 'tshal

ba tshu lo:chu khams rnam dag bde gshegs rigs kyi dbyings:gdul bya yongs la thugs rje bsil char 'bebs:zhe sdang rmang brgyur 'gro khams dong sprugs pa'i:dgyes bskyed dbyings phyugs ma la phyag 'tshal lo:thugs rje'i 'od zer bye ba'i rlabs phreng gis gang 'dul 'gro ba'i don kun 'grub mdzad cing:bde gshegs phrin las yongs rdzogs mthu thob pa:dri med padma dkar por phyag 'tshal lo:bde gshegs gsung gi gar 'dzin 'gro ba 'dul:thugs rje chags pas yab la dgyes pa bskyed byu ru'i mdangs 'dzin ma rig mun sel ba'i:gsang ba ye shes dbyings la phyag 'tshal lo:dmar ser 'char sha'i mdangs 'dzin chags thog bral:'dod 'byung nor bu'i dbul phongs 'byor rgud sel byang chub sems dpa'i tshul 'dzin 'gro ba 'dul:sras mchog nor bu 'dzin la phyag 'tshal lo:baḍūr lhun po lta bu'i mdangs 'dzin zhing:'bum phrag rgyud kyi gnyer 'dzin bstan pa'i gzhi sems ma'i tshul 'dzin 'gro khams dong sprugs pa'i:sras mo gsang sngags 'dzin la phyag 'tshal lo:dkar gsal gang la rta

bdun 'od 'khyugs bzhin sgrib gnyis g.ya' bral kun mkhyen ye shes 'bar:sems dpa'i tshul 'dzin zhe sdang 'gro khams 'dul chags thogs bral ba'i sku la phyag 'tshal lo ma chags dri bral padma rgyasapa'i zhal btso bsregs brdar ba'i gser gyi bzhin mdangs 'tsher:sems dpa'i tshul 'dzin nga rgyal lha khams 'dren dri ma med pa nyid la phyag 'tshal lo:mi shigasardo rje lta bu'i gsang gsum gar:'gro ba'i dpal shar snying po'i bstan pa spel:sems dpa'i tshul 'dzin yi dwags gnas stong mdzad rdo rje snying po'i sde la phyag 'tshal lo las rab rigs grub bde gshegs thugs kyi gar:byams brtse'i zhags pas 'gro khams 'ching zhing grol sems dpa'i tshul gyis lha min gnas rnams stong don yod zhags pa'i gar la phyag 'tshal lo thugs bskyed rnam dag ting 'dzin spob pa mtho:bskal pa dbyings rdzogs bar du bstan 'gro yi:don mdzad sems dpa'i tshul bzung rmongs khams 'dul spob pa rab mtho nyid la phyag 'tshal lo thugs rje chags pa'i btang snyoms gru bo yis ris med 'gro ba bde chen lam la

badzra spyor sems dpa'i tshul 'dzin mi yi gnas stong byed 'phags pa dpa' mi zhum la phyag 'tshal lo byams dang snying rje'i 'od zer stong 'bar bas 'gro ba yongs la phan bde nyi ma sbar sems dpa'i tshul 'dzin khams gsum dong sprugs pa'i 'gro ba rnam 'dren mchog la phyag 'tshal lo thugs dzeebartsebs 'gro ba bu bzhin skyongs: brtul zhugs gar gyis sbyor sgrol ma nges ston: sems dpa'i gar gyis sbyor sgrol ma nges ston: sems dpa'i tshul 'dzin 'khor ba dbyings su sgrol 'phags mchog brdul zhugs chen por phyag 'tshal lo dkar gsal shel gyi mdangs 'dzin 'gro ba 'dul rdo rje gar gyi rol rtsed mkha' la bsgyur: sems ma'i tshul 'dzin bde stong yab la stobs: dga' bzhi'i 'byung gnas sgeg mor phyag 'tshal lo spos shel mdog can ye shes gsal ba'i sku ku mud phyogs bcu 'thor ba'i rtse gar bsgyur: sems ma'i tshul 'dzin ye shes gsang ba'i sku ma le ser mo nyid la gus phyag 'tshal:dmar gsal padma rā ga'i mdang 'dzin zhing ma lus 'gro la dga' bzhi'i ye shes 'bebs snyan 'byur dam

bu ra yi sgra kun sgrogs: rdo rje glu dbyangs ma la phyag 'tshal lo: ljang gsalaldi1'i spo la nyi shar bzhin: bkrag mdangs rab rgyas 'gro ba thabs kyi 'dul: rdo rje gar bsgyur mkha' la 'ja' bzhin spro: las mdzad nidhi ma la phyag 'tshal lo: rtag par lta ba gnas su dag pa'i dbyings: tshad med lcags kyus 'gro ba dbyings su 'dren dkar gsal mdangs ldan khro gtum rngams pa'i sku: rdo rje rta mgrin nyid la phyag 'tshal lo: chad par lta ba gnas su dag pa'i gshis: byams brtse'i zhags pas 'gro ba 'ching zhigs sgrol:ser gsal mdangs 'dzin khro bo'i cha lugs can: ratna rta mgrin nyid la phyag 'tshal lo: mtshan mar lta ba gnas su dag pa'i dbyings dga' ba'i sgrogs gis 'khor ba dbyings su rol: dmar gsal padma rā ga'i kha dog 'chang padma rta mgrin nyid la phyag 'tshal lo: bdag tu lta ba gnas su dag pa'i gshis btang snyoms dril bus 'gro la chos char 'bebs: ljang gsal gar dgu'i nyams rdzogs khro bo'i sku: karma rta mgrin nyid la phyag 'tshal lo: byang chub thugs bskyed byang chub sems dpa'i sku: dmus long

ba tshu 'gro ba yongs kyi skyabs gcig pu ngan song dong sprugs mdzad pa rmad byung ba'i: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams la phyag 'tshal lo: bde gshegs 'khor ba 'jigs dang gser gyi thub: rgyal ba 'od srung bcom ldan shākya'i tog byams pa seng ge'i sgra dbyings la sogs pa'i: bskal bzang sangs rgyas stong la phyag 'tshal lo byin rlabasa'abyung gnas rtsa brgyud bla ma dang dngos grub kun 'byung yi dam rgyud sde'i lha: dbyings gsum gar 'dzin ma dang mkha' 'gro sogs rtsa gsum lha tshogs rnams la phyag 'tshal lo ye shes gsang ba'i gar 'dzin 'gro ba 'dul: legs nyes ltang 'dzin dam tshig rjes su gcod: las byed pho nya lha bu ming sring sogs dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo chos nyid zhi zhing chags pa ngang gis bral: phyi nang tshogs yul phung khams rnam par dag bde gshegs rig kyi gsang ba rdzogs pa'i dbyings zhi ba bzhi bcu gnyis la phyag 'tshal lo thugs rje zhi zhing rnam rol khros pa'i sku: kun rtog lnga bcu rtsa brgyad dag pa'i dbyings: rgyud dang sgrub sde yongs kyi spro bsdu mchog: khrag 'thung lnga

bcu brgyad la phyag 'tshal lo zhing rdul grangasamanyam lus sprul thar mo sbyar:dad pas brkyang phyag brdab de 'tshal ba'i mthus:dam tshig nyam chags nyes lhung yongs dag nas kun tu 'od kyi sal phyin par thegag de ltar phyag 'tshal bya bas nyams chags dag tshe dang bsod nams nyamasartogs gong 'phel rgyas don gnyis gegs med yid bzhin 'thub par 'gyur de tshom med do rdo rje rgyal po' bga' sam shā ye ma rgyal ba'i dbang po padma sgobha pa'i ma'ong 'gro la brtse ba chen po yis snying dang 'dra ba'i gdams ba med byung ba grub palidabang phyug khye'u chung khyod la gtad da dung spel ba'i dusal ma bab pa'i zab gsang mi 'gyur rin chen brda la thob mdo khams rdo rje'i rdzong du dgongs pra sdoms ma 'ongs snyigs ma sum cu kha ral dus nad mug mtshon che'i gzing pa ling ba'i tshe nga sprul dpa' bonusaldan rdo rje dang zab gsang 'di 'phrad bstan pa 'dzin skyong spel las can chos kyi bdag po rnams la 'doms gdul bya 'bum phrag 'og min zhing la 'god 'gro don bsam mi khyab pa'i rten 'brel yod bstan pa'i ba dan lho byang gnyis nas bsgrengs zab bcud thub par zung shig lha bu mched skal med lag tu ma shor a tham rgya dam ldan thugs kyi srasadang 'phrad par shog sa ma mā rgya rgya rgya phyag 'tshal sdig sgrib rang grol zhes bya ba ོgsaso gter rgya gtad

—41 rgya sbas rgya zab rgya gsang rgya gu rgya mo rgyan gyi slob dpon padma tho bha wa bka' bdag 'dra mkhar chen gza'i bkod pa'o brda thim lha sbyin sogs phyin drug dbang 'byorakun bzang dang sbyinapa mthar son ku mud dharmā pa sbyin pa'i nor phyugasadad ldan sgon skyab dang sbyin dga' ser sna'i mdud grol 'gyur ba med sbyin gtong la dgyesaratna sar sogs/sbyin bdag slob ma du ma'i bskul ba'i ngor sbyin gtong phong med nusaldan rdo ri smras sbyin pa rin chen nyid kyi yi ge bris sbyin yul 'gro khams dong sprug nusapar shog sarba maṅga lam/

badzra zab gsang rdo rje snying po las: thugs rje chen po dri med padma dkar po'i chos sde: bshags pa ye shes sgron me zhes bya ba bzhugs so:badzra na mo gu ru padma kā ra ye: ) rlabs chen spyod pa'i gang 'dul mdzad pa skyong rmad byung thugs rje'i gru la nye rang bral khams gsum srid pa'i ded dpon gcig gyur pa dri med padma dkar po la phyag 'tshal ma 'ongasalasacan skal bzang pho mo rnams gsang sngags rdo rje'i lam la zhugs pa 'i tshe dam tshig nyams chags nyes lhung dag pa'i phyir bshags pa'i rgyal po ye shes sgron mer brtson sa ma gi rgyargyaḥzanani| yu dkyil 'bar lha tshogs mdun gyi nam mkhar gsal sdig lhung dran zhing gnong 'gyod drag po'i blos 33 ye shes sku mchog rang bzhin dkyil 'khor ni: zla rgyas bzhin du spros pa mi mnga' yang: bcom ldan bde gshegs kun bzang zhi khro'i lha: thugs rje nyi ma'i zer ltar 'bar ba yi 'od mdangs dngas ba'i chu la legs bstan nas du ma ro gcig bde ba chen por bzhugs: dam tshig nyams chags sbyangs phyir phyag mchod bzhes dmigs med chos kyi sku la phyag 'tshal lo: rang bzhin longs spyod

rdzogs la phyag 'tshal lo thugs rje cir yang sprul la phyag 'tshal lo: gnas lugs 'gyur ba med la phyag 'tshal lo: mnyam brdal ngo bo nyid la phyag 'tshal lo: sku dang ye shes tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo ngo bo de bzhin nyid du dag mnyam rol: a la la ho ho bcom ldan rgyal ba zhi khro rab 'byams rnams thugs rje brtse ba chen po'i dgongs su gsol bdag na gsang sngags rdo rje'i lam zhugs nas dam tshig gzhung bzhin spyad par ma nus te: sdom las nyams shing 'gal ba mthol lo bshags: rigs dang dkyil 'khor 'byung gnas bla ma la: dad dang mos gus dag snang kun ral te ma dad log lta som nyi shor ba sogs: sku yi dam tshig nyams pa mthol lo bshags: yidam lha ma gsal zhing sngags bzlas g.yel: dus drug tshogs mchod rgyun chags bka' las 'das: gzhungs bzhin ma ldan sgrub g.yel 'chol rnyogs spyod gsung gi dam tshig nyams pa mthol lo bshags: rdo rje slob dpon byams pa'i sku drin gyis snyan khung brgyud nas man ngag thugs la brlan: ting 'dzin g.yel nas snying po ral ba sogs: thugs kyi

badzra dam tshig nyams pa mthol lo bshags: spyor sgrol ma byen len sogs ral ba dang: rigs dang dkyil 'khor yab yum 'od las 'das sgrub pa'i dam tshig rnam pa lnga yang ral: bdud rtsi ma sbyad nyon mongs spang ba sogs yan lag dam tshig nyams pa mthol lo bshags: bla med don spang bla ma ma bkur zhing sngags dang phyag rgya'i rgyun bcad mched la gshe: rtsa ba'i dam tshig nyams pa mthol lo bshags:gnas dus sgrub pa'i yo byad 'chol bar bsgrags: lha sngags gzungs ma grub rtags kun la bstan gsang bar 'os dang gsang ba gnyer gtad 'chol: cha lag dam tshig nyams pa mthol lo bshags snang srid med pa byang chub sems kyi klong: rig pa gcig pu dkyil 'khor gsum gyi ngang: bar med byams brdal dbyings rig spros mtha' bral: dag mnyam lhun grub ma rtog mthol lo bshags:thams cad sems las byung ba'i chos nyid la spang blang gnyis 'dzin mdud pa dam sprang ste: log 'khrul 'khor ba'i gshis su shor ba las: rang 'khrul rang mnar gyur pa mthol lo bshags lta ba 'phang dam

chos nyid don ma rtogs sgom pa yun thung nyams rtog stsal ma rdzogs: spyod pa tho co'i gsang sngags 'chol bar bsgrubs: rgyal ba'i thugs 'gal dri ma mthol lo bshags:dri med chos kyi dbyings ni mkha' ltar dag rig pa mnyam nyid ye shes nyi ltar gsal: thugs rje rtsol bral sku gsum bsam yas kyang: ma rtogs chags sdang spyod pa mthol lo bshags: phyi yi dam tshig sa gsum 'bum sde dang: khyad par dam tshig phyi nang gsang ba gsum lhag pa'i dam tshig rtsa ba yan lag la: nyams chags zhig ral 31ra ba mthol lo bshags rje btsun bla ma rnams kyi spyan lam du yo byad 'byor tshogs chung ba mthol lo bshags: yi dam lha tshogs rnams kyi spyan lam du mngon rtogs spang len bgyis pa mthol lo bshags: mkha' 'gro sde bzhi rnams kyi spyan lam du khas blangs dam bcas nyams pa mthol lo bshags: chos skyongs srung ma rnams kyi spyan lam du: gtor ma lo zlar 'das pa mthol lo bshags dus gsum pha ma rnams kyi spyan lam du: drin lan lan gyi ma lon mthol lo bshags: mched dang lcam dral rnams kyi spyan lam du:

ba:tshu dam tshig brtse gdung chung ba mthol lo bshags: so sor thar pa rnams kyi sdom pa dang byang chub sems dpa'i bslab bya ral pa dang: rig pa 'dzin pa rnams kyi dam tshig rnams: 'gal zhing nyams par gyur pa ci mchis pa: snying nas bshags so tshangs pa'i dngos grub stsol: de ltar brjod pas dam tshag nyams chags dag gling chen rab 'bogs rgyud dang mthun pa'i sgra rnam par bsgrang na ngan song dub zhi dpal ldan rdo rje sems dpa'i sras su 'gyur the tshom med do gu ru padma'i bka' sa ma pā ye ma rgyal ba'i dbang po padma saṃ bha was ma 'ongs 'gro la zugasarje brtse ba yis snying dang 'dra ba' gdamasapa rmad byung ba 'brog mi lo tsā khye'u chung khyed la gtad da dung spel ba'i dus la ma bab pas snyigasama'i nad mtshon gzang pa 'joms pa'i phyor chos dang gang zag bstan pa'i btses su smon zab gsang brda la thob cig sa ra bye mdo khams rdo rje'i rdzong la dgong rgya sdoms ma 'ongs sum cu kha ral 'khrugs rtsod sdang de tshe nga sprulanusaldan rdo rje yis rnyed nas bstan dang 'gro la phan bde spel gdul bya 'bum phrag 'og min zhing la 'god 'gro don bsam mi khyab pa'i rten 'brel yod bka' gsang thub par srungs shig lha bu srang dam log lag tu ma shor a tham rgya las can snying gi bu dang 'phrad par shog sa ma yu rgya rgya rgya bshags pa ye shes

sgon me zhe bya ba rdzogasaso garter rgya gtad rgya sbasargya zab rgya gsang rgya gu rgya o rgyan gyi slob dpon padma mibha wa'i bka' bdag 'dra mkhar chen gza bkod pa'o brda thim snyi klong yang rdo rje'agyur mad rgya mcho dang klong gsal don rtogasadharmā kumud grags klong chen bde ba'i ḍazhi la sogs pas klong mdzod bkrol bar yang yang bskur ba'i ngor klong rdol rnal 'byor nu ldan dorjesayis klong yangs bshags pa brjod med rdo rje'i sgras/ klong gi rom rtsol slob bu dharmā'i bris/ klong chen dbying su 'gro kham dong sprug shog sarba masgo lam/

badzra zab gsang rdo rje snying po las thugs rje go po dri med padma dkar po'i dgos chos rdzas bzhi'i bskang ba tshogs ོ rab rdzogs zhes bya ba bzhugs so badzra na mo gu ru padma kā ra ye:〈mi4711 rgyal ba kun gyi phrin las ma byung ba sna tshogs thabs mkhas spyod pas 'gro ba 'dul ngan song sgo gcod thar lam ded dpon mchog thugs rje go po' sku la phyag 'tshal lo ma 'ongasalasaldan skal bzang pho mo rnams gsang sngags rdo rje'i lam la zhugs pa'i tshe dam tshig nyamasachagaganyes lhung dag pa'i phyir tshog gnyis rdzog thabs bsod nams mtha' pasadapade yi cha lag sa bzhi'i bskang ba bstan sa ma shā la kyi rdo rje rnam 'byur mdzes pa yis bharnya g.yas btags bdud rtsi dor byas te skyid uhūṃ:mtshan ldan bhanta yangs pa'i nang dkar dmar byang chub sems bcud gtams dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams la 'bul:bskong gyur dbang dang dngos grub stsol dum gcig ka pā la yi nang:ko ro tsa na'i bcud chen 'byil:dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thugs dam bskangs:bskang gyur dbang dang dngos grub stsol:chos dbyings stong pa'i bhasto ru byang chub sems kyi bdud rtsis bkangs bskang gyur dbang dang

dngos grub stsol dag mnyam rol ba'i bhanta ru ye shes lnga ldan bdud rtsi'i bkang dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thugs dam bskangs: bskang gyur dbang dang dngos grub stsol:dam tshig nyam chags nyes lhung kun: bshags so dag cing tshangs par stsol: slar yang rakta'i sgod btegs skyems bsgrengs te o ba( mtshan ldan lcang lo'i snod nang du: mdangs ldan rakta 'bar ba'i bskang dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thugs dam bkangs: bskang gyur dbang dang dngos grub stsol tsitta rtsa yi bhanta rtsa gu hya mu la raktas bkang: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thugs dam bskangs bskang gyur dbang dang dngos grub stsol mtshan ldan rdzas kyi bhanta ru: gīdhi dmar mo'i raktas bkang dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thugs dam bskangs bskang gyur dbang dang dngos grub stsol rang byung bde ba'i bhanta rtsa rtsi bcud 'byung ba'i rakta'i bkang: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thugs dam bskangs bskang gyur dbang dang dngos grab stsol: mtshan lngan padru'i sngod nang du: bde stsong dga' ba'i raku'i bkangs: dkyil 'khor lnga tshogs thugs dam bsangs basmang gyar dbang dang dngos

ba tshu grub stsol: khams gsum 'khor ba rnam dag nas: sku gsungs thugs su sangs rgyas shog: slar yang padma'i snod btegs gtor ma bstab oṃ āḥhū: phyi snod 'jig rten gtor gzhong du nang bcud gtor ma 'dod yon brgyan dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thugs dam bskangs: bskang gyur dbang dang dngos grub stsol: lngags pa yangs pa'i gzhong pa phu phung khams skye mched gtor chen bshams: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thugs dam bskangs: bskang gyur dbang dang dngos grub stsol: kun gzhi yangs pa'i gzhong pa phutshogs brgyad gtor ma sems byung brgyan: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thugs dam bskangs: bskang gyur dbang dang dngos grub stsol 'dod yon zhen 'dzin rnams dag nas bde ba chen po'i dpal thob shog slar yang snang gsal btegs la 'di skad do yo uhū rdzas kyi skong bu brgya rtsa rtsa zhun mar gyis gtams sgron me sbar: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thugs dam bskangs: bskang gyur dbang dang dngos grub stsol: ma rig mun pa kun bcom nas: ye shes chen po'i sa thob shog: de nas smon lam gdab pa 'ad skad do oṃ uhā rmad byung

gsang ba mchog gi dkyil 'khor du 'od gsal rdo rje snying po'i don rtogs pa'i rdo rje sgob dpon mched dang lcam dral rnams: bla med tshogs kyi 'khor lo la brten nas:phyir mi ldog pa'i sa la phyin par 31ga: bshes gnyen dam pa'i bka' drin gyis brkyang ba'i yang dag lam zhugs dam pa thams cad dang: bzang ngan las kyis 'brel ba'i skye bo kun kheng 'khrugs dug lnga'i g.yul las rab rgyal te kun tu 'od kyi sa la phyin par shog: gsang chen lam zhugasarnal 'byor pho mo la dam tshig nyams chags skyon kyis mi gos par yang gsang rdo rje gsum gyi don rtogs nas 'bras bu bla na med pa'i dpal thob shog: mishes zhabrul pa'i snang ba rab zhi zhing ma rig mun pa'i dri tshogs skad cig dag nyon mongs shes byas sgrib pa kun bcom nas: bla med kun tu bzang po'i sa thob shog: 'khrul snang rigs drug lam la 'phyang ba yi: pha ma yongs la snang gsal 'od chen brdal: ma rig gnyis 'dzin dri ma kun bcom nas: bcu gsum rdo rje'i sa la phyin par shog: de ltar smon pas dam tshig nyams chags dag tshe dang bsod nams nyams rtogs yon ma

bsgoX rgyas gang 'brel rgyud la thar ba'i sa bon theb byin rlabs rno nusagazhan la khyad par 'phags bden rdzun lag tu long dang nges shesagasal rgyal dbang padma'i thugs bcud zab mo 'di 'brog mi lo tsā chosamadzod 'dzin la gtad da dung spel ba'i dus la ma bab pas rin chen brdar bstim rdo rje'i rdzong la sbos ma 'ong snyigasam nga sprul snying gi bu nus ldan rdo rje zhes byasalegs par rted bstan dang 'gro ba'i don chen gegasamed 'byung zab gsang thub par srung shig lha bu mched skal med lag tu ma shor a tham rgya som yu rgya rgya rgya rdosabazhi'i bskang ba tshogs chen rab rdzog rdzogasaso gter rgya gtad rgya sbasargya zab rgya gsang rgya gu rgya mo rgyan gyi slob dpon padma se bha wa'i bka' bdag 'dra mkhar chen gzasabakod pa'o brda thim snyi kun nas dad mosanyid rgyasa'agyur rgyam dang/ kun bzang dgos par blta ba'idharma pa/ kun 'byung 'khor bar zhen log rasnas/kun gyi yang yang bskul ba don ldan phyir/ kun bzang nyi ma 'bod ni nusaldan pas/ kun dga' ra ba'i bsil khang rnam par bzhengs/ kun gzugs yi ge'i ris byed smon semasaso/ kun rmong 'gro khams ma lu dong sprug shog sarba ma 'a pa/

ba tshu zab gsang rdo rje snying po las: thugs rje chen po padma dkar po'i chos sde: rig 'jin brgyud pa'i bskang ba nor bu'i do shal zhes bya ba bzhugs so badzra namo gu ru padma ka ra ye shā su khya〉〉〉 rab 'byams rgyal ba' ye shes rdo rje'i sku chags thog bral ba'i mkhyen brtse' 'od 'bar ba thugs rje chen po dri med pad dkar las sgo gsum gus pa chen po'i phyag 'tshal lo ma 'ongs las ldan skal bzang pho mo rnams gsang chen sgor zhugs nyams chags sbyangs ba'i phyir ga ṇa tsakra'i 'khor lo bskor ba'i tshe med du mi rung rig 'dzin rgyud bskang 'di rol mo sgra dang snyan pa'i dbyangs bcas te hū hrī: kun khyab brdal ba chos kyi dbyings nyid la: kun gzigs ye shes ma 'dres thams cad mkhyen: kun mkhyen rgyal ba yongs kyi gtsug gi rgyan:kun bzang 'od mi 'gyur ba'i thugs dam bskangs: rnam kun mchog ldan chos sku'i mkha' dbyings las: rnam rol ma 'gags longs sku'i tshul 'chang ba: rnam sprul byang chub sems dpar chos 'khor bskor: rnam dag rdo rje 'chang chen thugs dam bskangs: ma chags spros mtha' bral ba dag pa'i dbyings: ma 'gags zang thal 'ub chub rol pa'i

gdangs:ma rig mun sel 'gro ba yongs kyi mgon:ma bcos rdo rje sems dpa'i thugs dam bskangs:dmigs gtad bral ba dbyings su byang chub kyang:dmigs med thugs rje'i rol stsal 'phos pa las:dmigs bcas 'gro ba yongs kyi gtsug gi rgyan dmigs bral dga' rab rdo rje'i thugs dam bskangs:mkhas shing grub brnyes yongs kyi gtsug tu spud mkhas pa'i brda thabasagar gyi yang gsang ston:mkhas grub grags pa'i ba dan phyogs kun brdal:mkhas mchog shrī seng he'i thugs dam bskangs zag med thams cad mkhyen pa'i ting 'dzin gyis:zag bcas 'gro ba 'dul ba'i sgo gzigs pa zag pa skye 'chi gnyis spang rdo rje'i sku:zag bral padma 'byung gnas thugs dam bskangs:bod khams mun gling chos kyi sgron me sbar:bod 'bangs yongs la brtse bas lo tsā bsgyur:bod kyi mig gcig khye'u chung ye shes sku bod skyong 'brog mi lo sa'i thugs dam bskangs:lha mo dbyangs can mi yi zol tshul 'dzin:lhar bcas 'gro ba yongs kyi mgon gcig pu:lha gcig padma kā ra'i dgyes bskang dpal:lha lcam ye shes

bsgotshu mtsho rgyal thugs dam bskangs: mchog dman bar gsum 'gro ba thams cad la: mchog thun rgyu 'bras drang nges sgo phyes nas: mchog gsang bsam yas lhun grub chos 'khor bskor: mchog sprul rje 'bangs nyer lnga'i thugs dam bskangs: brtul zhugs gar gyis gdugs pa ma lus 'dul: brtul shugs ldan pas 'gro khams dbyings su 'dren: brtul byed rig pa'i gzung 'dzin dbu mar sgrol: brtul mdzad grum gyi mkhar nag thugs dam bskangs: he brag gsang ba'i grub gnas la brten nas: he ha stong nyid snying rjes yongs la brdal: he dbyings 'gyur med gshis su 'gro khams sgrol: he pa chos kyi 'byung gnas thugs dam bskangs bdud bzhi'i g.yo ba rang sar rab sgrol zhing: bdud 'dul gzhan snang zil gnon seng ge'i sgra: bdud rtsi zad med gter gyi sgo 'byed pa: bdud 'dul rdo rje rtsal gyis thugs dam bskangs: rol rtsal chos khams rgya mtsho'i snang ba la: rol pa chen po'i bdud rtsis bsil zer phab: rol gar 'gro ba yongs kyi skyabs gcig pu: rol stsal he ru ka yi thugs dam bskangs: gdul bya

tshogs smon gyis bsdus 'gro ba la gdul byed ston pa mi yi zol tshul 'dzin: gdul dka' 'dul mdzad rdo rje khro lod dngos: gdul mdzad bdud 'joms gling pa'i thugs dam bskangs snyigs ma'i 'gro ba phongs rgud nyes pa'i gzir: snyigs dus skyobs mdzad lha lnga las gzhan dben: snyigs mtshang phyogs rnams 'joms pa'i brtul zhugs can: snyigs ma'i mgon gcig dpa' bo'i thugs dam bskangs: chos dbyings yengs pa'i klong las ma g.yos bzhin chos kyisgo 'byed yongs la rnam par brdal: chos med 'gro khams smin cing grol byed pa'i: chos mdzad bla ma rnam kyi thugs dam bskangs: gzhan snang bkod pa'i rnam 'phrul mtha' yas pa gzhan 'phrul lha yi nor las khyad par 'phags: gzhan yang kun bzang rol pa'i mchod sprin kyang: gzhan 'dzin blo bral chen pos mchod cing bskangs: 'khor gsum yongs su dag pa'i sprin mchod kyis 'khor 'das mnyam nyid dag pa'i bla ma'i dal: 'khor bcas dgyes pa bskangs ba'i byin rlabs kyis 'khor ba dbyings rol chos sku chen po āḥ de ltar smon pas re 'bras gegs med 'grub

gtsakhri nyams rtog yon tan yar ngos zla ltar 'phel tshe bsod dpa la dgyes don gnyis gegs med 'grub the tshom med do rdo rje rgyal po' bka' sa ma mā yemargyal ba'i dbang po padma saṃ bha wa'i ma 'ongs 'gro la brtse ba chen po yis snying dang 'dra bas yang zab rmad byung ba grub pa' dbang phyugasakhye'u chung khyod la gtad da dung spel ba'i dus la ma bab pas rin chen brda ris mdzad cig sar bye mdo khams rdo rje'i brag la dgongs pra sdoms ma 'ongs snyigagam sum cu kha ral dus dpa' bo nus ldan rdo rje zhes byas rted bstan pa'i 'gro don lho dang byang nas 'gro gdul bya 'bum phrag 'og min zhing la 'god 'gro don bsam ma khyabs pa'i rten 'brel yod bka' 'di thub par srungs shig spu gri gsum dam nyams lag tu ma shor lha bu mched las can thugs kyi sras dang 'phrad par shog sa ma yu rgya rgya rgya rig 'dzan brgyud pa' bskang ba byin rlabs bang mdzod rdzogs so gter rgya gtad rgya sbas rgya zab rgya gsang rgya gu rgya o rgyan gyi slob dpon padma tho bha wa'i bka' bdag 'dra mkhar chen gzas bkod pa'o brda thim lha gtad gtad byung rgyal tshab tshub dharmadang / gtad bral nam mkha'i rnal 'byor 'gyur ba med/ gtad cang dad 'dun che ba sgon skyabasadang gtad rgya sad pa 'i lde mig ratna sogs/ gtad du gnas pa slob ma du mas ngor/ gtad pa 'i gter sgo 'byed pa nusaldan pas/ gtadabarda yi ge'i ris phabasgon sem
sogs/ gtad yul 'gro khams dong sprugs nus par shog sarba maṅga lam//

badzra: zab gsang rdo rje snying po las: thugasarje chen po dri med padma dkar po'i: bskang ba shel dkar phreng ba zhes bya bzhugs so:btsa/: na 31 ārya 31 ki shwa ra ye: 111—— —1 ma chagasadre bral ye sangs rgyas pa'i sku thugs rje phyogs ris bral ba'i ye shes dbyangs zung 'jug rig sku 'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs mi 'bral bde chen 'khor lo'i rgyan du mchod ma 'ongs snyegasam lnga brgya'i sems can la phan pa 'i gso sman yin bzhin nor lta bu'i gdams pa dri bral rdo rje snying po' bcud thugs chen dra med padma dkar po bstan sa ma yā de pang ga ṇa tsakra bskor ba'i tshe nye bar mkho ba'i bska ba zab mo ni phyi nang gsang gsum mchod pa'i yo byad bkram ma sngags phyag rgya chen pos byin gyas brlabs 'dod yon nam mkha' yangs pa'i mdzod du spel kun tu bzang po' rol pa la dmigs shings snyan ba 'i dbyangs da rol mo' sgra bcas te hū hṝ: ka dag skye med dbyings su byang chub kyang: ma 'gags snying rje'i rang mdangs zer 'bar ba'i 'gro ba yongs kyi skyabs gcig spyan ras gzigs: dri med padma dkar po'i thugs dam bskangs ma chags padma ra ga'i mdangs 'dzin cing ma lus 'gro kun bde chen zhing la 'god: srid

dang zhi ba'i mtha' las rnam grol ba'i rigs bdag snang ba mtha' yas thugs dam bskangs: dgos 'dod ma lus char ltar rab 'beb cing: sgrub pa po rnams bu bzhin skyong bar byed ngan song 'khor ba'i sgo gcod thar lam 'god: sras mchog nor bu 'dzin pa'i thugs dam bskangs: zab lam gsang ba sngags kyi bstan pa ni: phyogs bcu kun tu spel zhing dar bar byed ye shes snying pos 'gro khams dong sprugs pa'i: rgyal yum gsang sngags 'dzin ma'i thugs dam bskangs tshogs brgyad rtog pa rang sar gcod byed cing: sna tshogs thabs kyis 'khor ba kha lo bsgyur: 'gro drug duḥkha dbyings su rab bsgral ba'i: byang chub sems dpa' brgyad kyi thugs dam bskangs chags bral bde chen dga' bzhi'i 'phrul rtsal 'gyed: rgyal kun ma lus thugs kyi mnyes bskyed ma 'gro ba lcag kyus bde chen lam la gzud: rigs bzhi pho nya'i tshogs kyi thugs dam bskangs tshad med rnam bzhis 'gro ba 'dul bar byed: zhi rgyas dbang dang drag po'i las rnams sgrub: sna tshogs thabs kyi sgo bzhi bsrung bar byed: pho nya rta mgrin rigs bzhi'i thugs

ba:tshu dam bskangs ye shes ma 'gags kun snang thugs rje'i zer:sna tshogs 'od brgyas 'gro ba 'dul mdzad cing byams dang snying rje'i gru char 'bebs mdzad pa'i:dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams kyi thugs dam bskangs:sangs rgyas bstan pa rin chen bsrung ba dang:zab gsang bla med phyogs bcur dar rgyas byed:gdug pa'i dgra bgegs ma lus drungs 'byin pa'i:skyes chen lha bu ming sring thugs dam bskangs:hū hrī:thugs dam gnyan po bskang ba'i dam rdzas ni:lha rdzas phyi mchod rnam pa bdun dang ni:rang byung nang gi 'dod yon rnam pa lnga:gsang ba'i mchod pa ga ṇa tsakra'i gter:med byung sman gtor rakta byang chub sems:rdo rje'i rigs ma glu gar dbyangs kyi sgra:bza' bca' btung ba ldag gzhib 'dod dgu'i gter:dza gad snang gsal sbos mchog me sa dang reg bya sna tshogs 'bras bu mang po yis:thugs dzeechen po'i lha tshogs thugs dam bskangs:dngos po chos nyid yangs pa'i klong du bskangs snang ba ye shes chen po'i klong du bskangs:gsal ba shes rab 'bar ba'i klong du bskangs:sdug bsngal ka dag chos

nyid klong du bskangs kun rdzob don dam gnyis med klong du bskangs bskang gyur dbang dang dngos grub stsal du gsol: yi ge brgya pa bzla zhing bzod pa gsol gnad des tshogs rdzogs sgrib dag dbang bzhi thob sa ma mā ye ma rgyalaba'i dbang po padma saṃ bha was ma 'ongasa'agro la brtse ba chen po yis thugasakyi yang bcud rdo rje snying po'i chos las ldan grub pa'i dbang phyug khyed rnams la yongasasu bstan no da lta spel dus min rin chen brdar chug rtse shod gsham du sbos ma 'ongasasnyigasam sum cu kha ra dus nga spruladapa' bo nusaldan rdo rje dang 'phrad na 'gro la phan bde spel ba dang 'brel tshad rgyud la thar lam zhog pa dang gsang sngagasachosakyi sgron me sbar bar 'gyur the tshom med do rdo rje rgyal po'i bka' skal med lag tu ma shor spu gri gsum lasacan rig pa 'dzin dang 'phrad gyur cig sam mā rgya rgya rgya bskang ba shel dkar phreng ba rdzogs so gter rgya gtad rgya sba rgya zab rgya gsang rgya gu gye mo rgyan gyi slob dpon padma saṃ bha pa'i bka' bdag 'dra mkhar chen bzasabakod pa'o brda thim lha ces pa 'di'ang chosakyi bdag popadma chosa'apel rgya mtsho dang /chosabadag 'gyur med rgya mtsho/ chos bdag ratna sar rnams kyis pang yang bsdul ba dang slob bu padma rnam rgyal gyis dar dang rin chen gnyisapa'i rdo rje ldem sgro dbang lnga'i cod paṇa dang bcas nan tan gyis bskul ngor/ bdag 'dradapa' bo
gnye( nusaldan rdo rjesamakha' 'gro gsang ba'i brda' ris las sa ༅sa te dag par phab pa dge leg 'phel sabo maṅga lam/

'tshan gnam phud gnas mul bskang ba ni tshogs rdzas skyems phud bshams nas slar spyo ye shes dbyings dang 'jig rten khams bzhugs pa'i: dpa' bo dpa' mo ma dang mkha' 'gro'i sde: dpon g.yog 'khor bcas sngon gyis tha tshig bzhin tshogs dang skyems bzhes phrin las 'grub par mdzod: khyad par bod yul mod khams tsa ri tra: bkra shis rdzong chen gnas kyi bsrung ma ni: zhing skyong gzi 'bar yab yum 'khor dang bcas: sngags bdag yaka nag mo tsa ti dmar: sha za chen mo rdo rje ngas nus ma sman btsun nyer gcig sbas yum lnga bcu brgyad: ma mo sum brgya las mdzad drug bcu dang: gnyer skyong sum brgya dam can rdo rje legs drang sgong chen po spu gri mched gsum dang: klu bdud btsan dang 'byung ba lnga yi bdag: dzam lha mched drug rdo rje g.yar mo btsun: dpon g.yog 'khor bcas rgyan cha pu ru sa rol mo sil snyan sgra dbyangs 'u ru rtsa sgrub pa po la gdung shugs nyi li li rdo rje'i dam rtags 'od 'bar lams se lam: bshugs glu bro gar sna tshogs sangs se sang 'du ba tshogs kyis longs spyod spungs se spung: dgyes pa chen pos rol

la brtse ba'i skyongs: rnal 'byor phrin las rab 'byams sgrub pa dang: zab gsang bsgom la bar chad med pa dang: 'khu ldog ma byed byams dang brtse ba'i skyongs: ma g.yel bdag gi phrin las shākyab par mdzod bka' dang dam la ma 'da' sa ma yā: snyen ma hā gha ṇa tsakra la kha nyi: ces brjod tshogs skyems gtsang sar gshegs gang bcol phrin las thogs med 'grub gter gyi srung ma'i 'khru sdog zhi tshogs gnyis yongs su rdzogs pa dang don rnams lhun gyis grub pa yis cha lag phud bskang zab mo 'o sa ma yā rgya rgya rgya ces pa' bskang ba'i zab mo na/ khro tshul che ba'i a paṇa ro ra/ 'tshub cha che ba kun nyis bris/ 'byul zhig che ba' slob tshogs la/ nyal chog che ba'i don du phul/ dge ba' 'gro rnams sangs rgyasashog sarba masgo lam/

me tshu nye bar mkho ba'i tho gsos ni mchod gtor zhal shis bgo du bshams bsangs sbyangs byan rlabs grub pa 'i rjes rang nyid lha yi nga rgyal gyis: sgo bzhi skyongs ba'i tha tshig can: rgyal chen 'khor bcas sa ma dza: dza hūṃ baṃ ho re yam̐ kho: o āhwa nam mkha' mdzod sngags da oṃ dha ta raṣṭa ye swā pa ri wa ra e dam 67 bee ru ta ka ye 37 bee ru bakta ye ma tho shra ma ṇa ye bee phyogs skyongs rgyal chen sde bzhi po rang rang g.yog 'khor dpung dang bcas 'dir gshegs mchod gtor skyems bzhes la: sgrub pa po yi phrin las kun thogs med stsol cig dam tshig can: sgo bya khro bo ba na pa ni salas bhanta yangs pa'i nang gtor ma zag med bdud rtsir gyur 'o ātt+waṃ ho: 37 badzra kro ta ya man ta ka sa ma ya e dam bha ling ta kha kha khā hi khā hi: lan bdun gyis phul la ho dkyil 'khor phyi yi sgo srung ba: khro rgyal gshin rje gshed po yis: 'dod yon mchod pa rab bzhes la gzhal yas chen po'i sgo srung shig: dngos grub rku zhing 'phrog pa'i rigs: ma lus thal ba'i rdul bzhin rlog: sgrub pa'i 'bras bu mchis par mdzod: byin rlabs gong ltar grub pa 'i rjes oṃ badzra kro ta

a dṛ ta kun li sarba sa ma ya e dam ho dkyil gsar nang gi sgo srung ba'i khro chen rdo rje bgegs mthar gyis 'dod yon mchod pa rab bzhes la: phyi nang gsang ba'i dam rgya srung: dus drug nyul zhing 'khor ba'i bgegs chos kyi dbyings su bsgral ba dang: rtags mtshan mi 'khyang mi g.yel bar sgrub pa po la stsal du gsol: dam la ma 'da' sa ma mā: sgrub dus na ma chad pa ru nyin bzhin gtor ma 'di btang ba'i gegs rnams zhi zhing phrin lasa'agrub ya mtshan rmad byung dngos grub 'bebs sam yu 'di yang nyer mkho' cha lag zhunu ldan rdo rje bris pa dge sarba maṅga lam/

badzra zab gsang rdo rje snying po las thugs rje chen po dri med padma dkar po'i bstan srung lha bu ming sring gi bskang ba bdud rtsi'i bum bcud bzhugs so:badzra na mo arya lo ki shwa ra ya: /8)skosbyar// ma 'ongs las ldan pho mo rnams yang gsang lam la zhugasapa'i tshe phrin las lhun gya grub pa'i phyir bskang ba bdud rtsi' bum bcud bstan sa ma mā mthun pa'i nyer spyod yo byad bkrams bsangs sbyangs byin rgyas brlabs nas slar rang nyad lha yi nga rgyal gyis snyan pa'i dbyangs bcas 'di skad do hūṃ hrī: dmigs med mkha' ltar dag pa chos kyi dbyings lhun grub bde ba chen po'i pho brang nas: rgyal bstan srung ba'i pho nya lha bu mched 'khor tshogs sprul pa dpung bcas spyan 'dren gshegs bla rdo srog 'khor rten la brtan bar bzhugs rgyal bstan nub med srung phyir gus phyag 'tshal : gdung dbyangs rol mo'i sgra yi bstod par bgyi: phyi nang gsang gsum mchod sprin mtha' yas pas bstan srung lha yi rgyal po'i dgyes pa bskangs pa3 a dṛ stong sbar mchod pa yis mthu chen lha mo chen mo'i dgyes pa bskangs 'dod yon mchod sgrin nam mkha' mtha' yas pas lha

'khor bsam mi khyab pa'i thugs dam bskangs: dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i sha khrag skyems mchod kyis 'khor tshogs sprul par bcas pa'i thugs dam bskangs: sman gtor rakta bdud rtsi skyems phud kyis: 'khor tshogs sprul par bcas pa'i thugs dam bskangs sman gtor rakta bdud rtsi skyems phud kyis: yang g.yog bsam mi khyab pa'i thugs dam bskangs: khyed rnams thugs dam bskang ba'i byin rlabs kyis: nad mug dus 'khrugs rgud pa mtha' dag sol: bod yul bkra mi shes pa'i nyer 'tshe bzlog: tshe dpal 'byor ba yar ngos zla ltar 'phel: gdul bya mdzad phrin nub med gong 'phel mdzod: khams gsum srid gsum mos bzhi dbang du bsdus: rnal 'byor dben khrod 'grims pa'i 'tsho ba sbyor sgyu lus dngas ma'i 'ja' sku 'grub pa dang ri bo gru 'dzin zhing du lam sna drongs rnal 'byor bcol ba'i las mdzod sa ma yā: ces brjod gtor skyems gtsang sar gshegs pa ra bya phrin las gang bcol gegs med yid bzhin 'grub phyi nang bar chad bdud kya g.yul las rgyal don gnyis lhun gyis grub par the tshom med sa ma wā dhi ma rgyal bayidabang po padma saṃ bha was ma 'ongs 'gro

bsgo/: la brtse ba chen po yis snying dang 'dra ba'i yang zab rmad byung ba grub pa'i dbang phyugs khye'u chung khyod la gtad da dung ma spel ran chen brda la thob mdo khams rdo rje'i rdzong du dgongs rgya sdoms ma 'ongs snying ma sum cu kha ral dus nga sprul las can gcig gis rnyed par 'gyur bstan dang 'gro la phan bde nya ma spel dgos ched rmad byung 'gro don bsam mi khyabs bka' gsang thub pa ra srungs shag la bu mched skal med lag tu ma shor sbu gri gsum dam ldan thugs kyi sras dang 'phrad par shog sa ma yā rgya rgya rgya bstan srung bskang ba bdud rtsi bum bcud rdzogs so gter rgya gtad rgya sbas rgya zab rgya gsang rgya gu rgya o rgyan gyi slob dpon padma saṃ bha wa'i bka' bdag 'dra mkhar chen gzas bkod pa 'o brda thim ñtsā ga dran chal chol smra ba dharma dang / gang la zhal ta 'doms pa 'gyur rgyam dpal/ gang zhig kha lce bde baX na skyabasadang / gang dag rnamasagaye kairte rang grol zungs/ gang nas tsab tsub dal med ratna sogs/ gang yang ru ba slob ma/ du ma'i ro ra/ gang zag nyin 'khrul mtshan 'khrul nus ldan pas/ gang dran mkha' 'gro'i brda yig klong nas rdol/ gang gzugs yi ge'i ris byed smon sems sogs/ gang la ga 'dul 'gro khams dong sprugs re ga sarba masgo lam/
0〈tshu zab gsang rdo rje snying po las thugs rje chen po dri med padma dkar po'i: gshin po rjes 'dzin ngan song g.yul 'joms thugs rje'i lcags kyu bzhugs so:

gtsaX na tho ārya lo ki shā ra ye: 45 1 thugs rje 'od zer bye ba'i rlabs phreng gas 'gro ba'i kha lo bde chen dbyings la bsgyur sangs rgyas bstan pa'i srog shing 'dzan mdzad pa' dra med padma dkar por phyag bgyi'o ma 'ong snyigasam sems can dmu rgod rnams ye shes thugs rje' rjes su zin pa 'i thabs man ngag ches chung don chen 'grub pa'i sgo myur lam dri med padma dkar po yi zab sgrub phan bde'i dpal ster chen po yi cha lag gshin po rjes su 'dzin pa'i thabs ngan 'gro'i g.yeng skyobs thugs rje' lcags kyu bstan sa ma wā de mang bskyed rdzogasagazhung bsrangs bskang tshogs dang mchod gsol bum gnyas sgrub cang bdag 'jug sogs rang nyad 'jug pa' chos rnams grub pa'i rjes gshin po rjes su 'dzan pa ra bya ba la las ram rnam pa nya shu dag gi bstan dang po mang byangabaskyed pa ra bya ba na ces ma hā do/ hye ta dzñā na badzra su bha wa adma ko3nya: mdun gyi rten snangastong pa'i ngang nyid las: dri75sa tshe 'das phung khams skye mched rnams: gzhon tshul pu'i btsug thal sbyar me tog bsnams: zhi ba'i tshul can ras dkar gos su gyon: bla ma lha la dad gus gyis gnas bsam: bdag nyid thugs rje chen po'i thugs ka nas: 'od zer ye shes sna lnga rab 'phros pa'i: tshe 'das rnam shes

—4( 'jig rten bdun po'i yul: gang na gnas kyang bkug ste gzugs la bstims: gnyis pa bden brjod 'gugs pa bya ba ni na ma mchog gsum sku gsum rtsa gsum bden pa dang: yi dam thugs rje chen po'i mthu stobs kyis tshe 'das rnam shes srid gsum gar gnas kyang: myur ba nyid du mtshan byang rten la khug: brgya rtsa nyer gcig dgu sogs skabs dang bstun gsum pa rten dang dbyer med bstims pa ni hrī: 'dir snang 'j-ig rten las thal tshe 'das khyod: 'gro drug khams gsum gar skyes sdug bsngal gzeb: de las 'don phyir gzugs mings yid chags rdzas dmigs rten mtshan byang 'di dang gnyis med khug: dzaḥ( bo ho dachags yul che 'das kyi rnam par shes pa tiṣṭha badzra sa mā ya lhan: bzhi pa lan chags bsngo ba'i rim pa ni 'theb skru chang bu ting lo bsangs sbyangs bya stong pa'i ngang las (ཿlas rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du lan chaṭa glud kyi gtor ma kha tog dri ro regs bya nus pa phun sum tshogs pa 'dod pa'i sku na tan lnga dang ldan par gyur: yin yi (: lan gsum dang nas ka zo yis spel nam mkha'i mdzod sngags saṃ bha ra yis spros dang po zhi ba'i sbyangs

ba 'di ltar ro skyid a hū na ma sabo ta tha ga ta bhyo bhi shwa mi khe rbhe sarba tatt+waṃ 56na te spa ra ṇa e me ga ga na khaṃ skṛ sto bā lirnyi ye swā hā: lan gsum brjod la 'theb skru cog rdog bsngo de nas phyed mar sbyangs ba'i rim pa ni ces sum bha ni sum bha rtse: snyisto gri sto /: gri snyo pa ya gri sto pa ya /: a na ya ho bha ga wan: birya ra dza kro dha ya hūṃ phaṭa: lan gsum brjod la ting lo chang bu bsngo de nas drag por sbyangasaba'i rim pa la lnga pa bgegasatshogasabasgrad la brngan pa na hū je: ma dag khamadangagasum 'khor bar 'phen pa yi: las nyon rgyu'i bskyed za 'dre shi btagad rnams: gnas 'dir ma 'khor glud gtor 'di khyer la: rang rang so so'i gnas su phyir dnges shig: hū hūsnga tsa ta ya phaṭa: drag sngags brjod cing thun dzos brab byas la bar chad bgeg bdud ma lus stong par byed drug pa bsrung ba'i 'bor lo bsgom pa ni hū hrī snang srid snod bcud rdo rje gsum gyi ngang: bar chad bgegs kyi ming yang ma mchis so 'on kyang glo bur kun rtog 'khrul ba'i gdon rang grol chos dbyings ngang du mtshams bcad do: o badzra dzā na sa ma ya rakṣa rakta sbyo: bdun pa sdig sgrib bsreg sbyangs rim pa ni dhi: ye shes lnga ldan rdo rje 'bar ba'i me slob dpon dri

'a tshu med pad dkar sku las 'phros: tshe 'das sna bug nas drangs lus kun gang: rigs drug sa bon rang bzhin med par bsregs: rtsa sngags mthar aḥniḥsreḥtriḥpreḥduḥdzaḥsarba bha smi ku ru ye swā hā: brgyad pa khrus kya cho ga bya ba la dkyil 'khor lha la sku khrus rgyas pa ra bya de nas skyes bu'i ngan khrus bya ba ni hū hrī bde btagags kun 'dus dri bral thugs rje'i gter: padma dkar po'i la tshogs byin rlabs pa'i: zag med ye shes bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun gyis: tshe 'das lus kyi sgrib pa dag gyur cig: rtsa sngags mthar na maḥsarba ta tha ga ta a bhi ṣe ga te sa ma ye shrī nyu: tshe 'das kyi tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas dus gsum kun tu lus kyi sgo nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib thams cad shirnye ku ru ye swā hā:hūṃ hrī dus gsum rgyal ba'i sras po 'gro ba'i mgon: 'phags mchog rgyal ba'i byin gyis brlabs pa yis: zag med ye shes bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun gyis: tshe 'das ngag gi sgrib pa dag gyur cig: rtsa sngags mthar na maḥsarba ta tha ga ta a byi ṣe ga te sa ma ya dṛ hūṃ: tshe 'das kyi tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas dus gsum kun tu ngag gi sgo nas bsags

pa'i sdig sgrib thams cad shirnyi ku ru ye swā hā: nyu hrī: byams dang snying rje'i zer 'bar spyan ras gzigs: thugs rje chen po'i la tshogs byin rlabs pa'i: zag med ye shes bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun gyis: tshe 'das yid kyi sgrib pa dag gyur cig: rtsa sngags mthar na maḥsarba ta tha ga ta a bhi ṣe ga te sa ma ya shra (:che 'das kyi che 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas dus gsum kun tu yid kyi sgo nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib thams cad shirnyi ku ru ye swā hā: nyu hūṃ: rgyal kun dadza ngas pa'i klong chen thugs rje'i bdag 'phags mchog dri med dkar po'i byin rlabs pa'i: ye shes lnga ldan bdud rtsis khrus bgyi'o: nyon mongs dug lnga'i sgrib pa dag gyur cig: rtsa sngags mthar na maḥsarba ta tha ga ta a bhi ṣe ga te sa ma ya shra shā: tshe 'dasakyitsho 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas dus gsum kun tu nyon mongs pa dug lnga'i sgo nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib thams cad shidzña ku ru ye swā hā:/ hrī: bdegashadagasargyal ba'i sbas mchog thags rje'i bdag: dri med pad dkar po'i byin rwabs pa'i pha rol byen drag dag pa'i rtsa rgyan gyis: tshe 'das dri ma tshom drag dag gyar cig: rtsa sngags

ba tshu mthar na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ga te sa ma ya mṛ nyu: tshe 'das kyi che 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas dus gsum kun tu ma rig dri ma drug gis sgo nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib thams cad shidhe ku ru ye swā hā: dgu pa dug sbyong bya ba'i rim pa ni: 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug gsum 'di dag 'jig rten dug gsum ste: bcom ldan sangs rgyas dug mi mnga': sangs rgyas bden pa'i dug bcom mo 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug gsum: 'di dag 'jig rten dug gsum ste: bcom ldan dam chos dug mi mnga': dam chos bden pa'i dug bcom mo: 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug gsum 'di dag 'jig rten dug gsum ste: bcom ldan dge 'dun dug mi mnga': dge 'dun bden pa'i dug bcom mo: bden pa'i bden tshig 'di dag gis: tshe 'das dug rnams byang gyur cig: / ma rig 'khrul ba'i sgrib pa yis: 'od lnga bdag tu bzung ba las:phyi nang 'byung ba lnga phran zung: dug lnga las nyon bag chags kun: bskyed byed pha ma lta bu'i dug: lha sngags ting 'dzin rol rtsal gyis: dug phyung dug lnga'i sgrib pa rnams

'byung ba so (1'i dbyings su dengs: gzungs 'dzin mkha' ltar dag gyur cig: rtsa sngags sdig sgrib kun 'joms gzungs yig brgya rka ka ni sogs bzla bye ma brab cing dag par sbyangs bcu pa ngo sprod gdab pa'i rim pa ni kyi ho: nyon cig dmigs yul tshe 'das rigs kyi bu: thob dka'i dal 'byor mi lus rnyed na yang las nyon mi dge'i ngang la dus 'da' nas mi rtag 'chi ba glo bur thogs ltar bab: yi chad skyo ba'i bar do'i 'phrang la 'grims: gnyen dang nye 'brel mdza' bshes shul du bor: 'khor ba'i chos la snying po ma mchis pa'i gcer bu lag stong mchan bcug gcig pu na ma zhen ma chags bdag gi bka' la nyon: 'jig rten 'di snang phyi snang rmi lam snang: thams cad bden med rdzun pa'i rang bzhin la:chags 'dzin med par stong pa'i rol bar skyongs nye 'brel bdud kyi lcags sgrog 'khor ba'i 'phrang sems kyi bzos pa'i byis pa'i rtse 'jo ltar 'dod yon rol gar mkha' la 'ja' shar bzhin: dngos po med pa chu la gzugs brnyan 'dra: bden med rmi lam 'dra ba'i rang mtshang can: nges par rtogs nas 'khor ba'i 'khrul snang spongs bden

badzra par ma grub kun bzang dgongs pa skyongs: kun shes kun gsal kun rigs 'gags med 'di: don gyi ye shes yin no ma nor cig: lha dang bla ma dkon mchog rin po che: 'di phyi'i re ltos 'chong shig snying gi bu: yar mar sa 'tshams skad cig bye brag 'dir dad dang mos pa'i shugs chen rab bskyed la ri bo gru 'dzin zhing la phyin par 'acasad: lan gsum bcu gcig rigs drug gnas 'dren bya ba la dmyal ba' g.yang las 'dren par bya ba ni snang yul bkod pa ni skad cig snang ba gnas dza shākyar pa las: zhe sdang las 'bras dmyal ba'i yul snang mched: sgyu ma rmi lam snang ba ji bzhin tu: tshe 'das 'khrul snang sbyangs phyir gsal bar bkod: 'dren pa sprul ba ni hū hrī: nga ni 'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs dbang sku: thugs ga'i trīḥlas chos kyi rgyal po 'phrul: zhe sdang gnas stong ngan song g.yang las skyobs: thugs rje chen pos tshe 'das rjes su zungs: tshogs bsags ni hūṃ bcom ldan bde gshegs chos kyi rgyal po la: dri med dag pa'i zhal zas ro brgya ldan: 'dod yon brgyan ba'i mchod gtor 'di bzhes la: tshe 'das tshogs gnyis yongs

su rdzogs gyur cig: o badzra nee rsha hye āX hūṃ khrus gsol ni hū hrī dag byed me long ye shes chu rgyun gyis: skal ldan rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur ba'i nyon mongs zhe sdang sgrib pa kun dag nas: thugs mchog rdo rje sems dpa'i dpal thob shog o sarba pa pe da hā na shirnyi ku ru ye swā hā lan chags ni hūṃ hrī 'dod yon lnga ldan glud kyi gtor ma 'di:dmyal ba'i bu 31na lan chags sbyangs ba'i phyir: bar chad bdud bgegs lan chags mgron la bsngo: tshim nas thar lam bar chad gegs ma byed: na mtshosarba ta tha ga ta a wa lo ki te oṃ saṃ bha ra saṃ bha ra /: dbang bskur ni hū hrī: ngan songs sgo gcod bcom ldan chos kyi rgyal: 'gro 'dul thub pa chen po'i dbang bskur ro zhe sdang du kha'i gnas stong thar lam gyi: yang dag zhing la bde legs 'byor gyur cig: rtsa sngags dang kā ya a snyi ṣiñtsa sa: de nas gnas spar bsregs sbyangs ni hrī: rang nyed thugs rje chen po'i thugs ka nas:ye shes rnam lnga'i 'od zer me 'bar bas: dmyal ba'i sa bon bag chags dang bcas bsregs: sngang 'dzin las kyi 'khyal 'khor stong gyar cig: bcu gnyis yi dwags gnas 'dren bya

btsa/: ba ni snang yul bkod pa la skad cig snang ba gnas su gyur pa las:ser sna'i las 'bras yi dwags yul snang mched:sgyu ma rmi lam snang ba ji bzhin tu tshe 'das 'khrul snang sbyangs phyir gsal bar bkod:'dren pa sprul ba ni hūṃ hrī:nga ni 'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs dbang sku:thugs ga'i hrīXlas kha 'bar dhe wa 'phrul:'dod chags gnas stong ngan song g.yang las skyobs thugs rje chen pos tshe 'das rjes su zungs:tshogs bsags ni hūṃ:bcom ldan bde gshogs kha 'bar dhe wa la:dri med dag pa'i zhal zas ro brgya ldan:'dod yon brgyan pa'i mchod gtor 'di bzhes la:tshe 'das tshogs gnyis yongs su rdzogs gyur cig:37 badzra ne wa hye a hūṃ:khrus gsol ni hūṃ hrī:dag byed sor rtog ye shes chu rgyun gyis:skal ldan rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur bas:nyon mongs 'dod chags sgrib pa kun dag nas:rigs mchog snang ba mtha' yas dpal thob shog oṃ sarba pa shā da hā na shidzña ku ru ye swā hā:lan chags ni hūṃ hrī:'dod yon lnga ldan glud kyi gtor ma 'di:yi dwags bu lon lan chags sbyangs ba'i phyir:bar chad bdud

bgegs lan chags mgron la bsngo: tshim nas thar lam bar chad gegs ma byed: na maḥsarba ta tha ga ta a wa lo ki te oṃ saṃ bha ra saṃ bha ra hūṃ dbang bskur ni hūṃ hrī ngan song sgo gcod bcom ldan kha 'bar ma: 'gro 'dul thub pa chen po'i dbang bskur ro: 'dod chags duḥkha'i gnas stong thar lam gyi yang dag zhing la bde legs 'byor gyur cig rtsa sngags dang kā ya a snyi ṣiñtsa oṃ: de na gnasaspar bsregs sbyangs ni hrī: rang nyid thugs rje chen po'i thugs ka nas: ye shes rnam lnga'i 'od zer me 'bar bas: yi dwags sa bon bag chags dang bcas bsregs chags 'dzin las kyi 'khrul 'khor stong gyur cig: bcu gsum dud 'gro'i gnas 'dren bya ba ni snang yul bkod pa la skad cig snang ba gnas su gyur pa las rmongs pa'i las 'bras dud 'gro'i snang yul mched: sgyu ma rmi lam snang ba ji bzhin tu: tshe 'das 'khrul snang sbyangs phyir gsal bar bkod 'dren pa sprul ba ni hūṃ hrī nga ni 'phags mchog span ras gzigs dbang sna: thugs ga'i triXlas seng ge rab brtan 'phrul: gti mug gnas stong ngan song g.yang las smobs: thugs rje chen pos tshe 'das
