ba tshu rjes su zungs: tshogs bsags ni hūṃ bcom ldan bde gshegs seng ge rab brtan la: dri med dag pa'i zhal zas ro brgya ldan: 'dod yon brgyan pa'i mchod gtor 'di bzhes la: tshe 'das tshogs gnyis yongs su rdzogs gyur cig: 3 badzra nee zhe hye a /:khrus gsol ni hūṃ hrī dag byed chos dbyings ye shes chu rgyun gyis: skal ldan rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur bas: nyon mongs gti mug sgrib pa kun dag nas: bcom ldan rnam par snang mdzad dpal thob shog: yi sarba pa dzwa da ha na shirnye ku ru ye swā hā:lan chags ni hū hrī 'dod yon lnga ldan glud kyi gtor ma 'di: byol song bu lon lan chags sbyangs ba'i phyir: bar chad bdud bgegs lan chags mgron la bsngo: tshim nas thar lam bar chad gegs ma byed: na maḥsarba ta tha ga ta a wa lo ki te oṃ saṃ bha ra saṃ bha ra hūṃ: dbang bskur ni hūṃ hrī: ngan song sgo gcod bcom ldan seng rab brtan: 'gro 'dul thub pa chen po'i dbang bskur ro: gti mug duḥkha'i gnas stong thar lam gyi: yang dag zhing la bde legs 'byer gyur cig: rtsa sngags mthar kwa ya a snyi 〉〉 tshe: de nas gnas spar

bsregasasbyangs ni trī rang nyid thugs rje chen po'i thugs ka nas ye shes rnam lnga'i 'od zer me 'bar bas dud 'gro'i sa bon bag chags dang bcas bsregs: rmongs 'dzin las kyi 'khrul 'khe ra stong gyur cig: bcu bzhi lha min gnas 'dren bya ba ni snang yul bkod pa la skad cig snang ba gnas su gyur pa las: phrag dog las 'bras lha min snang yul mched:sgyu ma rmi lam snang ba ji bzhin tu tshe 'das 'khrul snang sbyangs phyir gsal bar bkod: 'dren pa sprul ba ni hūṃ hrī nga ni 'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs dbang sku: thugs ga'i hrīḥlas thag bzang rgyal po sprul: phrag dog gnas stong ngan song g.yang las skyobs: thugs rje chen pos tshe 'das rjes su zungs tshogs bsags ni hūṃ bcom ldan bdigashegs thegs bzang ris mchog la: dri med dag pa'i zhal zas ro brgya ldan: 'dod yod brgyan pa'i mchod gtor 'di bzhes la tshe 'das tshogs gnyis pongs su rdzogs gyur cig: ma badzra ne rlu tre a hūṃ: khrus gsol na hūṃ hrī dag byed bya grub ye shes chu rgyun gyis: skal ldan rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur bas nyon mongs phrag dog sgrib pa kun

badzra: dag nas: bcom ldan don yon grub pa'i dpal thob shog: oṃ sarba pa tswa da ha na shirnye ku ru ye swā hā: lan chags na hū trī 'dod yan lnga ldan glud kyi gtor ma 'di: lha min bu lon lan chags sbyangs ba'i phyir: bar chad bdud bgegs lan chags mgron la bsngo: tshim nas thar lam bar chad gegs ma byed:na maḥsabo ta tha ga ta a wa lo ki te oṃ saṃ bha ra saṃ bha ra ( dbang bskur ni hūṃ hrī ngan song sgo gcod bcom ldan thag bzang ris: 'gro 'dul thub pa chen po'i dbang bskur ro: phrag dog duḥkha'i gnas stong thar lam gyi: yang dag zhing la bde legs 'byer gyur cig rtsa sngags mthar kā ya a snye ṣiñtsa tshe: de nas gnas spar bsregs sbyangs ni trī: rang nyid thugs rje chen po'i thugs ka nas: ye shes rnam lnga'i 'od zer me 'bar bas: lha min sa bon bag chags dang bcas bsregs: rngams 'dzin las kyi 'khrul 'khor stong gyur cig bco lnga lha yi gnas 'dren bya ba ni snang yul bkod pa la skad cig snang ba gnas su gyur pa las: nga rgyal zhi gnas las 'bras wa yul mchod: sgra ma rmi lam snang ba ji bzhin tu: tshe 'das 'khyal snang sbangs

phyir gsal bar bkod: 'dren pa sprul ba ni hū hrī: nga ni 'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs dbang sku: thugs ga'i hrīḥlas dbang po brgya byin sprul: nga rgyal gnas stong ngan song g.yang las skyobs thugs rje chen pos tshe 'das rjes su zungs: tshogs bsags ni hūṃ bcom ldan bde gshegs dbang po brgya byin la dri med dag pa'i zhal zas ro brgya ldan:'dod yon brgyan pa'i mchod gtor 'di bzhes la: tshe 'das tshogs gnyis yongs su rdzogs gyur cig: ma badzra ne phe bye a /: khrusagasol ni hūṃ hrī: dag byed mnyam nyid ye shes chu rgyun gyis: skal ldan rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur bas: nyon mongs nga rgyal sgrib pa kun dag nas: bcom ldan rin chen 'byung ldan dpal thob 31ga byas sarba pā paṃ da ha na shirnyi ku ru ye swā hā: lan chags ni hūṃ hrī: 'dod yon lnga ldan glud kyi gtor ma 'di: lha yi bu lon lan chags sbyangs ba'i phyir: bar chad bdud bgegs lan chags mgron la bsngo tshim nas thar lam bar chad gegs ma byed: na maḥsarba ta tha ga ta a wa lo ki te oṃ saṃ bha ra saṃ bha ra hūṃ: dbang bskur ni hūṃ hri ngan song g.yul bzlog bcom ldan lha

badzra dbang rgyal 'gro 'dren thub pa chen po'i dbang bskur ro: nga rgyal duX kha'i gnas stong thar lam gyi: yang dag zhing la bde legs 'byor gyur cig: rtsa sngags mthar kwa ya a nyiṣiñtsa tshe: de nas gnas spar bsregs sbyangs ni hrī: rang nyid thugs rje chen po'i thugs ka nas: ye shes rnam lnga'i 'od zer me 'bar bas: lha yi sa bon bag chags dang bcas bsregs khengs sems 'dzin pa'i 'khrul 'ashesar stong gyur cig: bcu drug ma yi gnas 'dren bya ba ni snang yul bkod pa la skad cig snang bganas su gyur ba las: nyon mongs 'dod pa'i dge 'bras mi yul mchod: sgyu ma rmi lam snang ba ji bzhin tu: tshe 'das 'khrul snang sbyangs phyir gsal bar bkod: 'dren pa sprul ba na hū hrī nga ni 'phags mchogasbyan ras gzigs dbang sku: thugs ga'i trīḥlas shākya thub pa sprul: dug lnga'i gnas stong ngan song g.yang las skyobs: thugs rjes chen pos tshe 'das rjes su zungs:tshogs bsags ni hā bcom ldan bde gshegs shākya thub pa la: dri med dag pa'i zhal zas ro brgya ldan: 'dod yon brgyan pa'i mchod gtor 'di bzhes la: tshe 'das tshogs

gnyis yongs su rdzogs gyur cig: yo badzra nee rlu bye a :: khrus gsol ni hūṃ trī dag byed ye shes lnga ldan chu rgyun gyis: skal ldan rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur bas: nyon mongs dug lnga'i sgrib pa kun dag nas bcom ldan thugs rje chen po'i dpal thob shog: o sarba pā paṃ da ha na shirnyi ku ru ye swā hā: lan chags na hūṃ hrī 'dod yon lnga ldan glud kyi gtor ma 'di: mi yi bu lon lan chags sbyangs ba'i phyir: bar chad bdud bgegs lan chags mgron la bsngo: tshim nas thar lam bar chad gegs ma byed na ma sarba ta tha ga ta a wa lo ki te oṃ saṃ bha ra saṃ bha ra /: dbang bskur na hūṃ trī: ngan song g.yul bzlog bcom ldan shākya thub: 'gro 'dren thub pa chen po'i dbang bskur ro ngan song du kha'i gnas stong thar lam gyi: yang dag zhing la bde legs 'byor gyur cig: rtsa sngags mthar kā ya a snyi ṣiñtsa oṃ de nas gnas spar bsregs sbyangs ba ni trī rang nyid thugs rje chen po'i thugs ka nas: ye shes rnam lnga'i 'od zer me 'bar bas: mi yi sa bon bag chags dang bcas bsregs las nyon 'dzin pa'i 'khrul 'khor stong gyur cig smon lam ni trī

btsa/: 'phags mchog dri med rgyal po'i thugs rje yis: tshe 'das mi dge bcu dang mtshams med lnga rtsa ba yan lag dam tshig nyam chags kun: dag nas 'phags pa'i gdul byar rab gyur te bde chen po ṭa la ru lam sna drongs: gnas ngan srid pa'i rtsa ba drung 'byin nas: gzhan phan thugs rje'i 'gro don 'grub par shog: bcu bdun zab mo dbang bskur ram pa la gsol gdab ni na mo dmus 'o nga 'gro ba yongs kyi skyabs gcig pu: tshad med thugs rje'i gter chen spyan ras gzigs: skyabs med tshe 'das bdag la thugs rje'i dgongs: las ngan 'khor ba'i 'dams las drangs du gsol: lan gsum skyabs sems ni na mo mchog gsum ngo bo bla ma spyan ras gzigs: tshe 'das bdag gi skyabs kyi dam par 'dzin: 'khrul snang ma gyur dmus longs 'gro ba rnams: yang gsang lam la 'god phyir sems bskyod do: lan gsum yan lag bdun pa ni na mo chags bral dri med padma dkar po la: gus pas phyag 'tshal phyi nang mchod pa 'bul: mi dge sdig bshags yang dag rjes yi rang: zab mo chos bskor mya ngan mi 'da' bzhugs: dge

tshogs gcig tu bsdum te 'gro la bsngo: phyam gcig gdod ma'i rgyal sa zin par shog: lan gsum phyi nang sdom bzung ni ho phyogs bcur bzhugs pa'i skyabs gnas ma lus dgongs tshe 'das bdag ni gsang sngags sgor zhugs te: so sor thar dang byang chub sems dpa'i sdom rig 'dzin sngags kyi dam tshig ma lus pa: yongs su bsrung zhing dam tshig sdom par bgyi nam yang mi 'da' badzra sa ma yā: lan gsum de nas slob ma lha bskyed ni tshe 'dasaphung khamasaskye mched ma lus pa stong par sbyangs te mi dmigs ngang nyid las ye shesalha mchog 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dri med padma dkar po 'dzum mdzes bshad: zhal gcig phyag bzhi lcags kyu nor bu bsnams padma 'dab brgyad shel dkar phreng ba 'dzin: longs sku'i rgyan chas bcu gsum mdzes par spras: bzhengs pa'i stabs kyis 'khor ba'i sgo 'phar gnon: sku la bkod pa dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rdzogs gnas gsum rdo rje'i sa bon yig 'bru las: 'od 'phros rgyal ba sras bcas ma lus pa: kha ba bu yug 'tshubs pa ji bzhin tu: spyan drangs dam ye ro gcig brtan par

gtsas bzhugs: yo ārya lo ki shwa ra sarba sa pa ri wā ra badzra sa ma ya dza dza: e a ra li hrīng hrīng phe tho : a we sha ya a u ye shes pheb pa tiṣṭha badzra gyis brtan par bya'o me tog dor la mig dar bsal de nas bum dbang bskur ba ni hū: dri med kun zlum bum pa'i gzhal yas dbus: bde gshegs rgyal ba'i dgongs bcud gtams pa yi: deng 'dir tshe 'das khyod la dbang bskur bas: lus kyi sgrib dag sku yi dbang thob 37ga: rtsa sngags mthar kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ: de nas gsang dbang bskur ba ni hū hrī: bde stong bhanta kwa pa la yi nang dus gsum rgyal ba'i byin gyis brlabs pa'i bcud: deng 'dir tshe 'das khyod la gtad pa yis: ngag gi sgrib dag gsungs gsang dbang thob shog: rtsa sngags mthar wākka a je ṣiñtsa āḥ de nas sher dbang bskur ba ni hūṃ trī: mtshan ldan bde chen dga' bzhi'i dpal ster ma: bcu drug mdangs ldan dga' bzhi'i rol rtsal mkhas: deng 'dir skal ldan bu la gtad pa yis yid kyi sgrib dag shes rab dbang thob shog: rtsa sngags mthar pradzā dzā na a bhi ṣiñtsa hrī de nas tshig dbang bskur ba ni hā hrī: ka dag dri bral dwangs ma'i 'ja' shel ni:

gsal sgrib med pa 'od lnga'i dkyil 'khor rdzogs: deng 'dir tshe 'das khyod la gtad pa yis: sgo gsum sgrib bral ka dag dbang thob re ga: rtsa sngags mthar citta a snyi ṣiñtsa hūṃ spro na stong dbang bskur ba'am gzhung gi dbang rdzongs legasapar sprad mtha' rten shis brjod la sogs bya bco brgyad 'dod yon zas bsngos rim pa ni bza' btung dkar mngar ci 'byor bsags byas la bsangs sbyangs byin gyis brlabs nas 'di skad do mdun tu hūṃ las rin po che yi snod: yangs shing rgya che'i nang du oṃ ā ju: 'od zhu gsur rdzas 'dod yon lnga dang ldan: kun bzang mchod sprin nam mkha'i khams gang gyur: tso sa hūṃ lan gsum dang ni sngags drug phyag rgya drug ting nge 'dzin gyi nam mkha'i mdzod du sprul de nas snyan pa'i dbyangs dang ting ting sgras hrī: tshe 'dathangarig pa dbang po'i spyod yul du: mdzes sdug gzugs kyi bye brag ci mchis pa: rab 'phel nam mkha' mdzod du byin rlabs nas: phul bas mi zad gter la spyod par re ga: 31 ru pa ka ma gu ṇa pu tsi te hūṃ: hrī tshe 'das rig pa dbang po'i sprod yul du grags stong sgra yis bye brag ci mchis pa: rab 'phel nam mkha' mdzod du byin rlabs nas: phul bas mi zad gter la

ba tshu spyod par shog: yo shabha ka ma gu ṇa pu tsi te hūṃ: hrī tshe 'das rig pa dbang po'i spyod yul du: ngad ldan dri yis bye brag ci mchis pa: rab 'phel nam mkha' mdzod du byin rlabs nas: phul bas mi zad gter la spyod par shog:sa gharnye ka ma gu ṇa pu tsi te ::hrī tshe 'das rig pa dbang po'i spyod yul du: zhim mngar ro yi bye brag ci mchis pa: rab 'phel nam mkha' mdzod du byin rlabs nas: phul bas mi zad gter la spyod par 31ga: bla ra sa ka ma gu ṇa pu tsi te hūṃ:hrī: tshe 'das rig pa dbang po'i spyod yul du srab 'jams reg bya'i bye brag ci mchis pa: rab 'phel nam mkha' mdzod du byin rlabs nas phul bas mi zad gter la spyod par 3 ga: 37 spasne ka ma gu ṇa pu tsi te :: hrī tshe 'das rig pa dbang po'i spyod yul du: snang stong chos kyi bye brag ci mchis pa: rab 'phel nam mkha' mdzod du byin rlabs nas phul bas mi zad gter la spyod par shog o dharma ka ma gu ṇa pu tsi te hūṃ: hri: tshe 'das rig pa dbang po'i sgod yul du: bza' bca' btung ba ldag gzhib 'dod dgu'i gter: 'bru sman rin chen dkor nor

gos longs spyod: sbra khang gnas lam them skas la sogs pa'i: gang la gang 'dod nye bar mkho ba'i rdzas: mi zad nam mkha'i mdzod du sprul pa yis ngoms shing tshim nas bde dang ldan gyur cig saṃ bha ra'i sngagasalan bdun bshe da la tsham par bya'o brgya dgu yon 'bul gnas spar rim pa ni lus dbul ni trī: 'dinas 'u yi phyogs rol dpag tshad mthar: bcom ldan dri bral padma dkar po bzhugs: byang chub sems dpa' sems ma'i 'khor gyis bskor: rgyal ba yab yum ma lus dgyes pas dgongs tshe 'das phung khams skye mched dbang yul rnams: yon du 'bul lo dgyes pa'i tshul gyis bzhes thar ba'i lam la rnam par drangs du gsol: sku bzhi ye shes lnga dang ldan par mdzod sgron me thul ba ni mar miyeshesa'od lnga'i snang ba chen por dmigasal hrī 'khor ba'imun nag rba rlabs 'thib po ru las nyon duḥkha'i mnar ba'i 'gro ba la thugs rje shugs kyis sgron me 'di bstan pas: ye shes 'od la rtag tu 'de bar shog yang dag don gyi zhing du 'gro ba la: ma shes 'khrul dang ma rig rmongs pa dang: dag pa'i lam stor kun rmong 'thib na yang: ye shes sgon me 'di

me tshu yis gsal gyur cig:sngags 'chang bdag gis gsal byed khyod la sbyin:'di la brten nas rigs kyi bu khyod kyang:'og min dag pa'i zhing du 'gro bar gyis:ye shes lha mchog rnams dang 'phrad par re ga:sgo badzra dharma a lo ke ā (:gnas spar ni sa:thabs kyi gzhu la shes rab mda' bkang ste:ye shes thugs rje lcags kyu'i shugs kyis drangs:bla na med pa'i gnas mchog po ṭa lar:tshe 'das mda' 'phang bzhin du skye bar shog shā:zhing khams 'dinas lho yi phyogs rol na ri bo gru 'dzin bde chen zhing khams yod:de na sangs rgyas spyan ras gzigs dbang yod:g.yas su sras mchog nor bu 'dzin pa dang:g.yon du shes rab gsang sngags 'dzin ma bzhugs:tshogs brgyad rnam dag sems dpa' brgyad kyis bskor:sprul pa'i rig 'dzin bsam gyis mi khyab yod:de phyir po ṭa la yi zhing du grags:byang chub sems dpa' de yis sras mchog tu rtsal chen mda' 'phang bzhin du ste bar shog 'o dmigs yul che las 'das pa'i rlang sems ro gcig tu 'dres pa'i 'od lnga'i gong bu de rtsal po che'i mda' 'phang

ba bzhin du sangs rgyas dpal brtsegs kyi rgyal po'i thugs gar thim nas rgyal ba'i sras su gyur te sangs rgyas par gyur cig: aphaṭa aphaṭa aphaṭa: nyi shu ming byang bsregs pa'i rim pa ni hūṃ yang gsang bde gshegs 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor nas: dri med padma dkar po'i lha tshogs kyi sku las ye shes lnga yi me 'bar bas: nyon mongs dug lnga'i sdig sgrib dzwa la ram: phung po khams dang skye mched bsregs par byed las nyon bag chags dri ma dag gyur cig: khams gsum 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho stong bar bsam: sa ma ṇipadme hūṃ hrī: sarba pā paṃ da ha na aḥtsho suḥ38preḥduḥdzwa la re ram̐: ces pa'i ming byang bstegs la bye ba btab gzung sngags khyad 'phags ci rigs brjod par bya gnad des 'khor ba' g.yul las rnam par rgyal byamasabartse'i lcags kyu'i 'gro la phan bde 'byung sa ma yā yem rgyal ba'i dbang po padma saṃ bha was ma 'ongs 'gro la brtse ba chen po yas thugasakyi yang bcud rdo rje snying po'i chos zab gsang phrin las las ram bcugasum pa grub pa'i dbang phyugakhye'u chung khyod la gtad da lta ma spel rin chen brda la chug mdo khams rtse shod gsham du dgongs rgya thob ma 'ongs snyigs ma sum bcu kha ral dus nga sprul dpa' bonu ldan rdo rje dang 'phrad nas bstan dang

—4rdo 'gro la phan bde spel las can nyer lnga chos kyi bdag por 'byung gdul bya bsam yas rgyud la phan thog byed rmad byung myur lam tshe gcig sangs rgyas pa'i gdams pa thub par bsrungs shig bstan srung tshogs skal med lag tu ma shor spu gri gsum las can snyang gi bu dang 'phrad par shog sa ma yu rgya rgya rgya gshin po rjes 'dzan thugs rje'i lcags kyu rdzogs so gter rgya gtad rgya sbas rgya zab rgya gsang rgya gu gye o rgyan gyi slob dpon padma saṃ bha wa'i bka' bdag 'dra mkhar chen bzas bkod pa'o brda thim snyi ces pa 'di yang chos kya bdag popadma chosa'apel rgya mtsho dang chos bdag 'gyur med rgya mtshos rin po che'i sgod 'byu yis bkang ba dang slob bu dad ldanapadma rnam rgyal gyis rin chen gnyis pa'i rdo rje rtse rgyal ldem sgro dang bcas nas mos gus kyas yang yang bskul ba dang / slob buyeshesarang shar pad don chos gsal smon semasasogs kyi dga' spro'i maṇḍal dang bcas bskul ba dang grogs mo ratna sa ra'i yang yang nan tan gyis bskul ba don da ldan phyir bdag 'dra dpa' bo nus ldan rdo rje'i mkha' 'gro gsang ba'i brda ris lasazhal bshugate dag par phab pa dge legs 'phel/ sarba maṅga zug34/

ba tshu skad cig dran rdzogs pho po yis 'phags pa'i lha sku bsgom pa ni u skad cig dran rdzogs chen po'i ngang nyid las: rang snang ma 'gags thugs rje chen po'i sku: dkar gsal zhal gcig phyag gnyis 'dzum bcas bzhad: longs sku'i rgyan chas bcu gsum mdzes par spras: zhabs gnyis bzheng pa'i srid zhi'i sgo 'phar gnon: dri bral padma dkar po g.yas na bsnams: g.yon pa'i shel phreng brgya rtsas 'gro ba 'dul: mdzes 'dzum blta ba'i chog mi shes pa'i nyams: 'ja' 'od zer gyis 'phro 'du phyogs bcur 'gyed 'gro drug 'khor ba'i gnas rnams stongs par byed: thugs gar padma dkar po 'dab drug dbus: rig pa hrīḥl rtsa ba'i sngags kyis bskor bzlas pa'i ma rig gzung 'dzin dri ma dag: snang grags rig gsum lha sngags chos sku'i ngang: stong nyid snying rje'i ngang nas sngags 'di bzla: sa ma ṇi padme hūṃ hrī: smra bcad bye ba bzlas pa yis lus ngag yid kyi sdig sgrib dag tshe dang bsod nams nyams rtogs rgyas mos bzhi dbang bsdus bar chad sel bsam pa ma lus lhun gyis grub the tshom med do so ma wā rgya rgya rgya gu rgya lha slob spyon 'jigasamed bkra shisangor/ sngags spyonanus
ldan rdo rje phul/ ban spyon smon semasazhesabya bris/ spyon pa'i 'gro khams dong sprugs shog sarba maṅka lam/
badzra zab gsang rdo rje snying po las thugs rje chen po dri med padma dkar po'i:las bzhi'i bsreg blugs phrin las lhun grub zhes bya ba bzhugs so:

gsaX na mo ārya lo ki shwa ra ye:111shrī ——1 rsā dam mi 'gyur chos dbyings spros mtha' bral rang gsal 'gags med ye shes kun la brdal thugs rje'i dbang phyug dri bral pad dkar 'chang mi shig chos kyi 'khor lo'i rgyan du mchod ma 'ongasal dang skal ba ldan rnams kyis bsnyen sgrub gzhung bsrangs rtags mtshan mthong ba'i tshe kha bskang las rim bsreg blugs zab mo' sgo yongs su bstan no brtson pa'i nyams su longs sa ma mā de yang hom ni las bzhi'i shing sna yis zur brgyad ma ral yo 'byeg bral bar bkod tshom bu tshang bar 'god cing me dar dang rlung g.yab bsreg rdzas gzhung bzhin bsags byas nas rdo rje dang ni dgang gzar reg byas la khyen yi hūṃ ma ma ku ru shirnyi pus wa shaṃ mā ra ya sarba duṣṭa phaṭaḥtshe hūṃ swā e hā:sarba pañtsa pu dza spra ra ṇa khaṃ:ces pa lan bdun brjod la byin gyis rlabs de nas me thab sbar ba 'di ltar ro hūṃ snome yi ngo bo bcom ldan rdo rje sems:me yi rang bzhin gzung 'dzin mtshan rtog bsreg me ni rab 'bar kha tog lnga dang ldan:phrin las lhun gyis grub pa'i me sbor cig oṃ dzā na badzra dzwa la ram̐ re:de nas rdo rje'i rlung gis g.yab pa ni rji hūṃḥgayo byed rlang ni don yod grub pa'i ngang:rab twa bsgod pa dam tshig sgol ma'i gshis:gdug pa'i me dbal zhi

ba:tshu phyir dar gyis g.yab:las bzhi lhun gyis grub pa'i me sbor cig:hū hū dzñā na sarba ku ru phyo phyo ye swā hā:de nas me thab bskyed pa'i rim pa ni hū ༷me thab mi dmigs stong pa'i ngang nyid las:lhun grub me yi 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phro:de dbus ye shes lnga yi 'od zer 'khrigs:phyi gsal nang gsal dri ma bral ba'i klong:hrī:yig 'phro 'dus yongs su gyur pa las:'phags mchog thugs rje'i gter mdzod spyan ras gzigs:sku mdog dkar gsal gangs kyi ri bzhin brjid:zhal gcig phyag bzhi mnyam pa'i stabs kyis bzhengs g.yas gnyis lcags kyu 'dod 'byung nor bu bsnams:g.yon gnyis padma dkar po bsgrangs phreng 'dzin:longs sku'i rgyan chas bcu gsum mdzes par spras ye shes lnga yi 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phro rigs bdag sangs rgyas snang ba mtha' yas bzhugs 'phags pa'i g.yas g.yon nor 'dzin gsang sngags skyongs 'khor du byang chub sems dpa' mched brgyad bzhugs sgo grang dbang chen sde bzhi las mdog can bar mtshams dpa' bo dpa' mo dam can rnams:nyi dzul 'khrigs pa ji

bzhin lam mer sgoms: gnas gsum rdo rje'i sa bon yig 'bru las 'od 'phros rgyal ba sras bcas ma lus pa: kha ba bu yug 'tshubs pa ji bzhin tu: spyan drangs mdun gyi nam mkhar sa ma dza de nas sbyan 'dren bya ba'i rim pa ni hūṃ hrī: rang snang rnam par dag pa'i zhing khams dang lho phyogs po ṭa la yi gnas mchog nas: 'phags mchog sbyan ras gzigs dbang gtso 'khor bcas 'bar ba'i mchod pa bzhes phyir gshegs su gsol: yo ārya lo ki shwa ri badzra sa ma ya dza dza: de nas bzhugs su gsol bar bya ba ni hūṃ hrī: rang gsal dag pa ye shes me yi klong 'pho 'gyur bral ba 'phags mchog thugs rje'i gter dri med padma dkar po'i lha tshogs rnams: dam ye ro gcig brtan par bzhugs su gsol o dzñā na lo ki shwa ra badzra sa ma ya tiṣṭha lhan de nasagusapa'i phyag 'tshal rim pa ni hūṃ hrī bskal mang gong nas ye sangs rgyas mod kyang sna tshogs thabs kyis 'gro la phan bde spel: ngan song rang sar sgrol ba'i ye shes dbyings 'pho med don dam lta ba'i gus phyag 'tshal: o dzña na hṝ na mo na ma ho de nas byon skyems 'bul ba'i rim pa ni hūṃ hrī: snang

'amatshu ba bdochen yangs pa'i gzhong pa phu srid pa bcud kyi dpal yon rab spungs te: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs dgyes pa'i skyems du 'bul: thugs dam bskang la mchog thun dngos grub stsol: snyen ārya 'a ki shā ra sarba sa pa ri wā ra pañtsa a dṛ ta la kha re khā hi: nyer gcig dag gis byon skyems phul bar bya de nas phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa ni rgyas pa gzhung ltar bsdusanas 'di ltar bya hūṃ trī: kun tu bzang po'i rnam rol mchod pa'i sprin: me tog bdug spos mar me dri chab dang zhal zas rol mo gzugs sgra dri ro reg sman gtor rakta sbyor sgrol byang chub sems thugs rje chen po'i dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul: bdag sogs 'gro ba'i tshogs gnyis rdzogs pa dang: las bzhi lhun gyis grub pa'i phrin las mdzod: snyed ubadzra asto pakyi sogs shabha du pa sogs sparnye dharma dhartu ma hā pañtsa rakta bā ling ta sto dhi tsitta sta na gha ṇa sarba pu tsa ho: de nas zhi ba'i til 'bru mar gyi bam pa can phul la hūṃ hri: dribral thugs rje'i dkyil 'khor dgyes pa'i phyir til dkar 'bri mar bcud kyis rab brlan 'bul: bdag cag rnal 'byor sgrab mchog 'khor bcas kyis nad

gdon 'jigs brgyad zhi ba'i phrin las mdzod: a ma khaṃ padme hūṃ hrī: sarba pa paṃ da ha ye swā hā: nad gdon 'jigs brgyad shirnye ku ru nyu: brgya rtsa la sogs ci 'grub phul bar bya de nas 'dod gsol bya ba'i rim pa ni ho 'phags mchog thugs rje chen po dri med padma dkar po'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams la bdud rtsi bsregs blugs kyi mchod pa rgya chen po phul ba'i mthus: bdag cag rnal 'byor sgrub pa po'i nad gdon 'jigs brgyad zhi ba dang dam tshig nyams chags nyes ltung thams cad sor chud pa'i phrin las mdzod cig: de nas rgyas pa'i yams shing tsan tan dang bzang drug rde gu sbyor ba can yul la hūṃ hrī: lha mche ga thugs rdze'i bdag nyid dgyes pa'i phyir: rgyas pa'i yams shing sna tshogs sman bcas 'bul: bdag cag rnal 'byor sgrub mchog 'khor bcas kyi: tshe dang bsod nams rgyas pa'i phrin las mdzod ma ma ṣepas hūṃ hrī: sto dhi snyi kta ye swā hā tshe bsod dpal 'byor puṣṭi ku ru hūṃ brgya stong bee 'bum la sogs ci 'grub yul de nas 'dod gsol bya ba'i rim pa ni ho 'phags mche ga thugs rdze chen po dri med padma dkar po'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams la zhal zas

026 bsreg blugs kyi mchod pa rgya chen po phul ba'i mthus: bdag cag rnal 'byor sgrub pa po'i tshe dang bsod nams dpal dang 'byor ba thams cad rgyas pa dang:nyams dang rtogs pa'i ye shes yon tan thams cad gong nas gong du 'phel zhing rgyas pa'i phrin las mdzod cig: de nas dbang la 'byu sna tshogs dzos gsum ba pa can phul la hū hrī chags bral thugs rje'i mnga' bdag dgyes pa'i phyir 'byu sna bcu gsum dbang rdzas gsum bcas 'bul: bdag cag rnal 'byor sgrub mchog 'khor bcas kyis: khams gsum dbang du sdud pa'i phrin las mdzod yo ma ṇi padme hūṃ hrī: sarba puṣṭa sidha ye swā hā 'dod rgu'i dpal yon wa shaṃ ku ru st+waṃ: brgya stong khri 4ma la sogs ci rigs phul de nas 'dod gsol gdab pa'i rim pa ni ho: 'phags mchog thugs rje chen po dri med padma dkar po'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams la zhal zas bsreg blugs kyi mchod pa rgya chen po phul ba'i mthus bdag cag rnal 'byor sgrub pa po yi rlung sems ting nge 'dzin dbang du gyur ba dang khams gsum srid gsum gyi zas nor longs spyod 'dod rgu'i phywa g.yang thams

cad dbang du sdud pa'i phrin las mdzod cig de nasadrag po' sngagasabyang 'byu nag sha tshil bcas phul la hū trī: gdug pa rab 'dren thugs rje'i mnga' bdag mchog: dgyes phyir drag po'i sngags byang 'bru nag 'bul: bdag cag rnal 'byor sgrub mchog 'khor bcas kyis: bar chad dgra bgegs brlag pa'i phrin las mdzod 34 ma ḍi padme hūṃ hrī: ma hā pu tsa ratna khā hi gnod byed sarba sha hūṃ mā ra ya phaṭa khā hi brgya stong khri 'bum lasogs ci rigasaphul de nas 'dod gsol gdab pa'i rim pa ni he 'phags mchog thugs rje chen po dri med padma dkar po'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams la zhal zas bsreg blugs kyi mchod pa rgya chen po phul ba'i mthus bdag cag rnal 'byor sgrub pa po'i gzung 'dzin gnyis snang drungs nas 'byin pa dang bstan pa'i dgra bgegs bdud dang dam sri 'byung po thams cad ming tsam yang med pa'i drag po'i phrin las mdzod cig: de nas bstod pa rgya par gzhung ltar ram yang na rdo rje'i phyag rgya lnga ldan gyis hūṃ dhi bskal pa mang po'i gong nas sangs rgyas kyang smon lam dam bca' zab mo'i dbang gis ni: 'gro ba'i don du byang chub sems dpa' yis:

bsgo tshul bzung spyan ras gzigs la phyag 'tshal bstod: de nasatshogasadang bskang gsol rgya chen bya so rtsi 'bul bar bya ba'i rim pa ni then badzra tswa bu la ye swā ha de nas gos zung 'bul bar bya ba ni 31 badzra wasaṭa ye swā hā de nas phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa 'bul gshegs masa'abul bar bya ba'i rim pa na hū hrī: rtsi yi bcud dang 'bri mar kun sbyar nas: bde chen bdud rtsi'i rgyun gyi mchod chen po'i dkyil 'khor lha tshogs ma lus dgyes pa bskangs: skyems bzhes las rnams mtha' ru phyin par mdzod: rtsa sngags mthar pañtsa dzña na pu tsa a dṛ ta khā hi:nyer gcig brjod la gshegs skyems mnyes pa bskangs de nas bstod pa bya ba'i rim pa ni hūṃ hrī: 'a17 'dul thugs rje'i 'od zer rlabs g.yos pa'i: phan bde'i bde legs 'byung ba'i gzhir gyur cing skye 'gro ma lus dag pa'i zhing la 'god dri med padma dkar por phyag 'tshal bstod de nas dngos grub len par bya ba ni sa ā sa: sku gsum lhun rdzogs bde chen gsang gsum bcud ye shes dngas ma dngos grub mchog gi rgyun deng 'dir sgrub pa po la rab brtsal nas: don gnyis lhun gyis grub pa'i las mdzod cig blang āhūṃ sarba sirnyi pha

la hūṃ hrī de nasabazod gsol bya ba'i rim pa ni ho las bzhi lhun grub bsreg blugs gzhung bsrang nas: rdzas dang ting 'dzin phyag rgya rab g.yel zhing: ma rtogs log 'khrul nyams chags nyes lhung kun: bshags so dag cing tshang par stsal du gsol: sa ma ya snyi 8)bye sa yi ge brgya pa lan gsum brjod byas nas lhag chad ma lus kha bskangs bya ba'o de nas bsdu rim bya ba 'di ltar ro ba snang cha thabs kyi bskyed pa'i dkyil 'khor lhaḥ shes rab stong pa chen po'i dbyings su bsdu slar yang thugs rje ye shes rol pa'i gar: 'gro ba'i don du snang stong phyag rgyar bzhengs a āḥ shesapa dbyingasasu gshegs dam tshag pa rang gi thugs gar bsdu 'o de nas bsngo ba smon lam rim pa ni hūṃ hrī 'das dang ma 'ongs da lta dus gsum du: zag dang zag med dge ba ji bsags pa: gcig tu bsdus te ma gyur 'gro la bsngo: phyam gcig kun bzang bla ma'i sa thob thegag lan gsum de nas bkra shisabya ba'i rim pa ni hūṃ trī sku gsum lhun tshob nyi blo 'char ba'i mthus: ste 'gro'i bde legs myu ga rab gsang nas: thams cad rdzogs ldan gsar ba'i lang tsho la: spod nas dam pa chos kyi mdzes grur cig: nyin

ba:tshu yang bkra shis dpal 'bar kyi li li: mtshan yang bkra shis dpal 'bar ta la la: nyin mtshan rtag tu bkra shis zung tu 'jug phan bde'i dga' ston rgyas pa'i bkra shis regag: de ltar la sogs shis brjod mtha' rgyas bya smon pa'i 'bras bu phrin las lhun gyis grub nyams su longs dang rtags mtshan nges par gsal ze tshom med do rdo rje rgyal po'i bka' sa ma mā ye ma rgyal ba'i dbang po padma saṃ bha was ma 'ongs 'gro la brtse ba chen po yis gdams pa yang zab rdo rje snying po' chos rmad byung dra med padma dkar po yi chos bcud yang zab gcig tu dral ba ni grub pa'i dbang phyug khye'u chung khyod la gtad da lta ma spel rin chen brda' la thob mdo khams rtse shod gsham du dgongs rgya mdzod ma 'ongasasnyigs ma sum chu kha ral dus nga sprul dpa' bo nus ldan rdo rje dang 'phrad nas bstan 'gro'i bde legs spel ba dang sa gsum dam pa chosakya lang tshos mdzes skal med lag tu ma shor sbu gra gsum sa ma yā rgya rgya rgya las bzhi'i bsreg blugs phrin las lhun grub rdzogs so gter rgya gtad rgya sbas rgya zab rgya gsang rgya gu bye o rgyan gyi slob dpon padma saṃ bha wa'i bka' bdag 'dra mkhar chen bzasabakod pa'o brda pom snyi ces pa 'ad 'ang chos kyi bdag po padma chosa'aphel rgya mtsho dang / chos bdag 'gyur med rgya mtsho gnyas kyi bskul ba dang / slob bu padma

rnam rgyal gyi rin chen gnyisapa'i rdo rje ldem sgro dang dbang lnga'i cod paṇa bkra shis lha reg dang bcas te yang yang bskul ba dang nye gnas ye shes ratna sa ra sogs kyis bskul ba'i ngor bdag 'dradapa' bo nusaldan rdo rjesamakha' 'gro gsang ba'i bdo' risalasazhal bshusate dag par phab pa dge legasa'aphel/ sarba ma lam/
badzra zab gsang rdo rje snying po las: dri med padma dkar po'i dgos chos gsur mchod bdud rtsi'i sprin dpung bzhugs so:

bsgotshu na mo gu ru padma kwa ra ye: —1/bsgo / zab bsgospro bral 'od gsal 'dus ma byas bde go ye shes rgyal kun 'dus pa'i dpal don dam mi shag mchog gsum rdo rje 'chang sku gsum ye shes mchog la phyag 'tshal lo bdag 'dra rgyal dbang padma saṃ bha was ma 'ongs 'gro la brtse ba chen po yis lnga brgya'i rgud bsal 'jag rten phan bde'i gzhi gsur mchod kun bzang sprin dpung bstan par bgyi sa ma mā depang 'byu sna bdun gyi phye ma la 'bri brgya'i mar brlan shing sna bag tsam bsre ja chang 'o ma mngar gsum dkar gsum sbag bdud rtsi bsres la rab tu mye bar bya de nas 'byung po brngan phyir sha tshil yang cung zad bsre ba man ngag lugasayin no bdag bskyed padma dkar po bskyed bzlos bya de nas mdun bskyed gsur bsngosabya ba la dang po spyon 'dren bya ba 'di ltar ro ting ting sgra dang snyan pa'i dbyangs ba mo' hūṃ hrī:sku gsum dag pa 'od kyi gzhal yas nas:chos longs sprul gsum brgyud pa dgu ldan gyi:rtsa rgyud bla ma yi dam rgyud sde drug:gnas gsum mkha' 'gro sangs rgyas byang chub sems:dpa' bo mkha' 'gro bka' srung dam can sde nor lha mched brgyad gter bdag dam can rnams bdud rtsi kun bzang gsur mchod 'du bar gshegs:'ja' 'od lnga ldan 'od kyi klong du

ba tshu bzhugs ngo mtshar dad brgya'i yid kyis phyag 'tshal lo: thugs rje brtse ba chen po'i dgongs su gsol: 'gro ba rigs drug sde brgyad dregs pa can: yul lha gzhi bdag lha 'dre 'byung po'i tshogs bdud rtsi gsur gyi 'du bar gshegs su gsol: rang snang 'od kyi da lar bzhugs par mdzod: gzung 'dzin mtshan ma bral phyir gus phyag 'tshal: dad mos brtse ba chen po'i rab tu dgongs: ma badzra sa ma ya dza dza: dzñā na tiṣṭha lhan: na mo na ma ho: de nas me thab bskyed pa ni re'ago yi shes kyi mi thab zlum la 'khyil zhing 'od zer dkar gsal phyogs thams cad du 'phro zhing nad gdon 'jigs pa bcu drug zhi bar byed pa 'bar ba me yi rang bzhin gzung 'dzin gyi mtshan rtog ma rig dug lnga'i yo langs bsreg par byed pa'i rang bzhin can du gyur 3 a hū: lan gsum thab rgya de yi dbus su gsur rdzas 'dod yon lnga ldan gyi phung po gzugs mdzes pa: sgra snyan pa: dri zhim pa: ro mngar ba: reg bya 'jam pa: bza' ba'i mi zad pa btung ba'i mi 'dzad pa nad 'tsho'i sman: 'chi bsgru'i bdud rtsi: sdug bsngal sel ba'i gter:

gang la gang 'dod kyi longs spyod: ci la ci dgyes pa'i yo byad: mdor na ma tshang ba med pa mig 'phrul lta bu'i gter chen po 'dod yon nam mkha'i mdzod du spros te 'phags pa kun tu bzang po'i rnam rol du rgyas par gyur cig 'byu gsum sngagasaphyag drug gis spel lo de nasagasur mchod 'bul ba'i rim pa ni 31 ā /: chos sku kun tu bzang po longs sku rgyal ba rigs lnga sprul sku thub chen rnam drug bskal bzang sangs rgyas stong rtsa nye ba'i sras chen rnam brgyad: zhi khro rgyal ba rgya mtsho lung rtogs dam chos zab mo rig 'dzin paṇa grub rgya mtsho rtsa gsum sprul 'khor bka' sdod dang bcas pa rnams la gsur mchod ye shes kyi bdud rtsi 'dod yon nam mkha'i mdzod du sprul nas 'bul lo: tshog ba/ lan gsum de ltar phul ba'i mthus bdag sogs sems can thams cad kyi tshogs gnyis rdzogs: sgrib gnyis byang: zung 'jug rdo rje 'chang chen po'i sku gnyis mngon du 'gyur bar shog cig: o tso1 dam chos dgongs pa 'dus pa: sgrub chen bka' brgyad kyi lha tshogs bdun brgya nyer lnga: mdo rgya sems gsum: rgyad sde bcu gsum dang 'brel ba'i yi

ba tshu dam rtsa ba gsum gyi lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la gsur mchod kun bzang sprin gyis phung por dmigs nas 'bul lo:e āḥ/ lan gsum deltar phul ba'i mthus bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi 'phral rkyen ngan pa zhi nas nyams dang rtogs pa'i yon tan thams cad gong nas gong du 'phel zhing rgyas par gyur cig: bla sa(: thugs(chen po dri med padma dkar po rig bdag snang ba mtha' yas sras mchog nor bu 'dzin pa: sras mo gsang sngags rab skyongs: byang chub sems dpa' mched brgyad: rigs bzhi'i lha mo rnam bzhi sgo skyongs rta mgrin rigs bzhi skal bzang sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la gsur mchod 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga ldan du sprul nas 'bul lo bla unyu: lan gsum deltar phul ba'i mthus bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi rgyad la byams dang snying rje ting 'dzin gsangs shing yang dag pa'i don dang ldan nas 'khor ba'i pha mthar brgal bar shog cig a ā hūṃ mkha' 'gro rdo rje phag mo rigs lnga

dbyings kyi ḍakki: mkha' 'gro bye ba 'bum sde ma mo 'bum phrag yangs pa'i tshogs 'khor 'bangs dpung dang bcas pa thams cad la 'bul lo: skyid zhwa hū lan gsum de ltar phul ba'i mthus bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi dam tshig nyam chags 'gal zhakhrul nyes lhung thams cad sor chud nas bdag la mchog thun mong gi dngos grub bde stong dga' bzhi'i ye shes bskyed par mdzad du gsol o bahū: lha brgyad klu brgyad gza' brgyad phyogs skyong ba bcu 'jigs byed chen po dgu: rgyu skar nyer brgyad: rgyal chen sde bzhi: dpal mgon bdun cu rtsa lnga sprul 'khor bka' sdod dang bcas pa rnams la zag med gsur mchod ye shes kyi bdud rtsir sprul nas 'bul lo: sa ustsa lan gsum de ltar phul ba'i mthus bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi phrin las rnam pa bzhi rtsol med yid bzhin du 'grub nas mchog thun mong gi dngos grub stsol ba'i phrin las mdzod cig: o uhā: mgon po ma hwa ka la: dam can rdo rje leg pa: gza' bdud dug gi spra gri: gnod sprin shan pa dmar nag: shan pa srog skrub nag mo sngags bdag e ka dza

ba tshu ṭi lha mo dpal 'bar chen mo:dregs pa'i sde dpon sum cu:dregs chen las mdzad bco brgyad:phur srung ma mo bcu gsum:dbang phyug nyi shu rtsa brgyad:las mdzad spu gri mched gsum:gzhan yang sangs rgyas kyi bka' dang dam tshig la gnas pa'i dregs pa dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams kyis mchod sbyin gsur sprin kun bzang gi rol ba chen po 'dod yon mi zad pa'i gter du dmigs nas 'bul lo:sa uhū:lan gsum de ltar phul ba'i mthus bdag cag rnal 'byor sgrub pa po rnams kyi gnas skabs brin las rnam bzhi lhun gyis grub pa dang zab gsang rdo rje snying po'i bstan pa 'dzin srung spel gsum byed pa la dbang:tshe 'di dang phyi ma'i don rnams gegs med yid bzhin du 'grub pa'i phrin las dam pa rgya chen po yongs su grub par gyur cig e uhū:lan chags kyi mgron pho gdon rgyal po:mo gdon bse mo:klu gdon sa bdag gna' 'dre ning ba:da 'dre so ma:yul 'dre 'khyams po:dri za gnas gdon lus gdon:bgegs rigs stong phrag brgyad cu byis pa'i gdon chen bco lnga:

'phrog ma ma bu lnga brgya: btsan kha bzhi mgyogs sde brgyad: rgyal po dang rgyal bsen dmu the'u sa bdag 'gong po: 'byung po kha yi dbugs 'phrog pa: khong pa'i nang gi srog gcod pa phag tu yib cing 'gab tu 'khril ba'i 'byung po bgegs rigs che phra chung gsum 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad la gsur mchod 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga dang ldan pa mi zad nam mkha'i mdzod du sprul nas 'bul lo sa gi /: lan gsum de ltar phul ba'i mthus bgegs rigs 'byung po lan chags kyi mgron rnams so so'i gnod gdug gi bsam pa dang bral nas phan pa byang chub kyi sems rin po che dang ldan nas bde ba mchog dang ldan par gyur cig: de yi mthu dang nus pa la brten nas sems can thams cad bde skyid chos dang mthun pa'i bya ba la gnas par shog cig: yo sa/ snying rje'i mgron pha dang ma ru gyur ba'i sems can: dmyal ba yi dwags dud 'gro lha ma yin lha mi bar do'i 'gro ba rigs che chung bdun brgya sum cu'i tshogs rnams la gsur mchod nad gso'i sman: 'chi ba bsla ba'i bdud rtsi: sdag bsngal sel ba'i gter: ri rgyal bas

ba tshu dpangs mtho ba:rgya mtsho las gting zab pa:nyi zla las 'od gsal ba rtsi shing las lhun sdug pa rgya khyon chos kyi dbyings dang mnyam pa'i gter du sprul nas 'bul lo:3 uhū lan gsum de ltar phul ba'i mthus dmyal ba tsha grang:yi dwags bkres skom:dud 'gro blun rmongs mi skye rga na 'chi:lha ma yin 'thab rtsod:lha 'chi 'pho lhung ba'i sdug bsngal sogs rang rang so so'i las snang sdug bsngal rgya mtsho lta bu las bsgral nas bde ba mchog dang ldan par gyur cig:sa gisahū:snyegs ma'i dmu che da 'khrug pa'i cho rol bdud kyi 'bangs su gyur ba'i 'byung po:rgya 'dre ra yi mgo can sog gdon dred kyi mgo can:bon gdon sprel gyi gzugs can 1 gdon glang po'i gzugs can:klu gdon phag gi mgo can gnyan gdon sbrul gyi mgo can:sa bdag spyang gi'i mgo can:zhung zhung chu glang gdong can mu stegs sbal ba'i mgo can bse mo bya yi mgo can rgyal po bsde yi zha can gnod smin stag gi mgo can phra min sre mong gi mgo can:gzhan yang smon log sum brgya drag cu lngas ngan 'dre ru brdzas pa'i dam sri

nyul le bsnyen cing sgrub pa la bar du gcod pa nad kyi na bun slong ba dug gi tshang khang gtor ba: ngos mi zin pa'i gdon nad 'bebs pa rgyab brten bdud kyi 'khri ba:sna 'dren mo sri'i byed pa: sos yi 'jug pa gnyan gyis bzung ba sgrang zhing gas par byed pa klu yis gtong ba: hur thum rgyug 'gyel byed pa'i gza' yis cho 'phrul ngosami zin pa nag po sum sbrel: gso ru mi btub gshin rje'i kha rlangs shi tshad zhabrul ba kla sgo'i cho 'phrul dus ngan du ru'i rigs byed bco brgyad: rgya 'dre me zhen 'byung po rlung zhon: gson rnams dam sri: shi tshad 'dre ru gyur pa'i 'byung po'i tshogs rnams la sha khrag gtor ma gsur mchod 'dod pa'i yon tan nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam par sprul nas 'bul lo o sahūṃ lan gsum de ltar phul ba'i mthus bar chad 'byung po'i tshogs rnams ngoms shing tshims nas gnod gdug gi bsam pa dang bral: lan chags byang:bu lon sod sha mkhon dang: byang chub kyi sems rin po ches rgyud brlan yang dag pa'i lta ba phyin ci ma log pa rgyud la skye bar shog cig: slo bahūṃ bar do'i sems can

ba tshu khas zhan pa dbang chung ba zha bo long ba lkug pa 'on pa: tshe snga ma bor zhing phyi ma ma lon pa: srid pa bar ma do la 'khyam pa: skyabs dang skyel ma med pa: mgon dang dpung gnyen bral ba: sngon gyi bsags rgyab nyung ba ming bzhi 'dus pa'i phung po: snang ba dgra ru lang ba: tshor ba sdug bsngal gyi rang bzhin: 'jigs sgrag 'khrul snang gis gzir ba: bza' btung la re ba'i 'dod chags pa dge ba'i ra mda' nyung ba: 'khyag ltog skom pa'i gdung ba tshe tshad la nges pa med pa las rlung gis dbang gis gar 'gro'i rang dbang bral ba re zhing chags pa'i dmigs yul pho mos gtsor byas pa'i bar do la gnas pa thams cad la 'bul lo: tsho uhū: lan gsum de ltar phul ba'i las ngan pa'i sems can khas zhan pa rnams dpal grags dang ldan: dbang chung ba rnams blo shed stobs rtsal dang ldan: zha bo rkang mgyogs kyi mthu dang ldan long ba gsal byed mthong ba'i mig gi dbang po dang 'phrad: spug pa sma mkhas kyi lngags phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan: 'on pa kun thos rna ba'i dbang po dang ldan nas bde ba mchog dang ldan

par gyur cig gzhan yang bar do'i sems can rnams kyang rang rang so so'i las snang sdug bsngal bag chags dang bral: bar do la bar do yin par ngo shes: 'khrul snang rgyas theb: rjes dran drug dang ldan las ngan pa'i bag chags dang bral rig pa la rang dbang thob dag pa'i zhing khams rnams su btsan thabs nyid du bsgrod nus par gyur cig:oṃ sahūṃ bsod nams kyi tshogs rgya chen po 'di yi mthus bdag cag rnal 'byor sgrub pa po dang dge bar spyod pa'i skye 'gro yongs kyi shes rgyud la byams dang snying rje byang chub kyi sems rin po che dang ldan par gyur cig gnas skabs dang mthar thug kun tu bde ba phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan nas don gnyis lhun gyi grub par gyur cig bskal pa'i rtsub 'gyur ru 'dzing ngan pa zhi nas phan bde'i nyi ma gsar du 'khrung bar gyur cig: gzhan yang 'jig rten gyi khams kun tu char chu dus su 'bebs: lo phyug rtag tu legs mi nad dang phyugs nad kyi rgyun chad: rdzogs ldan gsar ba'i lang tsho la mnga' brnyeja/ pa ra gyur cig bdag mthong thos dran reg gi skye 'gro sems can thams cad kyi rgyud la

ba tshu thar ba'i sa bon 'jog nus par shog cig lo u/ a li.u li ta li haṃ bha li snya ti ya ya swā hā: lan bdun brjod par bya'o de nas bsdu rim bya ba 'di ltar ro snye u/:de ltar bsngos pa'i mgron bzhi'i lha tshogs rnams re bskang tshogs rdzogs sgrib pa kun dag nas don gnyis lhun grub dpal la dbang 'byor te: med byung rdzogs ldan dpal la spyod par shog snang cha thabs kyi bsdus pa'i dkyil 'khor lha shes rab stong nyid rdo rje btsun mo'i mkha': spros bral dbyings rig dbyer med chos sku'i ngang: 'khor gsum sku ngas dag chen por badzra rlu gzhan yang bsngo smon shis brjod la sogs pa yongs su grub par byas nas don gnyis kyi spyod pa mthar phyin tshogs rdzogs sgrib pa dag bar chad skyen sel bde dpal 'byor ba rgyas 'byung po'i tshog rnamasangoms shang tshim par 'gyur gnas skabs rgud pa ma lusazhi bar nges bden rdzun lag tu longasadang nge shesagasal dkon mod rgyal khamasa'agrim la ltosadang mthong thos nyung shu ga'i lce zur ston na yang rten 'brel legs nyes re dogs kun bral nas phyogs bcur sgogasadang phan bde'i lang tsho gzungs the tshom med do gu ru padma'i bga' sam mā rgya rgya rgya gsur mchod bdud rtsi'i sprin dpung rdzogasaso gter rgya

gtad rgya sbas rgya zab rgya gsang rgya o rgyan gyi slob dpon padma saṃ bha wa'i bka' bdag 'dra mkhar chen bzas bkod pa'o gu rgya lha cesapa 'di yang chos kyi bdag po 'gyur med rgya mchosabaskul ngor bdag 'dra dpa' bo nus ldan rdo rjes mkha' 'gro gsang ba'i brda ri las shas bshus te dag par phab pa dge legs 'phel/ sarba masgo lam/
badzra zab gsang rdo rje snying po las: thugs rje chen po dri med padma dkar po'i: lo rgyus rab gsal don gyi snying po ye shes sgon me zhes bya ba bzhugs so:

gtsarsha na mo ārya lo ki shwa ra ye: 4354411ma dusagasum rgyal ba sras bcas ma lus pa 'i ye shes dbyings sku thugs rje'i mnga' bdag mchog dri med padma dkar po'i dkyil 'khor la mthon mthing ral ba'i rgyan gyas rnam par mchod ma 'ongs snyig ma'i sems can dmu rgod rnams las nyon bdud kya 'tshe bas rtag tu mnar de tshe lha gzhan kun gyis gdul dka' bas thugs rje chen po yi dam mchog tu zungs sa ma mā de pang legasapa'i lo rgyus ma bshad na yad mi ches shang rgyu mtshan rtogs mi 'gyur de phyar mos da spro ba'i tshul gyis gson legs pa'i lo rgyus gsal bar smra bgya'o de yang dus gang gi tshe 'jig rten sgron ma rnam par bkod pa'i zhing khams su 'khor lo bsgyur rgyal ratna snang byed kyi sras su rgyal ba 'od mtshan stong 'bar sku bltam nas mngon par sangs rgyas pa'i tshe chos kyi blon po dha na dṛ sa manta zhes bya ba'i sras po dharma saṃ bṛ ta blo gros dang snying rje byams pa btang snyoms tshad med pa rnams 'byor ba'i skyes bu de nyid kyis byang chub mchog tu thugs bskyed nas rmad byung ye shes chen po'i ting nge 'dzin la mnyam par bzhag nas mngon par byang chub kyi go 'phang brnyes te rgyal ba nyid kyi spran sngar bskal ba ma stong bar du 'gro ba'i don rgya

ba tshu chen po byed par khas blangs dam bcas te byang chub sems dpa'i tshul bzung nas mtshan dri med padma dkar po 'am 'jig rten dbang phyug thugs rje chen po zhes yongs su grags pa'o: thugs bskyed dam bca' ltar 'khor ba dong nas lan gsum sprugs la slar ri bo po ṭa lar byon nas bltas tshe sngar ltar ma nyams par je mang du song nas 'dug pa'i skyo ba skyes te 'gro ba'i mtha' la zad dus med do da ni ci byed snyam nas sems bskyed cung zad ral ba'i tshe: dam bca' nyams pa'i rkyen gyis dbu tshal stong du gas pa'i skabs rgyal ba 'od mtshanastong 'bar gyi jo bo bcu gcig zhal du byin gyis brlabs nas 'gro ba'i don rgya chen po 'byung ba'i smon lam btab pa dang: spyan nas mchi ma byung ba srin mdzub kyis blang de sems can gyi don du smon lam btab cing dor ba'i tshe sgrol ma dkar sngonaganyis su gyur nas 'gro don rlabs po che mdzad pa dang: da dung yang bskal ba gang ga klong gi phye ma rted kyi grangs gnyis rdzogs pa'i bar du 'khor ba'i sems can rnams thugs rje thabs kyi 'dzin cing dbyings su 'dren par mdzad pa zhal

gyis bzhes so: de nas rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dpal brtsegs kyi rgyal po zhes bya bar gyur ba'i tshe sku tshe dang 'gro don gyi yun bskal ba bye ba khrag khrig dang 'bum phrag dgu bcu rtsa bdun gyi bar du bstan pa gnas zhing 'gro khams rgya mtsho dong nas sprugs par mdzad pa'i smon lam dang thugs bskyed rnam par dag pa de yi thugs rje'i sprul pa dang yang sprul bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig phyogs thams cad kun tu bkye ba las: 'jig rten gyi khams 'dir 'phags pa'i sprul ba'i spre'u byang chub sems dpa' dang: rje btsun ma'i sprul ba brag srin mo gnyis kyis khyims thab bzung nas bod mi bu rigs drug sprul la blo stobs rtsal dang ldan pa de yi rgyud las bod yul gyi mi rnams thams cad bskyed pa'i na 'phags pas gdung rgyud du grags pa dang khyad par mtha' 'khob pre ta pu ri'i zhing 'dul phyir phyag na rdo rje'i sprul pa rgyal po tho tho ri snyan btsan sku 'khrungs nas dam pa chos kyi dbu brnyes shing sems can la phan pa mdzad: de yis mthar rgyal rigs mang du byon rjes 'jig rten dbang phyug gi rnam 'phrul chos rgyal srong btsan sgam po sku bltam nas

ba:tshu dam pa chos kyi sgol btod la 'jig rten khams kyi mun pa gsal bar byas so:rje btsun sgrol ma dkar sngon gyi sprul pa rgya bza' dang bal bza' gnyis kyis tshul bzungs nas bstan gzhi gtsug lag khang ra sa 'phrul snang gis gtsos mtha' 'dul yang 'dul dang bcas pa dar zhing rgyas par mdzad do:de'i rgyun la bod yul 'phags pa rigs gsum mgon po'i 'dul zhing du gyur ba'i rten 'brel gyis dbang gis:'jig rten bod yul skyongs phyir 'jam dbyangs mi yi rgyal po khri sgong lde'u btsan sku 'khrungs nas bsam yas lhun grub kyi gtsug lag khang gling bzhi gling phran dang bcas pa bzhengs:sa rgyan gyi slob dpon padma saṃ bha wa dang mkhan chen bho dhi sa twa gnyis spyan drangs:sprul pa'i lo paṇa brgya rtsa brgyad po rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul du phyin nas dam pa'i chos sde ma lus gdan drangs:ma sangs dregs pa can thams cad tshar bcad:dam pa'i chos kyi sgron me sbar grub thob kyi lung pa bkang:rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin chen nyi ma shar ba lta bur dar zhing rgyas par mdzad do:bka' bab bu dgu smin grol gyi lam la gzud

nas grub pa'i rtags mtshan brtes:slar gu ru rin po che lho nub srin yul du bzhud par dgongs tshe gter gyi sgrub pa dang lta gon mdzan nas:miro tsa na:legs sbyin nyim:ldan ma rtse mang:klu yi rgyal mtshan ka ba dpal brtseg rnams kyis zab gsang brda yi ris su lhag chad med par bkod dgyes sde mopagashes mcho rgyal gyis zhu dag bgyis la byin gyis brlabs pa dang:ma hāgu ru rin po che'i rgya gsum chings lnga bsdam la da la'i dbus su bzhag:bsnyen sgrub bdun phrag bzhi dang zung gi bar du mdzad nas dga' ston tshogs 'khor rgya chen po bskor:gter bsrung dam can rgya mtsho rnams la brngan pa mdzad:rje 'bang nyer lnga po rang rang gi bsgo skal gdams bka' man ngag dbang lung khrid dang bcas pa gnang nas smin cing grol bar byas:gdams pa so so'i da la'i zhal phyes drod rtags ma byung bar du bsgrubs:de nas zab mo'i rdzas gter rnams ri brag mtsho chu gangs ljongs pha 'ong sgrub gnas thams cad la rgyas btab mi 'gyur ba'i rtags bkod:mi bsgra ba'i lung bstan mi 'da' ba'i phrin las bcol mi ral ba'i

ba:tshu gnyer kha gtad: bstan srung rnams kyis mi g.yel bar bsrung zhes khas blangs so: khyad par thugs rje chen po'i chos gter sgrub skor lnga bcu rtsa drug sbas pa las 'dir grub chen 'brog mi lo tsa'i dbang skal du: 'jig rten dbang phyug gi sgrub sde phyi nang gsang ba bdun gter kha snga phyi'i tshul du gtad pa'i nang tshan: byin rlabs kyi tshan kha che ba: dngos grub kyi rno myur zab pa: 'brel tshad don dang ldan pa: bar chad kyi sgrog grol ba: dam tshig la sel 'khris ma zhugs pa: zab gsang rdo rje snying po'i chos sde rmad byung dri med padma dkar po'i sgrub skor rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum du yod pa rnams gcig tu dril la yongs su bsdus nas rin po che'i brda yi ris su bcug la mdo khams rtse re da gsham du dgongs rgya btab po: o rgyan chen po srin yul du bzhud rjes bstan pa la 'phol bgrib re byung tshe gu rus smon lam gyi mthus gling pa rnam lnga gter chen brgya rtsa gter phran stong rtsa gnyis sogs byon nas phan bde spel ba'o: 'dir de dag gi nang tshan o rgyan chen po'i thugs kyi 'od zer las sprul pa'i gter ston: grub chen khye'u chung lo

tsā dngos su snang ba'i rig 'dzin nus ldan rdo rje de nyid kyis zab gsang rdo rje snying po'i chos skor rnams spyan drangs nas sgrub skor ma lus pa legs par gtan la phab pa dang khyad par 'phags mchog dri med padma dkar po'i sgrub skor rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum gyi nang tshan las: skabs 'dir bsdus pa'i las rim rnam gtan la phab pa'i nang tshan dbang mchog byin rlabs dngos grub kyi bang mdzod zhes bya ba'i brgyud pa ni: chos sku snang ba 'tha' yas: longs sku gsang ba 'dus pa: sprul sku dri med pad dkar sku gsang bde gshegs kun 'dus gsung mchog rgyal ba rgya mtsho: thugs dbyings 'gro ba kun grol yon tan sdug bsngal rang grol phrin las phyag na padma: tshogs brgyad rang grol gyi sems dpa' brgyad: yul tshogs rnam par grol ba'i sems ma bzhi: 'gro khams dong sprugs mdzad pa'i phyag stong spyan stong ngan song du kha 'joms par byed pa'i don yod zhags pa mdzod ldan yang gsang bla med: thugs rje'i mnga' bdag pad dkar phreng ba: ye shes kyi mkhyen cha ma 'gags pa'i ngan song dong sprugs dmus long mgo rmongs su

ba tshu gyur ba rnams bde chen gyi lam la 'god pa'i sras mchog nor bu 'dzin pa:yang gsang don dam pa'i chos kyi bcud skyongs ba'i sras mo gsang sngags 'dzin ma:sku gsung thugs yon brin las kyi rol gar rje btsun sgrol ma nyer gcig:zab gsang bstan pa'i sgron me o rgyan padma 'byung gnas mkha' 'gro ma las kyi dbang chen:slob dpon tsand+ra go mi:grub chen khye'u chung lo tsā:grub brnyes rma thogs rin chen:dge slong rgyal ba byang chub:rgyal mo g.yu sgra snying po:gzungs ma mkhar chen mtsho rgyal gnyag pa ye shes gzhon nu:nyang ban ting 'dzin bzang po:rig 'dzin bdud 'dul rdo rje dpa' bo bdud 'dul rol rtsal gar dbang bdud 'joms gling ba gter ston nus ldan rdo rje'i bar rim par brgyud ldan gyi zam pa ma chad:byin rlabs kyi rno nus ma yal:dngos grub kyi gzi 'od ma nyams:dam sel gyi lhung ba ma byung:brgyud ldan bla ma'i byin rlabs sim pa:ma dang mkha' 'gro'i zhal rlangs tho le:ye shes dang las la grub pa'i dam can rgya mtsho'i sgog snying:tshegs med la don 'grub pa:dka' thub med par nyams

len sla ba: 'brel tshad rnam grol gyi lam la 'god pa'i gdams pa bdud rtsi 'chi gsos kyis sman lta bu: dpe seng ge dkar mo'i 'o ma las rno nus che ba: snod gang yang rung ba la bcud mi chags pa dam tshig dang dad pa dag snang mos gus ldan pa la 'phrad pa tsam gyis bde chen ye shes stsol med du rtogs nas dag pa'i zhing la rnam par grol ba'i thabs zab mo khyad par 'phags pa yin pas kun gyis nyams su len par mdzod cig: de ltar brda sprad mos gus dag pa yis zhugs na dbang dang dngos grub ma lus thob the tshom med do rdo rje rgyal po'i bka' bden rdzun lag tu long dang nges shesagasal bka' gsang skal med lag tu ma shor cig dam ldan snying gi bu dang 'phrad par shog nga spruladapa' bo nus na rdo rje yis rted na 'gro ba bsam yasa'adren pa dang bstan pa'i ba dan phyogs bcur sgrogs gyur cig sam mā rgya rgya rgya lo rgyusarab gsal don gyi snying po ye shes sgron me zhes bya ba rdzogs so gter rgya gtad rgya sbasargya zab rgya gsang rgya gu rgya mo rgyan gyi slob dpon padma saṃ bha wa'i bka' bdag 'dra mkhar chen bzas bkod pa'o brda thim snyi cesapa 'di 'ang chosakya bdag popadma chesa'apel rgya mtsho dang chos bdaga'agyur med rgya mcho slob bu padma rnam rgyal gyis bkra shis lha reg dngul gyi

bsgo/ji rdo rje rtse rgyal ldem sgo dbang lnga'i cod paṇa dang bcas nas yang yang bskul ba'i ngor bdag 'dra dpa' bo nus ldan rdo rjes mkha' 'gro gsang ba'i brda ris lagazhal bsas te dag par phab pa dge legasa'aphel/sabo maṅga lam/
badzra cha zab gsang rdo rje snying po las: thugs rje chen po dri med padma dkar po'i gsang dbang byin rlabs dngos grub kyi bang mdzod zhes bya ba bzhugs so:

bsgo/: na mo ārya ma ki shwa ra ye: thob5141 rgyalakun thugasarje'i dbang phyug 'gro ba' mgon dri med padma dkar po ye shes dbyangs khams gsum 'khor ba sku gsum dbyings rol ba'i dri bral padma dkar por phyag bgyi'o ma 'ongasal ldan skal bzang pho mo rnams rim gnyis lam la 'jug par 'dod pa'i tshe med du mi rung 'jug sgo zab mo' dbang byan rlabs daro sa grub bang mdzod zhes pa bstan sa ma yu de mang spyor ba rdzas kya rim pa ni bum pa bharnya rig ma shel rdo da : nyer mkho' sku tsag la sogs mkho ba'i chas yongs su rdzogs pa grub par byas nas su da la'i dbus bkod mdzes shing yid 'ong bya rnam lnga nyer spyod sman gtor rakta bkram rnal 'byor blo sems dngas ba'i brtul bzhugs kyis bde ba'i stan la bag phab lus tshigs bsrang byams dang snying rje lta ba'i mdangs bskyed ci : mkhon 'dzing bral bar dga' spro tshad med pas bdag mdun bum bzlas tshad dang ldan par bya tshogs dang bskang gsol rgya chen gtong nas slar bdag 'jug rig me dor la dab bzhi blangs de nas sgo drung slob ma 'du byas la khrus byed sgrib sbyang bzlos pa 'a gnad la 'bad mig dar bkab cing me tog 'dzin par bya bgegs bsgrad bsrung 'khor bsgom la maṇḍal phul bden pa 'i don bshad spro ba'i shugs bskyed do de nas gsol ba gdab pa 'i ram pa ni kyi sku bzhi'i mnga' bdag rdo rje slob dpon dgongs:

ba:tshu bdag la smin grol rim gnyis 'jug pa'i sgo: zab lam rdo rje snying po'i chos sde yi: dri med padma dkar po'i dbang dngos grub: da lta nyid du gnang bar mdzad du gsol lan gsum rjes su bla ma'i lan gan ba rdo las smon dus 'dzom rigs bzang skyes bu rnams yang gsang rdo rje'i lam la rab mos pa: kha tsam min na don gyi ngo mtshar che: sdom pa dam tshag bsrung na dngos grub thob: gnad mi ldan rnams rang sar phyir dnges shig: de nas skyabs su 'gro ba'i rim pa ni na mo dus 'di nas bzung byang chub ma thob par: skyabs gnas mchog gyur yang gsang thugs rje'i gter dri med padma dkar po'i lha tshogs la: sgo gsum mos gus gdung bas skyabs su mchi lan gsum rjes su sems bskyed sgom pa ni ho pha mar gyur ba'i 'gro drug sems can rnams rang rig bde chen dbyings su ngal bso phyir tshad med rnam bzhis 'gro ba 'dul slad du: zung 'jug byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed do: lan gsum rjes su yan lag bdun pa ni ces yis/: skyabs gnas kun 'dus 'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs: dri med padma dkar po la phyag 'tshal:

snang srid 'dod yon kun bzang mchod pa 'bul:mi dge sdig pa'i las kun mthol lo bshags zag dang zag med dge la rjes yi rang:zeg gsum chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bskul rgyal rnams mya ngan mi 'da' bzhugs gsol 'debs:dus gsum dge tshogs bsdus te 'gro la bsngo phyam gcig gdod ma'i rgyal sa zin par 31ga:lan gsum rjes su rigs lnga'i sdom bzung ni ho:rdo rje slob dpon thugs rje brtse ba'i dgongs rdo rje rigs kyi dam tshig zab mo ni:phyag rgya rdo rje dril bu 'bral med bsten byang chub sems ni nam yang mi spang ngo:rin chen rigs kyi dam tshig sdom pa ni sbyin pa rnam bzhi rtag tu sbyin pa dang:'dod 'byung ye shes snying po bsgom par bya padma rigs kyi dam tshig sdom pa ni phyi nang gsang ba'i theg pa rnam gsum bshad:dam chos rgya mtsho'i gnad la rtag par brtson:las kyi rigs kyi sdom pa dam tshig tu bsam dang sbyor ba ma lus kun tu yang:'gro ba yongs kyi don la 'bad par bgyi:de bzhin rigs kyi dam tshig bla med du:dkyil 'khor gsum dang nam yang mi 'bral zhing:rtsa ba yan lag dam

ba tshu tshig bsrung bar bgyi: so sor thar dang byang chub sems dpa' sdom: rig 'dzin sngags kyi spyod pa brkyang bar bgyi: nam yang gnad las mi 'da' sa ma yā:lan gsum rjes su dam chu sbyin pa ni hūṃ hrī: 'di ni dus gsum rgyal ba thams cad kyis: phrin las gcig rdzogs rdo rje gnod sbyin gyi: sgog gi mna' chu gsang sngags snying po'i bcud:skal ldan sgob ma khyod kyi lce la bzhag dam tshig bsrung na zung 'jug sangs rgyas thob: nyams na rdo rje'i dmyal bar shi ka re: de ba'i sdom la gnas mdzod dam tshig can: nyen badzra sa ma yā na ra gaṇa du khaṃ rakṣa rakta: uddha 'i 'i: de nas slob ma lha bskyed bya ba ni bdag nyid skad cig gis thugs rje chen po dri med padma dkar po gsal ba'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros: skal ldan gyi slob ma rnams la phog: lus ngag yid gsum gyi sdig sgrib nyes lhung thams cad dag: dngas ma 'od kyi rang bzhin du gyur: gdos bral ye shes kyi lha ru bzhengs ba ni zhes pa'i mtshams su gzhung gi lha bskyed bya de nas ye shes dbab pa'i rim pa ni hūṃ hrī: rang snang mi shig bde chen dag pa'i zhing: ri bo po ṭa la yi gnas mchog nas:

'phags mchog thugs rje chen po gtso 'khor bcas: gnas 'dir dad pa'i spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: skal ldan slob ma 'di la dbang bzhi bskur bgegs dang log 'dren bar chad bsal ba dang: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsal du gsol: sgo ārya lo ki shwa ra sarba sa pā ri wā ra badzra sa ma ya dza dza: e a ra li hrīng trīng phe phe : a we sha ya a āḥ ye shes pa de brtan par bzhugs pa ni pra ti sarba arya ma ki shwa ra dzaḥhūṃ be ho: tiṣṭha badzra: de nas me tog dor bar bya ba ni hūṃ hrī tshe rabs las kyi lha skal gyur pa yi: yeshes thugs rje spyan ras gzigs dbang gi: sku gsung thugs mchog 'grub pa'i mkha' dbyings su: rigs kyi me tog phob la byin gyis rlobs: bla puspe pra ti tsa shrī ho: de nas gsang ba'i mtshan gdags rim pa ni me tog dbus su bab na padma klong yangs shar du bab na padma kun gzigs lho ru bab na pa dma rgyal po nub tu bab na padma chags spyod byang du bab na padma kun skyong mtshams su bab na padma sna tshogs rdo rje zhes gdags so me tog tshom bu'i dbang bskur bya ba ni hūṃ trī las smon rten 'brel phun sum tshogs pa yis: bskyed pa'i lhag lha dri bral thugs rje'i bdag: 'od zer sna lnga'i

ba:tshu spro bsdu dang bcas par: skal ldan rnams kyis chang pa'i bu gar zhugs: dbu ma'i lam brgyud mi shig thig le la: dbyer med 'dres nas dbang bzhi thob par mos: yo ārya lo ki shwa ra pra te skṛ ha ṇa e me tiṣṭha badzra : de nas mig dar bsal bar bya ba ni hūṃ hrī: bde gshegs snying po sku gsum ye shes zhal: bsgrib byed ma rig ling tog dri ma kun: ye shes thugs rje'i gser thur 'bar bas dbye: kun rmongs 'thibs pa'i bag chags bral gyur cig: 31 dzñā na tsakyu pra we sha ya phaṭa: de nas mthong ba bstan par bya ba na hūṃ:ltos shig mdun gyi dkyil 'khor nyid la ltos: mtshan ma rdzas kyi bkod pa phun tshogs 'di: brda' thabs phyag rgya'i rol pa la brten nas: ngo bo rang bzhin thugs rje ye shes gshis: dus gsum rgyal ba'i dgongs klong rtogs par mdzod: 'di las gzhan pa'i yi dam lha zhes pa: log na dngos por ma grub rigs kyi bu: don dam gshis kyi lha zhal mthong bar mdzod: a a āX phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa de nas thun mong rig pa'i dbang bskur ni rang nyid thugs rje chen po'i thugs ka nas: 'od zer rab 'phros rgyal ba sras dang bcas: bde

gshegs rigs lnga'i rnam par spyan drang nas: mdun gyi nam mkha'i gnas su sa ma dza 3 badzra pace dhu pe a lo ke gharnye nee phe bye shabha a hūṃ (: mi rtog rdo rje thabs kyi ye shes gar dmigasamed shes rab yum gyi dbyings su rol thugs rje'i bye brag sna tshogs 'gro ba 'dul: rgyal ba rigs lnga'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: cesabarngod pas gshegs pa rnamasakyisadagongs pa mdzad gshegasam rnamasakyis dbang bskur byang chub sems dpa' rnamasakyis shes pa brjod sems ma rnams kyis glu blang khro bo rnams kyis bgegs bskrad khro mo rnams kyis bro 'khyab kun kyang dbang gi bya ba la dgongs par bsam la mi bskyod pa chu yi dbang ni /: nyon mongs zhe sdang rtog pa rnam dag cing: ye shes thugs kyi rdo rje rtogs byed pa'i gtsang la dri ldan chu yi dbang bskur ro bum pa lha yi snod rung dpal thob shog rtsa sngags mthar dzñā na a dhiṣṭha na shrī a bhi ṣiñtsa /: rin 'byung dbu rgyan dbang ni 'di ltar ro sa: tshor phung nga rgyal rtog pa rnam dag cing gsang sngags bla med 'chad nyan la dbang ba'i bde gshegs rigs lnga'i dbu rgyan 'di bskon pas bde stong ye shes rtogs pa'i dbang thob shog: rtsa sngags mthar sa ratna a snyi ṣiñtsa

badzra shrī hūṃ:snang mtha' rdo rje'i dbang bskur bya ba ni sa:'du shes 'dod chags rtog pa rnam dag cing ma 'dres so sor rtog la mnga' brnyes pa'i:bde chen 'pho med rdo rje nyid gtad pas:mi 'gyur snang mtha' yas pa'i dbang thob shog:rtsa sngags mthar o padma badzra a bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ don grub dril bu'i dbang bskur rim pa ni /:'du byed phrag tog rtog pa rnam dag cing 'gro ba ma lus 'dul la mnga' brtes pa'i:chags bral chos dbyings dril bu 'di gtad pas zung 'jug chos nyid don rtogs dbang thob shog:rtsa sngags mthar oṃ garma pradzñā a bhi 144 1 hūṃ:rnam snang mi gi dbang bskur rim pa na sa:gzugs kung gtimug rtog pa rnam dag cing:chos rnams ma 'dres so sor mkhyen pa yi rmongs pa kun bral rnam par snang byed kyi:ming gi dbang mchog rig ldan khyod la sbyin rtsa sngags mthar o bhurnya ka la sha a bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ:de nas rdo nge rgyal po 'a dbang ni /:snang ba ma 'gags don gyi rdo rje che:sngong nyid rang rgol shes rab dil bu'i gzugs:gnyis med zung 'jag rngo rje sol po'i dbang:phyag rba lnga lngan dam tshig chos kyi rjen:rigs mchog stes bu khyed la

bdag gis sbyin: de rang phyin chad sgom bya'i dkyil 'khor dang: bsnyen sgrub bzlas brjod rtsa ba bdag yin pas: dam tshig phyag rgya chen po khyod kyis zungs: ma badzra sa ma ya hūṃ: dzñā na dhartu e: sarba ma hā su kha sirnyi hūṃ: dzaḥhūṃ baṃ ho: kā ya wākka tsitta tiṣṭha badzra ho nya: zhes pa'i bde' sbyar phyag rgya bca' ba'o de nas dngos gzhi'i dbang bskur zhu ba' yon maṇḍal phul la gsol ba gdab pa ni kye ho sku bzhi'i bdag nyid 'gro mgon bla ma dgongs: bdag cags las ldan skal bzang pho mo la: dri med padma dkar po'i dngos gzhi'i dbang yongs rdzogs ma lus gnang ba'i bka' drin stsol lan gsum rjes su bla ma'i lan gnang ba kye ho tshogs smon las 'phro 'dzoms pa'i rigs can rnams: yang gsang lam la mos pa ngo mtshar che:dbang bzhi'i ye shes bskyed sgom mthar phyin mdzod: tha mal 'khrul ba'i blo rtog bral gyis la rang gsal ga ga ma'i ye shes gdangs skyongs dang: smin grol dbang gi 'jug sgo sbyin bgyi'o: de nas bum pa thogs la 'ad skad do hūṃ hrī kun zlum bum pa rgya tshad bral ba'i dbus: bde gshegs kun gyi sku yi byin rlabs bcud: 'od zer dkar po'i 'phro 'du

ba tshu dang bcas pa: deng 'dir skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: snang stong gnyis med ye shes mjal ba dang: lus dang rtsa yis sgrib pa kun dag cing: rdo rje'i sku mchog 'grub pa'i dbang thob shog: rtsa sngags mthar kwa ya a snyi ṣiñtsa sa de nas thugs rje pho po' sku gtad la hūṃ hrī: byams dang snyeng rje'i 'od zer rlabs po ches: 'gro ba ma lus gang la gang 'dul mdzad: dri med padma dkar po'i dbang bskur ro: khams gsum g.yul las rgyal ba'i dpal thob 31ga: rtsa sngags mthar kā ya a snyi shisdom tshe: de nas snang ba mtha' yas kyis sku gtad la hūṃ hrī: ma chags padma rā ga'i mdangs 'dzin cing: thugs rje chags pa'i ngan song dong sprugs mdzad: 'dren pa 'od mtha' yas pa'i dbang bskur ro: bde chen zhing la spyod pa'i dpal thob shog: rtsa sngagasamathar kā ya a sti ṣiñtsa ma: de nas nor bu 'dzan pa'i sku gto la hūṃ trī: dgos 'dod kun 'byung yid bzhin nor ltar 'phel: dbul phongs rgyad sel phan bde'i lang tsho ston: sras mchog nor bu 'dzin pa'i dbang basmar ro: 'gro bar bde legs stsol nus dpal thob shog: rtsa sngags mthar ka ya a snyi 〉〉 tshe: de nas

gsang sngags 'dzin ma'i sku gam la hū hrī: gsang sngags rdo rje snying po'i bcud 'dzin cing: rgyal ba ma lus bskyed pa'i dbyings chen mo: dgyes mdzad gsang sngags 'dzin ma'i dbang bskur ro bstan pa phyogs bcur sgrogs pa'i dpal thob 31ga: rtsa sngags mthar kā ya a snyi ṣiñtsa ma: de nas byang sems mched brgyad kyi sku gtad la hū hrī: dzadzags brgyad gnas dag 'khor ba'i sgo brgyad gcod ye shes thugs rjes 'gro khams kha lo bsgyur: byang chub sems dpa' brgyad kyi dbang bskur ro: yul brgyad rang sar sgrol ba'i dpal thob shog rtsa sngagasamathar kā ya a snyi ṣiñtsa oṃ de nas sems ma bzhi'i sku gto la hū hrī dga' ba bzhi yi cho rol la brten nas: bcu drug gsum gyi don mthar rdzogs byed pa'i rigs mchog sems ma bzhi yi dbang bskur ro: tshad med rnam bzhis 'gro khams 'dren nus regag: rtsa sngags mthar kā ya a snye ṣiñtsa cha: de nas rta mgrin rags bzhi'i sku gtad la hū hrī: rtag chad mu bzhi gnas su dag pa'i dbyings gdug pa tshar gcod khro rgyal rigs mchog bzhi: sgo smong hya kṛ wa'i dbang bskar ro: phrin las rnam bzhi mdzad pa mthar phyin shog: rtsa sngags

ba tshu mthar kwa ya a snyi ṣiñtsa sa: de nas lha bu ming sring ga sku gtad la hūṃ hrī bde dang stong pa'i rgyas 'debs 'gro ba'i mgon: legs nyes ltang 'dzin bstan pa srung mdzad pa'i: skyes chen lha bu ming sring dbang bskur ro: zab gsang bstan pa phyogs bcur spel nus shog: rtsa sngags mthar kā ya a snyi ṣiñtsa sa: de nas gas dbang bskur ba ni bhasto bdud rtsi gto la hūṃ hrī: mtshan ldan dum gcig ka pā la yi nang: bde chen ye shes byang sems bcud kyis gtams: gsung gsang a li ka li'i rang sgra sgrogs: 'gags med bdud rtsi sman gyi bcud chen pos: deng 'dir skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: bde stong gnyis med ye shes mjal ba dang: ngag dang rlung gi sgrib pa kun dag cing: rdo rje'i gsung mchog 'grub pa'i dbang thob regag: rtsa sngags mthar wākka a snyi ṣiñtsa āḥ de nas sngags 'khor gam la hū hrī: gsang sngags rig sngags gzung sngags ma lus pa'i: snying po bcud dril ye shes sngags 'khor lo: deng 'dir skal ldan bu la dbang bskur ba'i: bzlas pas 'gro drag dbyings sgol dpal thob shog: rtsa sngagasamathar wākka a bhi 〉〉 ā de nas bsgra phreng

gtad la hūṃ trī rgyal ba rigs brgya'i dkyil 'khor rdzogs pa'i dbyings:—bzlas pa sngags la spyod pa'i rten 'brel rdzas dri bral bsgrangs phreng brgya rtsa'i dbang bskur ro bsnyen sgrub bzlas pa'i don rnams mthar phyin regag: rtsa sngags mthar wākka a snyi ྅kwa āḥ de nas dung dkar g.yas 'khyil gtad la /: gsung dbyangs 'gags med dam pa'i chos kyi sgras: 'khor ba'i g.yul bzlog mya ngan 'das la 'god: ma 'gags grags stong dung gi dbang bskur ro: gang 'dul chos sgo 'byed pa'i dpal thob shog: rtsa sngags mthar wākka a snyi ṣiñtsa u de nas sher dbang bskur ba na rdo rje'i rig ma gto la hūṃ hrī bcu drug mdangs ldan 'dzum pa'i lang tsho'i 'byud: rigs lnga'i tshul 'dzin rdo rje'i pho nya mo bde stong dga' bzhi'i 'byung gnas ḍakki ni: deng 'dir skal ldan bu la gtad pa yis: 'du shes gsum gyi rol rtsed la brten nas: dga' ba bcu drug stong pa'i 'od gsal 'bar: thig le bcu drag rgya ba rang sar dag: dga' stong ye shes mngon tu grur ba dang yid dang thig le'i snyib pa kun dag nas: rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sa la phyin par shog: rtsa sngags mthar ldami

ba tshu a snyi ṣiñtsa āḥ de nas phyag ma' rigs lnga gtad la hūṃ hrī: sku gsung thugs yon phrin las rdzogs pa'i gter rgyal ba rigs lnga'i byin rlabs mchog gi rdzas: phyag mtshan rnam pa lnga yi dbang bskur ro: ye shes lnga yis 'gro ba 'dul gyur cig: rtsa sngags mthar citta a snyi ṣiñtsa nyu: de nas padma dang bsgrang phreng gtad la hū hrī: ma chags padma 'dab brgyad dri ma bral: gsal 'bar shel dkar phreng ba brgya rtsa yis: deng 'dir skal ldan bu la dbang bskur ro: wan skyes ye shes rtogs pa'i dpal thob shog: rtsa sngags mthar tsitta a snyi ṣiñtsa nyu: de nas lcags kyu dang nor bu gtad la hū hrī thugs rje lcags kyus 'gro ba gnas nas 'dren: 'dod 'byung nor bus tshe dpal bsod nams bskyed: deng 'dir skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: don gnyis lhun gyis grub pa'i dpal thob shog rtsa sngags mthar citta a bhe ṣiñtsa hūṃ: de nas pusta ratna gtad la hūṃ hrī gsang sngags chos kyi 'byung gnas gegs bam dang sgrab la dngos grab char 'bebs ratra'i gter deng 'dir skol lngan bu la dbang bskar bas bsden sgrab bsgom brnas 'gro don mthar phyin shog:

rtsa sngags mthar tsitta a snyi ṣiñtsa /: de nas tshe bum 'bras snye pa dma rnams gtad la hūṃ hrī 'chi med tshe yi dpal ster bum pa bzang: bde chen ye shes 'dab rgyas myu gu dang dri bral chags med padma dkar po yis: deng 'dir skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: byams dang snying rjes 'gro 'dul dbang thob shog: rtsa sngags mthar tsitta a bhe ṣiñtsa hūṃ de nas lcags zhags sgog dril rnamasagam la hūṃ hrī snying rje lcags kyus 'gro ba gnas nas 'dren byams pa'i zhags pas ngan 'gro'i g.yang las skyob: dga' ba'i sgrog gis dmus long btsan thabs sgol: btang snyoms dril bus 'khor ba'i gnas stong mdzad: deng 'dir skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: tshad med rnam bzhis 'gro 'dul dbang thob shog: rtsa sngags mthar tsitta a snyi ṣiñtsa shā: de nas lcags kyu dang gter bum gto la hūṃ trī gdug pa'i rgenas stong lcags kyus 'gro ba 'dren 'dod 'byung bum pas sgrub la phan bde spel: deng 'dir skal ldan bu la dbang basmrar bas: bstan pa'i 'gro don gegs med 'byung gyur cig rtsa sngags mthar tsitā a snyi 〉〉 hūṃ de nas tshag dbang bskur ba ni 'ja' shel gam la tram̐ hri dri bral

ba:tshu 'od gsal dag pa chos kyi dbyings ma 'gags zang thal 'od dang thig le'i mdzes: rang grol mtshan 'dzin dag pa'i 'ja' shel gyis: rigs mchog skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: rig stong gnyis med ye shes mjal ba dang: snang gsum 'pho ba'i bag chags dri ma bral: rdo rje'i thugs mchog 'grub pa'i dbang thob shog: rtsa sngagasamathar sarba a snyi ṣiñtsa hrī: de nasardo rje gto la hū hrī rgyal ba kun gyi thugs dbyings mtshon pa'i rdzas: ye shes rdo rje gzung 'dzin dri bral 'dis: deng 'dir skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas 'gyur med rdo rje 'dzin pa'i dpal thob shog: rtsa sngags mthar sarba a snyi ṣiñtsa hrī: de nas a dkar gtad la hū hrī: uni skye med chos dbyings stong pa nyid: ma 'gags zang thal bde chen dri ma bral: rang grol 'pho med chen po'i dbang bskur ro: ka dag ye shes rtogs pa'i dpal thob shog rtsa sngags mthar sarba a snyi ṣiñtsa trī: de nas rtsal dbang bskur ba ni me long dngas gsal gtad la hūṃ hrī kun nas rlum la 'khyil zhing dngas gsal ba: mi shig grwa zur bral ba'i ye shes gshis g.ya' dag dri bral me long mdzes pa

'di: deng 'dir skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: rig dbyings zung 'jug ye shes mjal ba dang: ma rig dri ma mkha' ltar dag sangs nas: dbyings gsum 'gyur med don rtogs dpal thob shog: rtsa sngags mthar pradzñā dzñā na a snyi ṣiñtsa hūṃ hrī: de nas 'ja' thig gam la hū hrī chos dbyings mi 'gyur grwa zur kun bral ba'i ye shes lnga ldan thig le rab mdzes pa'i: deng 'dir skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: mtshan ma tshig bral rtogs pa'i dpal thob shog: rtsa sngags mthar pradzñā dzñā na a bhi ṇiñtsa hūṃ trī: de nas thig le stong sgron gto la hūṃ hrī klong chen sku gsum ye shes gnyug ma'i gshis: ma 'gags zang thal kun zlum ye shes dbyings: deng 'dir skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: sku gsum rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor mthong bar shog: rtsa sngagasamathar pradzñā dzñā na a bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ hrī: de nas a mthing gto la hūṃ hrī mthing gsal bde chen ye shes 'byung ba'i gnas: rgyal ba kun gyis thugs gsang aḥmathing nag: deng 'dir skal lngan bu la dbang bskor bas: gnas lugs rang zhal mjal ba'i dpal thob shog: rtsa sngags mthar pradzā dzā na a ji 〉〉 hūṃ hri de

0〈tshu nas gtor ma gam la hūṃ hrī: brdal khyab ka dag yangs pa'i gzhong pa rtsa lhun grub dpal gyi gtor chen brjid ldan ni: nyi zla 'od zer 'bar ba'i rgyan gyis spras: sku dang ye shes klong mdzod chen po ni: deng 'dir skal ldan bu la gtad pa yis: rang g.yin don gnyis lhun gyis grub pa dang: mdzad pa med byung mchog gi dpal thob regag: rtsa sngags mthar snyed yisahūṃ maṇḍal gu hye bha lirnyi sarba sirnyi pha la a bhi ྅༷/ hūṃ hrī: mtha' rten bkra shis rdzas rtags rgyal srad gtad bsngo ba smon lam shes brjod rgya chen bya gnad des don gnyis lhun gyis grub pa dang sku dang ye shes spyod pa mthar phyin 'gyur sa ma wā yem rgyal ba'i dbang po padma saṃ bha was ma 'ongs 'gro la brtse ba chen po yis thugs kya yang ba da rdo rje snying po' chos grub pa'i dbang phyugakhye'u chung khyod la gtad da lta ma spel rin chen brda' la thob mdo khams rtse shod gsham du dgongs rgya sdom ma 'ongs snyigs ma sum bcu kha ral dus nga spruladapa' po nus ldan rdo rje 'byung skyes bu de dang gdams pa 'di 'phrad nas bstan pa'i 'gro don rgya chen 'byung bar 'gyur 'brel thog 'bum phrag po ṭa la ru 'god bden rdzun lag tu longs dang nges shes gsal skal med lag tu ma shor lha yis sring las can snying gi bu ya dpal du shog sa ma yu rgya rgya rgya dbang

mchog bdud rtsi'i bum bzang rdzogs so gter rgya gtad rgya sbas rgya zab rgya gsang rgya gu rgya o rgyan gyi slob dpon padma saṃ bha wa'i bka' bdag 'dra mkhar chen bzas bkod pa'o brda thim snyi cesapa 'di'ang chosakyi bdag po padma chosa'aphel rgya mtsho dang chos bdag 'gyur med rgya mtshos radzing snod 'bru yis bkang ba dang slob bu padma rnam rgyal gyis bkra shisalha regs rin chen gnyis pa'i rdo rje rtse rgyal ldem sgro dbang lnga'i cod paṇa gyis skyesadang bca yang yang bskul ba dang slob bu ye shes grogs mo ratna sa ra rnamasakyis yang yad bskul ngor bdag 'dra dpa' bo nu ldan rdo rjesamakha' 'gro gsang ba'i brda' risalasazhal bshusate dag par phab pa dge legabanga'aphel/ sarba masgo lam/

bsgotshu zab gsang rdo rje snying po las: thugasarje chen po dri med padma dkar po'i don dbang bsdus pa padma'i do shal zhes bya ba bzhugs so:badzra na mo gu ru padma kā ra ye rgya1sngomadza /sgro//glo thugs rje brtse ba'i 'od stong gis dad lan gdul bya'i blo gros kyi padro'i 'dabs 'bras smin mdzad pa'i padma dkar po la phyag 'tshal bdag 'dra padma 'byung gnas nges ma 'ongs las ldan don phyir du snying dang 'dra ba'i man ngag mchog smin byed dbang gi rim pa bstan sa ma mā de nas bum pa rdzas ldan dang dza gad gtams pa'i kwa pa la shes rab rig ma 'ja' shel dang thig le stong pa'i sgron ma dang sgrub gtor padma zlum 'khor can da la' dbus bkod rnam lnga dang nyer spyod phyi nang gsang mchod sprin bdag nyid bde ba'i stan la gnas bdag mdun bum bzlas mchod tshogs bskang rig me dor zhing maṇḍal phul bdag nyid 'jug pa'i bya ba byed slob ma gral 'khod khrus bgegs bsal srung 'khor sgom zhing bden don bshad maṇḍal phul la gsol gdab ni (1ཿ ma11nga 11sa dran reg rnam 'dren bla ma dgongs bdag la smin byed dbang gi dngos grub mchog: da lta nyid du gnang bar mdzad pa dang: rdo rje snying po'i lam la 'god par zhu: lan gsum rjes su bla ma'i lan

gnang ba kyi loste: tshogs smon las 'bras dus su sad pa yi: rigs ldan skyes bu khyed cag gsan du gsol: gsang sngags sgor zhugs sla ste bsrung sdom dka': gnad gsang bsrung na dbang dang dngos grub sbyin: mi nus pa rnams rang sar phyir dengs shig: dbye bsal byas la skyab 'gro semasabaskyed 'bog sdom pa thob phyir yan lag bdun pa skyangs de nas dam khasablangs pa'i rim pa ni kyi rdo rje slob dpon sangs rgyas kun dngos dgongs: bdag ni gsang sngags rdo rje'i sgor zhugs nas: phyi nang gsang ba'i rigs lnga'i sdom pa bzung: so thar sdom bzung gzhan gnod bya ba spang byang sems sdom bzung gzhan phan don la bslab: gsang sngags dam bsrung sgo gsum rdo rjer blta: spyi dang bye brag lhag pa'i dam tshig rnams 'da' med srog gi gta' ru 'dzin par bya: lan gsum rjes su dam chu sbyin pa mi hūṃ trī: 'di ni dus gsum rgyal ba thams cad kyi: gsang ba'i mna' chu dam tshig sgog gi bcud rdo rje khro bo gnod sprin rang mdangs can: dad ldan sgob ma khyod kyi lce la bzhag: dam bsrung dbang dang dngos grub thob par byed: nyams na sgog gi gshed gyur mnar

gtsarsha bar 'gyur: de yi gnad las ma 'da' sa ma yā: yin sa hūṃ kā ya wākka tsitta badzra sa ma ya na ra gaṇa: me tog sbyin cing mig dar bkab par bya de nas slob ma lha bskyed bya ba ni gzung 'dzin gnyis bsdus kyi chos thams cad kyi gnas lugs rtag chad gnyis su ma gyur pa'i dbu ma'o: stong gsal de yi ngang las slob ma ye shes kyi lha skur ldang ba ni:gzhung bzhin bskyed cing ye shes nan du dbab pheb pa' ma tshogs brtan pa ra bzhugs su gsol de nas me tog dor ba'i rims pa ni hūṃ hrī spyodan spyod las kyis 'brel ba'i lhag pa'i lha'i: sku gsung thugs mchog rdzogs pa'i da la na dad ldan bdag gis phul ba'i me tog 'di dbab par mdzod la byin gyis brlab du gsol: padzapra te tstsha bṛ ho: gsang ba'i ma' btags tshom bu'i dbang bskur ni ye ma ho chos nyid skye med dbyings las ma g.yos kyang: thugs rje thabs kyis 'gro ba'i don mdzad phyir: sku gsung thugs yon phrin las 'dus pa'i gter lhag lha dri med padma dkar po'i dal: tshom bu gcig tu 'od zer 'du 'phro bcas: dad ldan slob ma'i tshangs pa'i bu gar zhugs: dbu ma'i lam brgyad mi shig thig ler 'dres: dbang

dang byin rlabs dngos grub thob par shog: pra ti e me tiṣṭha badzra: de nas mig dar dbye ba ni hū hrī bde gshegs gnyug ma'i rang zhal sku gsum klong: mngon du ma gyur gzung 'dzin smag gis g.yog thabs mkhas thugs rje'i ye shes lcags kyu yis dri ma kun bsal lha zhal mthong bar 31ga dzña na tsakyu pra we sha ya phaṭa: de nas bum dbang bskur ba'i rim pa ni hūṃ trī: kun zlum bum pa rgya tshad bral ba'i dbus bde gshegs thugs rje'i byin rlabs bcud gyis gtams: deng 'dir rigs ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: lus dang rtsa yi sgrib pa kun dag nas: snang stong gnyis med rtogs pa'i dbang thob shog: rtsa sngags mthar kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa tshe: de nas gsang dbang bskur ba'i rim pa ni hū bde skyong kā pa la yi snod kyi nang bla ma yab yum sbyor ba'i bcud kyis gtams: deng 'dir rigs ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: ngag dang rlung gi sgrib pa kun dag nas gsal stong gnyis med rtogs pa'i dbang thob shog: rtsa sngags mthar wākka a snyi ṣiñtsa u de nas sher dbang bskur ba'i rim pa ni hūṃ hrī dga' bzhi'i 'byung gnas gsang sngags thabs kyi lam: bcu drug bde

ba tshu ba'i mdangs ldan mdza' na mo'i: deng 'dir rigs ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: yid dang thig li'i sgrib pa kun dag nas: bde stong gnyis med rtogs pa'i dbang thob shog: rtsa sngags mthar pra dzñā dzñā na.a bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ: de nas ka dag tshag dbang bskur ba'i ram pa ni hū hrī: shin tu dwangs shingagasal ba 'od lnga zlum: dri bral 'ja' sher dag pa dpe yi rdzas: deng 'dir rigs ldan bu la dbang bskur bas: sgo gsum cha mnyam sgrib pa kun dag nas rig stong gnyis med rtogs pa'i dbang thob 31ga: rtsa sngags mthar tsitta a bhaḍiñtsa hrī: de nas rtsal dbang bskur ba'i rim pa ni trī hrī mkha' la nyi zla shar ba'i rten 'brel bzhin: dbyings rig 'ub chub zang thal sku gsum klong: deng 'dir skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas snang srid phra ba'i dri ma kun dag nas 'ub chub zang thal ye shes rtogs par thegag: rtsa sngags mthar sarba a snyi shiX/ tre: de nas mtha' rten gtor ma'i dbang bskur bya ba ni hū hrī: brdal khyab ka dgayangs pa'i gzhong pa rnga lhun grub dpal gyi gtor chen brjid ldan bshams: lha mchog thugs rje'i 'od zer 'du 'phro 'khrigs: dad ldan slob

ma'i gnas gsum la gtug pas lus ngag yid kyi 'dzin zhen rang sar grol khams gsum snang ba sku gsung thugs su zhig: bar do drug gi 'khrul 'khor bde klong grol gdod ma'i mgon po'i btsan sa zin pa dang sku dang ye shes mdzad pa mthar phyin nas: 'gro khams dong sprugs nus pa'i dpal thob shog rtsa sngags mthar maṇḍal bā ling ta a snyi ༷༷ skyod yis/: de nas mtha' rten bkra shis dzos rtags dang dam tshag khas blangs gtang rag maṇḍal phul sgo gsum stos med kyis phul me tog 'thor bkra shis mtha' brten bsdo smon rgyas par bya rje thob dam tshig srog ltar bsrung nusan nyams rtogs yon tan yar ngor zla ltar 'phel don gnyis mthar phyin zung 'jug sangs rgyas thob the tshom mi dgosardo rje rgyal po'i bka' bden rdzun lag tu long dang nges shesagasal sam mā rgya rgya rgya ye ma rgyal ba'i dbang po padma saṃ bha wa'i snying dang 'dra ba' gdam pa rmad byung ba grub pa'i dbang po khye'u chung khyod la gtad da dung ma spel rin chen brda la thob mdo khams rdo rje'i rdzong du dgongs pra sdom ma 'ongs snying ma sum cu kha ral dus nga sprul dpa' bo nus ldan rdo rje dang 'phrad nas bstan pa ran chen 'dzin skyong spel las can chos bdag snying gi bu la 'doms gdul bya 'bum phrag 'og min zhing la 'god 'gro don bsam mi khyab pa'i rten

gas/ji 'brel yod byin rlabs rno nus gzhan las khyad pa ra 'phags bka' gsang thub pa ra srungs shig lha bu mched skal med lag tu ma shor spu gri gsum las can snying gi bu da 'phrad par shog sa ma yā rgya rgya rgya don dbang bsdus pa padma'i do shal rdzogs so gte gtad rgya sbas rgya gsang rgya gu rgya o rgyan gyi slob dpo na pa dma saṃ bha wa'i bka' bdag 'dra mkhar chen gzas bkod pa 'o bdo zim lha las smon ldan pa dharma 'byur rgyam zung / las kyi bsdus pa' rte rang grold / las byed ratna sa ra sogs kyis ro ra/ las mdzad zab gter bdag po nu ldan pas/ las kyi bde ris wag chad med par smras las snang ya ge'i ras byed smon sems so/las 'khrul 'gro khams do sprug nus par shog

ba:tshudag snang sgyu 'phrul drwa ba las 'jam dpal dri ma med pa dang 'brel ba'i bde gshegs mtshan spungs gi lhan thabs mdzes rgyan zhes bya ba bzhugs so:badzra na mo gu ru buddha galpi ka pha la sarba dzñā na dhartu a:tham41zu1131 las ldan sgrub la snyang rus can dkon mchog la gus 'gro la byams 'khor bar wo log phyi ma yi phan bde skrub mkhan re mtshas na de yi bgo skal phan pas sman bde gshegs kun rgya mchod thabs bstan sa ma yā bkod pa khyad pa ra 'phags pa yis mchod sprin rgya mtsho spros byas te sngags dang ting nge 'dzin gyis spel mos gus dad dbyangs rol lo sgras hūṃ hrī dad ldan gdul bya yongs kyi skyabs gcig pu:bdud sde dpung dang bcas te brtul mdzad cing:chos rnams ma lus ji ltar mkhyen gzigs pas:bcom ldan 'khor bcas gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol:mi gnas mi dmigs nam mkha' dag pa nas:gser 'od snang ba rta bdun gzi 'od 'byugs:'das dang ma 'ongs da lta dus gsum gyi bde gshegs 'khor bcas gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol:dri med padma rgyas pa'i 'dzum zhal can:g.yu ral dpung bzang gnyis 'thung rgyan
