'chang zhing: stobs bzhi dpung lnga ldan pa'i rdzu 'phrul gyis sangs rgyas sras 'khor gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol: hrī chags pa'i ma gos dri med padma'i gdan: zhi zhing bsil bde zla ba nya gang ba mdzes 'jam yangs srab lha yi gos bzang por: bde gshegs sras 'khor bcas pa bzhugs su gsol: padma ka ma la ya st+waṃ de nas stong dbang bsku ra 'dod na hūṃ hrī: ngo mtshar mdzad pa nam mkha'i mthar mnyam shing: smon lam bsam yas gdul bya'i gsos su smin: sa lam mthar phyin bskal bzang rdzogs sangs rgyas: bde gshegs 'khor ba 'jigs la: yab yum sras 'khor btsun mo rim gro ba: phun sum tshogs mdzad de rnams dbang bskur bas: srid las rab thar mtshan dpe'i sku thob nas: bstan 'gros phan bde sbyor nus mthu thob shog: yo sarba galpi kā bha dra bhuddha kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa khro: de ltar bcu yo re bgo du sbyar la sangs rgyas stong rtsa yis dbang bskur bde gshegs sras gyur nas ma ldog ye shes sa la sbyor don rnams 'bad med 'byung bar 'gyur the tshom med do sa ma mā 7)2che de nas gsol ba gdab pa ni kye hoḥ kun mkhyen 'gro ba'i mgon gcig bla ma

ba tshu dgongs:dus gsum bde gshegs 'dus pa'i gsang mdzod dbang:srid las rab dben byang chub mchog thob phyir:da lta nyid du gnang bar mdzad du gsol:lan gsum rjes su lan gan ba he bsod nams las 'phro 'dzoms pa'i skal ba can yang dag gsang ba'i dngos grub sbyin dgos na:sdom dam gnyan bsrung bskal pa can la'o:nyam pa can la gsang ba mkha' 'gro'i bka':de nas rgyud sbyangs dam khas bla sa ba ni na rtse dke mchog gsum la snying nas bdag skyabs mchi:'gro phan bsgrub phyir byang chub sems mchog bskyed:gus pas phyag 'tshal phyi nang gsang mchod 'bul:lus ngag yid sgrib sdig ltung kun bshags sdoms:dge la yi rang chos 'khor bskor bar bskul mya ngan mi 'da' brtan bzhugs dge tshogs kun:mkha' khyab 'gro ba rdzogs sangs rgyas phyir bsngo so thar sdom bzung byang chub sems kyang bsrung:gsang ba sngags spyod med gcig phyal la gnas dang po sems bskyed bar du phyin drug bslabs:tha ma mi rtog ye shes mngon gyur nas tshogs sbyor mthong bsgoms mi slob lam la

sbyor de phyir smin byed dbang mchog bdag la 365:lan gsum zhu dam chu sbyin slob ma 'jam dpal dri ma med par gsal ye shes pa dbab bstimasabya rig pa'i me tog dor ma rig pa'i ling thog bsal / /༵ṭwāṃ /// ༵gas dag tshig dbang dang bcasapa gzhung ltar brtsal ba las bum dbang gi cha lags sku dbang dang 'brel bar sangs rgyas stong gi dbang sbyin par bya'o 'jig31chen10 re de las bstan pa'i

ba rte dag snang sgyu 'phrul drwa ba las: 'jam dpal dri med gsang lam dang 'brel ba'i bde gshegs mtshan spungs gyi cha lags padma'i phreng mdzes bzhugs so:badzra na mo gu ru gasnyi ka brnya sarba ya sha chanarma51tsug rab 'byams rgyal ba thams cad kyas phran las spyi gzigs padma 'byung bye ba phrag brgya'i dkyil 'khor la gus pa sa gas de phyag bgya'o skal bzang gdul bya pho mo rnams yang dag lam la sbyor ba'i phyir bskal bzang sangs rgyas mchod bskul thabs rgyun du nyams len man ga bstan sa ma yā de yang yan lag bdun ldan gyis: mchod bstod mnyes pa bskangs ba ni rdul snyed lus sems gus btud phyag mchod 'bul: nyes lhung yan lag bzhis bshags tshangs par stsol: rnam dkar dge la yi rang chos bskor bskul rtag par 'gro phan phyir bzhugs dge tshogs bsngo: dkon mchog thugs rjes nyer brkyangs srid mtsho las: nges legs byang chub dam pa thob par mdzod: shā lo ka grangs mtshungs bar sbyar de nas legs pa' rten 'byung du gus pas phyag 'tshal skyabs mchi gsol ba 'debs: bdag sogs mi mthun phyogs zhi nyes kun sol: tshe dpal nyams rtogs legs pa'i tshogs

rnams bskyed: rlabs chen rgyal sras spyod pa la brten nas: don gnyis 'bad med 'byung bar mdzad du gsol: mtshams kyi grangs dang mthun par sbyaraḥ de nas phyag 'tshal bya ba ni mtshan 'dzin dag pa rdul snyed grangs sprul nas: lus ni rab btud ngag dbyangs 'gyur khug glu: yid rab dang ba mos gus tshad med pas: 'khor ba'i mtsho las bsgral phyir phyag 'tshal lo: blo gros mkhas pas grangs su sbyar de nas mchod pa 'bul ba ni mtshan 'dzin grol ba'i mchod pa bsam mtha' yas: ngo mtshar yid 'ong kun bzang sprin rab 'byams: phyi nang gsang ba khyad par bla med kyi rdo rje'i mchod pa chen po bkod mdzes 'bul ma ma hā pu dza sarba sa ma ya ho: ces kyang blo gros mkhas pa sa sbyar de nas bstod pa bya ba ni dbyangs lnga tshogs drug yan lag gsum bcos nas: mdzad pa'i gter chen gdul bya'i dpal bskul slad: kun khyab rdo rje'i ngo bo mngon gyur gsang: dpag med cha kun mnyam pas phyag 'tshal bstod: de nas mar me 'bul ba ni 'khor ba'i mun nag rba klong 'thib pa'i khrod: ma rig dug lnga'i myos pa'i 'gro ba rnams: yang dag sa la 'gyur med sbyor ba'i phyir: rang rig

ba tshu gsal ba'i sgron me 'od ldan 'bul: de nas tshogs mchod 'bul ba ni gzung ba rnam dag stong gsum ka pā lar: 'dzin pa rang grol khams gsum tshogs chen po:zhen med phyi nang gsang ba'i rgyan gyis spras: klong chen rgyar mnyam kun bzang sprin tshogs 'bul de nas ༅gas pa bya ba ni:lus ngag yid sgrib phyi nang gsang ba gsum: so thar byang sems sngags kyi sdom dam la: chags nyams zhig ral nongs pa gang song yang: snying nas 'gyod pa'i sems kyis bshags bgyi'o: de nas maṇḍal 'bul ba ni ren chen maṇḍal stong gsum bkod pa'i sprin: sems nyid maṇḍal yul drug snang bas brgyan rig stong maṇḍal ye shes lnga 'od 'bar: bkod mdzes mnyes byed bde chen mchod pa 'bul: de nas me tog 'bul ba na padmal puṣṭa ge sar ka ma la: chags pa'i dri ma bag chags skyon kun byang: yon tan lo 'dabs ljon bzang rnam par spud mi 'gyur 'bras bzang 'dzom pa'i mchod pa 'bul: de nas gsol ba 'debs pa ni lus ngag yid rab dad dang gus shugs kyis rtag par rgyan du gsol ba lhang lhang 'debs thugs rjes zung la srid pa'i mtsho

las sgrol nges don byang chub snying po thob par mdzod: de nasaspos mchod 'bul ba ni rnam par dag pa bzang po'i dri bsung 'thul rmongs pa'i bag chags bsal byed bsang dud 'phro: ji snyed zhing khyab mnyes mchod bskang ba'i rdzas yongs su dag chen mnyam pa nyid du 'bul: de nas zhal zasalabyul ba ni 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga yi zer 'phro ba: mchod pa'i lha mo du ma'i rtse gar bsgyur: bdud rtsi ro mchog zhal zas yid 'phrog dpal: kun bzang mnyam par rol pa'i mchod chen 'bul de nas bon 4 labyul ba ni gtsang ma lha las bab pa'i chab kyi rgyun: dri bzang yan lag brgyad ldan chab kyi mchog: 'bab chu bzhi rgyun chab kyi 'byung khung ste: kun 'dzom spro bsdus yid skyis lha mos mchod de nasabakra shis dzos rtag dang rgyal srid sna bdun 'bul ba ni mtshan dpe las byung bkra shis rtags mchog brgyad yon tan rgya mtsho 'phags pa'i nor bdun dang shin tu bkra shis rdzas mchog rnam pa brgyad rdo rje'i sku mchog thob phyir gus pas 'bul: de nas reg bya 'bul ba ni yang 'jam mjes srab bstan legs gos bzang po: lha yis 'phrul pa'i pañtsa li ka zhes rin

ba tshu thang brjod bral reg na bde ba'i gos yid 'ong ḍikka'i sor rtser spros te mchod: kun la shes rab zab mo yis bsre zhing spyor la mkhas par bya bsdus don skyabs su 'gro ba'i dus dad mos gdung shugs drag pos skyabs su mchi: gzhan yang rab tu gus pa chen po'i phyag 'tshal lo: / srid pa'i mtsho las sgrol phyir gsol ba 'debs: 3) ma bshams ye rdzogs kun bzang sprin mchod 'bul 3) sor byang sngags sdom nyams 'gal dri kun bshags: 3) ma spangs rang grol rgyan gyi bye brag 'bul 3) mnyam gnas mnyam par rol pa'i tshogs ston 'bul: / dbyangs kyi yan lag rgya mtsho'i sgra yis bstod: 3) phyi nang gsang rdzogs mnyes byed maṇḍal 'bul: 3) bag chags dri ma dag phyir pursha 'bul 3) tshul khrims dri bsung 'thul phyir spos mchod 'bul: 3) dag byed gtsang chab yan lag brgyad ldan 'bul 3) mdzes 'jam yangs srab pañtsa li ka 'bul:de ltar gang 'os mos mthun sbyar tshe dpal nyams rtogs yon tan ོ yar ngos zla ltar 'phel zhing rgyas 'di phyi'i phan bde rgya chen 'byung 'bri klog kha rtan byed pa'i mi srid pa'i mtsho las brgal bar 'gyur don gnyis lhun

grub gdengs thobs po mi bsku ngesapa rdo rje'i bka' sam yu rgya rgya rgya yid bzhin nor bu dang 'dra mtshungs bas dag snang rin po che'i skor las snying slob chosakyi bdag po rgya mtshos ming gi cod paṇa can rnams gnyis kyisabaskul ba dang grogasaratna sar nan bskul dang chosakyi bdag po dharmā a dam zhesabya ba dang mo ldan padma sbyin pa zung gisadakon pa'i 'du shes bzang pos 'bad rtsol kyi bskul ba rtag rten 'brel bzang po ru mthong nasabadag 'dra nus ldan rdo rjesadag par phab pa dge legs 'phel/ sabo maṅga lam/ga( 2 / trī ngo mtshar mdzad pa nam mkha'i mthar mnyam shing smon lam̐ mtha' yas gdul bya gsos su smin sa lam mthar phyin bskal bzang rdzogs sangs rgyas: bde gshegs 'khor ba 'jigs la 7 yab yum sras 'khor btsun mo rim gro ba phun sum tshogs mdzad de rnams dbang bskur bas: srid las rab thob mtshan dpe'i sku thob nas: bstan 'gro'i phan bde spror nus mthu thob shog: tshe sarba galpi ka bha tra byudu kwa ya a snyi ṣiñtsa oṃ
pa dag snang sgyu 'phrul drwa ba las 'jam dpal drim med pa'i gsang lam dang 'brel ba'i bde gshegs mtshan spung dngos grub char 'bebs thugs rje'i lcags kyu bzhugs

sgo na mo gu ru sarba budha galpi ka bha dra sto dhi sa twa ya:bde gshegs rgyal ba kun las sngar sangs rgyas:sgrib bral sku 'od thugs rje phyogs ris bral:kun mkhyen rbe rngogs phung po khyab brdal ba:kha sbyor bdun ldan klong la phyag 'tshal lo:nus mthus 'jigs lta zil gnon gsang mdzod 'chang:mkhyen pas srid rtsa drung 'byin shes rab mtshon:brtse bas phrin las 'khor ba dong sprugs mdzad:ris med byang sems rgya mtshor phyag 'tshal lo byin rlabs klong las thugs rje'i nyi ma shar:dngos grub sprin 'khrigs gdul bya'i gsos char 'bebs lhan skyes 'dzin mkhas dga' chen 'od gsal gzhi:rtsa gsum 'dus pa'i zhal la phyag 'tshal lo:grimed dbo ngas pa rab gsal mkha' ltar yangs brda thabs rdo rje'i phyag rgya nyi ltar gsal:thugs rje'i gzi mdangs gdul bya'i snyan la sim:brgyud bzang dri bral gser phreng la phyag 'tshal:ngo bo sprosabral kun tu g.yo med kyang:rang bzhin rnam snang gangs chen nges pa lnga thugs rje bye ba phrag brgya'i mgon gcig pu:dus gsum bde bar gshegs la phyag 'tshal lo:bde

sgo gshegs 'khor ba 'jigs dang gser thub pa 'od bsrung shaka thub byams pa seng rab gsal me tog me tog gnyis pa rgyu skar bzang: rgyal ba 'gro ba'i byed rdopon lag chen la: 1 sangs rgyas stobs chen rgyu skar rgyal po dang: rtsi bcud sman pa snyan tog 'od chen 'phro: grol phung rnam snang nyi snying zla 'od 'phro: mi nub 'od bzang dgyes pa'i rgyal rnams la: 2 rgyal ba mya ngan med dang skar rgyal dang: rab mdzes phreng thog yon tan rgya mtsho'i 'od: don gzigs mar me dpal ldan sman pa'i rgyal rab tu dul zhing nges par mdzad pa la 3 mdzes spud brtan pa'i sde dang lha yi dpal: gdul bar dka' spyod yon tan rgya mtsho dang: sgra 'dzin tshogs dbang tshangs dbyangs 'gyur khug brtan mi 'bying char gzigs 'od phung mdzad de laḥ 4 rgyal ba gter lhun che dang rdo rje sdom: mi bsnyings rin po che dang padma'i spyan stobs kyi sde pa me tog ye shes dgyes: gzi chen po dang tshangs par mdzad rnams la 5 bde gshegs 'od dpag med dang klu gter sbyin: brtan gshegs don mthong brtson ster bzang skyongs dang: rab

dga' 'chi med seng ga'i rgyal mtshan dpal rgyal ba chos kyi snying po de rnams la: 6 sangs rgyas mchog tu dgyes rgyal kha lo bsgyur: dgyes gzigs chu lha yon lag sbos kyi glang rnams gzigs 'byug sgrogs brtse ba'i yid bzang po: dri ma bral ba zla ba'i dbang po la 7 bde gshegasagragasapa che dang gtsug nor bu yid sems drag shul gdong lnga'i stabs ldon pa: rnams par rgyal gshegs shes rab brtsegs legs gnas mi nub blo gros 'dab 'bras rab rgyas la 8 rgyal ba yan lag skyes pa dang gzugs bzang ba blo mtha' yas dang mkhyen ldan brtul zhugs brtan 'od zer rab 'bar bkra shis sred med bu mdzes zhal padma bden pa'i tog de la 9 sangs rgyas shes 'byung gnas legs bzang dang yon tan 'od dang tshangs sbyin rin chen 'byung: lha yi me tog legs sems chos dbang phyugs: blo gros dbang po spobs pa rab brtsegs la 10bcom ldan rdo rje rgyal mtshan bde sbyin dang: stobs bcu ldan dang phan bzhed rnam rol ldan: mun sel sgra gcan lha dang ri'i rgyal mtshan: tshogs can 'od dang ratna'i snying po la:

dzādzā 11 bde gshegs mthor gshegs dang ni skar rgyal dang ru ring mi dbang khams gsum mgon po dpal: yon tan grags pa nyi zla nyi 'od 'bar skar (de dang ni seng ge'i tog chen la: 12 rgyal ba dus mkhyen rgyal dang srid mtha' gzigs: dpal snying glog 'od gser gyi ri bo dang: gzhan gyis mi thub mchog dga' grags pa'i rgyal: brtson 'grus brtan dang grags rdzogs chen po la: 13 sangs rgyas bsnyengs bral dang ni mchod 'os lha sgron me dam pa rin chen 'od spos dri: yon tan mchog dang mtshungs med mun rnams bral seng ge'i 'gram dang rin chen grags pa la 14 bcom ldan skyo na rab zhi ba bdud rtsi 'chang: mi yi zla dang kun gzigs rab tu brgyan nor bu'i 'od 'bar ri brtsegs chos 'byung gnas: don nges ldan dang chos sbyin dpal de la 15 bdogashegs rin chen 'byung gnas skye dbang mtshungs: stabs gshegs blo gnas pa dang gdugs mdzes dang: gtso mchog 'phags dpal seng ge'i sgra dbyangs sgrogs/ /skyes bu gtso rgyal rnam par rol ldan la: 16rgyal ba klu yi 'od dang

padma'i ri: klu dga' dang ni spos dbang shin tu grags: stobs lha yon tan phreng ldan klu yi lag: mig brgyan pa dang drang srong chen po la: 17 sangs rgyasalegs sbyangs blo dang bden par gsung: zil gnon ye shes nyi 'od mtha' yas spyan: nges pa'i blo dang rnams rol mtha' yas gzugs nor bu'i tog dang the tshom rnam spangs la 18 bcom ldan mi g.yo rang byung srid las 'das: don yod rnams gnon me tog rgyal mtshan dang: nges par rtogs mdzad don gzigs gzi brngid che ri dbang rgyal po dang ni grags chen la:19 bde gshegs rin chen lha dang don gnas mkhyen blo yongs rdzogs dang dman min grags chen po: mya ngan med dang dri bral tshangs dbyangs lha: sa dbang dang ni me tog spyan ldan la 20 rgyal ba chos kyi 'od dang kun gzigs dpal: yon mdzod 'od gsal 'jig rten gsum mchod pa: skyen byang dri ma med dang zla ba'i zhal: ratna'i 'od dang rin chen tog de la 21 sangs rgyas grags pa'i bla dang 'od 'byed dpal gzi brjid dpag med dus mkhyen seng ge'i sku: mkhas blo rgyal dka' yon tan phung po dang:

dzaX mdzes pa'i tog dang mthu ni thob pa la:22bcom ldan rtsal thob dang ni mu mtha' med:zla shar dri med don gzigs dpa' bo dang:dpal ldan bsod nam byerdo rsha yon tan 'od blo yangs pa dang legs par skyes de la:23'phags pa nor dpal lha dang mid gnyis spongs 'dzin mkhas mchog stsol choms med dpa' ba dang:mi dmigs pa dang der gnas tshogs can gtso 'gro 'dul 'od zer dang ni phal chen la:24bde gshegs gze brjed mtha' yas don blo gros:sman dbang po dang thob spangs phyogs nyer zhi:legs sbyin dang ni grags bskyed me tog sbyin:skyes bus sbyin dang rdo rje sde bcas la:25rgyal ba phal chen byin dang zhi blo gros spos gling sred med bu dang mi tshugs pa:des pa nyi zla glog tog mchod pa'i rgyal:dpal sbas dang ni ye shes nyi ma la 26sangs rgyas don 'byung dang ni lhun po brtsegs:dgra 'dul ba dang padma dgra bcom grags:ye shes snang ba nyon bral 'dam bu dang:spos bzang yul 'khor rangs dang lha grags la 27bcom ldan srid pa'i mtha' gzigs zla ba'i dbang:sgra

gcan rin zla seng ge'i rgyal mtshan dang: bsam bstan dgyes dang ldan rol yon tan 'od: dgra bcom grags pa sad ngos mdzod ldan la: 28byang chub spob pa mtha' yas rdo rje gter tshe dpag med dang nor bkod dbang chen rgyal: yon 'byung lhun po grags dang 'od zer 'bar: ma smad gling po'i 'gros dang yid 'thad la 29 'phags pa rin chen zla dang rab gsal rgyal: zhi mdzad kha lo bsgyur dang dga' dbang phyug: gtsug na rin chen bsnyings bral rin snying po zla ba'i zhal bzang dri med grags pa la: 30 bdegashegs zhi ba'i gzi bajid dga' ba'i tog sgra gcan lha dang lha dga' na tshod bzang rin chen phung po mdzes gshegs seng ge'i phyogs: skyes mchog dbang dang shin tu mthor gshegs la: rgyal ba blo gros rab bzang 'jig rten 'od: rin chen gzi brjed kun rgyal dga' ba bkod: skal ldan shing rta stegs mdzad spos glang blo 'od zer 'phro dang ri bo'i rgyal mtshan la: 32 sangs rgyas spos bzang dang ni chos brtan po: chos kyi nor bu gzi brjed drag shul can: bzang byin bde gshegs zla dang tshangs dbyangs

dzaX mdzod: seng ge'i zla dpal dang ni legs skyes la 33 bcom ldan grags pa'i bshes gnyen thub med tshogs: dka' thub chen po lhun 'od yon tan babyedas mchod grags dpal dang chos grags sbyin pa'i 'od: glog 'byin dang ni bden par gsungs ba la: 34 byang chub 'cho byed gzhon dang na tshod bzang: legs tshogs can dang rnam nges blo gros dpal: nor bu'i sbos dang srid gzigs rgyal bas dgyes: seng ge'i 'od zer yongs su snang mdzad la 35 'phags mchog thugs rab gzhungs dang grags pa'i mchog: nor mdzes zla gzhen drag shul sde dang ni: 'od 'bar zer dang brtul zhugs thub med dpal 'gros mchod pa dang nor bu'i tshogs can la:36bdegashegs 'jig rten bla ma glang chen dbang: zla rin bkod chen 'od ni mtha' yas pa sgra gcan sted dang yon rgyas 'od ldan pa: rab tu zhi stabs 'jig rten bzang po la 37 rgyal ba mya ngan med dang shugs bcu rdzogs: stobs dgyes mthu yi dpal dang mthu thob pa mthu chen yon tan snying po bden par spyod: dge ba mchog gi rgyal dang

skar rgyal la 38 sangs rgyas 'od po che dang glog 'od dpal: yon tan rgya che dpal 'od bdud 'dul ba rin po che dang go bgos seng ge'i phyag: me tog bzang po rin chen mthon po la 39 bcom ldan rgya mtsho dang ni sa 'dzin dpal: don blo mnga' ba yon bsags yon tan tshogs: rin chen me dang 'khor rgyal 'jig rten zla dbyangs snyan sgrogs dang tshangs pa'i tog chen la 40 byang chub tshogs chen gtso dang seng ge'i stabs: drag shul 'bar ba gzi 'od 'od chen phro: rin chen grags pa tshogs gsal chos dbang phyug: grags pa mtha' yas 'od zer don yod la: 41 'phagasamachog lha yi drang srong skye dbang dang dge 'dun brtan dang bzang tog yul 'khor lo: padma'i tog dang chos blo rlung gi shugs: legs bsam grags pa snang bar ldan de la: 42 bde gshegs yon tan bsrung dang blo bsnyeng med: grogs brtan 'od gnas thar ba'i gzi brjid dang: nor zhabs dngos gzigs dang ni mang drang pa: blo gros bzang dang kun tu gzi brjid la: 43 rgyal ba ye shes mchog ma tshangs par gnas: bden pa gsung dang

shārnyi mkhyen bzang stobs byin dang: seng stabs me tog phreng ldan shes rab 'byung: rin chen grags pa grags pa rmad byung la 44 sangs rgyas nyi ma'i 'od dag (31sa med dpal tshug mi 'gyur ba tshangs gshegs ye shes dgyes: lha yi mthu rtsal nor snying yon tan grags: lha bden drang mkhan dang ni shugs brtan la 45 bcom ldan ye shes dpal dang bcings med pa: lha yi gzi brjid tshangs thub dal bzhud dpal: brtul zhugs rgyal dang dka' thub 'od phung po gzi brjid rgyas dang tsam pa ka de la 46 byang chub dga' rol mdzad dang tshogs bzang 'dzin dbang po'i rgyal dang dgyes chen bskrun mdzad mdangs: 'gro legs khyu mchog dang ni tshogs 'od nges: sna ma'i me tog 'od dang legs bzang la: 47 de bzhin gshegs pa 'od chen bsam byin pa: 'od zer 'bar ba dang ni bsod nams 'od rin dbyangs 'byor ldan tshangs stabs dri med spyan: rdo rje'i sde dang rgyal ba 'od 'dzin la: 48 'phags pa blo gsal dang ni ye shes 'gros: gzi mdangs brjid pa 'od chen drag shul rtse: nyi 'od dri med 'od mdang

sbrang rtsi'i zhal gzi dpal rnam rgyas khengs bral zla 'od la: 49 bde gshegs glog 'byen pa dang rab zhir gshegs: mi 'khrugs sems dang grags rgyas chos yon tan:zhing bzang snang dang bkod rgyal mngon par 'phags padma'i dpal dang sbyin bsregs 'od 'phro la 50 rgyal ba rin chen bkod dang shin tu bzang rin mchog thugs shin gzhung dang rgya mtsho'i byin: tshangs tog zla gdug pa dang 'od 'phro ba dri med rgyal po ye shes grags pa la: 51 sangs rgyas kun tu rgyal dang yon tan 'od: smra grags zla rgyal dang ni padma'i 'od: brtul zhugs bzang po sgron rgyal glog gi tog: 'od zer rgyal po dang ni skar mkhan la: 52 bcom ldan grags pa'i dpal dang rdzogs ldan 'od: pad snying rgyal dang spyan mdzes rnyog pa med: drag shul sde dang mthu rtsal bsod nams gzi: sgra gcan lha dang thogs med blo gros la: 53 byang chub thogs med gzigs dang sgra gcan lha shes rab phung po skyes dbang kha lo bsgyur me tog gtsug dang sman mchog sgra gcan 'dzin: rgyu skar rgyal po dang ni gso sman la: 54 debazhin gshegs pa nor rgyas glang

ro/ gcod mdzad: rnam grags rgyal dang chos lhun mdzod blo bzang: yon dbang mtshung dang shes brtsegs rdo rje'i sde: legs gnas blo sbyang dang ni tshangs mdzad la:/de phags pa yon tan mchog dang 'byug sgra'i dbyangs: mngon shes tog dang tog 'od dge tshangs pa: lhun sdug pa dang klus byin bden pa'i tog: skyes bu mchog gzigs dang ni brgyan ldan la: 56 kun mkhyen mgon po 'dod 'byung tshangs dbang sbyin: zhus pa med dbyangs seng 'byeng 'od sna tshogs: ye shes dbang po pad phung me tog rgyas: mthu rtsal stobs dang bsod nams phung po la: 57 bde gshegs gzugs bzang mchog dang skar mkhan rgyal zla ba sgron me byang chub rgyal mngon rtogs: mi zad pa dang yul rgyas yan lag mdzes: shes rab mchog dang gzi brjid chen po la: 58rgyal ba 'dza tshims mdzad dang shes rab sbyin: mgon po 'jam dbyangs gtso byin chags med mdzod gtso mthu rtsal dang 'od 'phro dbang shugs 'chang: skal bzang rgyal po dang ni 'od bzang la 59 sangs rgyas gzugs bzang rgyal dang don grub dpal: grags pa byin dang seng sde

nor bu'i lha: grags rgyal rgya chen snying po smrang 'dod pa: bsod nams 'od zer dang ni sgron rgyal la: 60 bcom ldan ye shes brtsal dang lha mchog zhal sa bdag po dang grol brnyes gtsug gser 'od: sgra gcan bzang dang thub dka' zla 'od zer thub gsal mdangs dang gser gyi 'od 'bar la 61 byang chub legs sbyin lha dang yon dbang po:chos gdug bsod nams lag dang chags med pa gya nom snang dang blo zhib rtsi sman dang: rnam grol tog dang gzi byin thams cad la: 62 de bzhin gshegs pa 'od mdzod ye shes rgyal: 'jigs mdzad pa dang chu sbong thogs med grags: bden phung dbyangs rnyan pa dang ri dbang mtshungs: chos brtsegs pa dang thar pa'i gzi brjid la: 63 'phags pa rab zhi'i sku dang yid 'ong gsung: legs mdzad dang ni blo sbyangs chu dbang lha: skal bzang po dang mi 'khrugs chos mthu rtsal: seng ge legs dang 'gros mchod chen po la:64 kun mkhyen mgon po gzi rgyal rtogs mdzad dang don gnas blo dang spyan legs snang 'od zer: don yon gshegs dang 'khro bcom gzugs legs dpal: sbos gzi'i

dzaX kun dga' mdzad dang mchod gshegs la 65 bde gshegs rab sbyin grags dang lha'i nyi ma: 'od gtsang 'gyed dang shes byin gzi mdangs rgyal mnyam (rsharsha bdag nyid gser mchog rnam grol gtsug: skal ldan shing rta dang ni sbos gnas la: 66 rgyal ba chos ldan dang ni dregs spang ba: ye shes mdzod dang tshangs gshegs tsasto dang mya ngan med dang seng 'od yul 'khor tog: padma'i snying po gzi brjid mtha' yas la: 67 sangs rgyas lha yi 'od dang shes rab dpal me tog 'gyed mkhas tshangs dbyig ye shes 'byor: rin dbang ldan pa mchog gnang rdzogs par gsung mchod 'os dam pa nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la: 68 bcom ldan skar ma'i rgyal dang 'dam brgal ba:ye shes brnyes dang chos sbyin grub rma bya: phan par bzhed dang ye shes ldan grags dpal: 'od zer drwa ba dang ni rnam bcom la: 69 byang chub beeḍūrya snying padma'i lha: zla ba dang ni dran 'od dge ba'i 'od kun yid 'ong dang rin dpal stes bu zla: yon tan mchog ma dang ni sma 'dzin la: 70 de bzhin gshegs pa rkar 'od zhi ba'i stobs: bdud rtsi'i

'od dang 'gro mchog ri dbang ba:ye shes rgya mtsho rab zhi yon tan mdzod:mthu dpal stobs dang lha dbang mig mdzes la:71'phags pa dbyangs kyi yan lag khyad 'phags mchog mdzes gzigs gshegs dang zhi don skyon byang ba:blo dbyangs po dang dge bzang padma'i mdzod:'od zer bzang po spob pa'i mchog de la:72ston pa rtegs bzang po dang tshogs dbang phyugs:bsnyengs bral ba dang spobs spyan blo mchog la ye shes bzhed dang rab gshegs zla rgyal po rin chen zla 'od dang ni dpe med ma 73bde gshegs gzigs pa che dang tshangs dbyangs sgrogs dbyangs bzang po dang blo rgyas zla med bu:rdo rje mkhregs dang byang chen blo gros gsal shes rab chen po'i stegs dang gdengs snyan la:74rgyal ba ldon shing dbang dang bsod nams stobs:mthu yi dpal dang 'phags skyes mthu bzang stobs:skar ma la rol bzang ldan spyan sdug zhal:sprin gyi rnga sgra dang ni 'byor ldan la:75sangs rgyas yon tan phung po shes rab gsal:chos sgra sgrogs dang mkha' mnyam mchod sbyin stsol:ye shes nga ro gzi 'bar

(6 yon ma zer shes rab rnams 'byed nga ro drang srong la 76btsam ldan blo gros ldan dang spobs pa'i tshogs: mchod sbyin bzang dang zla bkod shin tu rtebyedas rdul bral ba dang tog ldan yon tan tshogs: bsod nams rgyal mtshan dang ni yul spobs la: 77byang chub reg chen rab sbyin zla ba dgyes: dbang bsgyur rgyal dang seng stobs bdud rtsi gsal bsam gtan snyoms dang 'khrugs med ri rab zhi: phyogs med mnyam dang bde mdzes nga ro la 78debazhes gshadags pa zhal bzang gsung dbang po shugs gnas dang ni brjed chen ye shes ldan: blo zab dpal dang rtsi 'debs chos nyid stobs mchod par ldan dang me tog 'od de la: 79'phags pa khams gsum mchod gnas sgra gcan dbyings: nyi snying gsal dang lha'i mchod thar rgyal mtshan: dge ba'i gtsug dang bstan pa bdud rtsi'i 'od: phung po mdzes gshegs rdo rje dpa' ba la 80dadzad cog nyagashashegs pa dang dag pa'i 'od yon tan gtsug dang dpal rdzogs seng sgra'i stabs: srid 'phags me tog byin dang 'od 'gyed pa rin chen phyur bu

dang ni mdzes rdzogs la 81 bde gshegs padma spungs zhal bkod ldan dang gti mug med gnas rma med tog rgyal mtshan bde bar dgongs dang rin mnga' cho ga mkhyen:dag pa'i rgya mtsho khro ba mi mnga' la: 82 rgyal ba skye bo brtse mdzad dpa' mi zhus: rma bya'i nga ro spyod stegs lha'i snyan bsgrags: srid sred dri spangs dgra rgyal phyag pad bsnams 'byor ldan grags dang yul 'khor bzang po la: 83 sangasargyas nor bu'i stabs dang padma'i 'od: gdong lnga'i nga ro zla shar 'dzoms pa'i mchog mi g.yo ba dang phan gshegs sgron ma'i rgyal: kai ta mi dang bsod nams dbyangs bskul la 84 bcom ldan mdangs stobs dang ni dge mtshan dpal zla bzang byang chub yan lag legs par ston: me tog bkra shis mthu rtsal gzi brjid stobs dge ba'i sgron ma dang ni lha sgra la: 85 byang chub rab tu zhi mdzad rta bdun zhal thar pa'i brtul zhugs brdul med tshul khrims 'od snying po 'phags dang brdul gnas 'phel mdzad dang min sman rtsi dang dus mkhyen 'od de la: 86 de bzhin gshegs pa spos 'od dran pa'i dbang thog med rgyal dang

:dhi sprod gsal byang mchog bsgrod: 'dod 'byung dgyes dang chos dbang lha drang po: bshes gnyen chen po dang ni lhun 'od la 87'phags pa bges gnyen bzang byedro ngab zhi'i stobs: bdud rtsi'i bdag po 'phags bstod snang gzi 'bar: snang gzigs legs par spyad dang rnam smin sbyongs: legs dgyes mdzad dang mya ngan bral ba la 88 ded dpon rin chen 'od dang spyod par ldan: bsod nams thob dang rmad byung nga rgyal sbongs: yon tan rgya mtsho bdud brlag bag chags bcom: mi byed blo mnga' rgya mtsho stong mdzad la 89 bde bshegs khro ba can grol dga' ba'i 'od: yid gsal rin chen byang chub rgyal mtshan dang shin tu bsil ba tshangs rgyal ye shes dgyes: rdzu 'phrul tog dang skyes dbang mtshungs de la: 90 rgyal ba sa yi dbang phyug nyi zhal dgyes: sgra gcan zla dang me 'od sman bdag po: dpal yon dgyes dang mdangs mnga' dbyangs snyan dang dga' bar spyod stobs chos kyi dbang phyug la 91 sangs rgyas tshangs pa'i dbyangs dang spyod bzang po 'khrugs pa med blo snyan grags rnam rgyal ba dbyangs chen sgrogs

dang tog ldan gzi brjid rgyas 'gro ba'i dbang phyugs dang ni rnam grags la: 92 bcom ldan ljon pa'i 'dabs bzang gti mug zad: spob mtha' yas tog zla rgyal dpag med mgon: dgyes par gshegs dang 'gro blo brtul zhugs bstar: mchod gnas mya ngan rgal dang dge dgyes la: 93 byang chub zhabs mdzes ātpal spobs mtha' bral:dul bar gnas dang me tog 'od brgya pa: drang srong rig gsal yon rgyas btson 'grus snying: skal ldan shing rta dang ni lha bdag la: 94 de bzhin gshegs pa sbyin 'od rin chen mtho bsod nams blo gros yon mtha' gzi bajid 'bar: seng stabs rtag tu mi g.yo rab gsal dang: glu dbyangs 'khor lo 'dzin dang dbyig mchog la 95 'phagasapa 'od spyod glu dbyangs 'jig rten skyobs chos kyi zla 'od sprin tog shes rab 'gros: spos bzang mkha'i dbyangs dang ni lha zhal 'dzum: dga' ba mtha' yas grags dang lha rgyal la 96 ded dpon nor bu gsal dang nor bzang sgron skyes dbang rgyal dang sded pa sgra gcan 'dzin: dge rgyas mdzad dang seng blo rin chen grags: rin chen nga ro'i

'o/ dbyangs dang don mdzad la: 97 bde gshegs mdzad pas gzigs skyongs shugs 'dor dang mdzod spu bsam yas sbob chen srid me tog: rnam par 'byed da1 1kra brtsegs mtshungs med rgyal: ye shes rnam 'byed nga ro seng mche la: 98rgyal ba mjes gshegs dang ni bkra shis ldan: yul skyong mya ngan med blo sems don 'gyed:mdzes par ston dang bsod sgron chos sgron spyan: shin tu legs gzigs dang ni stobs chen la: 99 sangs rgyas shes rab dbang phyug me tog phul: brtan pa'i dbyangs dang bde ldan don gsung ba: dgyes gsal seng ga'i zhal dang gtsug phud 'chang: seng ge rnam snang mdzad dpal mos mtha' yas 100 bskal bzang 'di la rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas stong: re re las kyang bye phrag brgya spros nas: mdzad pa'i phrin las bstan pa drug rab 'gyed: mi 'gags rgyun mi 'chad pa'i sprul sku la: 100 rgyal ba dedag shes rab yum gyis bskyed: mi 'gyur lhun mtho rgyal po'i gdungs rigs 'chang: rten 'brel thabs la mkhas pas yab kyi cha thugs son sras dang rim gro mchog lnga la 100 nyan

rang byang sems phyi dang nang gi 'khor smon lam mthu 'dzom sku che'i tshad dang ni:gdul bya'i dpal bstun bstan pa'i bzhugs byang tshad:'od spros sku gdung che chung 'gyed grangs la 100mkhyen palirang mdangs shes rab ral gri brten brtse ba'i gzugs mchog phyag na padma 'chang nus pa'i rang bzhin lag na rdo rje 'dzin sngags kyi gsang bkrol pad 'byung phrag brgya la:100'jigs pa brgyad skyobs arya tā re ma:'gro khams dong sprung sprul sku thub pa drug:mdo sngags bstan skyongs skyes mchog rin po che:gang yang thub chen pad 'byung mdzad phrin la:100mthong thos dran reg bzang ngan 'brel tshad kun ma rig ngan song 'khor ba'i sgo kheg nas:thams cad mkhyen pa'i sa la rab sbyor ba'i:rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor bskal bzang sgron me la 100dzisnyod zhing khams chos dbyings mthar gcig par:de snyed ngo mtshar sprul pa khyab brdal la:rdul snyed bdag sogs dri bral lus ngag yid:nges rnyed khyed shes dad pas gsol gdab bcas:100phyag 'tshal mdza da 'bul sdig lhung chags nyams bshags:dge la yi rang mi

sgo nub chos bskor bskul:bzhugs par gsol 'debs 'gro khams rgya mtsho kun:mi sdog dbug 'byin zhing du byang chub shog:100de ltar bskal bzang sangs rgyas (1 1 mtshan bri 'dogs klogs dang mos pa thob tshad kun bsod nams rgya mtsho dang ldan yon tan che thugs rjes rab zin srid pa'i g.yul las rgyal sakha'i me nub bkres skom gdung ba zhi rmongs pa'i mun sel 'thab rtsod chags sdang zhi bzhugs gnas phyogasade yang mchod rten 'gyur gang ga rna bar tshor tshad byang chub ra me chu dug mtshon gshin rje' 'jigs pa byang dus man 'chi da nad mug kun las skyobs tshe rabs kun tu bud med lus las dben gshin po'i ched sbran bar do'i phreng las 'dren yon tan bsam yas zad pa'i mthar mi dpog ma 'ongs dad ldan yongs kya spyi nor yin lus sems dal phob gsol ba lhang lhang thob thugs rjes nye bar gzigs nges gtan tshig yin sa ma yu rgya rgya rgya ces padma kun tu brtsegs shing spungs ba'i gzhal med khang gi log gcag nas ḍakki mang po dang gzhon nu mdzesaldan du ma dang bcas nas 'di ltar gsung ba dang gzhan yang rtog brjod kyi rags du ma dang bde gshegs mchod thabs kyi cha lagasadang bcas gsung ba dag rang gi shes rab kya sgor shar ba dad ldan chos kya bdag po chos gsal dang dge btsun pad sprin gzhan yang chos kyi bdag po rgyal
mtshan ming gi cod paṇa can zung gis dga' spros me tog bcas nas bskul ngo mi sdog tsam du nu ldan 'dusapa rtsal gyisadag par phab pa dge legasa'aphel sarba ma lo/

ba tshu mtha' brten rnam gsum gto pa ni hūṃ hrī:rgyal ba'i byin rlabs 'dod 'byung rdzas mchog brgyad:phun tshogs yid 'ong ka dag bkra shis rtags bsod nams dpal spel 'phags pa'i nor mchog bdun deng 'dir skal ldan slob mar gtad pa yis:mdzad pa mthar phyin chos sku'i rgyal srid la:dbang 'byor zung 'jug kun bzang sa thob shog:oṃ ratna〈snan maṅga le a bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ hrī:de ltar galo pa'i bsod namasakyis rang don chosasku'i ye shes te ra med yon ma rtsal ོgas pa'i brda thabs rtags kyi dbang mchog go byin rlabasarno so khyad par 'phags the med do sa ma wā rgya rgya rgya chos bdag snyema'i ngor nus ldan pas smras te yi ge pa ni rang slob ye shesaso/ 4

༄7 / mtha' brten 'dod dgu char 'bebs ba sa so chos kyis gsar lo bsam 'phel dbang gi rgyal/ 'dod 'byung btsun mo re skong blon po dang / stobs bcu gling po rdzu 'phrul rkang bzhi rta/ nyon mongs g.yul ngo bzlog pa'i dmag dpon te/ rin chen bdun gyi khyed la bkra shis shog dbu la gdug mares gser nya'i sbyan bkra shis/ ljags la padma mgul tu bum pa bzang / gsung yang dung dkar thugs la dpal be'u ste/ sku yi rgyal mtshan phyag shadas 'khor lo'i mtshan: bkra shis des kyang khyed la bde legs shog me long bsgrub dag dung ni chos sgra sgrogs/ bul ba'i 'bru 'phel ghi waṃ nad kun 'joms: zho yi bcud 'phel li khri khams gsum dbang dur ba'i tshe 'phel yung dkar bgegs rnams 'joms/ bkra shis des kyang khyed la bde legs regag /bkra shis sarba masgo lam/bkra shisadapal 'bar 'dzam gling yongs/

gtsa) zab gsang rdo rje snying po las:thugs rje chen po dri med padma dkar po'i bka' them byang shel dkar phreng ba zhes bya ba bzhugs so:46 na ma gu ru padma kā ra ye:rdomirtsal 〉ma rgya thu / thugs rje 'od zer bye ba'i rlabs phreng gi dmus longs 'gro ba bde chen sa la 'god:byams dang snying rje'i bsil zer stong 'bar ba:dri med padma dkar po la phyag 'tshal:bdag 'dra o rgyan slob dpon padma ngas:ma 'ongs 'gro la brtse ba chen po yis:thugs kyi yang bcud rdo rje snying po'i chos bla rdzogs thugs gsum rtsa gsum bsgrub pa'i sde rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum zab pa bcud tig bcas:kha bskang las rim phran tshag sna tshogs dang:rim gnyis rnal 'byer dbyings rig zung 'jug lam bstan srung bsgrub pa drag sngags las mtha' bcas bcu gsum bcu gsum bsam mi khyab pa las:skabs 'dir bla bsgrub thugs rje chen po yi bskyed rdzogs chung ngu'i las rim sna tshogs pa:bka' ces phyag rgyas btab po ma brjed zung:zhal byang mun sel snying gi nor bu dang:kha bskang las kyi

rim pa bco lnga dang:brgyud 'debs rin po che yi phreng ba dang:zab sgrub bdud rtsi'i bum bcud byin rlabs mdzod:tshogs mchod bsod nams gter gyi bum bzang grags:bskang ba shel dkar phreng ba zhes bya ba:rig 'dzin bskang ba byin rlabs bang mdzod dang:gnam phud gnas yul bsrung ma'i bskang ba'o las bzhi'i dmigs rim phrin las lhun grub dang:byin 'bebs thugs dam gnad nas bskul thabs dang:rig 'dzin byin 'bebs rin po che yi tog sman gyi sgrub pa dngos grub bang mdzod dang:lag len kha bskang las rim nyer lnga pa:phyag 'tshal bya ba sdig sgrib rang grol dang:bshags pa ye shes sgron me rdzas bskang bcas:dngos grub bskul len 'dod 'jo'i bum bzang ngo las bzhi'i sreg blugs phrin las lhun grub dang:ro bsreg cho ga sdig sgrib kun 'joms mo:bum gnyis bsgrub pa dngos grub kun 'byung dang:lo rgyus rab gsal don gyi snying po'o:gsang dbang byin rlabs dngos grub bang mdzod dang don dbang bsdus pa padma'i do shal can:gshin po rjes 'dzin ngan song g.yul 'joms dang:btags grol

ba rte ye shes snying po rin chen rtsi:lhun grub rten bzhengs 'gro ba'i gtsug brgyan no:zang thal dgongs pa rang byung gcer grol dang:gsang lam thod rgal zung 'jug 'ja' sku che man ngag don 'dus lkog yig bdun ma dang:gsur mchod 'dod rgu'i gter mdzod zhes su grags zha bsang mgron bzhi'i dgyes bskang bdud rtsi'i sprin:chu sbyin gang 'dod re skong dam pa'o:'debs kha las rim rnam pa bcu gsum dang gsol 'debs mthong ba don ldan dang bcas so:bstan srung lha bu'i bla rdo sgog 'khor dang:lha bu ming sring zab sgrub 'dod 'byung nor de yi gsol mchod bdud rtsi'i thig pa dang:bskang ba bsdus pa smad las rno mdeludrag bsgrub lnga bcas yongs su rdzogs pa'o:snying las phang yang ma 'ong don phyir du:grub pa'i dbang phyug khye'u chung khyod la gtad:da dung spel ba'i dus la ma bab pa'i:rin chen brda' la thob cig sa ra bye bstan pa las smon zhog cig rjes 'bangs bcu:mdo khams rtse shod gsham du dgongs pra thob:ma 'ongs snyigs ma sum cu kha ral dus:nga sprul dpa' bo nus ldan rdo rje dang:

'phrad nas bstan pa rin chen 'dzin skyong spel: chos bdag skyes bu bcu la legs sprad nas zab gsang chos kyi nyi ma phyogs bcur sgrogs: gdul bya 'bum phrag po ṭa la ru 'god 'gro don bsam mi khyab pa'i rten 'brel yod: skal med lag tu ma shor lha yi bu: dam ldan rig pa 'dzin pa'i dpal du shog: sa ma yu rgya rgya rgya bka' them byang shel dkar phreng ba rdzogasaso gter rgya gtad rgya sbasargya zab rgya gsang rgya gu hre o rgyan gyi slob dpon padma saṃ bha wa'i bka' bdag 'dra mkhar chen bzasabakod pa'o brda thim snyi gtad med byung rgyal chosabadag dharma'i ngor/'dzin med gter ston nusaldan rdo rje yi/ mi med dben gnas mkha' 'gro 'du gling nas/ g.yo med them byang gsal ba'i ri mo bkod/ mdo med a paṇa shi yang tshig 'jug bskyang / chosamed su kha sogs kyi dge rtsar bsngo don med yig rtsom chal chol 'dres ma 'di/ 'od med mtshan mo skabs su rnam par smras/ rgyu med sprang po smon lam zhis byasabris/ mtha' med 'gro khams dongs nasasprugs gyur cig sarba marsha lam/

bsgotshu zab gsang mkha' 'gro'i snying thig las: rtsa gsum rgya mtsho'i bskangs bsdus dngos grub char 'bebs bzhugs:badzra rgon na mo gu ru padma ka ra ye gabyuragranyanazangethacasar sha 4 la song bza' bayo rigs 'byor tshad thams cad bshams byas nas ye shes bdud rtsir byin gyis brlabs 'dod yon nam mkha' mdzod du spel re ye kho oṃ āḥs: chos nyid nam mkha' mdzod kyi sgyu 'phrul las: tshogs mchod 'dod dgu'i dpal yon mi 'dzad gter: skyabs gnas dkon mchog gsum dang rtsa ba gsum: ye shes mkha' 'gro khros ma bsrung mar bcas 'dir gshegs zhal zas tshogs kyi mchod pa 'bul: rtsa gsum dam can bsrung ma'i thugs dam bskang: sdom dang bslab pa dam tshig nyams pa bshags: dgra bgegs gnod byed sha khrag sgog dbugs rol: lhag skyong pho mo'i lhag rol phrin las sgrub: bdag cag tshogs rdzogs sgrib dag sangs rgyas regag: 7 rgyal ba kun 'dus bla ma rdo rje 'chang 7 'jam dpal sgyu 'phrul gsang 'dus bsrung mar bcas ma gu ru zhi drag dpa' bo bsrung mar bcas 7rdo rje gzhen

nu'i lha tshogs bsrung mar bcas 7 zhi khro bka' brgyad dbang phyug bsrung mar bcas de ltar grang ldan bsogs gyur na tshe 'dir bkra shis dge legs 'phel nyams chags nyes lhung thams cad byang tshe rabs kun tu gsang sngags kyis snod dang 'phrad cing nyams su len mthar thugs rdzogs sangs rgyas 'gyur ro sam pā rgya rgya rgya brda thim cesapa 'di'ang nyer mkho'i ched du bdud 'joms rdo rje'i nam mkha'i klong mdzod las bsgyur ba'o dge'o legs theg masgo lam/

badzra zab gsang rdo rje snying po las: thugs dzeechen po dri med padma dkar po'i: bstan srung lha bu ming sring gi bskul pa glog zhags 'khyug ma bzhugs so:badzra na mo ārya lo ki shwa ra ye: zu/sgro1byesajo// ma 'ongasalas ldan pho mo rnams yang gsang lam la zhugs pa' tshe bar chad dgra yis rgol gyur na nye byed bzlog pa'i thu lum bstan sa ma yu de pang dmar gyisagator ma bshams 'gugs gzhugs gra sa ldan bskyar ba'i rjes rnga chen rol mo'i sgra sbir zhi snyan pa'i dbyangs bcas 'ad skad do hūṃ bye gtum drag 'jigs su rung ba nas: rgyal bstan srung ba'i pho nya ba: lha bu ming sring 'khor dang bcas: gnad nas bskul lo dbyings nas bzhengs gdug pa 'dul ba'i las mdzod cig: dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i sha khrag gis: dgyes pa bskang ngo brngan mchod bzhes: khyed la phrin las bcol ba ni: bdag gis dka' ba dang blang nas lha mchog thugs rje'i dkyil 'khor sgrub: lus srog 'ben du btsugs byas te: stong nyid snying rje'i don mchog bsgoms: lha dang bla ma gtsug tu khur: chos sbongs khyod nyid grogs su brten: rang don bor zhing gzhan don sgrab: ma nyes

rang khar 'dug pa la sdang byed dgra yi ma ster ro mi 'dod sna tshogs thog tu bab: ngan song gsum gyi gzhi rtsa btsugs bsgral ba'i zhing bcu tshangs ba yis: snying khrag drod mo mngos sum byung mig rtsa gcus la ltag par 'then: 'o dod 'bod cing brang brdung chugs than rigs sna tshogs gzugs su ston: pho rgyud skyes pa stsad nas chos mo rgyud bu med mngal nas skoms: chung gsum byis pa drungs nas 'byin: me stag chu dang 'phrad pa bzhin ming tsam med par rdul du rlog: bcol ba'i phrin las grub par mdzod dus la bab 21 sa ma yu ces brjod gtor skyems dgra phyogs gtor pha lam yan kyang rdul brlag 'gyur byin rlabs rno nus bsam mi khyab sa ma yu ye ma rgyal ba'i dbang po padma saṃ bha was ma 'ongs 'gro la brtse ba chen po'i yis snying dang 'dra ba'i yang zab med byung ba grub pa'i dbang phyugs khye'u chung khyod la gtad da dung spel ba'i dus la ma bab pa'i rin chen brdar thob rdo rje'i rdzongs la sbos ma 'ong snyigasam sum cu kha ral dus nga sprul dpa' bo nus na rdo rje dang 'phrad na bstan pa rin chen 'dzan skyong spel 'gro don bsam mi khyab pa'i rten 'brel yod bka' gsang thub par srungs shig lha bu mched skal med lag tu ma shor spu gri gsum dam ldan thugs

gtsardo kyi sras dang 'phrad par shog sa ma yu rgya rgya rgya bstan srungs lha bu ming sring gi bskul pa slog zhags 'khyugs ma rdzogs so gter rgya gtad rgya sbas rgya zab rgya gsang rgya gu rgya o rgyan gyi slob dpon padma saṃ bha wa'i bka' bdag 'dra mkhar chen gzas bkod pa'o brda tham snyi ci nus kha mtshams gcod mdzad dharmā dang / ci mdzad mos gus che ba 'gyur rgyam dpal/ ca yang mi 'dod rnal 'byor kun bzang dang / ci zhig 'khor bar zhen log tā re'i mang / ci gsung zab gter bskul nus ratna sogs/ ci yang snang ba slob ma du ma'i ngor/ ji ltar pha nor dpal rnyed nus ldan pas/ ci bzhin rtog pa' ma bslad rnam par smras/ ji snyed yi ge'i risabyed smon sems sogs/ cir snang 'gro khams dong sprug nus par shog sarba masgo lam/

badzra zab gsang rdo rje snying po las: thugs rje chen po dri med padma dkar po'i: dngos grub bskul len 'dod 'jo'i bum bzang zhes bya ba bzhugs so:badzra namagu ru padma kā ra ye: sna sngas ṭwāṃ rgyal kun yi shes rdo rjes 'gro ba 'dul mkhyen brtse'i gzi 'od smon lam dus su sad gdul bya'i skyabs mgon dra med pad dkar la mthon mthing ral pa'i brgyud de gu pas 'dud ma 'ongs la ldan bskal bzang pho mo rnams gsang chen lam zhugasabaskyed rdzog lhur len tshe med du mi rung dngos grub bskul len ni 'dod 'asna'i bum pa bzang po zhesabya bstan sa ma yu bsnyen sgrub yan lag bzhi po mthar phyin tshe sgod dus snang gsal 'od ldan mang du sbar spos dud spro zhing rol mo sna tshogasabasgrags snyan pa'i dbyangs bcas byin 'bebs rnams gnyis gtong de nas thugasadam gnad bskul gsol 'deb ni thal mo sbyar la mos gus tshad med pas hūṃ /: bzhengs shig bzhengs shig bde gshegs 'dus pa'i lha: dgongs shig gson cig yi dam thugs rje'i gter byams dang snying rjes dbang phyags smran ras gzigs dri med pad dkar po'i lha tshogs rnams yang yang balcen cing sgrab pa tshad 'khyol nas mos gus dad brgya'i nyi ma shar

lags so: yeng med ting nge 'dzin gyi gnad dang bcas lha mchog khyed la 'o dod 'bod lags na sngon gyi thugs bskyed dam bca' ma g.yel bar: mkhyen brtse nus pas dad ldan skyongs re ran: byams dang snying rje'i lcags kyus 'dzin skabs bab dbang byin dngos grub stsol ba'i dus la bab: nyams rtogs yon tan bskyed pa'i dus la bab lha dang bskal ba mnyams par byin gyis rlobs 'gro khams dong sprugs nus pa'i mthu stobs stsol: zhes brjod la mos gus tshad med pa dang ldan pa'i ngang nas 'dzab dbyangs byas te yin a hūṃ hrī: tsho/ ma ṇi padme hūṃ hrī: kā ya sirnyi tsho/ wākka sirnyi yas tsitta sirnyi hūṃ: sarba sirnyi hrī: brgya rtsa ba da la stong tshig mched bstod bya de nas tho rang bdag mdun bzlas dmigs gsol mchad dang bskang tshogs nyi le bsgrad cing bsgral bstab rjes gnad bskul gsol 'debasa'adzab dbyangs sngags brgya rtsa mchod cing bstod la bro bshagasabya de nas bum pa sku'i dngos grub ni hūṃ bye tsa)'a med pa rdo rje tshe yi dbang: kun tshom bum par bstel ba'i gsang gsum bcud: deng 'dir rnal 'byor bdag gi dpal du shar: snang stong gnyis med stogs pa'i dngos grub stsol rtsa sngagasamathar kwa ya 'ji

'amatshu tshe: ka ya a bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ: de nas bhasto gsung ga dngos grub na hū hrī: bde skyong kwa pa la ru bskyil ba yi: bla ma yab yum spyor bas bdud rtsi'i rgyun deng 'dir sgrub mchog bdag gi dpal du shar: gsung dbyangs drug cu'i byin rlabs ngag la phob: gsal stong gnyis su med pa'i dngos grub stsol: rtsa sngags mthar wākka sidhi ā wākka a bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ: de nasa'aja' shel thugs kya dngos grub ni hūṃ hrī dre bral ka nas dag pa'i 'ja' shel ni: mtshan ma tshig bral ye shes dpe yi rdzas deng 'dir rnal 'byor bdag gi dpal du shar: mkhyen brtse nus pa'i gzi 'od sems la phob: rig stong gnyis med rtogs pa'i dngos grub stsol: rtsa sngags mthar citta sirnyi /: tsitta a bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ: de nas ril bum yon ma dngos grub ni hūṃ hrī: dri bral shel bum yangs pa'i da la rtsa lha tshogs sku gsung thugs rdzogs ril bus gtams: deng 'dir rnal 'byor bdag gi dpal du shar: nus mthu stobs rtsal ldan pa'i yon tan bsted: bde stong gnyis med rtogs pa'i dngos grub rtsol: rtsa sngags mthar sarba si: hūṃ: sarba a bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ: de nas sman sgrom phron las dngos grub ni hā

hrī: yid bzhin gter ldan rdo rje'i snod kyi nang: gtams pa'i rtsa brgyad stong sbyar a dṛ ta: deng 'dir rnal 'byor bdag gi dpal du shar: phrin las 'gro ba 'dul ba'i nus mthu bskyed: myong grol ye shes rtogs pa'i dngos grub stsol: rtsa sngags mthar a dṛ ta sirnyi —: a dṛ ta a bhi ṣiñtsa /: de nas gtor chen lhun ོgas dngos grub ni hūṃ trī: bde chen ratna 'bar ba'i gzhong pa rtsa dam rdzas gtor chen dkyil 'khor lha yi dal: deng 'dir rnal 'byor bdag gi dpal du shar: las bzhi grub brgyad yon tan bcu drug bskyed:'phags mchog thugs rje'i mdzad pa bdag 'grub shog maṇḍal sirnyi st+waṃ: maṇḍal a snyi ṣiñtsa 〉: de nas lhag ma' rdzas rnams kun rol te hū hrī sgrub pa'i rnal 'byor skal ldan pho mo la:'jigs pa brgyad sogs zhi ba'i dngos grub stsol: tshe dpal 'byor drug rgyas pa'i dngos grub stsol: khams gsum 'dod dgu dbang sdud dngos grub stsol: log 'dren dgra bgegs sgrol ba'i dngos grub stsal: bde stong ye shes rtog pa'i dngos grub stsol: dbyings rig zung du 'jug pa'i dngos grub stsol: bla med rdzogs pa chen po'i dngos grub

ba rte stsol: mchog thun dngos grub ma hā sidhi st+waṃ: yin gi hūṃ hrī sarba ma hā gursha garma sirnyi a bhi ṣiñtsa tshe: dung dang gling bu'i sgra dbyangs snyan por bcas dngos grub dzos rnams gnas gsum gtug la rol dbang dang daro sa grub gcar phog thob par mos nyams rtogs yon tan gong 'phe la rgyas pa ra 'gyur drangs ba nasabazung lag ma chad brtan gtong gtang rag mchod cing bstod pa rgya cher bya gnad des gang bsam gegs med yid bzhin 'grub the tshom med do gu ru pa dma' bka' sa ma mā ye ma rgyal ba'i dbang po padma saṃ bha wa'i ma 'ongs 'gro la brtse ba chen po yis snying dang 'dra ba'i yang zab rmad byu ba grub pa 'i dbang phyugs khye'u chung khyod la gtad da dung ma spel rin chen bdo la thob mdo khams rdo rje'i rdzong du dgongs bra sdoms ma 'ongs snya ma sum cu kha ral dus nga sprul dpa' bo nus ldan rdo rje dang 'phrad nas bstan pa rin chen 'dzan skyong spel las ldan chos kyi bdag po rnams la 'doms gdul bya 'bum phrag 'og min zhing la 'god 'gro don bsam mi khyabs pa 'i rten 'brel yod bka' gsang thub par srungs shig lha bu mched skal med lag tu ma shor spu gri gsum las can snying gi bu dang 'phrad pa ra shog sa ma yu rgya rgya rgya dngosagrub bsku len 'dod 'jo'i bum bzang rdzogs so gter rgya gtad rgya sbas rgya zab rgya gsang rgya gu rgya o rgyan gyi slob dpon padma saṃ bha wa'i

bka' bdag 'dra mkhar chen gza bkod pa'o brda thim snyi rgyal bstan mchog la mos pa'isgom dang /rgyal bka' brtson sgrubakairti rang grol zung /rgyal gsang lhag zhabs bsdusapa'isgron maskyabs/rgyal dgongs brda 'byed ratna sar sogs/rgyal ba rdor 'chang bstan 'dzin du ma' ngor/rgyal dbang padma'i gdung 'dzananusaldan pas/rgyal byed mkha' 'gro'i brda tshig dag par smras rgyal bstan yig gesarisabyedaston the so/sarba maṅga lam/
'a( cha zab gsang rdo rje snying po las thugs rje chen po dri med padma dkar po'i bdud rtsi sman gyi sgrubs pa'i lag len kha bskang las rim nyer lnga pa dngos grub 'byung gnas zhes bya ba bzhugs so:

—41 na mo gu ru padma kā ra ye thu bsgrogashā ma(bye/ byamasadang snyang 'i 'od zer stob 'bar ba rgyal kun thugs rje' dbang phyugs spyan ras gzigs dri med padma dkar po'i dkyil labor la gus pas 'dud do snying nas phyag 'tshal lo bdag 'dra rgyal dbang padma saṃ bha wa'i ma 'o sa 'gro la thugs rje brtse ba yis snyang dang 'dra ba'i yang zab med byung ba sgrub pa'i cha lag las ram nyer lnga bstan sa ma yā gsang chen bla na med pa' 'jug ngog sgo bdud rtsi sman gyi sgrub pa bya ba la gnas mchog bkra shis srung bzhi tshangs ba'i sa rgyal dbang gong mas byin rlabs zhabs bcag gnas rig 'dzan rgyal ba'i byin gyis brlabs sa ru phyin te dkar dmar mchod pa rgya chen gtong bdag bskyed bzlas pa mchod bstod grub pa'i rjes sa chog dkar gtor shi rtsis brgyan pa can sngagasadrug phyag drug phyag rgyas byin gyis brlabs rang nyid 'phagasapa'i nga rgyal ldan pa yas yinam ho ngo mtshar rmad byung bkra shis phun tshogs gnas:dus gsum rgyal ba'i byin rlabs mdzad pa phudeng 'dir bdag gis dkyil 'khor bzhengs pa la:yul bzhi skyong mdzad dkar phyogs skyong ba'i tshogs:ma thogs gsang ba'i gnas 'dir sbyan 'dren gshegs:dkar skyems dam rdzas mchod pa 'di bzhes la bdag gi las 'di brtsam la

ba tshu bar chad bdud: ming tsam med par zhi bar mdzad pa dang rnal 'byor bcol ba'i phrin las grub par mdzod: 37 sarba lo ka pā la e dam bā lirnya kha kha khā hi khā hi: lan bdun gyis phul phrin las thog med sgrub phyi ya sa chog bya ba'i rim pa'o sa ma yu las rim da po'o rgya rgya rgya de nas da la'i sa gzhi tshol ba la dbang chen sa yi lha mo brngan pa ni gnasayid du 'ong zhi bkra shis pa'i sa la dbang chen wa mo byon par bsam la hūṃ trī rgyal ba shwaka thub o rgyan padma yi: spyan sngar khas blangs dbang chen sa yi bdag: bstan ma chen mo dpon g.yog 'khor dang bcas:dam tshig gsang ba'i gnas 'dir sbyan 'dren gshegs: tshe bhu mi pa ti sa pā ri wā ra badzra sa ma ya dza dza: dza:( baṃ ho: de nas mchod pa 'bul ba ni hūṃ hrī ngo mtshar phyi nang gsang gsum mchod pa'i sprin: kun tu bzang po'i rol par byin rlabs pas dbang chen sa yi lha mo'i dgyes pa bskangs rnal 'byor 'dod don 'grub pa'i phrin las mdzod o bhu mi pa ti sa pa ri wā ra ma hwa pañtsa pā dza ho: de nas gtor ma 'bul ba ni dkar skyemasa.a ka ro' brlabs bla uhūṃ sbyoḥ las rin chen snod du gtor ma ni: dkar gsum mngar gsum 'dod

yon nam mkha' mdzod myong grol ye shes bdud rtsir rab dmigs nas: dbang chen sa yi lha mor mchod pa 'bul: byu mi pa ti e dam bha lirnya khā hi lan bdun bo da la phul bar bya'o de na bstod pa bya ba ni hū hrī: dbang chen gser gyi sa gzhir mnga' mdzad cing: stong gsum gzhi bdag mi ma yin gyi sgog: rgyal ba sras bcas dgyes bskyed dbu bstod ma:dbang chen sa yi lha mor phyag 'tshal bstod: de nas phrin lasabacol ba ni khyed sa yi lha mo khyed mchod byin rlabs kyis: bdag gi sgrub pa 'di mthar ma phyin par phyi nang 'byung ba'i gcod ral zhi ba dang: rtag dang mtshan ma rten 'brel phun tshogs te: bdud rtsi yon tan thog med grub par mdzod swā sti sirnyi maṅga lam zhes brjod tshe lha mo 'dzum pa'i mdangasaphyung ste sgrub pa po khyod kyis phrin lasagang 'dod stsol zhes khas blangs te phyag byas nas sa la thim par bsam gnad des bar chad g.yul las rgyal nang gi sa chog rim pa'o sa ma mā lasarim gnyis pa'o rgya rgya rgya de nasarang nyid he ru ga'i nga rgyal ldan pas 'di skad do hūṃ rang nyid dza chen khams gsum rnam rgyal gyis: mig 'bras ma dang re las byung ba yis: nyi 'od bskal pa'i me yi gzi ngar gyis gnyis

btsa( rtogs mtshan ma'i yul rnams bsregs sbyangs byed: snyi hūṃ snyi shwa badzra kho mi tsakra dzwa la maṇḍal hūṃ ha la ha la hūṃ phaṭa: ces dang hūṃ bzhi'i sngags brjod cing slob dpon thun brab da la bskor kun rdzob khro bo'i sbyang ba'o sa ma yu las rim gsum pa 'o rgya rgya rgya de nas dra bza chags chags gdab pa ni sa: gzhi ma bkra shis phun sum tshogs pa'i dal: 'gyur ba med phyir ba byung rnams lnga dang: tshul khrim dag phyir dri bzang ngad pas brlan: byang chub sems mchog stong nyid snying rje'i dpal: kun nas bskyed phyir rten 'brel rgyas gdab po: bhu mi pa ti sa swā le le e na na sarba gharbhe sarba saṃ shwa rnya na ye swā hā: ces brjod rdo rje slob dpon gyi srin mdzub kyis dor chag chag gdab rdzas kyis gzha byin rlabs so sa ma yā las ram bzhi pa'o rgya rgya rgya de nas khro bcu'i phur pa rnams byin gyis brlabs pa'i rims pa ni hūṃ sa: gu gul dud spros bar chad bgegs tshogs bskrad: yungs dkar khro bo'i phyag mdas dam sri 'joms: rakta byug pas gzi mdangs nus pa bsted: phyogs bcu'i bdud 'dul bamong ba'i las byed do badzra a ko dra ya sarba brigrun baṃ hūṃ phaṭa ralnga ha nyi hūṃ garma sa na ralnga sbyo: zhes brjod gzi byan

bskyed pa'o slob dpon sngags kyi chas su zhugs tho chen g.yas la phur pa g.yon rdo rje' 'gros kyis rta stabasabasgyur 'tshogasapa'i rol chen rnga bcas te hūṃ hū: che chen hūṃ gar sgra 95byen mas: stong phyogs lha gdon 'byung po gardza gardza hūṃ phaṭa: sder mo'i sngagasakyang spyi ltar gtong phur pa shar stod gdon la 'debs hūṃ sa: khro chen rnam rgyal mda' snyems mas dri za'i gdon rnams zil gnon mdzod:oṃ badzra kro ta bi dza ya /: shar phyogs dri za pho mo ha na ha na hūṃ phaṭa: kur pa shar phyogs gdon la gdab hūṃ hūṃ khro chen gshin rje'i dur bdag mos: gshin rje'i gdon rnam zil gnon mdzod: ma badzra kro ta ya manta ka 〉: lho phyogs gshin rje'i pho mo pa tsa pa tsa hūṃ phaṭa phur pa lho phyogs gdon la gdab hū hū khro chen rta mgrin gtum mo yis chu lha'i gdon rnam zil gnon mdzod: ma badzra kro ta hya ṣṭṛ wa nyu: nub phyogs chu lha klu gdon pho mo hu lu hu lu hūṃ phaṭa: phur pa nub phyogs gdon la gdab hū hū khro chen bdud rtsi rlung 'byin mas gnod sbyin gdon rnams zil gnon mdzod yo badzra kro ta a mṛ ta kuṇḍa li hūṃ: byang phyogs gnod sprin pho mo tshismo tshind+ra hūṃ phaṭa: phur pa byang phyogs gdon la gdab hā hūṃ khro chen dbyug sngon sder

ba tshu mo yis: me lha'i gdon rnams zil gnon mdzod: o badzra kro ta ni lantan tra hūṃ: shar lho me lha pho mo da ha da ha hūṃ phaṭa: phur pa shar spyo gdon la gdab hūṃ hūṃ khro chen mi g.yo gtun khung mas srin po'i gdon rnams zil gnon mdzod: snyen badzra kro ta arya a tsa la hūṃ lho nub srin po pho mo bhanta bhanta hūṃ phaṭa phur pa sto nub gdon la gdab hūṃ /:khro chen 'dod rgyal snyem ma yis: rlung lha pho mo zil gnon mdzod: o badzra kro ta a pa ra tsitta hūṃ: nub byang rlung lha pho mo tiṣṭha tiṣṭha hūṃ phaṭa: phur pa nub byang gdon la gdab hūṃ hūṃ khro chen khams gsum gsod byed ma'i: dbang ldan pho mo zil gnon mdzod: o badzra kro ta kre lo kya bi dza ya (: byang shar dbang ldan pho mo bhisto snyinta hūṃ phaṭa phur pa byang shar gdon la gdab hūṃ shā: khro rgyal stobs chen bskul byed mas: sa bdag pho mo zil gnon mdzod: snye badzra 11 ta ma hā bā la /: 'og phyogs sa bdag klu gnyan pho mo sbo ṭa sbo ṭa hūṃ phaṭa: phur pa nub smad gdon la gdab hūṃ hūṃ khro rgyal mabyung nag rngams pa'i sa: 'jigs gzugs srin po khros 'dra las: khro chung me yi thog zer 'phro: bar chad bdud tshogs zil gnon

mdzod yin badzra ma hā kro ta padma kro ti shā ri badzra ke li ki la ya ma hā yakka ka la ru pa garma ram̐ ram̐ dzwa la ram̐ hūṃ phaṭa:khrobo rnam phyagasabacu'i bgegs laphur pa'i tshul du btab pas de rnams kyi lus phug te g.yo 'gul med par brgyal bar bsam gzhung bzhin srung 'khor bsgoms par bya de rnams sa chog rim pa'o sa ma mā las rim lnga pa'o rgya rgya rgya de nagazig chog bya ba ni bdag bskyid bsnyen /nga mchod bstod rjes da la'i steng du lding khri'i khar thig tho lnga po phyogasalngar 'god rang srog yi ge'i marga par bya rnams lnga nyer spyod dag gis bskor yin swā bha wa sogs mi dmigasasteng pa'i ngang nyid las mtshan nyid phun tshogs ratna'i snod yangs shing rgya cher gyur pa'i nang: mkha' tshon mthing gar rdo rje sems: chu tshon dkar po rnam snang mdzad sa tshon sel gsal rin chen 'byung me tshon dmar po snang mtha' yas: rlung tshon ljang gur don yod grub rang rang rigs kyi yum dang sbyor: 'dzin med sgyu ma'i rol par bskyed: rang sgog 'od kyi ye shes pa: spyan drangs gnyis su med par bstims yin hūsu o ha: ratna sirnyi hūṃ lī hūṃ bye hūṃ puṣṭi a we sha ya āḥ nyer gcig brjod la byin gyis brlabs rdo rje rgyal po' srin mdzub kyis yi ge rnams ni bsdu bar bya lha

—4( 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i thig tshon ratna lnga yi rang bzhin du gyur bar bsam sa ma ā lasarim drug pa 'o rgya rgya rgya de nas maṇḍal ldeng khra'i khar thig skud yi dam mtshon pa' dzos steng 'og tshul bshams rnams lnga bkrams o swā bha was stong par sbyangs dmigasamed chos dbyings rol pa las: thig skud ye shes lnga'i skud pa: ye thig rgyal ba rigs lnga'i dal: dam thig sku gsung thugs kyi rten: yab yum 'byu bcu 'bru gsum gyis: sbyang spel bsgyur la byin gyis brlabs: ma hū su e ha: rlu lī māṃ bye shā: ratna ma le sarba sirnyi /: nyer gcig brjod la ye thig brlabs can yi ༷/sarba ma hā su kha sidhi dzuṣṭa na ma hūṃ: nyer gcig brjod la dam thig brlabs ye shesakyi lha tshogs rnams 'od du zhu nas thig skud la thim pa sa byang chub sems kyis rgyud lam du dmigs la me tog 'thor zhing rab tu gnas las chus chags chag gdab pa ni hūṃ bisnan ta krita phaṭa: sarba saṃ shwa dha na ye swā hā: rdo rje 'gros kyis dkyil 'khor bskor las chas chag chag gdab par bya sa ma yu las rim bdun pa'o rgya rgya rgya de nas zig skud gdab pa la dang po thig skud blangs byas te slob busango zhes thig sna phyungs slob dponatswa zhis phyag rgyas blang gnyis gas rdo rje rtse gcig gis thig skud spyi bor bteg byas te hā dzha:

brdal khyab skye ba med pa chos kyi dbyings lhun grub zang thal rig pa byang chub sems: mi 'gyur rdo rje btsun mo'i mkha' klong du: 'ub chub rang grol chos sku'i thig thob cig:sgro dzñā na dhartu ratna spra ra ṇa tt+waṃ thig skud dbra la bar bzungs la 'di skad do hūṃ 1 lhun grub 'gag med 'od gsal dngas ba'i mkha': rmad byung ye shes lnga yi dkyil 'khor rdzogs: mi 'da' gsang gsum bde chen btsun mo'i mkhar: zang thal byang sems longs sku'i thig thob cig: dzñā sto snyicitta ratna spra ra ṇa tt+waṃ: zig skud mgrin par bzung la 'di skad do hūṃ dzñā:thugs rje dmigasapa med pa'i ye shes dbyings: brjod bral shes rab 'bar ba'i da la che mi 'khrurlo dag mnyam ḍakki'i mkha' debyings su bde chen sprul pa sku yi thig rgeb cig: st+waṃ ma hā su kha padma spra ra ṇa phaṭa se ha ratna tt+waṃ: zhes brjod dkar dmar mthing ga'i 'od zer gyis chos longs sprul sku'i byin rlabs bsdus te bstim de nas thig skud snying gar bzung byas te yin badzra su tra sa ma yā: ma ti pra ma hūṃ phaṭa: 'dud pa'i phyag rgya se gol sgra bcasate shar nub tshangs thag nas bzu bcu gnyas rdeb ye thig mkha' ru dkrol ba man ngag lugs dam thag 'dzin rgya gong ltar bya ba la zig gzhong la

gsaX brten sngags 'di bcas te gdab spyo sa ma ya ma ma ti pra ma hūṃ phaṭa:zhes brjod zig chen brgyad du bkrams par bya skud pa bsdu zhing las slob mchod cing bstod slob dpon se gol sgra bcas 'di skad do mkha' khyab kyirgyalab rnams sad cing ye shes kyi thig dam tshig gi zig dang ro gcig tu 'dris par gyur zhes brjod 'byung ba rim lnga sgo rdzogs zig bkram la lha reg dkar pos rnams par 'geb rdo rje rgyal po'i phyag rgya' bsrung ba'o zhags du dam rgya byas te legs par bzhag rten 'brel brtags la de nas rdul tshon bkram lhun gyis grub pa' dkyil 'khor bzhi ma'o bkra shis nyin par sa thig cho gar grags sa ma yā las rim brgyad pa'o rgya rgya rgya de nas gsum pa'i nya ma bde 'byor dus ya dam thugs rje'i bskyed bzlas mchod bstod bya tshom bu lha yi lta gon rim pa ni rin po che yi gzhi ma mdzes pa'i khar rdo rje rgyal po'i dri yi thig le bri las kyi rdo rjes 'bras dkar tshom bu blugs ston 'khor 'khor bcas kun gyis sngags ni dbyangs bcas te yin a hūṃ hrī: ma ṇi padme hūṃ trī:sa ma ya st+waṃ:snyen a :༄dhe wa trī:sa ma ya st+waṃ:yin ārya phroḥs ma ya st+waṃ:snyen ā puṣṭi rluḥs ma sto snyen ārya pā na ma sa ma ya ste:snyed ārya shwa dru yaXs ma ya sto:yin ārya badzra ghasgyu sa ma ya sto:snyen ārya 'a ki shu raḥs ma ya sto snyen ārya ma j-i dme waḥs ma ya sto:

lo ārya padme tshistoḥs ma ya sto: 67 ārya me tri shwa raḥs ma ya sto: rme ārya pa ra ti padmeḥs ma ya st+waṃ yin badzra wā suḥs ma ya sto: tso ratna mā phyeḥs ma ya sto: e padma /ltaḥs ma ya sto: ma garma nīrtiḥs ma ya st+waṃ e badzra rgya ṣṭṛ wa dza sa ma ya st+waṃ:yin ratna hya sto wa hūṃḥs ma ya sto 37 padma hya skṛ wa baṃḥs ma ya st+waṃ yin garma rgya skṛ wa hoḥs ma ya sto e ārya brnya sa twa sa sarba shrīḥs ma ya st+waṃ ces brjod da la'i dbus bkod rol mo btags mchod cing bstod par byas la phun tshogs bya sa ma yu las rim dgu pa'o rgya rgya rgya de nas bum pa rta gon bya ba la ku sha'i chun po drug bkram mje par bya rnams lnga nyer spyod mchod dzos rgya chen bkrams bum pa skyon med chu yis byug cing bkru gu gul dang ni sbyar spos dud pa bdug yung dkar rdo rje khro bo' phyag mdas brab lha sngagasabarjod la lnga tshan lnga yis gtams mgul chang kha rgyan gzungs thag rdo rje brten yongs su rdzogs rjes bkra shis gdan steng 'god rol mo'i sgra sbir bum bzlas bskyed chog bskyar bzhu btul bya ba' rim pa dang bcas so las kyi bum pa sgrub tshul de bzhin no bum pa rta gon bya ba'i rim pa'o sam mā las rim bcu pa'o rgya rgya rgya de nas slob ma sta gon bya ba la khrus dang bgegs bsgrad srung 'khor maṇḍal phul bden don bshad la gsol ba gdab pa na spre/ཿ gsang

bas/ chen rdo rje'i don ston bla ma dgongs: bdag ni bskyed rdzogs lam mchog sbyor ba la: dngos grub skal ba mchis sam ma mchis pas rten 'brel sta gon dbang gi dngos grub (65 lan gsum rjes su bla ma'i lan gnang ba e ma: las spyo na ldan pa'i skal bzang skyes bu gson gsang sngags sgrub chen lam du 'a cog pa la: rtsa ba yan lag dam tshig srung nus sam: bskyed bsgom ting 'dzin brtson pas brten nus sam: yongs su ldan na rten 'brel sta gon dbang: sbyin par rung ngo mi nus pa rnams dengs: skyabs sems yan bdun sdom bzungs dbang gzhung ltar de nas dam chu sbyin pa 'i rims pa na hūṃ hrī 'di ni dus gsum rgyal ba thams cad kyi gsang gsum rdo rje rang bzhin mna' yi chu: dam ldan rig pa 'dzin mdzad khyod la sbyin: rtsa ba yan lag dam tshig bsrung bar mdzod ces zhwa hū: / ā tsho zhes brjod gnas gsum dri yithag le byug rdo rje gsum kyi rang bzhin nyid du dmigs de nas 'od 'phros rgyal ba thams cad kyis sku gsung thugs kyi dbang byin bsdus te bstim rtsa ba yan lag dam srog thob par dmags de nas so shing sbyin pa'i rim pa ni ṭwāṃ hri las bzhi lcan grub rten 'brel so shing rdzas

dngos grub pra ltas brtags pa'i ya mtshan can bum pa lha yi skal pa dang ldan phyir: lus ngag yid kyi sdig sgrib dag gyur cig: tso ha zhes brjod rdo rje rgyal pos slob bur sbyin tshom bu' dbusasu dor la 'di skad do yin badzra ha sa ha rtse mo shar lho nub byang la bstanas na rim bzhin zhi rgyas dbang gi lasarnams 'grub mtshams bzhar phran tshegs lasadang dngosagrub 'grub steng 'og la bstan mkha' spyod sa spyod do lha dang bla ma la bstan phyag chen 'grub sa ma yu de na dung zhal las chu sbyin byas te hrī bo: dag byed gtsang ma yan lag brgyad dang ldan: rdo rje khro bo gnod sbyin rang mdangs can: deng 'dir skal ldan bu mchog rnams la sbyin: ma rig las nyon ngag sgrib dag pa dag: rdo rje gsung dbang skal pa dang ldan sgo ga:trī dzña na snyi shwa dha sarba galngan na ma saṃ shwa dha na ye swā hā: ces sbyan lan gsum 'thung bas sgrib gsum dag sku gsung thugs mchog thob pa' skal ba bzhag sa ma yu de nas srung skud sbyin pa'i rim pa ni bsangs sbyangs bsgyur brlabs grub nas 'di skad do trī /ri: che dza/(she rang bzhin srung skud sor bcu gnyis: skal ldan rnams kyi dpung par rab bcings bas: kurgyu byang chub sems kyi rgyud lam drangs: bde chen bdud rtsi nyams med srung bar

ba tshu byed: gnyis rtog mtshan ma'i sgrib pa kun dag phyir: las can skal pa'i bu mchog rnams la sbyin: shes rab ye shes lnga dang ldan par shog: rtsa sngags kyi sbyin mdud steng las chu dor hrīḥsnyi 85) sarba brnya rasnya rakta ku dhu swā hā ces sbyin gas ba'i snod du rung bar bya bar chad bdud kyi bgegs las srung bar byed sa ma mā de nas ku sha sbyin pa'i rim pa ni bsang sbyangs byin gyas brlabs pa grub nas slar dhi sa: sdon tshe rgyal ba'i byin rlabs bkra shis rdzas: rtsa mchog ku sha gdan btang rdzogs sangs rgyas: dengs 'dir skal ldan bu mchog rnams la sbyin: lha dang bskal ba mnyam par byin gyis rlobs: dge dang mi dge'i ltas mtshan rab brtags nas: gsang sngags thabs chen spyod pa'i skal ldan rnams: ka dag tshig dbang dgongs pa mngon gyur re ga: skyes badzra tikṣa rna: ces pas sbyin zhing slob bu'i 'di skad brjod snyen badzra tig na sirnyi shā: ces brjod sor bsgol phyag rgyas blang bar bya thung ba sngas dang rigs ba stan du bya rgyal ba mya ngan 'das gzum ltar du nyal rnam rtog gzhan gyas bar ma chod pa ru lha dang dkyil 'khor ci mtho snyams pa yis dmags pa de yi ngang nas gnyid du phyogs legs par 'dug na gsang chen sgo ru zhugs nyes

par gyur tshe srung rim thabs la 'bad de nas sta gon mchod bstod bya ba ni 31 ārya lo ki shwa ri sa pa ri wa ra a: pra ti tsa ye swā hā: pakyi sogs shabha'i bar sbyor hū hrī: sku ni mi 'gyur dri bral shel ltar dkar: gsungs dbyangs 'gags med 'bru drug chos char 'bebs: thugs mchog byams dang snying rjes 'gro ba 'dul: thugs rje chen po'i sku gsungs thugs la bstod sta gon gyi lha tshogs rnams mdun gyi nam mkhar dpag te 'od kyi drwa bar bzhugs par bsam bha ga gra ma ya: 3 badzra ༷je sogs nas shabha ā nyu: hū hrī: thugs rje 'od zer bye ba'i rlab phreng gis dad ldan gdul bya'i blo yi padmo 'byed: byams dang snying rjes 'gro khams dong sprugs pa'i: dri med padma dkar por phyag 'tshal bstod: yi ge brgya pas bzod gsol nongs pa bshags gsang sngags bsgrub pa'i cha lag rim pa'o sa ma yā las rim bcu gcig pa'o rgya rgya rgya de nas rgyal tho 'dzug pa rol mo sna tshogs sgra bcas te lu gu rgyud 'brel shar du pheb nyer spyod mchod dzos byin rlabs ni ces swā bha wa sogs bye las rin chen snod mchog yangs pa'i nang: ram̐ las phyi nang gsang gsum mchod pa'i sprin: 'dod yon lha mo'i gar bsgyur dang bcas nas: rgyal ba sras bcas

badzra dgyes pa'i mthu ldan gyur: yo badzra spa ra ṇa che: de nas tho byang bskyed pa ni oṃ ma hā shu hye ta sogs tho byang mi dmigs stong pa'i ngang nyid las: rang byung shel gyi gzhal med mdzes pa'i nang: bīḥlas byung ba'i rgyal chen yul 'khor srung: dkar gsal rab brjid pi waṃ dbyangs snyan brten: dngul rmog dngul srab dar dang ratna'i brgyan: dri za bye ba 'bum sde'i 'khor gyis bskor: rang srog 'od kyi bskul te ye shes pa: spyan drangs dam ye gnyis su med par bstim de nas spyan 'dren bya ba ni kye phyogs phyogs dag kyang pha gi na: nyi ma shar phyogs pha gi nas: dri za'i sde dpon yul 'khor srung: 'khor dang bcas pa gshegs su gsol oṃ dhi ta raṣṭa ye sa pa ri wa ra badzra sa ma ya dza dza de nas mchod pa 'bul ba na hūṃ mchod yon zhabs bsil me tog spos: mar me dri chab zhal zas rol phyi nang gsang gsum mchod pa'i sprin: rgyal chen 'khor dang bcas la 'bul: ces badzra a sogs shasta sarba pañtsa putstsha khā hi: de nas gtor ma 'bul ba ni ram̐ ye sa: gtor ma 'dod rgu'i dpal yon phun sum tshogs par gyur: nam mkha' mdzod

sngags bskyal te brlabs o rin chen yangs pa'i snod nang du: gtams pa'i gtor ma 'dod rgu'i gter rgyal chen 'khor dang bcas la 'bul: zhi ba'i phrin las grub par mdzod: ma dhi ta raṣṭa ye sa pa ri wā ra e dam bā lirnyi kha kha khā hi khā hi: lan gsum gyis phul phran las bcol ba ni ho: rgyal chen 'khor bcas dgongs su gsol: bdag gi sgrub pa zab mo 'di: dbu nas mthar ma phyin bar du phyi nang gsang ba'i bar chad bzlog: dngos grub sgrub pa'i srung ma mdzod: ma dhi ta ra ye sa pa ri wā ra sa ma ya uddha du rakta rakṣa :de nas bstod pa bya ba ni hūṃ trī: ri rab shar phyogs dri za'i rje: 'jigs brgyad zhi ba'i las la mkhas: rdzu 'phrul stobs kyi bdag po ni: yul 'khor srung ba 'khor bcas la:mchod cing bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal: de nas rten bzhugs bya ba ni ho: rgyal chen 'khor dang bcas pa rnams: sgrub pa'i dam rgya ma grol bar: rten 'dir rten chos brtan bzhugs la dngos grub sgrub pa'i srung ma mdzod: ma dhi ta ra ye sa pa ri wā ra sa ma ya rakṣa rakṣa: o su pra tiṣṭha badzra ye swā hā: de nasabakra shis bya ba ni ho: shar nas bkra shis don gyi lha:

btsa/: mi 'gyur rdo rje sems dpa' che: badzra rigs kyi bkra shis gang: deng 'dir bde legs mdzad du gsol: gnad des nad gdon 'jigs brgyad zhi sgrub pa'i bar pha srung bar 'gyur sa ma yā las ram bcu gnyis pa'o rgya rgya rgya de nas lho yi zo bya ji mchod rdzas byin rlabs go ltar ro snyed ma hā shu bye ta sogs tho byang mi dmigs stong pa'i ngang nyid las rang byung beeḍūr gzhal med mdzes pa'i nang: bee las byung ba'i rgyal chen 'phags skyes po: sngon po rab khros bsam gcod ral gri bsnams: gser rmog gser khrab dar dang ratnas brgyan: gshin rje bye ba 'bum sde'i 'khor gyis bskor: rang srog 'od kyis bskul te ye shes pa: spyan drangs dam ye gnyis su med par bstim de nas spyan 'dren bya ba ni kye phyogs phyogasadag kyang pha gi na: nyi ma lho phyogs pha gi nas: grul bum sde dpon 'phags skyes po 'khor dang bcas pa gshegs su gsol: snyen gri ru ta ka ye sa pa ri wā ra sa ma ya dza dza: de nas mchod pa 'bul ba ni nyi mchod yon zhabs bsil me tog spos: mar me dri chab zhal zas rol: phyi nang gsang gsum mchod pa'i sprin rgyal chen 'khor dang

bcas la 'bul oṃ badzra asnye sogs shabha sarba pañtsa pū tsa kha hi: de nas gtor ma 'bul ba ni ra ye sa: gtor ma 'dod rgu'i dpal yon phun sum tshogs par gyur nam mkha' mdzod sngags bskyar te bams ma: rin chen yangs pa'i snod nang du gtams pa'i gtor ma 'dod rgu'i gter: rgyal chen 'khor dang bcas la 'bul rgyas pa'i phrin las grub par mdzod: ma shī ru ta ka ye sa pā ri wā ra e dam bā lirnya kha kha khā hi kha hi: lan gsum gyisaphul phran las bcol ho: rgyal chen 'khor bcas dgongs su gsol: bdag gi sgrub pa zab mo 'di: dbu nas mthar ma phyin bar du: phyi nang gsang ba'i bar chad bzlog: dngos grub sgrub pa'i srung ma mdzod oṃ bre ru ta ka ye sa pā ri wā ra sa ma yadzasnya du rakta rakta de nas bstod pa bya ba ni hū trī ri rab lto phyogs grul bum rje dpal 'byor bskyed pa'i las la mkhas: rdzu 'phrul stobs kyi bdag po ni 'phags skyes po ni 'khor bcas la mchod cing bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal: de nas rten bzhugs bya ba ni hoḥ rgyal chen 'khor dang bcas pa rnams: sgrab pa'i dam rgya ma grol bar rten 'dir rten chos

ba tshu brtan bzhugs la: dngos grub sgrub pa'i srung ma mdzod: ma bī ru ta ka ye sa pa ri wā ra sa ma ya rakṣa rakta oṃ su pra tiṣṭha badzra ye swā hā: de nas bkra shis bya ba ni snosto nas bkra shis don gyi lha: yon tan kun rdzogs rin chen 'byung ratna rigs kyi bkra shis gang: deng 'dir bde legs mdzad du gsol: gnad des tshe dpal nyams rtogs rgyas sgrub pa'i mthun rkyen phun tshogs 'gyur sa ma mā las rim bcu gsum pa'o rgya rgya rgya de nas nub kyis tho byang ni mchod rdzas byan rlabs gong ltar ro 31 ma hā shu hye ta sogs tho byang mi dmigs stong pa'i ngang nyid las rang byung byu ru'i gzhal med mdzes pa'i nang bīḥlas byung ba'i rgyal chen spyan mi bzang: dmar gsal rab gtum mchod rten sbrul zhags 'dzin: zangs rmog zangs khrab dar dang ratna'i brgyan klu dbang bye ba 'bum sde'i 'khor gyis bskor rang sgog 'od kyis bskul te ye shes pa: spyan drangs dam ye gnyis su med par bstim: de nas spyan 'dren bya ba ni kyi phyogs phyogs dag kyang pha gi nas tsho dbang sde dpon mig mi bzang 'khor dang bcas pa gshegs su gsol: 31 de ru byu kru ye sa pa ri wā ra badzra

sa ma ya dza dza: de nas mchod pa 'bul ba ni hū: mchod yon zhabs bsil me tog spos: mar me dri chab zhal zas rol: phyi nang gsang gsum mchod pa'i sprin: rgyal chen 'khor dang bcas la 'bul: ka badzra aste sogs shabha sarba pañtsa puñtsa kha kha khā hi khā hi: de nas gtor ma 'bul ba ni re ye kho: gtor ma 'dod rgu'i dpal yon phun sum tshogs par gyur:nam 'a mdzod sngagasabaskyar te brlabs sa: rin chen yangs pa'i snod nang du: gtams pa'i gtor ma 'dod rgu'i gter rgyal chen 'khor dang bcas la 'bul: dbang gi phrin las grub par mdzod: ka bī ru bha kta ye sa pa ri wā ra e dam bha lirnyi kha kha khā hi khā hi lan gsum gyis yul phrin lasabacol pa ni ho rgyal chen 'khor bcas dgongs su gsol: bdag gi sgrub pa zab mo 'di: dbu nas mthar ma phyin bar du phyi nang gsang ba'i bar chad bzlog: dngos grub sgrub pa'i srung ma mdzod: ka gre ru bha kta ye sa pa ri wā ra sa ma ya uddha du rakṣa rakṣa: de nas bstod pa bya ba ni hā trī: ri rab nub phyogs klu dbang rje: khams gsum dbang sdud las la mkhas: rdzu 'phrul stobs kyi bdag po ni: spran mi bzang ba 'khor

btsasdo: bcas la mchod cing bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal: de nas brten bzhugs bya ba ni hoḥ rgyal chen 'khor dang bcas pa rnams: sgrub pa'i dam rgya ma grol bar rten 'dir rten chos brtan bzhugs la dngos grub bsgrub pa'i srung ma mdzod: tshe bī ru bha kta ye sa pa ri wā ra sa ma ya rakta rakta: sa su pra tiṣṭha badzra ye swā hā: de nas bkra shis bya ba ni ho: nub nas bkra shis don gyi lha: ma chags dri bral snang mtha' yas: padma rigs kyi bkra shis gang: deng 'dir bde legs mdzad du gsol: gnad des zas nor mthun rkyen sdud dkar nag dregs tshogs dbang byed 'gyur sa ma yu las rim bcu bzhe ba'o rgya rgya rgya de nas byang gi tho byang ni mchod rdzas byin rlabs gong ltar ro skyirngo ma hā shu hye ta sogs/ tho byang mi dmigs stong pa'i ngang nyid las: rang byung gser gyi gzhal med mdzes pa'i nang: bī las byung bas rgyal chen rnams thos sras: ser gsal 'dzum snyeṭa rgyal mtshan rte'u le 'dzin: g.yu rmog g.yu khrab dar dang ratās brgyan: gnod sbin bye ba 'bum sde'i 'khor gyis bsgor: rang sgog 'od kyis bskul te ye shes pa: sman drangs dam ye gnyis su med par bsnyim: de

nas spyan 'dren bya ba ni kye phyogs phyogs dag kyang pha gi nas: gnod sbyin sde dpon rnams thos sras: 'khor dang bcas pa gshegs su gsol yin badzra asnye sogs shabha sarba pañtsa pu tsa khā hi de nas gtor ma khrul ba ni re yo kho gtor ma 'dod rgu'i dpal yon phun sum tshogs par gyur nam mkha' masgo sngag bskyal te bams ma ren chen yangs pa'i snod nang du: gtams pas gtor ma 'dod rgu'i gter: rgyal chen 'khor dang bcas la 'bul: drag po'i phrin las grub par mdzod: o gye gro ma ṇa ye sa pa ri wā ra e dam bha lirnyi khā kha kha hi khā hi lan gsum gyis phul phran las bcol ba ni ho rgyal chen 'a (ra bcasadagongs su gsol bdag gi sgrub pa zab mo 'di: dbu nas mthar ma phyin bar du phyi nang gsang ba'i bar chad bzlog dngos grub sgrub pa'i srung ma mdzod: o gre ma ṇa ye sa pa ri wā ra sa ma yardzas du rakta rakta: de na bstod pa bya ba ni hūṃ hrī: rirab byang phyogs gnod sten rje bar chad bdud 'dal las la mkhas rdza 'phral stobs kyi bdag po ni rnams thos sras po 'khor bcas la mchod cing bstsod de phyag kyang 'tshal:

ba tshu de nas rten bzhugs bya ba ni ho rgyal chen 'khor dang bcas pa rnams: sgrub pa'i dam rgya ma grol bar: rten 'dir rten chos brtan bzhugs la: dngos grub sgrub pa'i srung ma mdzod: ma bre41 ma ṇa ye sa pa ri wa ra sa ma ya rakta rakṣa: o su pra tiṣṭha badzra ye swā hā: de nas bkra shis bya ba ni ho: byang nas bkra shis don kyi lha las rnams mthar phyin don yod grub rkarma rigs kyi bkra shis gang: deng 'dir bde legs 'dzad du gsol: gnad de bar chad bdud 'dul zhing dngos grub thog med 'grub par 'gyur sa ma yu las ram bco lnga pa'o rgya rgya rgya de nas phyi yi tho byang ni mchod dzos byin rlabs gong ltar ro o ma hā shu hye ta sogs tho byang mi dmigs stong pa'i ngang nyid las: rang byung me rlung 'tshubs ma'i dal dbus su:hūṃ las byung ba'i khro rgyal gshin rje gshed: sngo nag ral gri zhags pa gdangs thabs 'dzin: khro bo'i chas rdzogs gyad gyi 'dor thabs bsgrad: las byed pho nya'i 'du 'phro skar ltar 'khrigs: rang srog 'od kyi bskul te ye shes pa: spyan drangs dam ye gnyis su med par bstim: de nas spyan 'dren bya ba ni hūṃ: rang bzhin rnams dag 'og min zhing: dur khrod

me ri 'bar ba nas khro bo'i rgyal po gshin rje gshed: 'khor dang bcas pa gshegs su gsol: yo ya manta ka sa pa ri wā ra sa ma ya dza dza: de nasamachod pa 'bul ba ni hū: mchod yon zhabs bsil me tog spos: mar me dri chab zhal zas rol phyi nang gsang gsum mchod pa'i sprin: gshin rje 'khor dang bcas la 'bul: o badzra a sogs shabha sarba pa3 8 tsa khā hi: de na gtor ma 'bul ba ni ra yam̐ kha gtor ma 'dod rgu'i dpal yon phun sum tshogs par gyur: nam mkha' mdzod sngags bskyal te bams hū: bhanta 'bar ba'i snod nang du sha khrag gtor ma 'dod rgu'i gter: ya manta ka khyod la 'bul: bar chad srung bzlog phrin las mdzod: sa ya marnya ka sa pa ri wa ra e dam bhā lirte kha kha khā nyi khā hi lan gsum gyis phul phrin las bcol pa ni ho: gshin rje gshed po dgongs su gsol bdag gi sgrub pa zab mo 'di: dbu nas mthar ma phyin bar du: phyi nang gsang ba'i bar chad bzlog dngos grub sgrub pa'i srung ma mdzod: ma ya manta ka sa pā ri wā ra sa ma ya uddha du rakṣa rakṣa: de nas bstod pa bya ba ni hā hrī rngams khros gtum pa'i rang bzhin can log

bsgotshu lta 'dul mdzad khro bo'i rgyal khro chen gshin rje gshed po la: mchod cing bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal: de nas brten bams bya ba ni ho las mdzad rgyal po 'khor bcas rnams: sgrub pa'i dam rgya ma grol bar: rten 'dir rten chos bstan bzhugs nas phyi yi bar chad rkyen bzlog cing: nang gi dngos grub phyir ma gtong sgrub pa'i 'bras bu mchis par mdzod ma a manta ka sa pā ri wā ra sa ma ya rakta rakta: o su pra tiṣṭha badzra ye swā hā: de nas bkra shis bya ba ni ho rang bzhin chos kyi dbyings nyid las: gdug pa 'dul phyir gzugs skur bzhengs: mthu dang rdzu 'phrul bsam mi khyab: ya manta ga'i bkra shis thegag: ces brjod sgrub pa mthar phyin zhing bar chad g.yul las rgyal bar 'gyur sa ma pā las rim rsā drug pa'o rgya rgya rgya de nas nang gi zong byang ni mchod rdzas byin rlabs gong ltar o ma hā shu hye ta sogs tho byang mi dmigs stong pa'i ngang nyid las: rang byung me rlung dud sprin 'tshub ma'i dbus: hūḥlas byung ba'i khro rgyal bdud rtsi 'khyil: ljang nag rgya gram sdig mdzub dkur la brten: khro chas yongs rdzogs gyad gyi 'dor stabs bsgrad: bar chad bdud 'dul

pho nya skar ltar 'khrigs: rang srog 'od kyis bskul te ye shes pa spyan drangs dam ye gnyis su med par bstims de nas spyan 'dren bya ba ni hū dmigs med mkha' ltar dag pa'i dbyings: 'jigs rung dur khrod 'bar ba nas khro bo'i rgyal po bdud rtsi 'khyil: 'khor dang bcas pa gshegs su gsol oṃ badzra kro ta a dṛ ta kun li sa pā ri wā ra badzra sa ma yā dza dza de nas mchod pa 'bul ba ni reḥye kho: gtor ma 'dod rgu'i dpal yon phun sum tshogs par gyur: nam mkha' mas sngag bskyar de brlabs hū bhanta 'bar ba'i snod nang du sha khrag gtor ma 'dod rgu'i gter bdud rtsi 'khyil ba khyod la 'bul: bar chad srung bzlog 'phrin las mdzod oṃ badzra kro ta a bṛ ta kusgoli sa pa ri wā ra e dam ba ling ta kha kha khā hi khā hi: lan gsum gyis phul phrin las bcol ba ni ho khro chen bdud rtsi 'khyil ba dgongs su gsol bdag gi sgrub pa zab mo 'di dbu nas mthar ma phyin bar du: phyi nang gsang ba'i bar chad bzlog: dngos grub sgrub pa'i spung ma mdzod: o badzra kro ta a dṛ ta kurnya li sa pa ri wā ra sa ma ya āḥ du rakṣa rakṣa de nas bstod pa bya ba ni hā

badzra zhi ba chos sku'i rang bzhin las ma rung 'dul mdzad khro bo'i rgyal: bgegs mthar bdud rtsi 'khyil pa la: mchod cing bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal de nas rten btsos bya ba ni ho: las mdzad khro chen 'khor bcas rnams: sgrub pa'i dam rgya ma grol bar rten 'dir rten chos brtan bzhugs nas: phyi yi bar chad rkyen bzlog cing: nang gi dngos grub phyir ma gtong: sgrub drug nyul zhing 'khor ba'i bgegs: bskrad bsgral zer 'dren phrin las mdzod: o badzra kro ta a dṛ ta kurnya li sa pa ri wā ra sa ma yā rakta rakta oṃ su pra tiṣṭha badzra ye swā hā: de nas bkra shis bya ba ni ho: dmigs med ngang las ye shes gar: gdug pa 'dul phyir phrin las sgrub: khro rgyal bdud rtsi 'khyel ba yis rtag tu bde ba'i bkra shis 36pa cesabarjod sgrub pa gegs med 'grub don gnyis mtha' ru phyan par 'gyur sa ma ya las ram bcu bdun pa'o rgya rgya rgya sgo drung dam sri mnan pa ni gru gsum dong byu 'dom byed zab dam dri bya mgo can gzug ni rta rmig la ga de 2 brub rang tsho khro bo'i nga rgyal gyis e bskyed bden brjod bya ba ni e kho: rang mdun gru gsum gshin rje'i lto ba ru sgrub la bar chad dam sri nyul le'i rigs:

gzugs khams skye mched kun tshangs bya mgo can: bsdam bcing gcun 'ching nyam thag gzugs su gyur: rang srog triḥlas 'od 'phros nyulle ni: rang dbang med par bkug ste gzugs la bstims: na mo mchog gsum rtsa gsum bden pa dang: bden gnyis bslu ba med pa'i nus stobs kyis: sgrub la bar gcod dam sri nyu4 rnams: rang dbang med par gzugs kyi rten la khug: brgya rtsa lnga bcu nyer gcag gang rung brjod rjiḥtri badzra e gu sha dza bkugs pa'o zloḥtriḥratna pa sha hūṃ bcings pa'o rjoḥtriḥpadma sgro ṭa baṃ: bsdams pa'o rjinyi karma gharnye ho: phyos pa'o rjiḥtriḥpra we sha ya phaṭa: dbye pa'o rjiḥtriḥ.a we sha ya yis dbab pa'o de nas phur gdab bya ba ni dza: rdo rje khros pa ki la ya: rngams brjid dbyings las skur bzhengs la bar chad dam sri 'byung po rnams: bsgral zhing 'dren pa'i phrin las mdzod: dzaḥ snyeng rjes bsgral ba'i dam tshig ni: bsad cing mnan pa ma yin te: phung po rdo rjes gtams byas nas: rnam par shes pa chos skurje bsgoms: 31 badzra ki li ki la ya sarba cha ༅ pra we sha ya phaṭa: ces brjod la phur pa btab pa'i dran med du brgyal bar bsam dzaḥ phung sri

ba tshu bya ba'i las ngan rnams las kyi gshin rje'i lto bar tshud: sra brtan 'byung ba lnga yi rgya rgyal ba rigs lnga'i dgongs rgyas btab: 'phar ldang mgul bskyod med par bsam: drag sngagasabardod la rjes mi mngon par bya'o hūṃ bzhi'i sngagasamathar las bzhi'i shams brjod bzhin bro ra zhi rgyas dbang drag dbyibs su 'khyab gtor ma cha gsum phul zhing 'byung po brngan bar chad bdud kyis g.yul las rgyal bar 'gyur sa ma yu las rim bco brgyad pa'o rgya rgya rgya de nas rnal 'byor rdo rje'i mched lcam rnams na du phyan la lha khrus mnol bsang bya ma tram̐ du tra bsgral ba' rim pa na mdun du lcag snod gru gsum 'bar ba'i nang du: ma tram̐ ru tra rngams brjid 'jigs su rung ba'i las can du gyur: na mo dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo: dkon mchog gsum gyi bden pa dang: bden gnyis bslu ba med pa'i nus stobs kyis bstan la bar du gcod par byed pa'i ma tram̐ rū tra thams cad gzugs kyi rten la myur du khug cig: lan gsum bdun dang dgu yis bkug badzra e gu sha dza: ratna pa sha (: padma sgo ṭa baṃ: karma gharnye ho: dbyer med du bstems ral gri bsnams la 'di skad do pa: rngams brjed tsha sa dbyings rol pa las: 'jam
