dpal ye shes sems dpa'i sku rdzu 'phrul shugs kyis 'dir gshegs la: shes rab ral gri byin gyis rlobs snyed ya marnya ka sa ma ya tiṣṭha lhan bdun dang rten snying tshar gcig gis ral gri byin rlabs phu 'deb cing bkra shis me tog 'thor bar bya byas badzra 11 ta king ga ra gar ga khaṅga hūṃ dza lan bdun brjod skad cig gi las kyi king ka ra gnyis byung ste du tra bsgral ba'i las mdzad par bsam rkang gling drila'aphrol rol mo'i sgra yos bskul ral gri galo cing snyan pa'i dbyangs bcasate hūṃ hū las mdzad badzra king ga ras gnam lcags dbal phur rū tra'i snying la thob rnams shes chos kyi dbyings su bsgral ba dang gsang sngags bstan pa dar zhing rgyas par 31ga du stsapra we sha ya phaṭa: zhesabarjod pa rdo rje rigs kyi king ga ra phur pa du khri snying la btab pa'i rnam shesachosakyi dbyings su sbar tsitta byung ste dpa' rtaṭa su bdag he ru ka la bstabs par bsam hūṃ hūṃ: bsgral ba'i dpa' rtags ngo mtshar rmad du byung: las mdzad ki la dpal chen king ga ras shes rab ral gri 'bar ba'i sgo ngar gyis ma tram̐ ru tra'i phung khams dum bur gtubs: hūṃ hri 'jam dpal ye shes sems dpa'i rang bzhin can: rdo ngar shes rab 'bar ba'i ral gri yis

gtsarsha bstan la 'jigs pa'i ma tram̐ ru tra yis zhe sdang rtsad gcod lag g.yas rbad kyis gcod: nga rgyal khengs sems drung 'byin lag g.yon phyungs: 'dod chags rmang nas gzhig phyir rkang g.yon khrol: phrag dog rgyu ba gting 'byin rkang g.yas gtubs: ma rig rgyu log mdzad phyir mgo bo chod: srid rtsa skye rgyud gcod phyir gsang ba phyung:snang srid dag par sbyor phyir bzo khog khrol gsang sngags bstan pa rgyas phyir nang rol drongs: smad byung mthu rtsal bstan pa'i dus la bab: du tra sha rdu mā ra ya phaṭa: zhes brjod pas las kyi king ka ra nag po'i du tra'i phung po gtub te rngams pa' nga ro bsgrags par bsam la ha ha'i gar 'chams rdo rje'i dgu 'gros bya las kyi rdo rjes du tra'i phung khams rnams da la brten pa 'i gzha ru bkrams par bya rol mo snyan pa'i sgra bcas 'di skad do hūṃ sa: du tra bsgral ba'i dpa' rtags ni: gsang sngags bstan pa'i thabs su shar: lag g.yas dur khrod sku la rdzogs g.yon pa lho phyogs gsang chen rol: rkang g.yon nub phyogs padma brtsegs: g.yas pa byang phyogs bde byed 'bar: mtshan ma byang shar ling ga brtsegs: mgo bo lho nub bde chen brdal: bzo khog nub

byang 'jigs byed tshal: nang khrod shar lto drag gtum rngams dur khrod brgyad kyi bkod pa rten: tshogs yul rnam par dag pa'i rdzas: ma mo mkha' 'gro phra min dal: rig 'dzin lha dang lha mo'i gnas: brtul zhugs bkod pa phun sum 'tshogs e ma tram̐ du tra maṇḍal ṭwāṃ: zhes brjod dkyil gcor 'di dag pa'i gzhi ma'o dur khrod bkod pa med byung ya mtshan che sa ma yu lasarim bcu dgu pa'o rgya rgya rgya de nas dkyil 'khor rgyan bkod bya ba la rdo rje slob dpon he ru ga'i chas su zhugs sgordo ring dud bcas tshogs pa'i sna drangs shing rdo rje rgyal zeb nyid rkyas dzos rnams thogs zhing ka ra yis gu gul dud pa bdug las kyi rdo rjes da la'i rgyan bkod bkrams khro rgyal rngams pas bar chad bgegs tshogs basbrad kun gyi snyan pa'i dbyangs bcas 'di skad do hū hū ngo mtshar rmad byung rol pa'i da la che:lhun grub rgyal ba'i zhing bkod phun sum tshogs: gnyis rtog mtshan ma'i bdud tshogs 'joms byed rdzas: phyi nang gsang gsum dag mnyam dkyil 'khor ni: lding khri gong ma chos sku'i rang bzhin can: mi g.yo kun zlum bum pa bde gshegs mdzod: lhun grub ka pā la'i bcud a dṛ ta: dri med ka nas dag pa dpe yi rdzas: spros rtogs grwa zur las

badzra 'das me long zlum: myong grol ye shes shel bum ril bu'i gtams sgrub dang dkyil 'khor 'dus pa gtor chen po ro ldan myong ba phun tshogs thod rdzas lnga ril mar thud thum lnga ldan bzhi dbyibs thod rgya rnams somachan/ byin rlabs 'byung gnas dam rdzas bsam mi khyab dbyings las ma g.yos gzugs kyi bkod pa sprin: ngo mtshar zhing gi rnam 'gyur e ma ho sa: mi'agyur 'dus ma byas pa'i mkha' klong nas bde gshegs thugs rje'i nyi ma rab sbar ba: lding khri bar ma longs spyod rdzogs pa'i gnas rig 'dzin bla ma'i byin rlabs pad skrung mdzes: yi dam lha yi dngos grub gter gyi mdzod ma dang mkha' 'gro'i bde bskyed dpal gyi gzhi: chos skyong nor lha'i phrin las rasgo'i rdzong 'gro khams dong nas sprugs pa'i bdud rtsi sman: rtsa brgyad stong la sbyar ba'i a mṛ ta: nyon mongs chags pa bsgral ba'i dmar chen po ro brgya nus pa stong ldan bā lirte:snang srid rgyan du shar ba'i rgyal srid bdun rig stong rjen par sgrol ba'i 'dod yon lnga: ye shes lnga ldan zhing bkod phun sum tshogs rang byung lhun grub da la e ma ho: rtu rtu:

thugs rje dmig pa med pa'i ye shes gar:rtsol med bde rol byang chub sems kyi gnas:ldeng khri 'og ma sprul sku'i dkyil 'khor ste:kun rtog lnga bcu rtsa brgyad gnas dag pas:mun sel snang ba'i sgron me brgya rtsa sbar:dur khrod brgyad kyi bkod pa phun sum tshogs tshogs gnyis yongs rdzogs ga ṇa tsakra'i gter:zla rgyas zla phrum rang grol dag pa'i rdzas:mchod sgrub rten bskang dgyes pa'i yo byad bkram:mi 'gyur 'ja' tshon bkra ba'i rang bzhin las:byung ba'i thugs rje'i bkod pa ya mtshan che:'phro 'du mdzad pa rmad byung e ma ho:/ hrī mnyam brdal byang chub sems kyi bla bre la:phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i rgyal mtshan bzhi:sku lnga'i 'gro don mdzad pas 'phan yab dang 'chi med tshe yi g.yung drung mda' dar bzhi:ngo bo rang bzhin thugs rje ye shes lnga'i 'ja' 'od gsum rdzogs dar sna'i 'phur ma can:byang chub sems kyi rang bzhin drwa gur mdzes:bar chad bdud tshogs zil gnon stag gzigs sham gzung 'dzin drungs 'byin shes rab ral gri bzhi:phyogs bzhi'i bdud dpung 'joms pas lcags phur brten:mchod

ba tshu pas lha mo du mas gar bsgyur spro: ye shes drug rdzogs rus pa'i rgyan drug spras dbyings las ma gapos zhing bkod phun tshogs la sku gsum dbyer med snang ba'i phyag rgya yis: 'gro khams dong sprugs phrin las e ma ho: ces brjod rol mo snyan pa'i sgra dang bcas dkyil 'khor rgyan bkod bkrams pa'i rim pa'o sa ma yu las rim nyi shu pa'o rgya rgya rgya skabs su sgrub pa'i nyuste bskrad chog ni lcagasakhang nang du dam sri'i liṅga btsud rnal 'byor lha sngags phyag rgya ldan pa yis rdo rje khros pas las gzhung bsring byas te srung ma gtor mas brngan par bya ba ni hū: padma ga༄/nga 4de bka' nyan dam tshig can khye spyang bcu drug dmus long rgyab 'brel tshogs dam rdzas brgyan pa'i gtor ma 'di bzhes la: dam sri nyulle'i bar chad rdul tu rlog:rdo rje'i las mdzad ging chen bcu drug dang: phur pa'i srung ma ma mo bcu gnyis kyis: dam rdzas brgyan pa'i gtor ma 'di bzhes la dam sri nyuste'i bar chad rdul tu rlog: tha tshog gnyan 'j-in lha bu ming sring dang: pho nya chen mo kun thub rgyal mo yis: dam rdzas brgyan pa'i gtor ma 'di bzhes la: dam sri nyunye'i bar chad rdul du rlog: phyi rkyen bar chad bdud kyi 'tshe ba

bzlog: nang du 'phong byed dam sri las ngan rnams ming tsam med par rdul tu brlag pa sogs: rnal 'byor phrin las gegs med 'grub par mdzod kro ti shā ri pañtsa a bṛ ta bā lirnya khā hi tri pa tri pa hūṃ phaṭa kha la ro sha kha la ro sha hūṃ phaṭa yag ku baṃ dza hūṃ phaṭa dzwa la ram̐ dzwa la ram̐ hūṃ phaṭa: dzwa la dzwa mu ka dzwa la a mu ka hūṃ phaṭa: e dam bha lirte khā hi: 31 badzra dha ti ma ma rkarma shrī tram̐ nya ka ra uddha sarba e dam bā lirnya kha kha khā hi khā hi o ma hā dī wa dzñā na de wi tsa du na e dam bā lirnya kha kha khra hi khā hi ces brjod gtor skyems gtsang sar gshegs phrin lasagang bcol gegs med 'thub de nasab bskyed bya ba ni e dza: mdun du gru gsum las kyi btson khang rgya che la gting zab pa'i nang du: sgrub pa zab mo la bar du gcod par byed pa'i gnod byed dam sri nyunye rnams nyam thag pa'i gzugs can du gyur de nas bden brdar bya ba ni na mo dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo dkon mchog gsum gyi bden pa dang rtsa rgyud rig 'dzin bla ma'i bden pa dang yi dam rgyud sde bzhi drug gi bden pa dang: ma gnas gsum gyi dpa' bo mkha' 'gro rnams kyi bden pa dang: don

badzra dam chos nyid ngo bo gdod nas dag cing chos can rgyu 'bras bslu ba med pa'i bden pa'i mthus: sgrub pa zab mo la bar du gcod par byed pa'i gnod byed nyuste nag po bdud kyi rigs su gyur pa thams cad mtshan ma rdzas kyi rten ming gzugs liṅka 'di la khug cig dmo tri badzra yo gu sha ya dza: dzaḥhūṃ baṃ ho bdun dgu nyer gcig sogasabaskyar de nas las byed spro ba na bdag nyid dpal chen por gsal ba'i sku yi ba spu'i bu ga thams cad nas 'jigs byed dpal gyi khro mo mi bsrun bltar mi bzod pa dpag tu med pa 'phros te gnod byed dam sri nyulle spun dgu sna 'dren sdong zla rgyab brten dang bcas pa thams cad bkug cing liṅga la bstims: la las mtshon cha sna tshogs kyis bsad: la las sra brtan lci zhing 'thas pa'i rdzas kyi char phab ste brgyal zhing mnan pa'i las mdzad par bsam hūṃ bye tshog〈gachogs kyi dkyil 'khor du: 'bar ba gtum chen rngams pa ru khros pa'i yid kyis sngong mig bsnad sra bachun mtshon cha ngar lngan thogs gang la dmigs pa'i dam sri rnams thar 'chor 'phar lngang mi nus par: rngal tu bachog rte

tshogs su 'bul rdo rje khrag 'thung chen po yi: zhal du bstab la ming med gyur: yo badzra ma hā kro ta padma kro ti shwa ri badzra kai li gī la ya ma hā yakru ka la ru pa garma ram̐ ram̐ dzwa la ram̐ hūṃ phaṭa: ma grum bu a pa tse ru pa tse na ra tse rtsa me thun: na sha stam bha yakru bi na ya ga phye ma phye ma rdul phran rdul phran tsitta rbad: drag sngags bo da cing rdo rje'i thun char brab bar chad bdud tshogasa'adul bar the tshom med sa ma ga las rim nyer gcig pa'o rgya rgya rgya de nas sman srung gsol mchod bya ba la dkar dmar bsris pas bsgos bu bdun shams te 31 swā bha wa sogs tram̐ḥlas rin chen yangasapa'i snod nang du o las gtor ma 'dod yon nam mkha' mdzod: myong grol ye shes bdud rtsir byin gyis brlabs: las byed pho nya'i dgyes bskang gter du spel oṃ sa/ lan gsum dang ni a ka ro yis brlabs rang nyid lha gsal ting 'dzin brtan po yis hū bhyo: sngon tshe spyi dpal che mchog he ru dang: o rgyan chen po padma 'byung gnas kyi bka' dang dam tshig gnyan la bzhag pa yis: sman skrung lha mo mched lnga spran 'dren gshegs: bdud rtsi 'o phud dkar mngar sman mchod kyis: lha mo tsan dri ka sogs gsol zhing mchod

bsgotshu bzang drug bdud rtsi sman phud dam rdzas kyis: lha mo nul num chen mo gsol zhing mchod: ku mud sna tshogs tshal chen bkram pa yis: lha mo gar dri bam sman gsol zhing mchod: bshos bu dri bral zla phrum rgyan ldan gyis: lha mo gu hya shrī kṣe gsol zhing mchod: phyi nang gsang gsum mchod sprin mtha' yas pas lha mo shrī tri ga baṃ gsol zhing mchod 'dod yon nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyams pa yis: sman srung dpa' bo mkha' 'gro gsol zhing mchod: khyed rnams gsol zhing mchod pa'i byin rlabs kyis:bdud rtsi sman gyi srung ma dam pa mdzod: phyi nang gsang ba'i bar chad zhi ba dang: grub pa'i rtag dang mtshan ma bzang po ston: nad mug mtshon 'khrugs ming gi lhag mar gyur 'jig rten bde skyid ldan pa'i phrin las mdzod: bka' dang dam la ma 'da' sa ma yā: ces pa ca 'grub grangs su bsags mchod gtor gtsang sar gshegs par bya yang cig gtor ma 'bul ba ni byin rlabs bya ba gong ltar ro rol mo'i sgra bcas 'di skad do hūṃ bhyo: khams gsum srid pa'i mnga' bdag ni: dbang phyug ma hā dī wa dang: lha chen tshangs pa gdong bzhi pa: dbang po mig

stong bkra ba sogs sman srung dam 'dzin pho nya rnams dam tshig gsang ba'i gnas 'dir gshegs bdud rtsi 'o phud gtor skyems bzhes: rnam bzhi'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: khyad par bdud rtsi sgrub pa la bar du gcod pa'i bgegs tshogs sgrol: dam sri nyu lce bdud kyi rigs ming tsam med pa'i phrin las mdzod: sgrub pa'i rtag mtshan ma lus pa: ring por mi thogs myur du ston rnal 'byer bcol ba'i phrin las kun: myur du sgrub shig sa ma yā: ci 'grub brjod la gtor skyemasamachod gnad des phrin las gegs med 'thub the tshom med do rdo rje'i bka' sa ma shā la rim nyer gnyis pa'o rgya rgya rgya de nas na mchod bya ba ni ces chu hū ka dag snye med dbyings las ma g.yos gar: chos sku'i ston pa snang ba mtha' yas la rtsa brgyad stong sbyar bdud rtsi sman mchod 'bul mchog dang thun mongs dngos grub stsal du gsol: ma hā pañtsa a mṛ ta khā hi: lhun 'grub 'gag pa med pa'i ye shes gar:longs spyod rdzogs mdzad gsang 'dus yab yum la: rtsa brgyad stong sbyar bdud rtsi sman mchod 'bul: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsal du gsol: ma hwa pañtsa a mṛ ta khā hi:

ba tshu thugs rje dmigs rtog las 'das byang chub sems sprul pa'i sku mchog dri med pad dkar la: rtsa brgyad stong sbyar bdud rtsi sman mchod 'bul: mchog dang thun mongs dngos grub rtsal du gsol ma hā pañtsa a mṛ ta la khā hi byin rlabs 'byung gnas rig 'dzin brgyud pa'i dbab: brdzus skyes sprul sku padma 'byung gnas la rtsa brgyad stong sbyar bdud rtsi sman mchod 'bul mchog dang thun mong dngos grub rtsal du gsol: ma hā pañtsa a bṛ ta kha hi:dngos grub 'dod rgu'i char 'bebs dpag bsam shing:don gnyis dpal spel dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la: rtsa brgyad stong sbyar bdud rtsi sman mchod 'bul: mchog dang thun mongs dngos grub stsal du gsol ma hā pañtsa a dṛ ta kha hi:bde stong dga' bzhi'i 'byung gnas shes rab gzugs: mkhar chen grub pa'i dbang phyugs mtsho rgyal la: rtsa brgyad stong sbyar bdud rtsi sman mtshod 'bul: mchog dang thun mongs dngos grub stsal du gsol: ma hwa pañtsa a mṛ ta la kha hi: legs nyes stongs 'dzin phrin las kun sgrab pa'i dpa' bo mkha' 'gro dam can rgya mtsho la: rtsa brgyad stong

sbyar bdud rtsi sman mchod 'bul: mchog dang thun mongs dngos grub stsal du gsol: ma hā pañtsa.a dṛ ta khā tī: sgrub pa'i phyi nang gnyer 'dzin pho nya ba bka' sdod dregs pa yul bzhi skyong mdzad la: rtsa brgyad stong sbyar bdud rtsi sman mchod 'bul: mchog dang thun mongs dngos grub stsal du gsol: ma hā pañtsa.a dṛ ta khā tī rang snang 'brul ba'i mnar ba'i sems can ni: 'gro drug pha ma snying rje'i mgron rnams la: rtsa brgyad stong sbyar bdud rtsi sman mchod 'bul rang 'khrul rang mnar bde ba chen por grol: sku dang ye shes btsan sa zin par shog: log gzul dug lnga'i gzir ba'i 'gro ba ni: bgegs rigs 'byung po lan chags mgron rnams la: rtsa brgyad stong sbyar bdud rtsi sman mchod 'bul: khengs sems gnod gdug ma ga sbyor dang bral nas stong nyid snying rje'i dpal la spyod par re ga: ces bo da bdud rtsi zegs ma phyogs kun 'thor phrin las lhun thub dngos grub char ltar 'bebs sa ma pā las rims nyer gsum pa'o rgya rgya rgya bdud rtsi rkam sgron sgrub pa mthar phyin nas las bzhi'i srag blugs kha bskang bcas grub mthar dngos grub bskul pa 'dod 'jo'i bum bzang ltar byin 'bebs

brterdo gnad bskul gsol 'debs 'dzab dbyangs rnams legs par bya zhing bkra shis rol mo sgrogs tho rang dngos grub len par bya ba la bdag mdun bskyed bzlas mchod bstod bskang tshoṭa bya gsol mchod dam sri nyul le mnan bskrad gzab tshig bdun dbyangs dang bcas te lan gsum bskyar sman srung byin 'bebs rig 'dzin gzhung byin dbab grub te snyan gsan dbab par bya ba ni hūṃ hrī: rje btsun thugs rje'i dbang phyug spyan ras gzigs: dri med padma dkar po'i lha tshogs rnams: yang yang bsnyen cing sgrub pa mthar phyin nas: thugs dam ma g.yel brtse ba chen pos dgongs: deng sang rdo rje srin po'i nam langs nye byin rlabs dngos grub stsol ba'i dus la bab: mchog thun sarba sirnyi pha la st+waṃ ma g.yel ma 'khyang 'phags mchog thugs rje'i gter ma g.yel ma 'gying rig 'dzin padma 'byung ma bul ma g.yel dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs: ma bul ma 'gyeng sman srung pho nya rnams: mchog dang thun mongs dngos grub ma lus pa: da lta nyid du stsol zhig rtsa gsum lha: rtsa sngags mthar kwa ya sirnyi sa: wākka sirnyi yis tsitta sirnyi shā sarba sirnyi hrī: 'dzab dbyangasabyas la brgya rtsa brgyad brjod bya de nas sman gyi rtogs brjod sman mchod 'bul

bro bshagasargyud lasabyung ba'i yi ge brgya pa brgya dang rtsa brgyad bzla badzra sa ma ya dza: zhes su btags de nas bskul bar bya ba'i gsol gdab pa ni hū dpal ldan sangs rgyas thugs rje'i mnga' dbang can: mkhyen brtse nus pa'i dbang byin dngos grub kun da lta nyid du sgrub mchog bdag cag la: brtsal nas smin cing grol bar mdzad du gsol: zhesagasolab bawa pa'i mdun bskyed lha tshogs thams cad kyi sbyor mtshams dang sku yi ba sbu'i bu ga thams cad nas 'od zer yi ge'i rnams pa can byung ste bdag bskyed kyi gnas rnams su tham pas mchog thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa thob par bsam sku gsung thugasayon dbang rnams bum bzang ltar phrin las bdud rtsi sman dbang blangasab ni mos gus tshad med kyis bskul thal mo sbyar gsol ba gdab par bya ba 'di skad do kyi rdo mi chagag 'dus ma byas pa'i pho brang nas: rgyal kun thugs rje'i dbang phyug spyan ras gzigs: grangs su spro ba rtsa ba'i lha mchog dang: nor 'dzin gsang 'dzin sems dpa' mched brgyad dang: sems ma rnams bzhi sgo skyong hya ṣṭṛ tshom bu spro ba lha tshogs bsam mi khyab: sangs rgyas stong dang dus gsum bde bar gshegs bla ma yi dam dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i lha: byang chub

keshāX sems dpa'i tshogs ni bsam mtha' yas dkyil 'khor spro ba nyis sa ya 'bum: thams cad thugs rje brtse bas dgongs su gsol: bdag gis dka' ba dang blang ngal ba bsad: lus sgog 'ben btsugs yi dam lha mchog bsgoms: bstan dang 'gro ba'i don gnyis 'byung ba'i phyir: bdud rtsi yon tan sman gyi sgrub pa brtsams:gta' tu phye bsgrub sgog tu rlon sgrub sgoms: yengs med ting nge 'dzin gyi gzer chen gdab: bzlas pa tshad rtags dus grangs rnams par 'phel: da ni dngos grub stsol len dus la bab byin rlabs mchog gi nyi ma 1nga nas sbor: 'dzad med dbang byin sbrang char sib sib stsol: 'gro 'dren mdzad pa rmad byung nus byin phob: ces brjod rol lo sgra 4sa snyan gsan phab las kyi rdo rjes sman sgrom btegs byas nas 'bul tshig snyan pa'i dbyangs bcas bstab rjesasu slobasadapon dgyes pa chen po'i 'di sgad do hū trī sku la skye 'chi gnyis su mi mnga' bas rdo rje tshe yi dngos grub stsal du gsol gang 'dul chos sgra'i 'gro khams 'dul ba yiḥ rdo rje gsung gi dngos grub stsal du gsol: stong nyid snying rje byang chub sems kyi dpal: rdo rje

thugs kyi dngos grub stsal du gsol: mthong thos dran reg rnam 'dren sar 'god pa'i: 'gro 'dul stobs kyi dngos grub stsal du gsol: dpag bsam shing dang yid bzhin nor ji bzhin: 'gro ba'i re bskang dngos grub stsal du gsol: nad mug mtshon 'khrugs ming gi lhag mar gyur: 'jigs tshogs zhi ba'i dngos grub stsal du gsol: rdzogs ldan gsar ba'i lang tsho'i dga' ston 'phel: 'byor drug rgyas pa'i dngos grub stsal du gsol: khams gsum srid gsum chos la 'god pa yi: dbang chen re bskang dngos grub stsal du gsol: bar chad bdud tshogs zil gyi gnon pa sogs: drag po mthu yi dngos grub stsal du gsol: dge legs dpal 'byor ma tshangs med pa'i gter: yid bzhin nor bu lta bu'i dngos grub stsol lha dang bskal pa mnyam par byin gyis rlobs: 'phags mchog thugs rje'i 'dzad pa bdag 'grub nas: 'gro khams dong sprugs nus pa'i dngos grub 365: 31 yisahūṃ: sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta sirnyi pha la hūṃ: ces brjod sgrub rdzas gnas gsum la gtugs rol dam tshig mi ldan pa la sbyin mi rung bum bzang mtha' sbyin sgrub dzos gzhan dag rol: smon

—41 lam shes brjod bkra shis rol mo sgrogs drangs pa nas bzang lhag bskul chad mdo sogs mtha' rgyas bya ba man ngag dam pa'o sa ma shā las rim nyer bzhi pa'o rgya rgya rgya de nas rgyal chen tho rnams bkrol ba la mchod jos byin rlabasabya zhing mchod pa 'bul gtor ma 'bul zhing bstod pa grub pa'i rjes bzod gsol bya ba'i rim pa 'di ltar ro ho: las mdzad pho nya 'khor bcas dgongs su gsol:gtor tshogs mchod pa gzhung bzhin ma ldan zhing sku gsung thugs 'gal nyam chags ci song yang snying nas 'gyod sems drag po'i bshags bgyi'o o badzra sa twa sa ma ya āḥyig brgya lan gsum brjod la lhag chad bskangs gshegs su gsol ba'i ram pa 'di ltar ro ho bdag gi sgrub pa mthar phyin gyis las mdzad pho nya dam tshig can rang bzhin gnas su gshegs su gsol slar yang 'byon par mdzad du gsol: badzra rlu: rang rang mjug gi bkra shisabarjod par bya de nas dam rgya grol la gzhan 'phrad rung bdag mdun bskyed bzlasatshogs bskang rgya cher bya gshin po la dmags ga song gamul 'joms dang gson po'i ched du dbang gnyis gang rung bskur chad brtan la sogs bshagasapa grub pa'i rjes rdul tshon bsdu ba'i rim pa 'di ltar ro trī: chos dbyings rol pa chen

po las byung ba'i: sgyu 'phrul drwa ba sku gsung thugs kyi dal mi 'gyur thig le 'dzin pa'i mkha' ru spros: da ni mdzad pa rmad byung mthar phyin pas skye med ka dag klong du badzra thu zhesabo da pasapheshesakyi 'khor lo chos kyi dbying su gshegs dam tshig pa rang gi snying gar bsdu'o yig ge brgya palan gsum bzla par bya rdo rje rgyal po'i phyag mtshan gyi reg pas rdul tshon byang shar phyogasanasadabuthasu bsdu bsngo ba smon lam yong su grub par bya de na garter jed rim pa 'di ltar ro hrī: bkra shis sa gzhi bde ba'i da la ru dgos 'dod kun 'byung dpal gyi gter sbed do yangs pa'i rgyal khab bde skyid snang bsa'atsho nad mug mtshon 'khrugs ming gi lhag mar gyur rdzogs ldan gsar ba'i lang tsho rab rgyas nas: ngo mtshar rmad byung mdzad pas 'gro khams 'dul don gnyibasalhun gyibasagrub pa'i bkra shis regag: gzhung gi shisabarjod rgya chen leg par bya de nasamar me'i smon lam bya ba ni rdo rje mched lcam lu gu rgyud du sbrel kun gyi gamasagayon sbosadang mar me thogs rdo rje ma lo snyan pa'i dbyangs4 te ho:ngo mtshar lhun gyisagrub pa'i dkyil 'khor du: mdzad pa rmad byung grub chen las sbyor brtsams: mthong thos dran reg rnam 'dren sa

ba:tshu la bkod myong grol ye shes bdud rtsi ya mtshan che thugs rje brtse bas sgrub mchog bdag cag la: dbang dang dngos grub stsol ba bka' drin che stong gsum mi mjed bkod pa blos blangs nas: phang med zhen bral mchog gi maṇḍal 'bul: bkra shis lha reg dkar po dri bral dang: zhal du brda ba pañtsa a mṛ ta: thugs byon rdo rje'i rig ma lang tshos mdzes: thams cad ma lus yongs su 'tshogs byas te: bka' drin mnyam med rdo rje'i bla mar 'bul: thugs rje brtse ba chen pos bzhes su gsol bzhes nas bdag sogs byin gyis brlabs tu gsol: a u3: dur khrod gsang ba mchog gi dkyil 'khor du: rdo rje slob dpon gnyan gyi dbu bzung nas rgyal ba'i gdung sob mched dang lcam dral rnams: nam zhig byang chub lhum su zhugs pa'i tshe: 'khor ba'i g.yang sa chen por mi lhung zhing: ma rig mun pa'i klong du mi 'thums shing gcong rong zab mo'i gnas su mi ste zhing: las kyi mtshon rnon dbal gyis mi phog shog: bges gnyen dam pa bka' drin che ba dang: dam tshig gcig pu rdo rje sngan grogs rnams shes rab

gnyen gyis 'brel ba'i gzungs ma gsum: mi 'bral ting 'dzin gcig sgom rten 'brel gyis: sa bcu gcig char nyid du rdzogs par shog: nyon mongs dug lnga'i bo 1nga skad cig dag: snang ba'i go 'byed zhun mar mdangs dang ldan gsal ba'i sgron me 'od gsal lam byas te rig 'dzin dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dang bcas: kun tu 'od kyi sa la phyin par 37ga gnyis rtog gol sa'i phreng kun rab bsgral te: snang gsal mar me'i 'od lam la brten zhing: zhi khro rab 'byams rgyal ba'i dpung dang bcas: padma can gyi sa la phyin par shog phyi nang gnyis med ye shes klong du grol kun bzang 'od gsal lam la rab brten zhing rtsa gsum rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i dpung dang bcas: rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sa la phyin par shog rang grol 'od zer chen po la brten nas dag pa 'bras bu'i sa gsum gcig char brgal: sprul dang longs spyod rdzogs sku'i dpung dang bcas nang dbyings gzhon nu bum sku'i rgyal sa la rmad byung khyad chos drug ldan mnga' dbang brnyes: gang 'dul sprul bas 'gro khams dong sprugs te: kun tu bzang po'i mdzad pa

ba rte mthar phyin shog cesabarjod smon lam rgya cher gdab par bya rdul rga chur gshegs shi brjod smon lam gdab gsang spyod las kyi shul mi mngon par bya gnad 'dibs pas byin rlabs bsam mi khyab lce brgyas bstod kyang yon ma zad mtha' bral rtsa rgyud bla ma'i byin rlabs nyi ma shar yi dam lha yi dngos grub sbrangs char 'bebs ma dang mkha' 'gro'i bde stong dngos grub stsol chos skyong srung ma'i phrin las gegs med bsgrub nor lha gter bdag 'dodargya'i gru char 'bebs gnam la bkrashis nyi ma gza' skar 'bar bar snang bkra shis char chu dugasu 'bebs sa la bkra shisalo phyugs rtag tu legs dus gsum kun tu phan bde snang ba rgyas sa la bcud chags rtsi shing lo 'bras smin phyugs la bcud chags gnag lug rta nor 'phel nor la bcud chags 'dod rgu gegs med 'grub zas la bcud chagasazad med nus stobs 'bar gos la bcud chags bde drod me ltar 'bur lus la ba da chagasand med lang tsho dar khams la bcud chags sha rgyas gnyer ma bral tshe la bcud chags nyi blo ltar du gsal srog la bcud chags rdo rje ltar du brtan dpal la ba da chags gang bsam thog med 'grub las la bcud chags gang byed chos su 'gro 'byor ba bcud chags bsod nams longs spyod 'phel kha rje bcud chags ya rab lan mo shom dbang thang bcud chags kun gyis 'dud cing brtse rlung rta bcud chags snyan

grags pha mthar brdal gnas la bcud chagasamo rgyan he ru'i zhing mi la bcud chags dpa' bo mkha' 'gror sad rdzas la bcud chags myong grol bdud rtsir grags rig 'dzin dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i bu bzhin skyongs ma sring dam can rgya mtsho'i snying ltar brtse yo rgyan nga yisabyin gyis brlabs par 'gyur 'phags mchog thugs rje'i gdung zin 'gro don 'byung mthong thosadran reg rnams 'dren sal 'god nyams dang rtog pa'i yon tan nyi ma shar phyi nang bar chad bdud kyi gegs lasagrol che sgrub mthar phyin dag pa'i zhing la 'gro zad med bdud rtsi sgrub pa'i yon tan no skal ldan rnams kyis srog gi gta' ru zungs g.yel ba thang ltod bral bar brtson pa sgrubs mi basmu ngesapa pad 'byung tha tshig go sa ma shā rjesakyi rim pa dang phan bon bstan pa ste las rim nyer lnga pa'o rgya rgya rgya ye ma rgyal ba'i dbang po padma saṃ bha mas ma 'ongs 'gro la brtse ba chen po yis snying dang 'dra ba'i yang zab rmad byung ba grub pa'i dbang phyug 'brog ban khyod la gtad da dung spel ba'i dusal ma bab pas rin chen brda la thob cig sa ra bye mdo khamasardo rje'i rdzong du dgongs pra sdom gter bdag bzang phyir klu bdud btsan la gnyer ma 'ongs snyigs ma sum cu kha ral dus nad mug mtshon che'i gzeng pa lang pa'i tshe nga sprul nga dang mi gzhan dpa' bo ni o rgyan rig 'dzinanu ldan 'dusapa rtsal gang gis bgo skal dam pa 'di rnyed nas las can skal bzang

gnye〈 chosabadag nyer lngar 'doms khyad par 'phags pa'i las can bu dgu yis bstan pa rin chen 'dzin skyong spel bar byed rma thog sgrul pa'i sgrub rgyud bstan pa 'dzin rtseming sprul pasabartul zhugasabya btang bsgrub gdub ban sprul pas kun la ba dan bsgrengs rolasprul pa mi nub bstan pa 'dzin galu sgramisprul pa brtul zhugaga'agro don mdzad dran nam sprul pas rang smin gzhan phan sgrub rgyal ba byang chub sprul pasadon gnyis 'byung gnyag ban tswa na'i sprul bas khams brgyad smin 'o bran sprul pa rtog pa mngon du gyur 'od 'chang sprul pasarang rig tshad la pheb basmu ba bral lo rdo rje padma'i bka' yid gnyis mi dgosalag tu longs dang gsal bka' 'di thub par srung shigaspu grigasum skal med lag tu ma shor lha bu mched dam ldan thugs kyi srasadang 'phrad par shog sam mā rgya rgya rgya lag len kha bskang las rim nyer lnga pa dngos grub nga gnas ོgas so gter rgya gto rgya sbas rgya zab rgya gsang rgya gu gye o rgyan gyi slob dponapadma bha wa'i bka' bdag 'dra mkhar chen gzas bkod pa'o brda zim lha klong yangs rnal 'byoradharmā ku mud kyas klong mdzod 'dzin skyong spel ba'i dam bca' bcas klong gsal skal ldan ramad rgya mcho bras klong chen dgong pa skyong ba'i dam bca' bcas klong rdol la dad sbyin bdagasgron skyabs kyis klong yang bka' rten bzhengs pa'i dam bca' bcas/klong

la mnyam bzhag sku skyesapadma yis/klong 'di'i sgrub rgyud 'dzug pa'i dam bca' bcas klong sgo phyogs mthong chosanyed rang gsalagyis/klong gnas phyag mchod rgyun mi bcad dam bcas/klong kyi lde migaratna sar yis/klong gter yi ge phab pa nan bskul ngor 1nga las ma g.yos nu ldan rdo rje yis/klong gsum gnyug ma'i gshis sad brda ris phab/klong rtsalaspron semasazhes bya yi ger bris/klong ma rtogs pa'i 'gro khams dong sprug shogasarba ma lam/
badzra zab gsang rdo rje snying po las: thugs rje chen po dri med padma dkar po'i: bdud rtsi sman gyi sgrub pa byin rlabs dngos grub kyi bang mdzod zhes bya ba bzhugs so:

ba:tshu na mo gu ru padhā ka ra ye:tshosnari ste 141 bzod na rnam par dag mod kya thugs rje brtse bas 'gro ba skyongs dri med padma dkar ོ pha gusapas gas do snying nas 2da bdag 'dra padma 'byung gnasakyis phyi rabs las ldan don phyir du phyong grol bdud rtsi sgrub pa'i thabs byin rlabs dngos grub bang mdzod bstan sa ma shā spyor ba dngos gni rjes kyi rim pa gsum dang po la yang rnams pa gnyis su bshad a par sgyur gsum tsan tan dkar dmar dang dza sug ka ko la dang cu gang dang gur gum li shi gtso bo gcig dang ni rin chen srang la bkyag ste srang bcu'o drod bsil snyomasapa'i ro nus ldan pa yis blon la rin chen srang du bkyag pa srang bdun no kha tog dri ro nusapa'i spyang gu rnams ma 'drisapa yi sman sna lnga bcu pa srang la sbyar lte thamasacad gcig tu bsdu ya mtshan nusapa ldan pa'i sbyar ba'o 'brasabu gsum gyi 'tshab ra me tog dang bzang po drug 'dzin ku mud gtso bo'o tsha mkhris rlung gsum gso byed rtsi yi bcud nyi shu rtsa lnga blon gyi rang bzhin te bka' dang mthun par brtsam nas tshang bar bsags spyang ku bzhi bsal sman kyi rang bzhin can lnga bcu rtsa brgyad 'bangs kyi rnams pa'o gcig tu bsdus nasarin chen sgod du gzhug da la'i ldeng khri'i khar bkod gzungs ga brten yar sna lha chen tshangs pa'i phyag tu 'god phyi nang gsang mchod rgya cher dag gis bskor sman gtor

—4rdo rakta brten sgrub mchod gtor dang ga ṇa tsakra rgya chen ji ltar bkrams snang gsal 'od ldan rab sbar spos dud spro gyirgya bsdams pa rgyal chen tho mtshams bcad nang rgya bsdams pa sgo srung rnamasaganyisabarten gsang rgya bsdams pa dkyil 'khor rgyan bkod bya gyimatshamasabacad pa dam sri mnan pa dang nang mtshams bcad pa phyi nang rgyu 'grul bsdams gsang mtshams bcad pa blo semasabag phab gnas phyi ru brngan pa bgegasatshogs 'byung po bsgrad nang du brngan pa gtor ma cha gsum gtong gsang bar brngan pa dbang phyug ma sring mchod gyiyigazer la mchod sa yo byad bkrams nang gi gzer du dam gtsang thugs mthun gal gsang ba' gzer du lha sngags ting 'dzin gtad gyiyimagrod du tshangasachen mched gnyis dbabs nang gi mgron du rig 'dzin byin chen dbabs gsang ba'i mgron du dri bral thugasarjes brlabs spyoyiganyer spyang spu gri gsum la bcol nang gi gnyer byang lha bu zung la bgo gsang ba'i gnyer byang sman srung mched lngar gnyer gyiyisgrob sbyang rdor sems sgom bslosabartson nang gi sgrib sbyangs phyag dang mchod pas gso gsang ba'i sgrib sbyang ga ṇa tsakra phul phyeltar bstan pa lus ni g.yo med bsrings nang ltar brtan pa tha mal 'chor tshig bral gsang ltar bstan pa sems rtog 'dzin rgya grol gyiltar phun tshog lnga ldan gzhi bzung zhing nang ltar phun tshogs dgongasapa mi 'gyur gzer gnad bcu gzer lnga

phun tshogasarnams gsum gyis tshom bu tshogs sgrub bdud rtsi sman la 'jug gnasaskabs tshe ring dpal 'byor nyams rtog 'phel mthar thugs rdo rje 'chang dbang sa la sbyor 'di 'dre'i man ngag 'jig rten gsum na dkon rin chen sgog dang bsdos nas nyams su longs sbyor ba sngon du 'gro ba'i rim pa'o sa ma yu rgya rgya rgya gnyisapa dngos gni'i las la 'jug pa ni rnam grangs bco lnga dag gis bstan par bya dang po bdag bskyed bzlas dmigs mchod bstod rjes mdun bskyed dam dzos lha ru gsal ba ni 61 ka dum na ya hūṃ phaṭa: mi dmigs ngang nas rang byung gzhal med khang gru bzhi sgo khyud rta bab bang rim rdzogs: 'dod snam mchod pa'i lha mo'i spro bsdu 'khrigs: phyi nang gsang gsum zhing bkod phun sum tshogs de dbus chags med ku mud 'dab rgyas khar: skyon bral ri bong 'dzin pa nya gang ba'i gdan steng hrīḥyig dkar po'i 'phro 'du las: yongs gyur bdag snang bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin lha 'phags mchog dri med padma dkar po ni: zhal gcig phyag bzhi zhabs gnyis 'ja' sham can: dar dang rus pa'i rgyan rdzogs pad phreng spras: dbu sgra thor cog ratna'i rtse phran mdzes gser g.yu'i snyan cha ratna'i thod gdengs spud dang po gnyis kyi thal

ba tshu sbyar nor bu 'dzin:de 'og phyag gnyis padma bgrangs phreng brten:'ja' 'od rang bzhin snang stong 'dzin med sgom:'od lnga'i 1nga bzhugs rigs bdag snang mtha' yas dmar gsal mnyam bzhag tshe yi bum pa 'dzin:grangs spro ba la rang 'dra 'bum 'bum 'gyed g.yas g.yon nor 'dzin gsang 'dzin dkar sngo mdzes:phyi rim byang chub sems dpa' mched brgyad dang dgyes bskyed sgegs mo phreng ba glu gar ma:las mjad sgo skyong hya snyi wa ste:zhal phyag rgyan dang cha lugs yongs su rdzogs:tshom bu spro ba nyi khri stong stong 'byed:bar mtshams bskal bzang sangs rgyas stong rtsa dang:byang chub sems dpa' sems ma nyan rang sde:pad 'byung bye ba phrag brgya mtshan mchog brgyad:rig 'dzin paṇa grub rje 'bangs lo paṇa dang:rgyud sde bzhi drug yi dam dkyil 'khor lha:gnas gsum ma rgyud dpa' bo mkha' 'gro dang:las mdzad bka' yi srung ma mthu ldan rigs rnam sras nor bdag 'dzam lha'i tshogs rnams kun:ma 'dres yongs rdzogs 'ub chub chen por bskyed dkyil 'khor spro ba bsam mi khyab pa'i dal:thams cad

ro mnyams bde ba chen po'i gshis: sku gsum mdzad pa rmad byung rol par bskyed: rang sgog 'od kyis rgyal kun spyan drangs bstim: skyid ārya ma ki shwa ra sa ma dza dza pho pho :gzhud bzhan spyan 'dren bzhugs gsol phyag kyang 'tshal:phyi nang gsang ba' mchod pa rgya chen phul bstod pa glu yi dbya sa bcas dgyes pa bskangs bzlasapa 'dzab kyi 'khrul 'khor bya ba ni bdag gi sdo ga'/ka nas ce(da zer sna lnga mchod pa'i tshul du 'phros mdun bskyed 'phag mchog thugs rje chen po rtsa ba'i lha tshogs rnams kyi thugs rgyud bskul: thugs rje byin rlabs dbang dang dngos grub thams cad 'od dang 'od zer gyi rnam par sku'i ba spu'i bu ga thams cad nas bab zag med ye shes kyi bdud rtsi dang ro gcig tu 'dres nas rgyal kun thugs rje'i gsang ba rje gas par bsam: sa ā lha trī tshe ma ṇi padme hūṃ hrī: sarba pañtsa ra sa na a mṛ ta hūṃ trīXtha zhag bdun bar du sgrub par bya'o snga gro'i dus su sman srung byin 'bebs dang nyin gung dus su dur khrod brgyad kyi byin 'bebs rakta dbab cing bdud rtsi che ba brjod dgong mo nya le bsgrad ci rig 'dzin gyis byan 'beb rdo rje'i bstod ri tshogs bskang phul srod dus srung ma gsol mchod gzhung byin 'bebs gtor ma gtong zhing 'gab

—4rdo 'dre mnan bsgrad bskyar des ni phrin las gegs med yad bzhin 'grub sa ma yu las rim dang po'o rgya rgya rgya gnyis pa bskyed dmigs bstod pa gong ltar la bzlas pa sngags kyi lde kha bsgyur ba ni bdag nyid thugs rje chen po'i thugs ka ba spu'i bu ga thams cad nas 'od zer sna lnga kun bzang mchod pa'i sprin gyi rang bzhin du spros te 'phags mchog thugs rje chen po dang tshom bu'i dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams kyi thugs rgyud bskul: kun gyi dbang dang byin rlabs dngos grub thams cad phyag rgya yig 'bru phyag mtshan byi rnam par bun ling ling ba spu'i bu ga thams cad nas byung ste zag med ye shes kyi bdud rtsi la thim pas: myong grol rmad du byung ba'i dam rdzas chen po yi dam lha yi dkyil 'khor gyi rol par dag smin rdzogs par dmigs la: o āḥ/ trī: slo ma ṇi padme hūṃ hrī: arya lo ki shwa ri sa pā ri wā ra pañtsa a dṛ ta tshoḥhūṃḥ(ཿhrīḥ.āX ra sa ya na sta na dza ye hūṃ leḥme bye gyisarba sirnyi tt+waṃ hūṃ: lha sngags phyag rgya ting 'dzin gsal ba yis zhag bdun bar du sgrub par bya ba'o 'od 'khrugs 'ad 'a 'jigs dri bzang ngad pa g.yo sbyar ba'i las kyi rim pa gong ltar ro byin rlabs dngos grub 'byung bar gdon mi za sa ma yu

lasarim gnyis pa'o rgya rgya rgya gsum pa sgom dmigs rim pa gong ltar la sngags kyi sde kha bsgyur ba'i rim pa ni bdag nyid thugs rje chen po'i thugs ka nas 'od zer mchod pa'i tshul can dpag tu med pa 'phros mdun bskyed thugs rje chen po'i lha tshogs rnams dang grangs su spros pa'i da la rnams kyi thugs rgyud bskul 'khor 'das gnyis kyi dpal yon dngas bcud thams cad bsdus te: dam rdzas la thim pas phyong grol ye shes kyi rol pa chen por dmigs la ma ā hūṃ hrī: o ma ṇi padme hūṃ hrī: o u: sarba pañtsa ra sa ya na a ra pa tsa mi ta trī dwa ye a ralce ya ralce badzra puspyo sirnyi hūṃ: zhag bdun bar du smra bcad bzlas pa bya grub pa'i rtag mtshan phya nang gsang gsum 'byung bar chad gegasazhi nyam rtog yon tan 'phel don gnyisalhun grub mdzad pa mthar phyin 'gyur sam yu las ram gsum pa'o rgya rgya rgya nyer mkho'i sman srung byin 'bebs bya ba la spo dkar tsandan dkar po ka ko la'i dud pa spro zhing rol mo sna tshogs sder snyan pa'i dbyangasadang bcas te 'di skad do hūṃ hūṃ rnyi yo rgyan padma 'byung gnas dang: grub pa'i rig 'dzin chen po yis: bka' dang dam tshig bgo ba bzhin sman srung rdo rje pho nya rnams gnas 'dir spran 'dren byin phob

ba tshu cig:sum cu rtsa gsum lha yul nas:lha chen tshangs pa gdong bzhi dang: rang rang g.yog 'khor dpung tshogs bcas: gnas 'dir spyan 'dren byin phob cig:rnam 'phrul ma nges cha lugs 'dzin dbang po mig stong ldan pa yang: sngon gyi tha tshig ji bzhin du: gnas 'dir spyan 'dren byin phob cig khams gsum mnga' dbang mdzad pa yis: dbang phyug ma hā dī wa yang: sngon gyi tha tshig ji bzhin du: gnas 'dir spyan 'dren byin phob cig:masang gsal nā nga yangs rol pa nas: sangs rgyas rigs kyi mkha' 'gro ma:sman 'dzin lha mo tsan tri ga:sngon kyi tha tshig ji bzhin du: gnas 'dir spyan 'dren byin phob cig:bdud rtse dud pa'i ngang la byon:rol mo gdung ba'i dbyangs la gson: bdud rtsi sman phud yar bzhes la:grub pa'i rtag mtshan bstan du gsol dkar gsal dre ma med pa nas:rdo rje rigs kyi mkha' 'gro ma sman 'dzin lha mo nipha num ma:sngon gyi tha tshig ji bzhin du:gnas 'dir spran 'dren byin phob cig:dar tshon g.yab mo'i sna la byon:yi dbyangs snyan pa'i tshig la gson:gtsang phud sman gyi mchod

pa bzhes grub rtags mtshan ma bzang po ston: ser gsal brjed ldan bde klong nas: rin chen rigs kyi mkha' 'gro ma sman 'dzin lha mo gar tri bam: sngon kyi tha tshig ji bzhin du: gnas 'dir spyan 'dren byin phob cig: lhab lhub dar gdugs 'phan la byon: tha tshig gnyan po bsgrags la gson: dza gad stong sbyar skyems bzhes la: rtags mtshan dngos grub bzang po ston: dmar gsal chagasabral rol pa nas: padma rigs kyi mkha' 'gro ma:sman 'dzin lha mo gu hya kṣe: sngon gyi tha tshig ji bzhin du:gnas 'dir spyan 'dren byin phob cig: lha rdzas mchod sprin gtibs la byon: sngags rgya ting nge 'dzan la dgongs: pañtsa sirnyi'i mchod pa bzhes:grub rtags dad ldan bu la stsol ljang gsal las rab grub pa nas: karma rags kyi mkha' 'gro ma: sman 'dzin wa mo tri ga bam: sngon gyi tha tshig ji bzhin du: gnas 'dir spyan 'dren byin phob cig a dṛr stong sbrar dpung la byon dam dgongs gnad nas bskul la gson: bdud rtsi skyems phud 'di bzhes la rtags mtshan bzang po bstan du gsol:tha tshig gsang ba'i pho brang nas:

badzra dpa' bo dpa' mo king liṅga:rig 'dzin paṇa grub rgya mtsho'i tshogs:gnas 'dir spyan 'dren byin phob cig:ma g.yel ma 'khyangs dam ldan tshogs:sngon tshe dpal chen he ru gas:ma tram̐ rū tra bsgral nas su:gsang sngags sgrub chen myong grol brtsams:de tshe khas blangs dam can rnams:sgrub pa'i gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs:rtag mtshan bzang por bstan du gsol bar du hūṃ chen ka ra yis:mchod rten pad spung brtsegs pa dza phyong grol ye shes bdud rtsi bsgrubs de tshe khas blangs dam bcas pa'i:dpa' bo dpa' mo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs:gnas 'dir spyan 'dren byin phob cig:tha ma sa rgyan chen po yis:yar lung shel gyi brag phug tu:bdud rtsi sman gyi sgrub pa mdzad de tshe khas blangs dam bcas pa'i:sman srung lha mo mched lnga po:gnas 'dir spyan 'dren byin phob cag:sgong grol yeshes bdud rtsi dra dam rdzas byin gyis brlabs du gsol:rig 'dzin dpa' bo mkha' 'gro masgrab mchog byin gyis brwabs du gsol:bkod pa lngan 'grab dkyil 'khor du:da la byin gyis brwabs du gsol:o gron

he ru'i dur khrod du gnas 'dir byin gyis brlabs du gsol: byin chen rnams kyi byin phob cig: dbang chen rnams kyis dbang bskur cig: rtag dang mtshan ma bstan pa dang:55 dṛ ta yi da1rngos dza/ba cesal: sarba sa ma ya hrīng hrīng tho phe 55 we ro/ ya tsasdo āḥ ces brjod rtags mtshan khyad 'phags 'byung ngar 'dogs phyir du skabs skabasagal skal pa can gyisadapal du shog sa ma mā la rim bzhi pa'o rgya rgya rgya de nas dur khrod brgyad rdzogasakyi byin chen dbab pa'i rim pa la rol po sna tshogs sgra bcas shang sbos dud spro zhing snang gsal sbar sna tshogasadar gyi 'phan yab bcas snyan pa'i dbyangasakyi 'di skad do hū hūṃ yul gyi ming ni sku la rdzogs: mchod rten rang byung shel gyis rdzogs: ma mo chen mo ko'u ri ma: mkhas shing grub pa'i rig 'dzin mang hūṃ chen ka ra'i byin phob cig byin chen ngo mtshar khyad 'phags gnas: lho phyogs dur khrod bsil ba'i tshal rang byung gser gyi mchod sdong mdzes: ma mo chen mo tso'u ri ma: 'byor ba longs spyod bsam mi khyab 'jam dpal bshes gnyen byin phob cig: byin chen ngo mtshar khyad 'phags gnas: nub phyogs dur khrod padma brtsegs: rang byung mchod rten kha shor grags

ba tshu ma mo chen mo pra mo ha sbyor sgrol mdzad pa bsam mi khyab: klu grub snying po'i byin phob cig: byin chen ngo mtshar khyad 'phags gnas: byang phyogs dur khrod bde chen rol rang byung mchod rten he ru'i rdzogs: ma mo chen mo be ta li: snying stobs ldan pa bsam mi khyab: pra bha hasti'i byin phob cig byin chen ngo mtshar khyad 'phags gnas:shar lho dur khrod gsang chen rol: rang byung mchod rten ka ni ga: ma mo chen mo puska si: brtul zhugs mthu stobs bsam mi khyab: dha na saṃ kri'i byin phob cig: byen chen ngo mtshar khyad 'phags gnas: lho nub dur khrod bde byed 'bar: mchod rten chen po rdan rdo la: ma mo chen mo gasma ri: gsang chen spyod pa bsam mi khyab: bī ma mi tra'i byin phob cig byin chen ngo mtshar khyad 'phags gnas: nub byang dur khrod 'jigs byed tshal: mchod rten rgyas byed dpe yi rdzogs: ma mo chen mo tsanta li rang grol rtogs pa bsam mi khyab rom bu gu byu'i byin phob cig: byin chen ngo mtshar khyad 'phags gnas: byang shar dur khrod pad sprang brtsegs mchod rten bde chen ratā'i rdzong: ma mo chen mo sme sha ni

nus mthu ldan pa bsam mi khyab shirnyi gharbha'i byin phob cig:byin chen ngo mtshar khyad 'phags gnas o rgyan yul gyi dur khrod du khams gsum dbang sdud dngos grub brnyes ma mo su kha sirnyi brten padma rgyal po'i byin phob cig: byin chen ngo mtshar khyad 'phags gnas za hor yul gyi dur khrod du: gson bsregs me khams chu ru bsgyur: rdzu 'phrul rmad byung dngos grub brnyes lha lcam chen mo'i dgyes pa bskang padma saṃ bha'i byin phob cig byin chen ngo mtshar khyad 'phags gnas mdangs ldan ko sha'i mtsho gling du: ya mtshan mchog gi dngos grub brnyes dpa' bo mkha' 'gro sprin ltar 'khrigs mtsho skyes rdo rje'i byin phob cig byin chen ngo mtshar khyad 'phags gnas: kha che'i yul gyi dur khrod du: bdud rtsi bam ro'i dngos grub brnyes sbyor sgrol brtul zhugs mdzad pa skyong nyi ma 'od zer byin phob cig byin chen ngo mtshar khyad 'phags gnas: ma gha dha yi dur khrod du thams cad kun mkhyen dngos grub brnyes 'dul 'dzin sangs rgyas gnyis par grags: shākya seng ge'i byin phob cig:byen chen ngo mtshar khyad 'phags gnas: a

ba tshu shā ga'i yul dur khrod du gsang sngags bstan pa'i bka' bab brnyes: kun dga' mo yi rjes bzung smin: blo ldan mchog sred byin phob cig byin chen ngo mtshar khyad 'phags gnas: bde byed brtsegs pa'i da la ru bdud 'dul chen po'i dngosagrub brnyes lta log mu stegs drung nas 'byin seng ge sgra sgrogs byin phob cig byin chen ngo mtshar khyad 'phags gnas: stag tshangs bsam 'grub ke'u tshang du: dregs pa dgra bgegs tshar gcod cing zab gsang gter gyi dngos grub brnyes rdo rje gro lod byin phob cig: byin chen ngo mtshar khyad 'phags gnas: dpal gyi bsam yas pho brang du: bod khams mun sel 'gro ba 'dul 'gro don phrin las bsam mi khyab o rgyan chen po'i byin phob cig: byin chen ngo mtshar khyad 'phags gnas: raku srin yul dur khrod dbus rang byung thod pa'i sku mkhar nas gdug pa tshar gcod dngos grub brnyes raku thod phreng byin phob cig byin chen ngo mtshar khyad 'phags gnas zangs mdog dpal gyi ri bo ru 'phags bod lo paṇa smin grol mdzad snyigs ma'i 'gro khams thugs

rjes 'dzin: phyag rgya zil gnon byin phob cig: byin rlabs sprin dpung thibs se thib: dngos grub sbrang char nyi li li: 'chi med na bun thu lu lu nyams rtogs sbrang char nyi li li gnas 'dir byin phob bdag dbang bskur mchog dang thun mongs dngos grub stsol gu ru dhe wa ḍākki ni sarba sa ma ya dza dza po phe a we sha ya a u bdug glu rkang gling rol ma'i sgra bcas rte byin chen dbab pas rtag dang mtshan ma 'byung yid gnyisami dgos rdo rje'i bka' yis gnang sa ma mā lasarim lnga pa'o rgya rgya rgya de nas rakta gnad dbab bya ba ni rkang gling ha bskrug dung chen ngang skad sgrir rnga chen cha ling rol mo mtshams rngamasabacas srin po'i rngams 'gros dbyangs kyis 'di skad do hū hū: gu gul byin bskyed gdug pa 'dul ba'i rdzas rakta khrag gi rba klong 'khor ba'i rgyu: rten 'brel rtsa ba khams gsum mnyam sbyor rdzas rdo rje khro mo'i mkha' ru byin gyis brlabs ma mo chen mo brgyad kyi rakta'i rgyun: lha tshogs dgyes bskang 'khor ba dbyings sgrol byed:dpal chen ki la ya yis rtags su bsgrengs ma badzra ko'u ri ha ha he rakta phaṭa: zlo badzra rtso'u ri ha ha he rakta phaṭa: ma badzra pra mo ha ha he rakta phaṭa: rme badzra be ta li ha ha he rakta

bsgotshu phaṭa: sa badzra puska su ha ha he rakta phaṭa: skyid badzra gasma ri ha ha he rakta phaṭa: 3 badzra tsasto li ha ha he rakta phaṭa: skye badzra spe sha ni ha ha he rakta phaṭa: sngags tshar re bzhin slob dpon dar nag g.yab slobs bu'i gar gyis rakta bsgrengs bar bya ging ga ra yis gu gul phyogs kun spro rgyal theb kyis ni phur 'chams rakta dbab gnad des 'khor ba dbyangs rol rten 'brel dang rakta'i dpal bskyed thabs mchog dgyes bska ngo sa ma yu las rim drug pa'o rgya rgya rgya de nas bdud rtsi che ba brjod pa ni king ga ra yis dar dkar sbos ri spro las kyi rdo rjes bdud rtsa bsgrengs byas te yin āX3: mtshan ldan bhasto yangs pa'i snod nang du: bdud rtsi a dṛ ta ru bskyil ba ni: dri chen rnam par snang mdzad rang bzhin la ga pur shel byi spos phor rdo rje che: padma me tog chags bral snang mtha' yas sha chen mchod pa rin po che yi rdzas: rdo rje'i chu ni las rnams grub pa'i dbyings sha lnga yab la bdud rtsi lnga klong yum: ngo bo byang chub sems kyi rang bzhin can rnams pa rgyud lnga'i sems can kun sgrol byed: brtul zhugs nyon mongs ye shes lnga klong spyor: rang bzhin myong grol ye shes bdud rtsir grags: byed las gnyis snang dbyings

su gtor bar byed: nus mthu skye 'chi med pa tshe yi rdzas ro gcig bla ma yab yum sbyor bas rgyun: mu tig dkar po dri ma med pa'i bcud: tsan dan spug po rma med padmar bsre:gnyis med bde chen bde ba'i mchog las byung: bcu drug lha mo'i gar bsgyur dang bcas nas: grangs dang tshom bu dkyil 'khor spro bsdu la: bdud rtsi a dṛ ta yi zag ma'i bskangs: rmad byung rtag mtshan 'byung ba'i dus la bab: rdo rje gsang ba'i dngos grub stsal du gsol: ra sa ya na a mṛ ta dṛ ha hi /: ces brjod bdud rtsi'i zegs ma da lar reg gnad des mchog thun dngos grub thob par 'gyur sa ma pā las rim bdun pa'o rgya rgya rgya de nas rdo rje'i bstod ring bya ba la slob dpon 'khor bcas lug gu rgyud gral sprel phyag rgya lnga ldan ngang nas da la bskor snyan pa'i dbyangs dang 4sa te 'di skad do hū hrī: rdo rje thugs mchog chos dbyings spros mtha' bral: rdo rje nam mkha' byang chub sems kyi dbyings: rdo rje'i sku 'grub skye 'chi mi mnga' ba'i rdo rje chags pa bral la phyag 'tshal bstod: rdo rje las kyi ye shes gsang ba 'dzin: rdo rje snying rje'i dbang phyug don yod zhags rdo rje'i shugs can 'gro ba yongs kyi mgon rdo rje dri

bsgos ma med la phyag 'tshal bstod:rdo rje'i gdung 'jin dpal ldan padma skyes:rdo rje'i las mdzad brtul zhugs grub pa'i dbang:rdo rje gar gyi dbang phyug sku gsum 'dzin:rdo rje thod phreng rtsal la phyag 'tshal bstod:rdo rje dbyangs las rnam par snang byed cing:rdo rje'i stabs kyi thabs chen gdul bya'i mgon:rdo rje nor bu'i phyag rgya gdengs thabs 'dzin:rdo rje ratna 'dzin la phyag 'tshal bstod:rdo rje sang yangs dri ma med pa' gar:rdo rje sngags kyi gar 'dzin bstan pa'i gzhi:rdo rje'i pho nya rnams la bde stong 'gyed:rdo rje gsang sngags 'dzin la phyag 'chal bstod:rdo rje las bsgyur gar gyi rnam rol can:rdo rje gsang ba'i las mdzad 'gro drug 'dren:rdo rje'i glu de btang snyoms nye ring bral:rdo rje'i pho nya brgyad la phyag 'tshal bstod:rdo rje ye shes skye 'gags dmigs su med:rdo rje klong la sna tshogs thabs mang bsgyur rdo rje'i rigs kyi thabs mang dgyes pa bskang:rdo rje'i ḍakki bzhi la phyag 'tshal bstod:rdo rje sgeg bshad ha la ha la sgrogs:rdo rje'i gad rgyang hi hi 'jags rngams can:rdo rje'i las mdzad bdud 'dul
